meta.name: West Saxon Gospels (Wessex Gospels, c. 990)
meta.source: Wikisource: Matthew (ed. J. W. Bright, 1910), Mark (Bright, 1905), Luke, and John (Bright and Harris, 1904) in West Saxon
meta.license: Text public domain; Wikisource transcription CC BY-SA 4.0

1.1: Æfter Matheus gerecednysse, hēr is on cnēorisse bōc Hǣlendes Crīstes, Dauides suna, Abrahames suna.
1.2: Sōðlīce Abraham gestrȳnde Isaac; Isaac gestrȳnde Iacob; Iacob gestrȳnde Iudam and his gebrōðra;
1.3: Iudas gestrȳnde Phares and Zaram of þām wīfe þe wæs genemned Thamar; Phares gestrȳnde Esrom; Esrom gestrȳnde Aram;
1.4: Aram gestrȳnde Aminadab; Aminadab gestrȳnde Naason; Naason gestrȳnde Salmon;
1.5: Salmon gestrȳnde Booz of þām wīfe Raab; Booz gestrȳnde Obeth of þām wīfe Ruth; Obeth gestrȳnde Iesse; ​
1.6: Iesse gestrȳnde þone cyning Dauid; Dauid cyning gestrȳnde Salomon of þām wīfe þe wæs Urias wīf.
1.7: Salomon gestrȳnde Roboam; Roboas gestrȳnde Abiam; Abia gestrȳnde Asa;
1.8: Asa gestrȳnde Iosaphath; Iosaphath gestrȳnde Ioram; Ioras gestrȳnde Oziam;
1.9: Ozias gestrȳnde Ioatham; Ioatham gestrȳnde Achaz; Achaz gestrȳnde Ezechiam;
1.10: Ezechias gestrȳnde Mannasen; Mannases gestrȳnde Amon; Amon gestrȳnde Iosiam;
1.11: Iosias gestrȳnde Iechoniam and his gebrõþru, on Babilonis gelēorednysse.
1.12: And æfter Babilonys gelēorednysse, Iechonias gestrȳnde Salathiel; Salathiel gestrȳnde Zorobabel;
1.13: Zorobabel gestrȳnde Abiud; Abiud gestrȳnde Eliachim ; Eliachim gestrȳnde Azor;
1.14: Azor gestrȳnde Sadoc; Sadoc gestrȳnde Achim; Achim gestrȳnde Eliud;
1.15: Eliud gestrȳnde Eleazar; Eleazar gestrȳnde Mathan; Mathan gestrȳnde Iacob; ​
1.16: Iacob gestrȳnde Ioseph Marian wer, of þǣre wæs ācenned'sē Hǣlend þe is genemned Crīst.
1.17: Eornostlīce ealle cnēoressa fram Abrahame oð Dauid synd fēowertȳne cnēoressa; and fram Dauide oð Babilonis gelēorednysse fēowertȳne cnēoressa; and fram Babilonis gelēorednesse oð Crīst fēowertȳne cnēoressa. Đys godspel gebyrað on mydewyntres mæsseǣfen.
1.18: Sōðlīce þus wæs Crīstes cnēores: Đā þæs Hǣlendes mōdor Maria wæs Iosepe beweddod, ǣr hī tōsomne becōmun, hēo wæs gemēt on innoðe hæbbende of þām Hālegan Gāste.
1.19: Sōðlīce Iosep hyre wer, ðā hē wæs rihtwīs and nolde hī gewīdmǣrsian, hē wolde hī dīhlīce forlǣtan.
1.20: Him þā sōðlīce ðās þing ðencendum Drihtnes engel on swefnum ætȳwde, and him tō cwæð, Iosep, Dauides sunu, nelle þū ondrǣdan Marian þīne gemæccean tō onfōnne; þæt on hire ācenned ys, hyt ys of þām Hālgan Gāste. ​
1.21: Witodlīce hēo cenð sunu, and þū nemst hys naman Hǣlend; hē sōðlīce hys folc hāl gedēð fram hyra synnum.
1.22: Sōþlīce eal þys wæs geworden þæt gefylled wǣre þæt fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh þone wītegan,
1.23: Sōðlīce sēo fǣmne hæfð on innoðe, and hēo cenð sunu, and hī nemnað his naman Emanuhel, þæt ys gereht on ūre geþēode, God mid ūs.
1.24: Đā ārās Iosep of swefene, and dyde swā Drihtnes engel him bebēad, and hē onfēng his gemæccean;
1.25: and hē ne grētte hī. Hēo cende hyre frumcennedan sunu, and nemde hys naman Hǣlend.

2.1: Eornustlīce þā sē Hǣlend ācenned wæs on Iudeiscre Bethleem, on þæs cyninges dagum Herodes, þā cōmon þā tungolwītegan fram ēastdǣle tō Hierusalem,
2.2: and cwǣdon, Hwǣr ys sē Iudea Cyning þe ācenned ys? Sōðlīce wē gesāwon hys steorran ​ on ēastdǣle, and wē cōmon ūs him tō geēadmēdenne.
2.3: Ðā Herodes þæt gehȳrde, ðā wearð hē gedrēfed and eal Hierosolimwaru mid him.
2.4: And þā gegaderode Herodes ealle ealdras þǣra sācerda and folces wrīteras, and āxode hwǣr Crīst ācenned wǣre.
2.5: Đā sǣdon hī him. On Iudeiscere Bethlem; witodlīce þus ys āwriten þurh þone wītegan,
2.6: And þū Bethleem, Iudea land, witodlīce ne eart þū lǣst on Iuda ealdrum; of ðē forð gǣð sē heretoga sē þe recð mīn folc Israhel.
2.7: Herodes þā clypode on sundersprǣce ðā tungelwītegan, and befrān hī georne hwænne sē steorra him ætēowde.
2.8: And hē āsende hī tō Bethlem, and ðus cwæð, Farað and āxiað geornlīce be þām cilde; and þonne gē hyt gemētað, cȳþað eft mē, þæt ic cume and mē tō him gebidde.
2.9: Đā hī þæt gebod gehȳrdon, þā fērdon hī; and sōþlīce sē steorra þe hī on ēastdǣle gesāwon him beforan fērde, oð hē stōd ofer þǣr þæt cild wæs. ​
2.10: Sōþlīce þā ðā tungelwītegan þone steorran gesāwon, fægenodon swȳðe myclum gefēan.
2.11: And gangende intō þām hūse hī gemētton þæt cild mid Marian hys mēder; and hī āðenedon hī, and hī tō him gebǣdon; and hī untȳndon hyra goldhordas, and him lāc brōhton, þæt wæs gold and rēcels and myrre.
2.12: And hī āfēngon andsware on swefnum þæt hī eft tō Herode ne hwyrfdon; ac hī on ōðerne weg on hyra rīce fērdon. Đys godspel sceal on cylda mæssedæg.
2.13: Þā hī þā fērdon, þā ætȳwde Drihtnes engel Iosepe on swefnum, and þus cwæð, Ārīs and nim þæt cild and his mōdor, and flēoh on Egypta land, and bēo þǣr oð þæt ic ðē secge; tōweard ys þæt Herodes sēcð þæt cild tō forspillenne.
2.14: Hē ārās þā and nam þæt cild and his mōdor on niht, and fērde on Egyptum;
2.15: and wæs þǣr oð Herodes forðsīð: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe fram Drihtne gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, Of Egyptum ic mīnne sunu geclypode. ​
2.16: Đā wæs Herodes swȳde gebolgen, for þām þe he beþǣht wæs fram þām tungelwītegum, and hē āsende þā and ofslōh ealle þā cild þe on Bethleem wǣron, and on eallum hire gemǣrum, fram twȳwintrum cilde and binnan þām, æfter þǣre tīde þe hē geāxode fram ðām tungelwītegum.
2.17: Đā wæs gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh Hieremiam þone wītegan,
2.18: Stefn wæs on hēhnysse gehȳred, wōp and mycel þotorung; Rachel wēop hyre bearn, and hēo nolde bēon gefrēfred, for þām þe hī nǣron. Đys [godspel] sceal on twelftanǣfen.
2.19: Sōðlīce þā Herodes wæs forð faren, witodlīce on swefne Drihtnes engel ætȳwde Iosepe on Egyptum,
2.20: and þus cwæð, Ārīs and nim þæt cild and his mōdor, and far on Israhela land; nū synd forð farene þe ðæs cildes sāwle sōhton.
2.21: Hē ārās ðā and onfēng þæt cild and his mōdor, and cōm on Israhela land.
2.22: Đā hē gehȳrde þæt Archelaus rīxode on Iudea þēode for ðone [ fæder ] Herodem, hē ondrēd ​ þyder tō faranne ; and on swefnum gemynegod hē fērde on Galileisce dǣlas,
2.23: and hē cōm þā and eardode on þǣre ceastre ðe is genemned Nazareth: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, for þām ðe hē Nazarenisc byð genemned.

3.1: On þām dagum cōm Iohannes sē fulluhtere, and bodude on þām wēstene Iudee,
3.2: and cwæð, Dōþ dǣdbōte; sōðlīce genēalǣceð heofona rīce.
3.3: Đis ys sē be þām þe gecweden ys þurh Esaiam ðone wītegan, Clypiendes stefn wæs on wēstene, Gegearwiað Drihtnes weg, dōþ his sīðas rihte.
3.4: Sē Iohannes witodlīce hæfde rēaf of olfenda hǣrum, and fellenne gyrdel embe hys lendenu; and hys mete wæs gærstapan and wuduhunig.
3.5: Đā fērde tō him Hierosolimwaru and eal Iudea ðēod, and eal þæt rīce wiðgeondan Iordanen. ​
3.6: And hī wǣron gefullode on Iordane fram him, and hī andettan hyra synna.
3.7: Sōðlīce þā hē geseh manega þǣra sunderhālgena and þǣra rihtwīsendra tō his fulluhte cumende, hē cwæð tō him, Lā, nǣddrena cyn, hwā geswutelode ēow to flēonne fram þām tōweardan yrre?
3.8: Eornostlīce dōþ medemne wæstm þǣre dǣdbōte;
3.9: and ne cweþað betwux ēow, Wē habbað Abraham ūs tō fæder. Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt God ys swā mihtig þæt hē mæg of þysum stānum āweccean Abrahames bearn.
3.10: Eallunga ys sēo æx tō ðǣra trēowa wurtrumum āsett. Eornustlīce ǣlc trēow þe gōdne wæstm ne bringð byð forcorfen, and on fȳr āworpen.
3.11: Witodlīce ic ēo wfullige on wætere tō dǣdbōte. Sē þe æfter mē tōwerd ys, hē ys strengra Þonne ic, ðæs gescȳ neom ic wyrðe tō berenne; hē ēow fullað on Hālgum Gāste and on fȳre:
3.12: ðes fann ys on his handa, and hē āfeormað his þyrscelflōre; and hē gegaderað hys hwǣte on ​ his bern; þā ceafu hē forbærnð on unādwǣscendlīcum fȳre. Đys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg ofer twelftandæg.
3.13: Þā cōm sē Hǣlend fram Galilea tō Iordane tō Iohanne þæt hē hine fullode.
3.14: Iohannes þā sōðlīce forbēad him, and cwæð, Ic sceal fram þē bēon gefullod, and cymst ðū tō mē?
3.15: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð. Lǣt nū; þus unc gedafnað ealle rihtwīsnesse gefyllan. Þā forlēt hē hine.
3.16: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend gefullod wæs, hrædlīce hē āstāh of ðām wætere; and him wurdon þǣrrihte heofenas ontȳnede, and hē geseah Godes Gāst niþer stīgende swā swā culfran, and wunigende ofer hine.
3.17: And sōðlīce þā cōm stefn of heofenum, and þus cwæð, Hēr is mīn gecorena Sunu on þām mē gelīcode.

4.1: Đā wæs sē Hǣlend gelǣd fram Gāste on wēsten þæt hē wǣre fram dēofle costud. ​
4.2: And þā þā hē fæste fēowurtig daga and fēowurtig nihta, þā ongan hyne syððan hingrian.
4.3: And þā genēalǣhte sē costniend , and cwæð, Gyf þū Godes Sunu sȳ, cweð þæt þās stānas tō hlāfe gewurðon.
4.4: Ðā andswarode sē Hǣlend, Hit ys āwriten, Ne leofað sē man be hlāfe ānum, ac be ǣlcon worde þe of Godes mūðe gǣð.
4.5: Þā gebrōhte sē dēofol hine on þā hālgan ceastre, and āsette hine ofer þæs temples hēahnesse,
4.6: and cwæð tō him, Gyf þū Godes Sunu eart, āsend þē þonne nyðer; sōþlīce hit ys āwriten, Þæt hē his englum bebēad be ðē, þæt hig þē on hyra handum beron, þē lǣs þe ðīn fōt æt stāne ætsporne.
4.7: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend eft tō him, Hit ys āwriten, Ne costna þū Drihten þīnne God.
4.8: Eft sē dēofol hine genam, and lǣdde hine on swīðe hēahne munt, and ætēowde him ealle middaneardes rīcu and hyra wuldor,
4.9: and cwæþ tō him, Ealle þās ic sylle þē, gyf þū feallende tō mē geēadmētst. ​
4.10: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gang þū sceocca on bæc; sōþlīce hit ys āwriten, Tō Drihtne þīnum Gode þū ðē geēaðmētsð, and him ānum þēowast.
4.11: Ðā forlēt sē dēofol hine, and englas genēalǣhton and him þēnodon. Dys [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg ofer twelftadæg.
4.12: Sōðlīce þā sē Hǣlend gehȳrde þæt Iohannes belǣwed wæs, þā fērde hē tō Galileam;
4.13: and forlǣtenre þǣre ceastre Nazareth, hē cōm and eardode on Capharnaum, on þām sǣgemǣrum, on endum Zabulon and Neptalim:
4.14: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh Esaiam þone wītegan,
4.16: Ðēoda folc ðe on þȳstrum sæt geseah mycel lēoht, and sittendum on earde dēaþes sceade is lēoht ūp āsprungen.
4.17: Syððan ongan sē Hǣlend bodian and cweðan, Dōð dǣdbōte; sōðlīce heofona rīce genēalǣcð. Ðis godspel sceal on Andreas mæssedæg.
4.18: Þā sē Hǣlend ēode wið ðā Galileiscean sǣ, ​ hē geseh twēgen gebrōðru, Symonem, sē wæs genemned Petrus, and Andream his brōþor, sendende hyra nett on þā sǣ; sōðlīce hī wǣron fisceras.
4.19: And hē sǣde him, Cumað æfter mē, and ic dō þæt gyt bēoð manna fisceras.
4.20: And hī þǣrrihte forlēton hyra net, and him fyligdon.
4.21: And þā hē þanon ēode, he geseh twēgen ōðre gebrōþru, Iacobum Zebedei and Iohannem his brōþur, on scype mid hyra fæder Zebedeo, rēnigende hyra nett, and hē clypode hī.
4.22: Hī ðā sōna forlēton hyra nett and hyra fæder, and him fylidon. Ðis [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg on þǣre þryddan wucan ofer twelftandæg.
4.23: And þā befērde sē Hǣlend ealle Galileam, lǣrende on hyra gesomnungum; and hē wæs bodiende godspel þæs rīces, and hǣlende ǣlce ādle and ǣlce untrumnysse on þām folce.
4.24: And ðā fērde hys hlīsa intō ealle Syriam; and hī brōhton him ealle yfel hæbbende missenlīcum ādlum and on tintregum gegripene, and ​ þā ðe dēofelsēocnyssa hæfdon, and mōnoðsēoce, and laman, and hē þā gehǣlde.
4.25: And him fyligdon mycele menigu fram Galilea, and fram Decapoli, and fram Hierusalem, and fram Iudea, and fram begeondan Iordanen.

5.1: Sōðlīce þā sē Hǣlend geseh þā menigu, hē āstāh on þone munt; and þā hē sæt, þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas tō him.
5.2: And hē ontȳnde his mūð and lǣrde hī, and cwæð,
5.3: Ēadige synt þā gāstlīcan þearfan, for þām hyra ys heofena rīce.
5.4: Ēadige synt þā līðan, for þām þe hī eorðan āgun.
5.5: Ēadige synt þā ðe nū wēpað, for þām þe hī bēoð gefrēfrede.
5.6: Ēadige synt þā ðe rihtwīsnesse hingriað and þyrstað, for þām þe hī bēoð gefyllede. ​
5.7: Ēadige synt þā mildheortan, for þām þe hī mildheortnysse begytað.
5.8: Ēadige synt þā clǣnheortan, for þām þe hī God gesēoð.
5.9: Ēadige synt þā gesybsuman, for þām ðe hī bēoð Godes bearn genemnede.
5.10: Ēadige synt þā þe ēhtnysse þoliað for rihtwīsnysse, for þām þe hyra ys heofonan rīce.
5.11: Ēadige synt gē þonne hī wyriað ēow, and ēhtað ēow, and secgeað ǣlc yfel ongēn ēow, lēogende for mē.
5.12: Geblissiað and gefægniað, for þām þe ēower mēd ys mycel on heofonum; swā hī ēhton þā wītegan þe beforan ēow wǣron.
5.13: Gē synt eorþan sealt; gyf þæt sealt āwyrð on þām þe hit [ gesylt bið, hit ] ne mæg syððan tō nāhte, būton þæt hit sȳ ūt āworpen, and sȳ fram mannum fortreden.
5.14: Gē synt middaneardes lēoht. Ne mæg sēo ceaster bēon behȳd þe byð uppan munt āset.
5.15: Nē hī ne ǣlað hyra lēohtfæt, and hit under ​ cȳfe settað, ac ofer candelstæf þæt hit onlīhte eallum þe on þām hūse synt.
5.16: Swā onlīhte ēower lēoht beforan mannum þæt hī gesēon ēowre gōdan weorc, and wuldrian ēowerne Fæder þe on heofenum ys. Ðys godspel sceal on þone ōðerne wōdnesdæg ofer pentecosten.
5.17: Nelle gē wēnan þæt ic cōme tōwurpan þā ǣ, oððe þā wītegan; ne cōm ic nā tōwurpan, ac gefyllan.
5.18: Sōþes on eornost ic secge ēow, Ǣr þām gewīte heofon and eorðe, ān i oððe ān prica ne gewīt fram þǣre ǣ, ǣr þām ealle þing gewurðan.
5.19: Eornostlīce sē ðe tōwyrpð ān of þysum lǣstum bebodum, and þā men swā lǣrð, sē byð lǣst genemned on heofonan rīce; sōþlīce sē ðe hit dēð and lǣrð, sē biþ mycel genemned on heofonan rīce. Ðis godspel sceal on þone fēorðan sunnandæg ofer pentecosten.
5.20: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Būton ēower rihtwīsnyss māre sȳ þonne þǣra wrītera and sundorhālgena, ne gā gē on heofonan rīce. ​
5.21: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ealdum tīdum, Ne ofsleh þū; sē þe ofslihð, sē byð dōme scyldig.
5.22: Ic secge ēow sōþlīce þæt ǣlc þe yrsað hys brēþer byð dōme scyldig; sōþlīce se þe segð hys brēðer, þu āwordena, he byð geþeahte scyldig; sē þe segð, Þū stunta, sē byþ scyldig helle fȳres.
5.23: Eornostlīce gyf þū bringst þīne lāc to wēofode, and þū þǣr geþencst þæt ðīn brōðor hæfð ǣnig þing agēn ðē,
5.24: lǣt þǣr þīne lāc beforan þām altare, and gang ǣr and gesybsuma wið þīnne brōðer, and þonne cum þū syððan and bring þīne lāc. Ðis godspel sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre þryddan wucan ofer pentecosten.
5.25: Bēo þū onbūgende þīnum wiðerwinnan hraðe, þā hwīle þe ðū eart on wege mid him; þē lǣs þe ðīn wiðerwinna þē sylle ðām dēman, and sē dēma þē sylle ðām þēne, and þū sȳ on cwertern send.
5.26: Sōþes ic secge þē, Ne gǣst þū þanone, ǣr ðū āgylde þone ȳtemestan fēorðling . ​
5.27: Gē gehȳrdon þæt on ealdum cwydum gecweden wæs, Ne unrihthǣme ðū;
5.28: sōðlīce ic secge ēow þæt ǣlc þǣra þe wīf gesyhð and hyre gewylnað eallunga, þæt sē gesyngað on hys heortan.
5.29: Gyf þīn swȳðre ēage þē ǣswicie, āhola hit ūt, and āwurp hyt fram þē; sōðlīce þē ys betere þæt ān þīnra lima forwurþe, þonne eal þīn līchama sī on helle āsend.
5.30: And gyf þīn swīðre hand þē āswīce, āceorf hī of, and āwurp hī fram þē; witodlīce þē ys betere þæt ān þīnra lima forwurðe, þonne eal þīn līchama fare tō helle. Ðis [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre xvi. wucan ofer pentecosten.
5.31: Sōðlīce hit ys gecweden, Swā hwylc swā his wīf forlǣt, hē sylle hyre hyra hīwgedāles bōc.
5.32: Ic secge ēow tō sōðum þæt ǣlc þe his wīf forlǣt būton forlegennysse þingum, hē dēð þæt hēo unrihthǣmð; and sē unrihthǣmð þe forlǣtene æfter him genimð.
5.33: Eft gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs on ​ ealdum cwydum, Ne forswere þū; sōðlīce Drihtne þū āgyltst þīne āðās.
5.34: Ic secge ēow sōþlīce þæt gē eallunga ne swerion, nē þurh heofon, for þām þe hēo ys Godes þrymsetl;
5.35: nē þurh eorðan, for þām ðe hēo ys hys fōtscamul; nē þurh Hierusalem, for þām þe hēo ys mǣres cyninges ceaster .
5.36: Nē ðū ne swere þurh þīn hēafod, for þām þe þū ne miht ǣnne locc gedōn hwītne oððe blacne.
5.37: Sōðlīce sī ēower sprǣc, Hyt ys, hyt ys, Hyt nys, hyt nys; sōðlīce gyf þǣr māre byð, þæt bið of yfele.
5.38: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Ēage for ēage, and tōð for tēð;
5.39: sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Ne winne gē ongēn þā ðe ēow yfel dōþ; ac gyf hwā þē slēa on þīn swȳþre wenge, gegearwa him þæt ōðer.
5.40: And þām ðe wylle on dōme wið þē flītan, ​ and niman þīne tunecan, lǣt him tō þīnne wǣfels.
5.41: And swā hwā swā þē genyt þūsend stapa, gā mid him ōðre twā þūsend.
5.42: Syle þām ðe þē bidde; and þām ðe [ wylle ] æt þē borgian, ne wyrn þū him. Ðis [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre systēoðan wucan oter pentecosten; and on frīgedæg innan þǣre cȳswucan.
5.43: Gē gehȳrdon þæt gecweden wæs, Lufa þīnne nēxtan, and hata þinne fēond.
5.44: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Lufiað ēowre fȳnd, and dōþ wel þām ðe ēow yfel dōð, and gebiddað for ēowre ēhteras and tǣlendum ēow:
5.45: þæt gē sīn ēowres Fæder bearn þe on heofonum ys, sē þe dēð þæt hys sunne ūp āspringð ofer þā gōdan and ofer þā yfelan; and hē lǣt rīnan ofer þā rihtwīsan and ofer þā unrihtwīsan.
5.46: Gyf gē sōðlīce þā lufiað [ þe ēow lufiað ,] hwylce mēde habbað gē? hū ne dōð mānfulle swā?
5.47: And gyf gē þæt ān dōð þæt gē ēowre gebrōðra wylcumiaþ, hwæt dō gē māre? hū ne dōð hǣþene swā? ​
5.48: Eornustllce bēoð fulfremede, swā ēower heofonlīce Fæder is fullfremed. A geseah þa mæniu.

6.1: Begȳmað þæt gē ne dōn ēowre rihtwīsnesse beforan mannum þæt gē sīn geherede fram him; elles næbbe gē mēde mid ēowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
6.2: Eornustlīce þonne þū þīne ælmessan sylle, ne blāwe man bȳman beforan þē, swā līceteras dōð on gesomnungum and on wīcum þæt hī sīn geārwurþode fram mannum. Sōð ic secge ēow, Hī onfēngon hyra mēde.
6.3: Sōþlīce þonne þū þīne ælmessan dō, nyte þīn wynstre hwæt dō þīn swȳþre;
6.4: þæt þīn ælmesse sȳ on dīglum, and þīn Fæder hit āgylt þē sē þe gesyhþ on dīglum.
6.5: And þonne gē ēow gebiddon, ne bēo gē swylce līceteras; þā lufiað þæt hig gebiddon hī, standende on gesomnungum and [ on ] strǣta ​ hyrnum þæt men hig gesēon. Sōþ ic secge ēow, Hig onfēngon hyra mēde.
6.6: Ðū sōþlīce, þonne þū ðē gebidde, gang intō þīnum hēdclyfan, and þīnre dura belocenre, bide þīnne Fæder on dīhlum; and þīn Fæder þe gesyhð on dīhlum hyt āgylt þē.
6.7: Sōðlīce þonne gē ēow gebiddon, nelle gē sprecan fela, swā swā hǣðene; hig wēnað þæt hī sīn gehȳrede on hyra menigfealdan spǣce.
6.8: Nellen gē eornostlīce him geefenlǣcan; sōðlīce ēower Fæder wāt hwæt ēow þearf ys ǣr þām þe gē hyne biddað.
6.9: Eornustlīce gebiddað ēow ðus: Fæder ūre þū þe eart on heofonum, Sī þīn nama gehālgod.
6.10: Tōbecume þīn rīce. Gewurþe ðīn willa on eorðan swā swā on heofonum.
6.11: Ūrne gedæghwāmlīcan hlāf syle ūs tō dæg.
6.12: And forgyf ūs ūrne gyltas, swā swā wē forgyfað ūrum gyltendum.
6.13: And ne gelǣd þū ūs on costnunge, ac ālȳs ūs of yfele. Sōþlīce.
6.14: Witodlīce gyf gē forgyfað mannum hyra ​ synna, þonne forgyfþ ēower sē heofenlīca Fæder ēow ēowre gyltas.
6.15: Gyf gē sōðlīce ne forgyfað mannum, nē ēower Fæder ne forgyfð ēow ēowre synna. Ðys [godspel] gebyrað tō caput ieiunii on wōdnesdæg.
6.16: Sōðlīce þonne gē fæston, nellon gē wesan swylce lēase līcceteras; hig fornymað hyra ansȳna þæt hig ætēowun mannum fæstende. Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt hig onfēngon hyra mēde.
6.17: Ðū sōðlīce, þonne ðū fæste, smyra þīn hēafod, and þweah þīne ansȳne;
6.18: þæt þū ne sȳ gesewen fram mannum fæstende, ac þīnum Fæder þe ys on dīglum; and þīn Fæder þe gesyhð on dȳglum hit āgylt þē.
6.19: Nellen gē goldhordian ēow goldhordas on eorþan, þǣr ōm and moððe hit fornimð, and þǣr ðēofas hit delfað and forstelaþ.
6.20: Goldhordiað ēow sōðlīce goldhordas on heofenan, þǣr nāðor ōm nē moþðe hit ne fornimð, and ðār ðēofas hit ne delfað nē ne forstelaþ;
6.21: witodlīce þǣr ðīn goldhord is, þǣr is ðīn heorte. ​
6.22: Ðīnes līchaman lēohtfæt is þīn ēage; gyf þīn ēage bið ānfeald, eall þīn līchama bið beorht.
6.23: Gif þīn ēage sōþlīce bið mānfull, eall þīn līchama byþ ðȳsterfull. Eornustlīce gyf þæt lēoht þe on ðē is synt þȳstru, hū mycle bēoþ ðā þȳstru! Ðys [godspel] sceal on þone syxtēoðan sunnandæg ofer pentecosten.
6.24: Ne mæg nān man twām hlāfordum þēowian; oððe hē sōðlīce ǣnne hatað and ōðerne lufað, oððe hē bið ānum gehȳrsum and ōðrum ungehȳrsum. Ne magon gē Gode þēowian and woruldwelan.
6.25: For þām ic secge ēow þæt gē ne sīn ymbhȳdige ēowre sāwle hwæt gē eton, ne ēowrum līchaman mid hwām gē sȳn ymbscrȳdde. Hū nys sēo sawl sēlre þonne mete, and ēower līchama betera þonne þæt rēaf?
6.26: Behealdað heofonan fuglas, for þām þe hig ne sāwað, nē hig ne rīpað, nē hig ne gadriað on berne; and ēower heofonlīca Fæder hig fēt. Hū ne synt gē sēlran þonne hig? ​
6.27: Hwylc ēower mæg sōþlīce geþencean þæt hē geēacnige āne elne tō hys anlīcnesse?
6.28: And tō hwī synt gē ymbhȳdige be rēafe? Bescēawiað æcyres lilian, hū hig weaxað; ne swincað hig, nē hig ne spinnað.
6.29: Ic secge ēow sōðlīce þæt furðon Salomon on eallum hys wuldre næs oferwrigen swā swā ān of ðyson.
6.30: Sōþlīce gyf æcyres wēod, þæt ðe tō dæg is and bið tō morgen on ofen āsend, God [ swā ] scrȳt, Ēalā gē gehwǣdes gelēafan! þām mycle mā hē scrȳt ēow.
6.31: Nellen gē eornustlīce bēon ymbhȳdige, þus cweþende, Hwæt ete wē? oððe, Hwæt drince wē? oððe, Mid hwām bēo wē oferwrogene?
6.32: Sōþlīce ealle þās þing þēoda sēceað; witodlīce ēower Fæder wāt þæt gē eallra þyssa þinga beþurfon.
6.33: Eornustlīce sēceað ǣrest Godes rīce and hys rihtwīsnesse, and ealle þās þing ēow bēoþ þǣr tō geēacnode.
6.34: Ne bēo gē nā hogiende ymb þā morgenlīcan ​ nēode; sōðlīce sē morgenlīca dæg carað ymb hyne sylfne. Ǣghwylc dæg hæfð genōh on hys āgenum ymbhogan.

7.1: Nellen gē dēman, þæt gē ne sȳn fordēmede.
7.2: Witodlīce ðām ylcan dōme þe gē dēmað, ēow byð gedēmed; and on ðām ylcan gemete þe gē metaþ, ēow byþ gemeten.
7.3: Tō hwī gesihst þū þæt mot on þīnes brōþor ēagan , and þū ne gesyhst þone bēam on þīnum āgenum ēagan?
7.4: Oþþe hūmeta cwyst þū tō þīnum brēþer, Brōþur, þafa þæt ic ūt ādō þæt mot of þīnum ēagan, þonne sē bēam biþ on þīnum āgenum ēagan?
7.5: Lā þū līccetere, ādō ǣrest ūt ðone bēam of þīnum āgenum ēagan, and behāwa þonne þæt þū ūt ādō þæt mot of þīnes brōður ēagan.
7.6: Nellen gē syllan þæt hālige hundum, nē gē ne wurpen ēowre meregrotu tōforan ēowrum ​ swȳnon, þē lǣs hig mid hyra fōtum hig fortredon, and hig þonne ongēan gewende ēow tōslȳton. Ðys godspel sceal tō gangdagon.
7.7: Biddaþ, and ēow bið geseald; sēceaþ, and gē hit findaþ; cnuciað, and ēow biþ ontȳned.
7.8: Witodlīce ǣlc þǣra þe bit, hē onfēhþ; and sē þe sēcð, hē hyt fint; and þām cnuciendum bið ontȳned.
7.9: Hwylc man is of ēow, gyf his sunu hyne bit hlāfes, sylst þū him stān;
7.10: oððe gyf hē bytt fisces, sylst þū him nǣddran?
7.11: Eornustlīce nū gē þe yfle synt cunnun gōde sylena ēowrum bearnum syllan, mycle mā ēower Fæder þe on heofenum ys syleþ gōd þām þe hyne biddað.
7.12: Eornustlīce ealle þā þing ðe gē wyllen þæt men ēow dōn, dōþ gē him þæt sylfe; þæt ys sōþlīce ǣ and wītegena bebod.
7.13: Gangað inn þurh þæt nearwe geat; for þon ​ þe þæt geat is swȳþe wīd, and sē weg is swīþe rūm þe tō forspillednesse gelǣt, and swȳþe manega synt þe þurh þone weg farað.
7.14: Ēalā hū neara and hū angsum is þæt geat and sē weg þe tō līfe gelǣdt, and swȳþe fēawa synt þe þone weg findon! Ðys godspell gebyrað on þǣre nygoðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
7.15: Warniað ēow fram lēasum wītegum, þā cumað tō ēow on scēapa gegyrelum, ac hig bēoð innane rēafigende wulfas.
7.16: Fram hyra wæstmun gē hī undergytað. Cwyst þū gaderað man wīnberian of þornum, oððe fīcæppla of þyrncinum?
7.17: Swā ǣlc gōd trēow byrþ gōde wæstmas, and ǣlc yfel trēow byrþ yfele wæstmas.
7.18: Ne mæg þæt gōde trēow beran yfle wæstmas, ne þæt yfele trēow gōde wæstmas.
7.19: Ǣlc trēow þe ne byrð gōdne wæstm sȳ hyt forcorfen, and on fȳr āworpen.
7.20: Witodlīce be hyra wæstmum gē hig oncnāwað.
7.21: Ne gǣð ǣlc þǣra on heofena rīce þe cwyþ ​ tō mē, Drihten, Drihten; ac sē þe wyrcð mīnes Fæder willan þe on heofenum is, sē gǣð on heofena rīce.
7.22: Manega cweþað on þām dæge tō mē, Drihten, Drihten, hū ne wītegode wē on þīnum naman, and on þīnum naman wē ūt āwurpon dēoflu, and on þīnum naman wē worhton mycle mihta?
7.23: Þonne cweðe ic tō him, Þæt ic ēow nǣfre ne cūðe; gewītað fram mē, gē þe worhton unrihtwȳsnesse.
7.24: Eornustlīce ǣlc þǣra þe ðās mīne word gehȳrð, and þā wyrcð, byþ gelīc þām wīsan were sē hys hūs ofer stān getimbrode;
7.25: þā cōm þǣr rēn and mycele flōd, and þǣr blēowun windas, and āhruron on þæt hūs, and hyt nā ne fēoll; sōðlīce hit wæs ofer stān getimbrod.
7.26: And ǣlc þǣra þe gehȳrþ ðās mīne word, and þā ne wyrcð, sē byþ gelīc þām dysigan men þe getimbrode hys hūs ofer sandceosel;
7.27: þā rīnde hit, and þǣr cōmun flōd, and ​ blēowun windas, and āhruron on þæt hūs, and þæt hūs fēoll, and hys hryre wæs mycel. Ðys [godspel] sceal on þone þryddan sunnandæg ofer epiphaniam.
7.28: Þā wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlend þās word geendode, þā wundrode þæt folc his lāre.
7.29: Sōþlīce hē lǣrde swylce hē anweald hæfde, and nā swā swā hyra bōceras and sundorhālgan.

8.1: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend of þām munte nyþer āstāh, þā fyligdon him mycle mænio.
8.2: Þā genēalǣhte ān hrēofla tō him, and hine tō him geēaðmēdde, and þus cwæð, Drihten, gyf þu wylt, þū miht mē geclǣnsian.
8.3: Ðā āstrehte sē Hǣlend hys hand, and hrepode hyne, and þus cwæð, Ic wylle; bēo geclǣnsod. And hys hrēofla wæs hrædlīce geclǣnsod.
8.4: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Warna þē þæt þū hyt nǣnegum men ne secge; ac gang, ætēowe þē þām sācerde, and bring hym þā lāc þe Moyses bebēad, on hyra gecȳðnesse. ​
8.5: Sōþlīce þā sē Hǣlend in ēode on Capharnaum, þā genēalǣhte hym ān hundredes ealdor, hyne biddende,
8.6: and þus cweðende, Drihten, mīn cnapa līð on mīnum hūse, lama and mid yfle geðrēad.
8.7: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ic cume and hyne gehǣle.
8.8: Ðā andswarode sē hundredes ealdor and þus cwæð, Drihten, ne eom ic wyrðe þæt þū in gange under mīne þecene; ac cweð þīn ān word, and mīn cnapa biþ gehǣled.
8.9: Sōðlīce ic eom man under anwealde gesett, and ic hæbbe þegnas under mē; and ic cweðe tō þysum, Gang, and hē gǣð; and ic cweðe tō ōþrum, Cum, and he cymð; tō mīnum þēowe, Wyrc þis, and hē wyrcð.
8.10: Witodlīce þā sē Hǣlend þis gehȳrde, þā wundrode hē, and cwæð tō þām þe hym fyligdon, Sōþ ic secge ēow, ne gemētte ic swā mycelne gelēafan on Israhel.
8.11: Tō sōþum ic secge ēow þæt manige cumað fram ēastdǣle and westdǣle, and wuniað mid Abrahame, Isahace, and Iacobe on heofena rīce. ​
8.12: Witodlīce þises rīces bearn bēoð āworpene on þā ȳtemestan þȳstro; þǣr bið wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
8.13: And sē Hælend cwæð tō þām hundrydes ealdre, Gā, and gewurþe ðē swā swā þū gelȳfdest. And sē cnapa wæs gehǣled on þǣre tīde. Đis [godspel] gebyrað on frīgedæg on þǣre twā and twēntugoðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
8.14: Đā sē Hǣlend cōm on Petres hūse, þā geseah hē hys swegre licgende, and hriþgende.
8.15: And hē æthrān hyre hand, and sē fēfor hig forlēt; ðā ārās hēo, and þēnode him.
8.16: Sōþlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, hig brōhton him manege dēofolsēoce ; and hē ūt ādrǣfde þā unclǣnan gāstas mid hys worde, and hē ealle gehǣlde þā yfel hæbbendan:
8.17: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Esaiam þone wītegan, þus cweðende, Hē onfēng ūre untrumnessa, and hē ābær ūre ādla.
8.18: Đā geseah sē Hǣlend mycle menigeo ymbūtan hyne, þā hēt hē hig faran ofer þone mūþan. ​ Đis [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre fēorðan wucan ofer twelftandæg.
8.19: Đā genēalǣhte him ān bōcere, and cwæþ, Lārēow, ic fylige þē swā hwæder swā þū færst.
8.20: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Foxas habbað holu, and heofenan fuglas nest; sōþlīce mannes Sunu næfð hwǣr hē hys hēafod āhylde.
8.21: Đā cwæð tō him ōþer of hys leorningcnihtum, Drihten, ālȳfe mē ǣrest tō farenne and bebyrigean mīnne fæder.
8.22: Þa cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Fylig mē, and lǣt dēade bebyrigean hyra dēadan. Đis [godspel] sceal on þone fēorðan sunnandæg ofer twelftandæg.
8.23: And hē āstāh on scyp, and hys leorningcnyhtas hym fyligdon.
8.24: Đā wearð mycel styrung geworden on þǣre sǣ, swā þæt þæt scyp wearð ofergoten mid ȳþum; witodlīce hē slēp.
8.25: And hig genēalǣhton, and hȳ āwehton hyne, þus cweðende, Drihten, hǣle ūs; wē mōton forwurþan.
8.26: Đā cwæð hē tō him, Tō hwī synt gē forhte, gē lȳtles gelēafan? Đā ārās hē, and bebēad þām ​ winde and þǣre sǣ; and þǣr wearð geworden mycel smyltness.
8.27: Gewisslīce þā men wundrodun and þus cwǣdon, Hwæt is ðēs þæt windas and sǣ him hȳrsumiað?
8.28: Þā sē Hǣlend cōm ofer þone mūþan on Geraseniscra rīce, þā urnon him tōgēnes twēgen þe hæfdon dēofolsēocnesse, of byrgenum ūt gangende; þā wǣron swīðe rēþe, swā þæt nān man ne mihte faran þurh þone weg.
8.29: And hig hrȳmdon and cwǣdon, Lā Hǣlend, Godes Sunu, hwæt ys þē and ūs gemǣne? cōme þū hider ǣr tīde ūs tō þrēagenne?
8.30: Đǣr wæs sōþlīce unfeorr ān heord †manegra swȳna lǣswiende.
8.31: Þā dēofla sōðlīce hyne bǣdon þus cweþende, Gyf þū ūs ūt ādrīfst, āsende ūs on þās swīna heorde.
8.32: Đā cwæð hē tō him, Faraþ. And hig þā ūt gangende fērdon on þā swīn, and þǣrrihte fērde eall sēo heord myclum onrǣse niwel on þā sǣ, and hig wurdon dēade on þām wætere.
8.33: Đā hyrdas witodlīce flugon, and comun on ​ þā ceastre, and cȳddon ealle þās þing, and be þām þe ðā dēofulsēocnyssa hæfdon.
8.34: Ðā ēode eall sēo ceasterwaru tōgēanes þām Hǣlende; and þā þā hig hyne gesāwun, þā bǣdon hig hyne þæt hē fērde fram heora gemǣrum.

9.1: Đā āstāh hē on scyp, and oferseglode, and cōm on his ceastre .
9.2: Đā brōhton hig hym ǣnne laman, on bedde licgende; þā geseah sē Hǣlend hyra gelēafan, and cwæð tō þām laman, Lā bearn, gelȳfe; þē bēoþ þīne synna forgyfene.
9.3: Đā cwǣdon hig sume þā bōceras him betwȳnan, Đēs spycð bysmorsprǣce.
9.4: Þā sē Hǣlend geseah hyra geþanc, ðā cwæð hē, Tō hwī þence gē yfel on ēowrum heortum?
9.5: Hwæt is ēaþelīcre tō cweðenne, Þē bēoð forgyfene þīne synna, oððe tō cweþanne, Ārīs, and gā?
9.6: Þæt gē sōþlīce witon þæt mannes Sunu hæfð ​ anweald on eorþan synna tō forgyfenne,—þā cwæð hē tō þām laman,—Ārīs, and nym þīn bedd, and gang on þīn hūs.
9.7: And hē ārās, and fērde tō hys hūse.
9.8: Sōðlīce ðā þā sēo mænigeo þis gesāwon, þā ondrēdon hig hym, and wuldrodon God þe sealde swylcne anweald mannum. Đis godspel sceal on sancte Matheus mæsseǣfen.
9.9: Đā se Hǣlend þanon fērde, hē geseah ǣnne man sittende æt tollsceamule, þæs nama wæs Matheus; and hē cwæð tō him, Fylig mē. And hē ārās, and fyligde him.
9.10: And hyt wæs geworden þā hē sæt innan hūse, þā cōmun manega mānfulle and synfulle and sǣton mid þām Hǣlende and hys leorningcnyhtum.
9.11: Đā þā sundorhālgan þæt gesāwon, þā cwǣdon hig tō hys leorningcnyhtum, Hwī ytt ēower Lārēow mid mānfullum and synfullum?
9.12: And sē Hǣlend cwæð, þis gehȳrende, Nys hālum lǣces nān þearf, ac sēocum.
9.13: Gāð sōðlīce and leornigeaþ hwæt is, Ic wylle mildheortnesse, næs onsægdnesse; sōþlīce ​ ne cōm ic rihtwīse tō gecīgeanne, ac þa synnfullan. Đis [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg on þǣre ōðre ēasterwucan.
9.14: Þā genēalǣhton Iohannes leorningcnihtas tō hym, and þuss cwǣdon, Hwī fæste wē and þā sundorhālgan gelōmlīce? sōþlīce þīne leorningcnihtas ne fæstað?
9.15: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Cweþe ge sceolun þæs brȳdguman cnihtas wēpan, þā hwīle þe sē brȳdguma mid hym byþ? sōðlīce þā dagas cumað þæt sē brydguma byð āfyrred fram him, and þonne on ðām dagum hig fæstað.
9.16: Ne dēþ witodlīce nān man nīwes clāðes scyp on eald rēaf; hē tōbrycð hys stede on þām rēafe, and sē slite byþ þē wyrsa.
9.17: Nē hig ne dōð nīwe wīn on ealde bytta; gyf hī dōð, þā bytta bēoþ tōbrocene, and þæt wīn āgoten, and þā bytta forwurþað. Ac hig dōð nīwe wīn on nīwe bytta, and ǣgðer byþ gehealden. Đis [godspel] sceal on sunnandæg on þǣre fīf and twēntugoðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
9.18: Đā [ hē ] þās þing tō him spræc, þā genēalǣhte ān ealdor, and geēaðmēdde hyne tō him, ​ þus cweðende, Drihten, mīn dohtor is dēad; ac cum, and sete þīne hand uppan hig, and hēo lyfað.
9.19: And sē Hǣlend ārās and fyligde hym, and hys leorningcnihtas.
9.20: And þā ān wif þe þolode blōdryne twelf gēar genēalǣhte widæftan, and æthrān hys rēafes fnæd;
9.21: hēo cwæð sōðlīce on hyre mōde, For ān ic bēo hāl, gyf ic hys rēafes æthrīne.
9.22: And sē Hǣlend bewende hyne and hig geseah, and cwæð, Gelȳf, dohtor; þīn gelēafa þē gehǣlde. And þæt wīf wæs gehǣled on þǣre tīde.
9.23: And þā sē Hǣlend cōm intō þæs ealdres healle, and geseah hwistleras, and hlȳdende menigeo,
9.24: hē cwæð, Gāð heonun; nys þys mǣden dēad sōðlīce, ac hēo slǣpð. And hig tǣldon hyne.
9.25: And þā hē þā menigeo ūt ādrāf, hē geēode in, and nam hyre hand; and þæt mǣden ārās.
9.26: And þēs hlīsa sprang ofer eall þæt land. ​ Đis [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre xiii. wucan ofer pentecosten.
9.27: Þā sē Hǣlend þanun fōr, þā fyligdun hym twēgyn blinde, hrȳmynde and cweðende, Lā Dauides sunu, gemiltsa unc.
9.28: Sōðlīce þā hē hām cōm, þā blindan genēalǣhton tō him, and sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Gelȳfe gyt þæt ic inc mæg gehǣlan? Hig cwǣdon tō hym, Witodlīce, Drihten.
9.29: Đā æthrān hē hyra ēagena, cweðynde, Sȳ inc æftyr incrun gelēafan.
9.30: And hyra ēagan wǣrun ontȳnede. And sē Hǣlynd bebēad him, cweþende , Warniað þæt gē hyt nānum men ne secgeon.
9.31: Hig sōðlīce ūt gangynde gewīdmǣrsudun hyne ofer eall þæt land.
9.32: Đā hig wǣron sōðlīce ūt āgāne, hig brōhton him dumbne man, sē wæs dēofulsēoc.
9.33: And ūt ādryfenum þām dēofle, sē dumba spræc; and þā menigeo wundredon, cweðende, Nǣfre ætȳwde swylc on Israhela folce. ​
9.34: Sōþlīce þā sundorhālgan cwǣdon, On dēofla ealdre hē drīfð ūt dēoflu.
9.35: And sē Hǣlend ymbfōr ealle burga and ceastra, lǣrende on hyra gesomnungum, and bodiende rīces godspell, and hǣlende ǣlce ādle and ǣlce untrumnesse.
9.36: Hē gemiltsude sōðlīce þǣre menigeo, þā hē hī geseah, for þan hig wǣrun gedrehte, and licgende swā swā scēap þe hyrde nabbað.
9.37: Þā hē sǣde hys leorningcnihtun, Witodlīce micel rip ys, and fēawa wyrhtyna.
9.38: Biddaþ ðæs ripes hlāford þæt hē sende wyrhtan tō his ripe.

10.1: And tōsomne gecīgydum hys twelf leorningcnihtun, hē sealde him unclǣnra gāsta anweald, þæt hig ādryfun hig ūt, and hǣldun ādle and ǣlce untrumnysse.
10.2: Đis synt sōðlīce þǣra twelf apostola naman: Sē forma ys Simon þe ys genemned Petrus, and ​ Andreas hys brōðor; Iacobus Zebedei, and Iohannes hys brōður.
10.3: Philippus, and Bartholomeus; Thomas, and Matheus, publicanus ; and Iacobus Alphei, and Taddeus.
10.4: Simon Chananeus, and Iudas Scarioth þe hyne belǣwde.
10.5: Ðās twelf sē Hǣlynd sende, him bebēodende and cweþende, Ne fare gē on þēoda weg, and ne gā gē innan Samaritana ceastre;
10.6: ac gāð mā tō þām scēapun þe forwurdun Israhela hīwrǣdene.
10.7: Sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō hys leorningcnihton, Gāð, and bodiaþ, cweþende þæt heofona rīce genēalǣcþ.
10.8: Hǣlað untrume, āwecceað dēade, clǣnsiað hrēofle, drīfað ūt dēoflu; gē onfēngun tō gyfe, syllað tō gyfe.
10.9: Næbbe gē gold, nē seolfer, nē feoh on ēowrum bigyrdlum;
10.10: nē codd on wege, nē twā tunecan, nē gescȳ, ​ nē gyrde; sōþlīce sē wyrhta ys wyrþe hys metys.
10.11: On swā hwylce burh oððe ceastre swā gē in gāð, āhsiað hwā sī wyrðe on þǣre; and wuniaþ ðǣr, oð gē ūt gān.
10.12: Þonne gē in gān sōþlīce on þæt hūs, grētað hit, cweðende, Sȳ syb þisun hūse.
10.13: And gyf þæt hūs witodlīce wyrþe byð, ēower syb cymð ofer hyt; gyf hyt sōðlīce wyrþe ne byð, ēowur syb byð tō ēow gecyrred.
10.14: And swā hwā swā ēow ne underfēhð, nē ēowre sprǣca ne gehȳrð, þonne gē ūt gān of ðām hūse oððe of ðǣre ceastre, āsceacaþ þæt dūst of ēowrum fōtum.
10.15: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ācumenlīcre byð Sodoma lande and Gomorra on dōmes dæg, þonne ðǣre ceastre. Ðys godspel sceal tō manegra martyra mæssedæge.
10.16: Nū ic ēow sende swā scēap gemang wulfas; bēoþ eornustlīce glēawe swā nǣddran, and bylwite swā culfran.
10.17: Warniað ēow sōþlīce fram mannum; hig ​ syllaþ ēow sōþlīce on gemōtum, and swingað ēow on hyra gesomnungum.
10.18: And gē bēoþ gelǣdde tō dēmun and tō cyningun for mē, tō hyra dōme and þēodun.
10.19: Þonne belǣwaþ [ hig and ] syllað ēow, ne þence gē hū oððe hwæt gē sprecun; ēow byð geseald sōþlīce on þǣre tīde hwæt gē sprecun.
10.20: Ne synt gē nā þe þǣr sprecað, ac ēowres Fæder Gāst þe sprycð on ēow.
10.21: Sōþlīce brōþur sylþ hys brōður tō dēaðe, and fæder hys sunu; and bearn ārīsaþ ongēn māgas, and tō dēaþe hī fordōþ.
10.22: And gē bēoþ on hatunge eallum mannum for mīnum naman; soðlīce sē [ ðe ] þurhwunaþ oð ende sē byþ hāl.
10.23: Đonne hī ēow ēhtaþ on þysse byrig, flēoþ on ōþre; and ðonne hī on þǣre ēow ēhtaþ, flēoþ on þā þryddan. Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ne befaraþ gē Israhela burga, ǣr þan þe mannes Sunu cume.
10.24: Nys sē leorningcniht ofer hys lārēow, nē þēow ofer hys hlāford. ​
10.25: Genōh byþ sōþlīce þām leorningcnihte þæt hē sȳ swylce hys lārēow, and þēow swylce hys hlāfurd. Gyf hī þæs hīredes fæder Belzebub clypedon, mycle swȳþur hig ēow clypiað. Đys godspel gebyrað tō ānes confessores mæssedæge.
10.26: Eornustlīce ne ondrǣde gē hig; nys sōþlīce nān þing dȳhle þæt ne wurðe geswutelod, nē nān dīhle þing þæt ne wurðe geopenod.
10.27: Đæt ic ēow secge on þȳstrum, secgað hyt on lēohte; and þæt gē on ēare gehȳrað, bodiaþ uppan hrōfum.
10.28: And ne ondrǣde gē þā ðe ēowyrne līchaman ofslēaþ; ne magon hig sōþlīce þā sāwle ofslēan; ac ondrǣdað mā þone þe mæg sāwle and līchaman fordōn on helle.
10.29: Hū ne becȳpað hig twēgen spearwan tō peninge? and ān of ðām ne befylð on eorðan būtan ēowrun Fæder.
10.30: And sōþlīce ealle ēowres hēafdes loccas synt getealde.
10.31: Ne ondrǣde gē; gē synt sēlran þonne manega spearuan.
10.32: Ǣlcne eornustlīce þe mē cȳþ beforan ​ mannun, ic cȳþe hyne beforan mīnun Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
10.33: Sē þe mē wiðsæcð beforan mannun, and ic wiþsace hyne beforan mīnum Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
10.34: Ne wēne gē þæt ic cōme sybbe on eorþan tō sendanne; ne cōm ic sybbe tō sendanne, ac swurd.
10.35: Ic cōm sōþlīce mann āsyndrian ongēn hys fæder, and dohtur ongēn hyre mōdur, and snore ongēn hyre swegre;
10.36: and mannes fȳnd, hys gehūsan. Đys godspel gebyrað tō ānes martyres mæssedæge.
10.37: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hys leorningcnihtum, Sē þe lufaþ fæder oððe mōdor mā þonne mē, nys hē mē wyrþe; and sē ðe lufað sunu oððe dohtor swȳþur þonne mē, nys hē mē wyrþe.
10.38: And sē þe ne nimþ hys cwylminge, and fyligþ mē, nys hē mē wyrþe.
10.39: Sē þe gemēt hys sāwle sē forspilþ hig; and sē þe forspilþ hys sāwle for mē, hē gemēt hī.
10.40: Sē þe ēow underfēhþ, hē underfēhð mē; ​ and sē ðe mē underfēhþ, hē underfēhð þone þe mē sende.
10.41: Sē þe underfēhð wītegan on wītegan naman, hē onfēhþ wītygan mēde; and sē þe underfēhþ rihtwīsne on rihtwīses naman, hē onfēhþ rihtwīses mēde.
10.42: And swā hwylc swā sylþ ānne drinc cealdes wæteres ānum þyssa lȳtylra manna on leorningcnihtes naman, sōþ ic secge ēow, Ne āmyrð hē hys mēde.

11.1: And hyt wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlynd þys geendude, hys twelf leorningcnihtum bebēodende, hē fōr þanun þæt hē lǣrde and bodude on hyra burgum. Đys [godspel] gebyrað on þǣre ǣrran wucan ǣr mydawyntra.
11.2: Þā Iohannes on bendum gehȳrde Crīstes weorc , þā sende hē tō him twēgen hys leorningcnihta,
11.3: and cwæð, Eart þū þe tō cumenne eart, oððe wē ōþres sceolon ābīdan? ​
11.4: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð tō him, Gāþ, and cȳþaþ Iohanne þā ðing þe gē gehȳrdon and gesawōn:
11.5: blinde gesēoþ, healte gāð, hrēofe synt āclǣnsude, dēafe gehȳraþ, dēade ārīsað, þearfan bodiað.
11.6: And ēadig ys sē þe ne swicað on mē.
11.7: Đā hī ūt ēodon, sōþlīce þā ongan sē Hǣlynd secgan be Iohanne and cwæþ tō þǣre menigeo, Hwī ēode gē ūt on wēsten gesēon winde āwegyd hrēod?
11.8: Oððe hwī ēode gē ūt gesēon mann hnescum gyrlum gescrȳdne? Nū þā þe synt hnescum gyrlum gescrȳdde synt on cyninga hūsum.
11.9: Ac hwæt ēode gē ūt wītegan gesēon? Ic ēow secge, Ēac māran þonne wītegan.
11.10: Đēs ys sōþlīce be þām āwryten ys, Nū ic sende mīnne engyl beforan þīne ansȳne, sē gegearwað þīnne weg beforan þē.
11.11: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Ne ārās betwyx wīfa bearnum māra Iohanne fulwihtere; sōðlīce sē þe lǣssa ys ys on heofena rīce him māra.
11.12: Sōþlīce fram Iohannes dagum fulwihteres ​ oð þis heofena rīce þolað nēad, and strece nimað þæt.
11.13: Sōþlīce ealle wītegan and ǣ wītegudun oð Iohannes.
11.14: And gyf gē wyllað gelȳfan, hē ys Helias þe tō cumenne ys.
11.15: Sē ðe ēaran hæbbe tō gehȳrynne, gehȳre.
11.16: Sōþlīce hwām telle ic þās cnēorysse gelīce? Hēo ys gelīc sittendum cnapun on foretīge; þā hrȳmað tō hyra efengelīcon,
11.17: and cweþað, Wē sungun ēow, and gē ne frīcudun; we cwīþdun, and gē ne wēopun.
11.18: Sōþlīce Iohannes cōm nē etende nē drincende, and hī cwǣdun, Hē hæfð dēofulsēocnysse.
11.19: Mannes Sunu cōm etende and dryncynde, and hī cweðaþ, Hēr ys ettul mann and wīndrincende, mānfulra and synfulra frēond! And wīsdōm ys gerihtwīsud fram heora bearnum. Đys godspel gebyrað on frīgedæg on þǣre þrȳttēoþan wucan ofer pentecosten.
11.20: Đā ongan hē hyspan þā burga on þām wǣrun ​ gedōne manega hys mægena, for þām þe hī ne dydon dǣdbōte.
11.21: Wā þē, Corozaim! wā þē, Bethsaida! for þām gyf on Tyro and Sydone wǣrun gedōne þā mægnu þe gedōne synt on ēow, gefyrn hī dydun dǣdbōte on hǣran and on axan.
11.22: Đēah ic secge inc, Tyro and Sydone byþ forgifenlīcor on dōmes dæg þonne ēow.
11.23: And þū Capharnaum, cwyst þū byst þū ūp āhafen oþ heofen? ac þū nyþer færst oþ helle; for þām gyf on Sodomum wǣron gedōne þā mægnu þe gedōne synt on þē, witodlīce hī wunedun oþ þysne dæg.
11.24: Đēah hwæþere ic secge ēow þæt Sodumwara lande byð forgyfenlīcre on dōmes dæg þonne þē. Đys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre syxtan wucan ofer pentecosten.
11.25: Sē Hǣlynd cwæð andswariende, Ic andytte þē, Drihten heofenes and eorþan, þū þe behȳddyst þās þing fram wīsun and glēawun, and onwruge þā lȳtlingun; ​
11.26: swā, Fæder, for þām hyt wæs swā gecwēme beforan þē.
11.27: Ealle þing mē synt gesealde fram mīnum Fædyr; and nān mann ne can þone Sunu, būtun Fadyr; nē nān mann ne can þone Fædyr, būtun Sunu, and þām þe sē Sunu wyle onwrēon.
11.28: Cumaþ tō mē, ealle þe swincað and gesȳmede synt, and ic ēow geblissige.
11.29: Nimaþ mīn geoc ofer ēow, and leorniaþ æt mē; for þām ic eom bilwite and ēadmōd on heortan; and gē gemētað reste ēowrum sāwlum.
11.30: Sōþlīce mīn geoc ys wynsum, and mīn byrþyn ys lēoht.

12.1: Sē Hǣlynd fōr on restedæge ofyr æcyras; sōþlīce hys leorningcnihtas hingryde, and hig ongunnun pluccian þā ēar, and ǣtan. ​
12.2: Sōþlīce þā ðā sundorhālgan þæt gesāwon, hī cwǣdon tō him, Nū þīne leorningcnihtas dōð þæt him ālȳfyd nys restedagun tō dōnne.
12.3: And hē cwæþ tō him, Ne rǣdde gē hwæt Dauid dyde, þā hyne hingrede, and þā ðe mid hym wǣrun;
12.4: hū hē in ēode on Godes hūs, and ǣt þā offringhlāfas þe nǣrun him ālȳfede tō etynne nē þām þe mid him wǣrun, būtun þām sācerdum ānum?
12.5: Oððe ne rǣdde gē on þǣre ǣ þæt þā sācerdas on restedagum on þām temple gewemmað þone restedæg, and synt būtan leahtre?
12.6: Ic secge sōðlīce ēow þæt þēs ys mǣrra þonne þæt templ.
12.7: Gyf gē sōðlīce wistun hwæt ys, Ic wylle mildheortnesse and nā onsægdnysse, ne genyþrude gē ǣfre unscyldige.
12.8: Sōðlīce mannes Sunu ys ēac restedæges hlāfurd.
12.9: Ðā sē Hǣlend þanun fōr, hē cōm intō hyra gesomnunge. ​
12.10: Þā wæs þǣr ān man sē hæfde forscruncene hand. And hī āhsudon hyne þus cweðende, Ys hyt ālȳfed tō hǣlenne on restedagum? þæt hī wrēhton hyne.
12.11: Hē sǣde him sōþlīce, Hwylc man ys of ēow þe hæbbe ān scēap, and gyf þæt āfylþ restedagum on pytt, hū ne nymþ hē þæt and hefþ hyt ūpp?
12.12: Witodlīce micle mā mann ys scēape betera! witodlīce ys ālȳfed on restedagum wel tō dōnne.
12.13: Đā cwæð hē tō þām menn, Āþene þīne hand. And hē hī āþenede; and hēo wæs hāl geworden swā sēo ōþer. Đys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre xiiii. wucan ofer pentecosten.
12.14: Þā sundorhālgan ēodun þā ūt sōþlīce, and worhton geþeaht ongēn hyne hū hī hyne forspildon.
12.15: Sē Hǣlend sōþlīce þæt wiste, and fērde þanon, and him fyligdon mycel mænigeo; and hē hǣlde hig ealle;
12.16: and bebēad him þæt hig hyt nānum men ne sǣdon: ​
12.17: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt þe gecweden wæs þurh Isaiam þone wītegan, þus cweþende,
12.18: Hēr is min cnapa þone ic gecēas, mīn gecorena on þām wel gelīcode mīnre sāwle; ic āsette mīnne Gāst ofer hyne, and dōm hē bodað þēodum.
12.19: Ne flīt hē, nē hē ne hrȳmð; nē nān man ne gehȳrþ hys stemne on strǣton.
12.20: Tōcwȳsed hrēod hē ne forbrytt, and smēocende flex hē ne ādwǣscþ, ǣr þām þe hē āworpe dōm tō sige.
12.21: And on hys naman þēoda gehyhtað. Đys [godspel] sceal on þone þryddan sunnandæg innan lencten.
12.22: Đā wæs him brōht ān dēofolsēoc man sē wæs blind and dumb; and hē hyne hǣlde, swā þæt hē spæc and geseah.
12.23: And þā menigeo ealle wundrudon, and cwǣdon, Cweðe wē is þēs Dauides sunu?
12.24: Sōþlīce þā þā sundorhālgan þis gehȳrdon, þā cwǣdon hig, Ne ādrīfþ ðēs dēoflu ūt, būton þurh Belzebub dēofla ealdre.
12.25: Sē Hǣlend sōþlīce wiste hyra geþancas, and ​ cwæð tō him, Ǣlc rīce þe byð twȳrǣde on him sylfum byþ tōworpen; and ǣlc ceaster oððe hūs þe byð wiþerweard ongēn hyt sylf, hyt ne stent.
12.26: And gyf sē deoful ādrīfð ūt þone dēoful, hig bēoþ tōdǣlede; hū mæg þonne his rīce standan?
12.27: And gyf ic þurh Belzebub ādrīfe ūt dēofla, þurh hwæne ādrīfað ēowre bearn? for þām hig sylfe bēoð ēowre dēman.
12.28: Gyf ic sōþlīce on Godes Gāste āwurpe dēoflu, witodlīce on ēow becymð Godes rīce.
12.29: Oþþe hū mæg man in gān on stranges hūs, and hys fata hyne berēafian, būton hē gebinde ǣrest þone strangan, and þonne hys hūs berēafige? Ðys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre twelftan wucan ofer pentecosten.
12.30: Sē þe nys mid mē, hē is ongēn mē; and sē þe ne gaderaþ mid mē, hē tōwyrpð.
12.31: For þām ic secge ēow, Ǣlc synn and bysmurspǣc byþ forgyfen mannum; sōþlīce þæs Hālgan Gāstes bysmurspǣc ne byð forgyfen.
12.32: And swā hwylc swā cwyð word ongēn mannes Sunu, him byð forgyfen; sē þe sōðlīce cwyþ ongēn Hāligne Gāst, ne byð hyt hym for ​ gyfen, nē on þisse worulde nē on þǣre tōweardan.
12.33: Oþþe wyrceað gōd trēow, and hys wæstm gōdne, oððe wyrceað yfel trēow, and hys wæstm yfelne; witodlīce be þām wæstme byð þæt trēow oncnāwen.
12.34: Lā gē nǣddrena cynryn, hū magon gē gōd sprecan, þonne gē synt yfele? sōþlīce of pǣre heortan willan sē mūþ spicþ.
12.35: Gōd mann sōþlīce of gōdum goldhorde bringþ gōd forð; and yfel mann of yfelum goldhorde bringð yfel forð.
12.36: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow þæt ǣlc īdel word þe menn specað, hī āgyldaþ gescēad be þām on dōmes dæge.
12.37: Sōþlīce of þīnum wordum þū byst gerihtwīsod, and of þīnum wordum þū byst genyðerod. Ðys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre forman lenctenwucan
12.38: Þā andswarodun hym sume þā bōceras and þā sundorhālgan þus cweþende, Lārēow, wē willaþ sum tācn of þē gesēon. ​
12.39: Hē andswarode hym and cwæð, Yfel cnēorys and forliger sēcð tācn; and hyre ne byð nān tācn geseald, būton Ionas tācn þæs wītegan.
12.40: Witodlīce swā swā Ionas wæs on þæs hwæles innoþe þrȳ dāgas and þrēo niht, swā byþ mannes Sunu on eorþan heortan þrȳ dagas and þrēo niht.
12.41: Niniuetisce weras ārīsað on dōme mid þysse cnēorysse, and hig genyþeriað hig; for þām þe hig dydon dǣdbōte on Ionas bodunge; and þēs ys māra þonne Ionas.
12.42: Sūþdǣles cwēn ārīst on dōme mid þysse cnēorysse, and hēo genyþerað hig; for þām ðe hēo cōm fram landes gemǣrum tō gehȳranne Salomones wīsdōm; and þēs is māra þonne Salomon.
12.43: Sōþlīce þonne sē unclǣna gāst ūt færþ fram men, hē gǣð geond drīge stōwa, sēcende rest, and hē ne gemēt.
12.44: Þonne cwyþ hē, Ic gecyrre on mīn hūs þanon ic ūt ēode; and cumende hē gemēt hyt ǣmtig, and geclǣnsod mid besmum, and gefrætwod.
12.45: Ðonne gǣþ hē, and him tō genymþ seofun ōþre gāstas wyrsan þonne hē, and in gangende ​ hig eardigeað þǣr; and þonne wurðaþ þæs mannes ȳtemestan wyrsan þonne þā ǣrran. And swā byð þysse wyrrestan cnēorysse.
12.46: Đā hē þās þing þā gȳt spæc tō þām mænegum, þā stōd hys mōdor and his gebrōðra þǣr ūte, sēcende spæcon tō him.
12.47: Sōþlīce þā cwæþ sum tō him, Witodlīce þīn mōdur and þīne gebrōþra standaþ hēr ūte, þē sēcende.
12.48: And hē andswarode hym secgendum and cwæð, Hwylc ys mīn mōdur? and hwylce synt mīne gebrōþra?
12.49: And hē āþenede hys hand on his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð,
12.50: Witodlīce swā hwylc swā wyrcþ mīnes Fæder willan þe on heofenan is, he is mīn brōþur, and mīn swustor, and mōdor.

13.1: On þām dæge þām Hǣlende ūt gangendum of hūse, hē sæt wiþ ðā sǣ. ​
13.2: And mycle mænigeo wǣron gesamnode tō hym, swā þæt hē ēode on scyp, and þǣr sæt; and eall sēo mænigeo stōd on þām waroþe.
13.3: And hē spræc tō hym fela on bigspellum, cweþende, Sōþlīce ūt ēode sē sǣdere hys sǣd tō sāwenne.
13.4: And þā þā hē sēow, sume hig fēollon wiþ weg; and fuglas cōmun, and ǣton þā.
13.5: Sōþlīce sume fēollon on stǣnihte, þǣr hyt næfde mycle eorþan; and hrædlīce ūp sprungon, for þām þe hig næfdon þǣre eorþan dȳpan.
13.6: Sōþlīce ūp sprungenre sunnan, hig ādrūwudon; and forscruncon, for þām þe hig næfdon wyrtrum.
13.7: Sōþlīce sume fēollon on þornas; and þā þornas wēoxon, and forþrysmudon þā.
13.8: Sume sōþlīce fēollon on gōde eorþan, and sealdon wæstm , sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne, sum þrīttigfealdne.
13.9: Sē þe hæbbe ēaran tō gehȳrenne, gehȳre.
13.10: And þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas, and ​ cwǣdon tō hym, For hwig spycst þū tō hym mid bigspellum?
13.11: Đā andswarode hē hym, For þām þe ēow is geseald tō witanne heofena rīces gerȳnu, and him nys nā geseald.
13.12: Sōþlīce þām þe hæfþ, him byþ geseald, and hē hæfð; sōþlīce sē þe næfð, and þæt þe hē hæfð him bið ætbrōden.
13.13: For ðām ic spece tō him mid bigspellum; for þām þe lōciende hig ne gesēoþ, and gehȳrende hig ne gehȳraþ nē ne ongytaþ:
13.14: þæt on him sī gefylled Esaias wītegung, Of gehȳrnysse gē gehȳraþ, and gē ne ongytaþ; and lōciende gē gesēoþ, and [ gē ] ne gesēoð.
13.15: Sōþlīce þises folces heorte is āhyrd, and hig hefelīce mid ēarum gehȳrdon, and hyra ēagan beclȳsdon; þē lǣs hig ǣfre mid ēagum gesēon, and mid ēarum gehȳron, and mid heortan ongyton, and sīn gecyrrede, and ic hig gehǣle.
13.16: Sōþlīce ēadige synt ēowre ēagan, for þām þe hig gesēoþ; and ēowre ēaran, for þām þe hig gehȳraþ.
13.17: Sōþlīce on eornust ic ēow secge þæt manega wītegan and rihtwīse gewilnudon þā þing tō ​ gesēonne þe gē gesēoþ, and hig ne gesāwon; and gehȳran þā þing þe gē gehȳrað, and hig ne gehȳrdon.
13.18: Gehȳre gē sōþlīce þæs sāwendan bigspell.
13.19: Ǣlc þǣra þe Godes word gehȳrð and ne ongyt, þonne cymþ dēoful and berēafað þæt on hys heortan āsawen is; þæt is sē þe wiþ ðone weg āsawen is.
13.20: Sōþlīce sē þe ofer þone stān āsawen is, þæt is sē þe þæt Godes word gehȳrð, and hrædlīce þæt mid blisse onfēhþ;
13.21: sōþlīce hyt næfþ þone wyrtrum on him, ac is hwīlwendlīc; gewordenre gedrēfednesse and ēhtnesse for þām worde , hrædlīce big bēoð geuntrēowsode.
13.22: Sōþlīce þæt þe āsawen is on þornum, þæt is sē þe þæt word gehȳrþ; and þonne geornfullnes þisse worulde and lēasung þissa woruldwelena forþrysmiaþ þæt word , and hit is būtan wæstme geworden.
13.23: Sōþlīce þæt þe āsawen wæs on þæt gōde ​ land, þæt is sē þe þæt word gehȳrþ and ongyt; and þone wæstm bringð, and þonne dēþ sum hundfealdne, sum sixtigfealdne , sum þrīttigfealdne .
13.24: Hē rehte him þā ōþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofona rīce is geworden þām men gelīc þe sēow gōd sǣd on his æcyre.
13.25: Sōþlīce þā þā men slēpon, þā cōm his fēonda sum, and ofersēow hit mid coccele on middan þām hwǣte, and fērde þanon.
13.26: Sōþlīce þā sēo wyrt wēox, and þone wæstm brōhte, þā ætēowde sē coccel hine.
13.27: Þā ēodon þæs hlāfordes þēowas, and cwǣdon, Hlāford, hū ne sēow þū gōd sǣd on þīnum æcere? hwanon hæfde hē coccel?
13.28: Þā cwæþ hē, Þæt dyde unhold mann. Þā cwǣdon þā þēowas, Wylt þū wē gāð and gadriað hig?
13.29: Þā cwæð hē, Nese, þē lǣs gē þone hwǣte āwurtwalion, þonne gē þone coccel gadriað.
13.30: Lǣtað ǣgþer weaxan oð riptīman; and on þām riptīman ic secge þām rīperum, Gadriaþ ǣrest þone coccel, and bindaþ scēafmǣlum to forbærnenne; and gadriaþ ðone hwǣte intō mīnum berne. ​
13.31: Hē rehte him þā gȳt ōþer bigspel þus cweþende, Heofena rīce is geworden gelīc senepes corne þæt sēow sē man on hys æcre.
13.32: Þæt is ealra sǣda lǣst; sōþlīce þonne hit wyxþ, hit is ealra wyrta mǣst, and hit wyrþ trēow, swā þæt heofnan fuhlas cumaþ and eardiaþ on his bōgum.
13.33: Hē spræc tō him ōþer bigspel and þus cwæð, Heofena rīce is gelīc þām beorman þone þæt wīf onfēng and behȳdde on þrīm gemetum melwes, oð hē wæs eall āhafen.
13.34: Ealle þās þing sē Hǣlend spræc mid bigspellum tō þām weredum, and nān þing ne spræc hē būtan bigspellum:
13.35: þæt wǣre gefylled þæs wītegan cwyde, Ic ātȳne mīnne mūþ mid bigspellum; ic bodige dīgelnesse fram middaneardes gesetednesse.
13.36: Hē forlēt þā ðā mænegeo, and cōm tō his inne; and þā genēalǣhton tō him his leorningcnihtas, and cwǣdon, Ārece ūs þæt bigspell þæs hwǣtes and þæs coccles.
13.37: Þā andswarude hē him, Sē þe sēow þæt gōde sǣd sē is mannes Sunu. ​
13.38: Sōþlīce sē æcyr is þēs middangeard; þæt gōde sǣd, þæt synt þæs heofonlīcan rices bearn; sē coccel synt sōþlīce þā mānfullan bearn.
13.39: Sē unholda man sē þe þone coccel sēow, þæt is dēoful; sōðlīce þæt rip is worulde endung; þā rīperas synt englas.
13.40: Eornustlīce swā swā sē coccel byþ gegaderud and mid fȳre forbærned, swā byð on worulde endunge.
13.41: Mannes Sunu sent his englas, and hī gadriað of his rīce ealle gedrēfednesse, and þā þe unrihtwīsnesse wyrceað,
13.42: and āsendað hig on fȳres ofen; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
13.43: Þonne scīnað ðā rihtwīsan swā swā sunne on hyra Fæder rice. [ Gehȳre, sē ðe ēaran to gehȳranne hæfð .] Đys godspel sceal tō sancta Agnan mæssan.
13.44: Heofona rīce is gelīc gehȳddum goldhorde on þām æcere; þone behȳt sē man þe hyne fint; and for his blysse gǣð and sylþ eall þæt hē āh, and gebigþ þone æcer. ​
13.45: Eft is heofena rīce gelīc þām mangere þe sōhte þæt gōde meregrot;
13.46: þā hē funde þæt ān dēorwyrðe meregrot, þā ēode hē and sealde eall þæt hē āhte, and bohte þæt meregrot.
13.47: Eft is heofena rīce gelīc āsendum nette on þā sǣ, and of ǣlcum fisccynne gadrigendum;
13.48: þā hī þā þæt nett ūpp ātugon, and sǣton be þām strande, þā gecuron hig þā gōdan on hyra fatu; þā yflan hig āwurpon ūt.
13.49: Swā byþ on þisse worulde endunge; þā englas farað and āsyndriað þā yfelan of þǣra gōdra midlene,
13.50: and āworpað hig on þæs fȳres ofen; þǣr byð wōþ and tōða grīstbitung.
13.51: Ongyte gē ealle þās þing? Þā cwǣdon hig, Witodlīce wē hit ongytað.
13.52: Þā sǣde hē him, For þām is ǣlc gelǣred bōcere on heofenan rīce gelīc þām hīredes ealdre þe forð bringð of his goldhorde nīwe þing and ealde.
13.53: And hit wæs geworden, þā sē Hǣlend geendode þās bigspel, þā fērde hē þanone. ​
13.54: And þā hē cōm tō his earde, hē lǣrde hig on hyra gesamnungum, swā þæt hig wundredon and cwǣdon, Hwanon ys þysum þēs wisdōm and þis mægen?
13.55: Witodlīce þēs ys smiþes sunu; hū ne hātte hys mōdor Maria, and hys brōþru Iacob, and Ioseph, and Simon, and Iudas?
13.56: And hū ne synt ealle hys swustra mid ūs? Hwanon synt þisum ealle þās þing?
13.57: And hig wǣron geuntrȳwsode on him. Đā sōþlīce sǣde sē Hǣlend hym, Nys nān wītega būtan wurþscype, būton on hys earde and on hys hūse.
13.58: And hē ne worhte þǣr manega mægena, for hyra ungelēafulnysse.

14.1: On þǣre tīde gehȳrde Herodes sē fēorðan dǣles rīca þæs Hǣlendes hlīsan.
14.2: And þā sǣde hē his cnihtum, Þēs is Iohannes sē fulluhtere þe ic behēafdode; hē ārās of dēaþe; and for þan synd þās wundru gefremode on him. ​
14.3: Sōðlīce Herodes nam Iohannem, and geband hyne, and sette on cwertern for þām wife Herodiaden, Philippes hys brōþer.
14.4: Iohannes him sǣde, Nys þē ālȳfed hī tō wīfe tō hæbbenne.
14.5: And þā hē hyne ofslēan wolde, hē ādrēd him þæt folc, for þām þe hig hæfdon hyne for ǣnne wītegan.
14.6: Đā on Herodes gebyrddæge tumbude þǣre Herodiadiscean dohtur beforan him; and hit līcode Herode.
14.7: Þā behēt hē mid āþe hyre tō syllenne swā hwæt swā hēo hyne bǣde.
14.8: Đā cwæð hēo, fram hyre mēder gemyngod, Syle mē on ānum disce Iohannes hēafod þæs fulluhteres.
14.9: Đā wæs sē cyning geunrēt for þām āðe, and for þām þe him sǣton mid.
14.10: And hē āsende þā, and behēafdode Iohannem on þām cwerterne.
14.11: And man brōhte þā his hēafod on ānum disce, and sealde þām mǣdene, and þæt mǣden hyre mēder.
14.12: And þā genēalǣhton his leorningcnihtas, and ​ nāmon hys līchaman, and bebyrgdon hyne, and cōmon and cȳddon hyt þām Hǣlende.
14.13: Đā sē Hǣlend þæt gehȳrde, þā fērde hē þanon onsundron on ānum scype; and þā þā gangendan mænigeo þæt gehȳrdon, hig fyligdon him of þām burgum.
14.14: And þā hē þanon fērde, hē geseh mycele mænigu; and hē him gemiltsode, and gehǣlde þā untruman.
14.15: Sōðlīce þā hyt wæs ǣfen geworden, him tō genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him tō cwǣdon, Đēos stōw ys wēste, and tīma is forð āgān; forlǣt þās mænegeo þæt hī faron intō þās burga and him mete bicgean.
14.16: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Nabbað hī nēode to farenne; sylle gē him etan.
14.17: Þā andswarodun hig, Wē nabbað hēr būtun fīf hlāfas and twēgen fixas.
14.18: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Bringaþ mē hider þā.
14.19: And þā hē hēt þā menegu ofer þæt gærs hī sittan; and hē nam þā fīf hlāfas and twēgen fixas, and beseah on þone heofon, and blētsiende bræc þā hlāfas, and sealde his leorningcnihtum, and hī þām folce. ​
14.20: And hī ǣton ealle and wǣron gefyllede; and hī nāmon þā lāfa, twelf wylian fulle þǣra gebrytsena.
14.21: Sōþlīce þǣra etendra getæl wæs fīf þūsenda wera, būtan wīfum and cildum. Đys godspel sceal in octabas Petri et Pauli.
14.22: And þā sōna hēt sē Hǣlend his leorningcnihtas on scyp āstīgan, and tōforan him faran ofer þone mūþan, oð þæt hē þā menegu forlēte.
14.23: And þā hē hig forlǣten hæfde, hē ēode on þone munt, and hyne þǣr āna gebæd; sōþlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, hē wæs āna þǣr.
14.24: Witodlīce wæs þæt scyp of þām ȳþum tōtorfod; for þām þe hyt wæs strang wind.
14.25: Þā cōm sē Hǣlend embe þone fēorþan hancrēd tō him, ofer þā sǣ gangende.
14.26: Đā hī gesāwon þæt, hī wurdon þā gedrēfede, and for þām ege clypodon and cwǣdon þus, Sōþlīce hyt ys scīnlāc.
14.27: Đā spræc sē Hǣlend and cwæþ, Habbaþ gelēafan; ic hyt eom; nellen gē ēow ondrǣdan.
14.28: Đā andswarode him Petrus and cwæð, ​ Drihten, gyf þū hyt eart, hāt mē cuman tō þē ofer þās wæteru.
14.29: Đā cwæð hē, Cum tō mē. Đā ēode Petrus of þām scype ofer þæt wæter þæt hē tō þām Hǣlende cōme.
14.30: Þā hē geseh þone strangan wind, hē him ondrēd; ðā hē wearð gedofen, hē cwæð, Drihten, gedō mē hālne.
14.31: And þā hrædlīce hē gefēng hyne, and þus cwæð, Lā lȳtles gelēafan, hwī twȳnedest þū?
14.32: And þā hī wǣron on þām scype, geswāc sē wind.
14.33: Sōþlīce þā þe on þām scype wǣron cōmon, and tō him gebǣdon, and þus cwǣdon, Sōþlīce þū eart Godes Sunu.
14.34: And þā hig ofer segelodon, hī cōmon on þæt land Genesareth.
14.35: And þā þæt folc hyne gecnēow, hī sendon geond eall þæt land, and brōhton tō him ealle untrume;
14.36: and hyne bǣdon þæt hig huruþinga his rēafes fnæd æthrinon; and swā hwylce his æthrinon wurdon hāle.

15.1: Ðā cōmon tō him fram Hierusalem þā bōceras and Fariseisce, and cwǣdon,
15.2: Hwī forgȳmað þīne leorningcnihtas ūre yldrena lage? ne þwēað hī hyra handa, þonne hig mete þicgeað.
15.3: Đā andsworode hē him, And hwī forgȳme gē Godes bebod for ēowre lage?
15.4: Witodlīce God cwæþ, Wurþa þīnne fæder and mōdor; and, Sē þe wyrgð hys fæder and mōdor, swelte sē dēaþe.
15.5: Sōþlīce gē cweðaþ, Swā hwylc swā segð hys fæder and mēder, Swā hwylc lāc swā of mē is fremaþ þē;
15.6: and ne wurðiaþ fæder and mōdor. And gē for nāht dydon Godes bebod for ēowre lage.
15.7: La līcceteras, wel be ēow wītegode Isaias sē wītega, þā hē cwæð, ​
15.8: Þis folc mē mid welerum wurþað, and hyra heorte ys feorr fram mē;
15.9: būtan intingan hig mē wurþiaþ, and lǣrað manna lāra.
15.10: And hē þā, ðām menegum tōgædere geclypedum, þus cwæð, Gehȳrað and ongytaþ:
15.11: ne besmīt þone mann þæt on hys mūþ gǣþ; ac hyne besmīt þæt of hys mūþe gǣþ.
15.12: Þā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and cwǣdon, Wāst þū þæt þā Fariseiscean synt gedrēfede, þisum worde gehȳredum?
15.13: Þā andswarode hē him, Ǣlc plantung þe mīn heofenlīca Fæder ne plantode byþ āwyrtwalod .
15.14: Lǣtað hī; hig synt blinde and blindra lāttēowas. Sē blinda gyf hē blindne lǣt, hig feallað bēgen on ǣnne pytt.
15.15: Đā andswarode him Petrus, Ārece ūs þis bigspell.
15.16: Đā andswarode hē him, And synt gē gȳt būtan andgyte?
15.17: Ne ongyte gē þæt eall þæt on þone mūþ gǣþ gǣþ on þā wambe, and byþ on forþgang āsend? ​
15.18: Sōþlīce þā þing þe of þām mūðe gāþ cumað of þǣre heortan, and þā smītaþ þone mann.
15.19: Of þǣre heortan cumaþ yfle geþancas, mannslyhtas, unrihthǣmedu, forligru, stale, lēase gewitnyssa, tāllīce word:
15.20: þis synt þā ðing þe þone mann besmītað; ne besmīt þone mann, þēah hē unþwogenum handum ete. Đys godspel gebyrað on þone forman þunresdæg innan lenctene.
15.21: And þā fērde sē Hǣlend þanon on Tyrisce and Sydonisce endas.
15.22: And efne þā of þām Chananeiscum gemǣrum clypode sum wīf and cwæð, Drihten, Dauides sunu, gemiltsa mē; mīn dohtor ys yfle mid dēofle gedreht.
15.23: Þā ne geandswarode hē hyre. Þā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas, and him tō cwǣdon, Forlǣt hig; for þām hēo clypað æfter ūs.
15.24: Đā andswarode hē, Ne eom ic āsend, būton tō þām scēapum þe forwurdon of Israhela hūse.
15.25: Đā cōm hēo, and hig tō him gebæd and þus cwæð, Drihten, gefylst mē. ​
15.26: Đā cwæ ð hē, Nys hit nā gōd þæt man nime bearna hlāf and hundum wurpe .
15.27: Þā cwæþ hēo, Drihten, þæt ys sōð; witodlīce þā hwelpas etað of þām crumum þe of hyra hlāforda bēodum feallaþ.
15.28: Þā andswarode Drihten hyre, Ēalā þū wīf, mycel ys þīn gelēafa; gewurþe þē eal swā þū wylle. And þā of þǣre tīde wæs hyre dohtor hāl geworden.
15.29: Đā sē Hǣlend þanon fērde, eft hē cōm wiþ ðā Galileiscean sǣ; and āstāh on þone munt, and þǣr sæt.
15.30: Þā genēalǣhton him tō mycele menegu, mid him hæbbende manega healte, and blinde, and wanhāle, and manega ōþre, and ālēdon tō hys fōtum; and hē gehǣlde þā:
15.31: swā þæt þā mænegu wundredon, gesēonde dumbe specende, healte gangende, blinde gesēonde; and hig mǣrsodon Israhela God. Đys godspel gebyrað on þǣre eahtoðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
15.32: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, tōgædere geclypedum his leorningcnihtum, Đisse menegu ic gemiltsige, for þām hig þrȳ dagas mid mē ​ wunodon, and hig nabbað hwæt hig eton; and ic hig nelle fæstende forlǣtan, þē lǣs hig on wege getēorian.
15.33: Đā cwǣdon hys leorningcnihtas, Hwār nime wē swa fela hlāfa on þīs wēstene, þæt wē gefyllan swā mycele mænegu?
15.34: Þā cwæð hē, Hū fela hlāfa hæbbe gē? Þā cwǣdon hig, Seofon, and fēawa fixa.
15.35: And hē bebēad þā þæt sēo menegu sǣte ofer þǣre eorþan;
15.36: and hē nam þā þā seofon hlāfas and þā fixas, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and hig sealdon þām folce.
15.37: And hig ǣton ealle and wǣron gefyllede; and þæt tō lāfe wæs of þām gebrote hig nāmon, seofon wilian fulle.
15.38: Witodlīce þā [ þe ] þǣr ǣton wǣron fēower þūsend manna, būtan cildum and wīfum.
15.39: And hē forlēt þā þā menegu, and ēode on scyp, and cōm on þā endas Magedan.

16.1: And þā genēalǣhton him tō Farisei and Saducei, and hyne costodon and bǣdon þæt hē him sum tācen of heofone ætȳwde.
16.2: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, On ǣfen gē cweðaþ, Tō morgen hyt byþ smylte weder; þēs heofon ys rēad.
16.3: And on morgen gē cweþað, Tō dæg hyt byþ hrēoh weder; þēos lyft scīnð unwederlīce. Nū cunne gē tōcnāwan heofones hīw; witodlīce gē ne magon witan þǣra tīda tācnu.
16.4: Sēo yfele cnēoryss and unrihthǣmende tācen sēcþ; and hyre ne byð geseald būton Ionas tācen þæs wītegan. And him forlǣtenum, hē fērde.
16.5: And þā his leorningcnihtas cōmon ofer þone mūþan, hig forgēton þæt hig hlāfas nāmon.
16.6: And þā sǣde hē, Gȳmað and warniað fram beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum.
16.7: Þā ðōhton hig betwux him and cwǣdon, [ Ne ] nāmon wē hlāfas mid ūs. ​
16.8: Þā sē Hǣlend wiste hyra geþancas, hē cwæþ tō him, Hwæt þence gē betwux ēow, lȳtles gelēafan, þæt gē hlāfas nabbað?
16.9: Ne understande gē gȳt, nē gē ne geþenceað þǣra fīf hlāfa and fīf þūsend manna, and hū fela wyligena gē nāmon?
16.10: Nē þǣra seofon hlāfa and fēower þūsend manna, and hū fela wyligena gē nāman?
16.11: Hwī ne ongyte gē gȳt þæt ic ne sǣde be hlāfe, Warniað fram ðām beorman Fariseorum and Saduceorum?
16.12: Þā ongēton hig þæt hē ne sǣde, Warniað fram hlāfa beorman, ac fram lāre Fariseorum and Saduceorum. Đys godspel gebyrað on Petres mæssedæg.
16.13: Witodlīce þā cōm sē Hǣlend on þā dǣles Cesareæ Philippi, and āhsode hys leorningcnihtas, Hwæne secgeað menn þæt sȳ mannes Sunu?
16.14: Đā cwǣdon hig, Sume, Iohannem þone fulluhtere; sume, Heliam; sume, Hieremiam, oðþe ān þǣra wītegyna. ​
16.15: Đā sǣde hē, Hwæt secge gē þæt ic sī?
16.16: Đā andswarode him Petrus, Đū eart þæs lyfigendes Godes Sunu.
16.17: Þā andswarode him sē Hǣlend, Ēadig eart þū, Simon, culfran bearn; for þām hit þē ne onwrēah flǣsc nē blōd, ac mīn Fæder þe on heofenum ys.
16.18: And ic secge þē þæt þū eart Petrus, and ofer þisne stān ic timbrige mīne cyricean; and helle gatu ne magon ongēn þā.
16.19: And þē ic sylle heofona rīces cǣgia: and swā hwæt swā þū ofer eorþan gebindst, þæt byþ on heofonum gebunden; and swā hwæt swā þū unbindst ofer eorþan, þæt byð unbunden on heofonum.
16.20: Þā bebēad sē Hǣlend hys leorningcnihtum þæt hig nānum menn ne sǣdon þæt hē wǣre Hǣlend Crīst.
16.21: Syððan hē ongan swutelian hys leorningcnihtum þæt hē wolde faran tō Hierusalem, and fela þinga þolian fram yldrum, and bōcerum, and ealdormannum þǣra sācerda, and bēon ofslegen, and þȳ þryddan dæge ārīsan. ​
16.22: And þā genam Petrus hyne onsundron, and cwæð tō him, Drihten, ne gewurþe þæt.
16.23: Þā beseah hē hyne, and cwæð tō Petre, Gang bæftan mē, Satanas; wiþerrǣde þū eart mē, for þām þū nāst þā þing þe synd Godes, ac þā þe synt manna. Đys godspel sceal on sancte Laurentius mæssedæg.
16.24: Þā sǣde sē Hǣlend hys leorningcnihtum, Gyf hwā wylle fyligean mē, wiþsace hyne sylfne, and nyme hys rōde, and mē fylige.
16.25: Sōþlīce sē þe wyle hys sāwle hāle gedōn, hē hig forspilþ; and sē þe wyle hig for mē forspyllan sē hig fint.
16.26: Hwæt fremað ǣnegum menn, þēah hē ealne middaneard gestrȳne, gyf hē hys sāwle forwyrd þolað? Oððe hwylc gewrixl sylþ sē mann for hys sāwle?
16.27: Witodlīce mannes Sunu ys tō cumenne on hys Fæder wuldre mid hys englum; and þonne āgylt ǣghwylcum be hys āgenum weorce . Đys [godspel] sceal on sæternesdæg on þǣre forman lenctenwucan.
16.28: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Sume synt hēr ​ dende þe dēaþ ne onbyrigeað, ǣr hig gesēon mannes Sunu cumende on hys Fæder rīce.

17.1: And æfter six dagum nam sē Hǣlend Petrum, and Iacobum, and Iohannem hys brōþor, and lǣdde hig onsundron on ǣnne hēahne munt.
17.2: And hē wæs gehīwod beforan him; and his ansȳn scēan swā swā sunne, and hys rēaf wǣron swā hwīte swā snāw.
17.3: And efne þā ætȳwde Moyses and Helias mid him sprecende.
17.4: Þā cwæð Petrus tō him, Drihten, gōd ys ūs hēr tō bēonne; gyf þū wylt, uton wyrcean hēr þrēo eardungstōwa, þē āne, Moyse āne, and Helie āne.
17.5: Him þā gȳt sprecendum, and sōþlīce þā beorht wolcn hig oferscēan; and þā efne cōm stefn of þām wolcne and cwæþ, Hēr ys mīn lēofa Sunu on þām mē wel gelīcaþ; gehȳrað hyne.
17.6: And þā hig þis gehȳrdon hys leorningcnihtas, hig fēollon on hyra ansȳne, and hym swȳþe ādrēdon.
17.7: Hē genēalǣhte þā and hig æthrān, and him tō cwæþ, Ārīsað, and ne ondrǣdaþ ēow. ​
17.8: Đā hig hyra ēagan ūpp hōfon, ne gesāwon hig nǣnne būton þone Hǣlend sylfne.
17.9: And þā hig of ðām munte ēodon, sē Hǣlend hym bebēad and þus cwæþ, Nānum menn ne secgean gē þis, ǣr mannes Sunu of dēaþe ārīse. Đys [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg on þǣre fīftan wucan ofer pentecosten.
17.10: And þā āxodon hys leorningcnihtas hyne, Hwæt secgeað þā bōceras þæt gebyrige ǣrest cuman Heliam?
17.11: Đā andswarode hē hym, Witodlīce Helias ys tōweard, and hē geednīwað ealle þing.
17.12: Sōþlīce ic ēow secge þæt Helias cōm, and hig hyne ne gecnēowon; ac hig dydon ymbe hyne swā hwæt swā hig woldon. And swā ys mannes Sunu ēac fram him tō þrowigenne.
17.13: Đā ongēton hys leorningcnihtas þæt hē hyt sǣde be Iohanne þām fulluhtere. Đys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg tō þām fæstene ǣr hærfestes emnyhte.
17.14: And þā hē cōm tō þǣre menegu, him tō genēalǣhte sum mann, gebīgedum cnēowum tōforan him, and cwæþ, ​
17.15: Drihten, gemiltsa mīnum suna, for þām þe hē ys fyllesēoc, and yfel þolað; oft hē fylþ on fȳr, and gelōmlīce on wæter.
17.16: And ic brōhte hyne tō þīnum leorningcnihtum, and hig ne mihton hyne gehǣlan.
17.17: Đā andswarode hē him, Ēalā gē ungelēaffulle and þwȳre cnēores, hū lange bēo ic mid ēow? hū lange forbere ic eow? bringað hyne tō mē hider.
17.18: And þā þrēade sē Hǣlend hyne, and sē dēofol hyne forlēt; and sē cnapa wæs of þǣre tīde gehǣled.
17.19: Đā genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas him tō, and him tō cwǣdon dīglīce, Hwī ne mihte wē hyne ūt ādrīfan?
17.20: Þā cwæð hē for hyra ungelēafulnesse, Sōþlīce on eornost ic ēow secge, Gyf gē hæfdon gelēafan swā senepes corn, and gē cwǣdon tō þissum munte, Far heonone, þonne fērde hē; and ēow ne byð ǣnig þing unmihtelīc.
17.21: Sōþlīce þis cynn ne byþ ūt ādryfen, būton þurh gebed and fæsten.
17.22: Đā hig wunedon on Galilea, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Mannes Sunu ys tō syllenne on manna handa; ​
17.23: and hig ofslēað hyne, and hē ārīst on þām þriddan dæge. Đā wurdon hig þearle geunrōtsode.
17.24: And þā hē cōm tō Cafarnaum, þā genēalǣhton tō Petre þā þe gafol nāmon, and þus cwǣdon, Ēower lārēow ne gylt hē gafol?
17.25: Þā cwæð hē, Gyse, hē dēð. And þā hē cōm intō þām hūse, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Hwæt þincð þē, Symon? æt hwām nimað cyningas gafol oððe toll? of hyra bearnum, hwæðer ðe of fremedum?
17.26: Đā cwæþ hē, Of fremedum. Þā cwæð hē, Eornostlīce þā bearn synt frīge.
17.27: Þēah hwæþere þæt wē hī ne geunrōtsigeon, gang tō þǣre sǣ, and wurp þīnne angel ūt, and nim þone ǣrestan fisc, and hys mūþ geopena; þū fintst ǣnne wecg on him; nim þone, and syle for mē and for þē.

18.1: On þǣre tīde genēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas tō þām Hǣlende, and cwǣdon, Hwa wēnst þū ys yldra on heofena rīce? ​
18.2: And ðā clypode sē Hǣlend ǣnne lȳtling, and gesette on hyra midlen,
18.3: and cwæþ, Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Būton gē bēon gecyrrede, and gewordene swā swā lȳtlingas, ne gā gē on heofena rīce.
18.4: Swā hwylc swā hyne geēaþmēt swā þēs lȳtling, sē ys māra on heofena rīce.
18.5: And swā hwylc swā ānne þilīcne lȳtling on mīnum naman onfēhþ, sē onfēhþ mē.
18.6: Sōþlīce sē þe beswīcð ǣnne of ðyssum lȳtlingum þe on mē gelȳfað, betere him ys þæt ān cwyrnstān sī tō hys swȳran gecnytt, and sī besenced on sǣs grund.
18.7: Wā þysum middangearde þurh swicdōmas! Nēod ys þæt swycdōmas cumon; þēah hwæðere wā þām menn þe swycdōm þurh hyne cymð!
18.8: Gyf þīn hand oððe þīn fōt þē swicað, āceorf hyne of, and āwurp fram þē; betere þē ys þæt þū gā wanhāl oþþe healt tō līfe, þonne þū hæbbe twā handa and twēgen fēt and sȳ on ēce fȳr āsend.
18.9: And gyf þīn ēage þē swicað, āhola hyt ūt, and āwurp hyt fram þē; betere þē ys mid ānum ēagan ​ on līfe tō gānne, þonne þū sī mid twām āsend on helle fȳr.
18.10: Warniað þæt gē ne oferhogian ǣnne of þysum lȳtlingum þe gelȳfað on mē.
18.11: Sōðlīce mannes Sunu cōm tō gehǣlenne þæt forwearð.
18.12: Hwæt ys ēow geþūht? gyf hwylc mann hæfð hund scēapa, and him losað ān of þām, hū ne forlǣt hē þā nigon and hundnigontig on þām muntum, and gǣð and sēcþ þæt ān þe forwearð?
18.13: And gyf hyt gelimpþ þæt hē hyt fint, sōðlīce ic ēow secge þæt hē swȳdor geblissaþ for þām ānum, þonne ofer þā nigon and hundnigontig þe nā ne losedon.
18.14: Swā nys willa beforan ēowrum Fæder þe on heofenum ys, þæt ān forwurþe of þisum lȳtlingum. Đis [godspel] sceal on tīwesdæg on þǣre þryddan lenctenwucan.
18.15: Sōþlīce gyf þīn brōþor syngað wið þē, gā and stȳr him betwux þē and him sylfum; gyf hē þē gehȳrð, þū gestaþelast þīnne brōþor.
18.16: Gyf hē þē ne gehȳrþ, nim þonne gȳt ǣnne ​ oððe twēgen tō þē, þæt ǣlc word stande on twēgra oððe þrēora gewittnesse.
18.17: Gyf hē hig ne gehȳrþ, sege hyt gefērrǣddene; gyf hē hig ne gehȳrð, sī hē þē swā swā hǣþen and mānfull.
18.18: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Swā hwylce swā gē gebindað ofer eorþan, þā bēoþ gebundene on heofonum; and swā hwylce swā gē ofer eorþan unbindaþ, þā bēoþ on heofonum unbundene.
18.19: Eft ic ēow secge, Gyf twēgen of ēow geþwǣriað ofer eorþan be ǣlcum þinge þe hig biddað, hit gewurð him of mīnum Fæder þe on heofonum ys.
18.20: Đǣr twēgen oððe þrȳ synt on mīnum naman gegaderode, þǣr ic eom on hyra midlene.
18.21: Đā genēalǣhte Petrus tō him, and cwæð, Drihten, gyf mīn brōþor syngaþ wið mē, mōt ic him forgyfan oð seofon sīþas?
18.22: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Ne secge ic þē, Oð seofon sīþas; ac, Oð seofon hundseofontigon sīþon. ​ Đys [godspel] sceal on þǣre xxiii. wucan ofer pentecosten.
18.23: For þām ys heofena rīce anlīc þām cyninge þe hys þēowas gerādegode.
18.24: And þā hē þæt gerād sette, him wæs ān brōht sē him sceolde tȳn þūsend punda.
18.25: And þā hē næfde hwanon hē hyt āgulde, hyne hēt hys Hlāford gesyllan, and hys wīf, and hys cild, and eall þæt hē āhte.
18.26: Þā āstrehte sē þēow hyne, and cwæð, Hlāford, gehafa geþyld on mē, and ic hyt þē eall āgylde.
18.27: Þā gemiltsode sē hlāford him, and forgeaf him þone gylt.
18.28: Þā sē þēowa ūt ēode, hē gemētte hys efenþēowan sē him sceolde ān hund penega; and hē nam hyne þā and forþrysmede hyne, and cwæð, Āgyf þæt þū mē scealt.
18.29: And þā āstrehte hys efenþēowa hyne, and bæd hyne and þus cwæð, Geþyldega, and ic hyt þē eall āgyfe.
18.30: Hē ðā nolde; ac fērde and wearp hyne on cweartern, oð ðæt hē him eall āgēfe.
18.31: Đā gesāwon hys efenþēowas þæt, ðā wurdon hig swȳðe geunrōtsode, and cōmon and sǣdon hyra hlāforde ealle þā dǣde. ​
18.32: Đā clypode hys hlāford hyne, and cwæþ tō him, Ēalā þū lȳþra þēowa, eallne þīnne gylt ic ðē forgeaf, for þām þe ðū mē bǣde;
18.33: hū ne gebyrede þē gemiltsian þīnum efenðēowan, swā swā ic þē gemiltsode?
18.34: Đā wæs sē hlāford yrre, and sealde hyne þām wītnerum, oð þæt hē eall āgulde.
18.35: Swā dēþ mīn sē heofonlīca Fæder, gyf gē of ēowrum heortum ēowrum brōðrum ne forgyfaþ.

19.1: And þā sē Hǣlend geendode þās sprǣca, hē fērde fram Galilea and cōm on Iudeisce endas begeondan Iordanen.
19.2: And hym fyligdon mycele mænegu, and hē hig gehǣlde þǣr.
19.3: Đā genēalǣhton him to Farisei, hyne costnigende, and cwǣdon, Is ālȳfed ǣnegum menn hys wīf tō forlǣtenne for ǣnegum þinge?
19.4: Đā andswarode hē him, Ne rǣdde gē, Sē þe on fruman worhte, hē worhte wǣpmann and wīfmann,
19.5: and cwæþ, For þām sē mann forlǣtt fæder ​ and mōdor, and hyne tō his wīfe geþēot; and bēoð twēgen on ānum flǣsce?
19.6: Witodlīce ne synt hig twēgen, ac ān flǣsc. Ne getwǣme nān mann þā ðe God gesomnode.
19.7: Đā cwǣdon hig, Hwī hēt Moyses syllan hīwgedāles bōc, and hig forlǣton?
19.8: Đā cwæð hē, Moyses for ēower heortan heardnesse lȳfde ēow ēower wīf tō forlǣtenne; [ sōðlīce næs hyt on frymðe swā .]
19.9: Sōþlīce ic secge ēow, Swā hwā swā forlǣtt hys wīf, būton for forligere, and ōþer fetað, sē unrihthǣmð; and sē ðe forlǣtene æfter him nymð sē unrihthǣmð.
19.10: Đā cwǣdon hys leorningcnihtas, Gyf hyt swā ys þām menn mid hys wīfe, ne fremað nānum menn tō wīfienne.
19.11: Đā cwæþ hē, Ne underfōð ealle menn þis word, ac þām þe hyt geseald ys.
19.12: Sōþlīce synd belistnode þe of hyra mōdor innoþum cumað; and eft synd belistnode [ þā men þe man belistenað; and eft synd belistnode ] þe ​ hig sylfe belistnodon for heofena rīce. Undernyme, sē þe undernyman mæge.
19.13: Þā wǣron him gebrōhte lȳtlingas tō þæt hē hys hand on hig āsette and hig geblētsode; þā þrēadon hys leorningcnihtas hig.
19.14: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lǣtað þā lȳtlingas, and nelle gē hig forbēodan cuman tō me; swylcra ys heofena rīce.
19.15: And þā hē him hys handa on āsette, þā fērde hē þanon.
19.16: And þā genēalǣhte him ān mann tō, and cwæþ, Lā gōda Lārēow, hwæt gōdes dō ic þæt ic ēce līf hæbbe?
19.17: Đā cwæþ hē, Hwæt āxast þū mē be gōde; ān God ys gōd; sōþlīce gyf þū wylt on līf becuman, heald þā beboda.
19.18: Đā cwæþ hē, Hwylce? Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Ne dō þū mannslyht; Ne dō þū unrihthǣmed; Ne stel þū; Ne sege þū lēase gewittnysse;
19.19: Wurða þīnne fæder and mōdor; and, Lufa þīnne nēhstan swā þē sylfne.
19.20: Þā cwæð sē geonga, Eall þiss ic gehēold; hwæt ys mē gȳt wana? ​
19.21: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Gyf þū wylt bēon fullfremed, gā and becȳp eall þæt þū āhst, and syle hyt þearfum, and þonne hæfst þū goldhord on heofone; and cum and folga mē.
19.22: Đā sē geonga mann gehȳrde þis word, þā ēode hē aweg unrōt; sōþlīce hē hæfde mycele ǣhta.
19.23: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hys leorningcnihtum, Sōþlīce ic ēow secge, Þæt earfoðlīce sē welega gǣð on Godes rīce.
19.24: And eft ic ēow secge, Þæt eaðelīcre byð þām olfende tō gānne þurh nǣdle ēage, þonne sē welega on heofona rīce gā.
19.25: Đā hys leorningcnihtas þis gehȳrdon, hig wundrodun and cwǣdon, Hwā mæg þis gehealdan?
19.26: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Unēaþelīc þæt ys mid mannum; ac ealle þing synt mid Gode ēaþelīce. Đys [godspel] sceal tō sancte Paulus mæssedæge, and tō sancte Benedictus.
19.27: Đā andswarode Petrus and cwæð, Nū wē forlēton ealle þing , and folgodon þē; hwæt byð ūs tō mēde? ​
19.28: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Sōþ ic ēow secge þæt gē þe mē folgodon, on edcenninge þonne mannes Sunu sitt on hys mægenþrymme, þæt gē sittað ofer twelf setl, dēmende twelf mǣgða Israhel.
19.29: And ǣlc þe forlǣt for mīnum naman hys hūs, oððe hys gebrōþru, oððe swustra, oþþe fæder, oþþe mōdor, oððe wīf, oþþe bearn, oððe land, be hundfealdon hē onfēhþ lēan, and hæfð ēce līf.
19.30: Sōþlīce manega fyrmeste bēoð ȳtemeste, and ȳtemeste fyrmeste.

20.1: Sōþlīce heofona rīce ys gelīc þām hīredes ealdre þe on ǣrne mergen ūt ēode āhȳrian wyrhtan on hys wīngeard.
20.2: Gewordenre gecwydrǣdene þām wyrhtum [ þæt ] hē sealde ǣlcon ǣnne penig wiþ hys dæges worce, hē āsende hig on hys wīngeard.
20.3: And þā hē ūt ēode embe underntīde, hē geseah ōþre on strǣte īdele standan. ​
20.4: Đā cwæð hē, gā gē on mīnne wīngeard, and ic sylle ēow þæt riht byþ; and hig þā fērdon.
20.5: Eft hē ūt ēode embe þā sixtan and [ þā ] nigoþan tīde, and dyde þām swā gelīce.
20.6: Þā embe þā endlyftan tīde hē ūt ēode, and funde ōþre standende; and þā sǣde hē, Hwī stande gē hēr eallne dæg īdele?
20.7: Þā cwǣdon hig, For þām þe ūs nān mann ne hȳrode. Đā cwæð hē, And gā gē on mīnne wīngeard.
20.8: Sōþlīce þā hyt wæs æfen geworden, þā sǣde sē wīngeardes hlāford hys gerēfan, Clypa þā wyrhtan, and āgyf him heora mēde; āgynn fram þām ȳtemestan oþ þone fyrmestan.
20.9: Eornostlīce þā ðā gecōmon þe embe þā endlyftan tīde cōmon, þā onfēngon hig ǣlc his pening.
20.10: And þā þe þǣr ǣrest cōmon wēndon þæt hig sceoldon māre onfōn; þā onfēngon hig syndrige penegas.
20.11: Đā ongunnon hig murcnian ongēn þone hīredes ealdor,
20.12: and þus cwǣdon, Þās ȳtemestan worhton ​ āne tīde, and þū dydest hig gelīce ūs þe bǣron byrþena on þises dæges hǣtan.
20.13: Đā cwæð hē andswarigende hyra ānum, Ēalā þū frēond, ne dō ic þē nǣnne tēonan; hū ne cōme þū tō mē tō wyrceanne wið ānum penige?
20.14: Nim þæt þīn ys, and gā; ic wylle þysum ȳtemestan syllan eal swā mycel swā þē.
20.15: Oþþe ne mōt ic dōn þæt ic wylle? hwæþer þe þīn ēage mānful ys, for þām þe ic gōd eom?
20.16: Swā bēoð þā fyrmestan ȳtemeste, and þā ȳtemestan fyrmeste; sōþlīce manega synt geclypede, and fēawa gecorene. Đys godspel gebyrað on wōdnesdæg on þǣre ōðre lenctenwucan.
20.17: Đā fērde sē Hǣlend tō Hierusalem, and nam hys leorningcnihtas onsundron, and þus cwæð,
20.18: Nū wē farað tō Hierusalem; and mannes Sunu byþ geseald þǣra sācerda ealdrum and bōcerum, and hig genyþeriað hyne tō dēaþe,
20.19: þēodum tō bysmrigenne, and tō swingenne, and to āhōnne; and þām þryddan dæge hē ārīst.
20.20: Đā cōm tō him Zebedeis bearna mōdor mid ​ hyre bearnum, hig geēadmēdende and sum þing fram him biddende.
20.21: Þā cwæð hē, Hwæt wylt tū? Đā cwæð hēo, Sege þæt þās mīne twēgen suna sittan, ān on þīne swīþran healfe and ān on þīne wynstran, on þīnum rīce.
20.22: Đā andswarode him sē Hǣlend, Gyt nyton hwæt gyt biddaþ. Mage gyt drincan þone calic ðe ic tō drincenne hæbbe? Þā cwǣdon hig, Wyt magon.
20.23: Đā cwæð hē, Witodlīce gyt mīnne calic drincaþ; tō sittanne on mīne swīþran healfe, oððe on wynstran, nys mē inc tō syllanne, ac þām þe hyt fram mīnum Fæder gegearwod ys.
20.24: And þā ðā tȳn leorningcnihtas gebulgon wiþ ðā twēgen gebrōðru.
20.25: Þā clypode sē Hǣlend hig tō him, and cwæð, Wite gē þæt ealdormenn wealdað hyra þēoda, and þā ðe synt yldran habbað anweald on him.
20.26: Ne byþ swā betweox ēow; ac swā hwylc swā wyle betweox ēow bēon yldra, sȳ hē ēower þēn;
20.27: and sē þe wyle betweox ēow bēon fyrmest, sȳ hē ēower þēow: ​
20.28: swā mannes Sunu ne cōm þæt him man þēnode, ac þæt hē þēnode, and sealde his sāwle līf tō ālȳsednesse for manegum.
