Gē wilniað tō geþēonne on gehwǣdum þinge, and bēon gewanod on þām mǣstan þinge. Witodlīce þonne gē tō gerēorde gelaþode bēoð, ne sitte gē on þām fyrmestan setlum, þē læs þe ārwurðra wer æfter þē cume, and sē hūsbōnda hāte þē ārīsan and rȳman þām ōðron, and þū bēo gescynd; gyf þū sitst on gerēorde on þām ȳtemestan setle, and æfter þē cymþ ōþer gebēor, and sē laþigenda cweþe tō þe, Site innor, lēof, þonne byþ ðē ārwurðlīcor þonne þē man ūttor scufe. Đys [godspel] sceal on sæternesdæg on þǣre pentecostenes wucan tō þām ymbrene.
20.29: And þā hig fērdon fram Hiericho, him fyligde mycel menegu.
20.30: And þā sǣton twēgen blinde wiþ ðone weg, and gehȳrdon þæt sē Hǣlend fērde; and þā clypodon hig tō him and cwǣdon, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.
20.31: Đā bēad sēo menegu him þæt hig suwodon; ​ þā clypodon hig þæs ðē mā, Drihten, gemiltsa unc, Dauides sunu.
20.32: Þā stōd sē Hǣlend, and clypode hig tō him, and cwæð, Hwæt wylle gyt þæt ic inc dō?
20.33: Đā cwǣdon hig, Drihten, þæt uncre ēagan sīn geopenode .
20.34: Đā gemiltsode hē him, and hyra ēagan æthrān; and hig sōna gesāwon, and fyligdon him.

21.1: And þā hē genēalǣhte Hierusalem, and cōm tō Bethfage, tō Oliuetes dūne, þā sende hē hys twēgen leorningcnihtas,
21.2: And sǣde him, Farað on þæt castel þæt foran ongēn ēow ys, and þonne sōna finde gyt āne assene getiggede and hyre folan mid hyre; untīgeað hig, and lǣdað to mē.
21.3: And gyf hwā ēow ǣnig þing tō cwyð, secgeað þæt Drihten hæfð þyses nēode; and þonne forlǣt hē ēow hrædlīce.
21.4: Eall þis wæs geworden þæt wǣre gefylled þæt þurh Esaiam þone wītegan gecweden wæs, ​
21.5: Secgeað hēahnesse dehter, Nū þīn Cyning þē cymð tō, gedæfte, and rīt uppan tamre assene, and hyre folan.
21.6: Þā fērdon hys leorningcnihtas and dydon swā hē him bebēad,
21.7: and lǣddon þā assene tō him and hyre folan, and lēdon hyra rēaf uppan hig, and setton hyne anuppan.
21.8: Witodlīce þæt folc strehton hyra rēaf on þone weg; sume hēowun þǣra trēowa bōgas, and strewodun on þone weg.
21.9: Þæt folc þæt þār beforan fērde and þæt þār æfter fērde clypodon and cwǣdon, Hāl sȳ þū, Dauides sunu; sȳ geblētsod sē þe cōm on Drihtenes naman; sȳ him hǣl on hēhnessum!
21.10: Đā hē fērde tō Ierusalem, þā wearð eall sēo burhwaru onstyred, and cwǣdon, Hwæt is þēs?
21.11: Þā cwæð þæt folc, Þis ys sē Hǣlend, wītega, of Nazareth on Galilea .
21.12: Þā sē Hǣlend intō þām temple ēode, hē ādrāf ūt ealle þā þe cēapodun innan þām temple, and þāra mynetera sceamelas and hyra setlu þāra þe culfran sealdon hē tōbræc; ​
21.13: and cwæþ tō him, Hyt ys āwriten, Mīn hūs ys gebedhūs; witodlīce gē worhtun þæt tō þēofa cote.
21.14: Đā ēodan tō him þā blindan and þā healtan; and hē hī gehǣlde.
21.15: Witodlīce þā ðāra sācerda ealdras and þā bōceras gesāwun þā wundru þe sē Hǣlend worhte, and gehȳrdon hū þā cild clypodun on þām temple and cwǣdon, Sȳ Dauides sunu hāl! ðā wǣron hig yrre,
21.16: and cwǣdun, Gehȳrst þū hwæt þās cweðaþ? Þā cwæð hē, Witodlīce; ne rǣddon gē nǣfre, Þū fulfremedest lof of cilda and of sūcendra mūþe?
21.17: And hē forlēt hī þā, and fērde of þǣre byrig tō Bethania, and lǣrde hī þār be Godes rīce.
21.18: On morgen þā hē eft tō þǣre byrig fōr, þā hingrede hyne.
21.19: And hē geseh ān fīctrēow wið þone weg; þā ēode hē tō him, and ne funde on him būton þā lēaf āne; ðā cwæð hē, Ne wurþe nǣfre wæstm of þē ācenned. Đā sōna forscranc þæt fīctrēow.
21.20: And his leorningcnihtas wundrodon and ​ cwǣdon, Lōca, nū hū hrædlīce þæt fīctrēow forscranc!
21.21: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Gyf gē habbað gelēafan and ne twȳniað, ne dō gē nā þæt ān be þām fīctrēowe, ac ēac þēh gē cweþan tō þisum munte, Āhefe þē ūpp and feall innan þā sǣ,
21.22: and ealles þæs þe gē biddaþ gē bēoð tīþa, gyf gē gelȳfað. Đys [godspel] sceal on wōdnesdæg on þǣre fīftan wucan ofer pentecosten.
21.23: Đā hē cōm intō þām temple, þā cōmon þāra sācerda ealdras him tō, and cwǣdon, On hwylcre mihte wyrcsð þū þās þing? and hwā sealde þē þisne anweald?
21.24: Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, And ic āhsige ēow ānre sprǣce; gyf gē mē þā sprǣce secgeað, þonne secge ic ēow on hwylcum anwealde ic þās þing wyrce.
21.25: Hwæðer wæs Iohannes fulluht? þe of heofonum, þe of mannum? Đā cwǣdon hig betwux him, Gyf wē secgaþ, Of heofone, þonne cwyð hē, For hwām ne gelȳfde ge him? ​
21.26: Gyf wē secgað, Of mannum, wē ondrǣdað þis folc; ealle hig hæfdon Iohannem for ānne wītegan.
21.27: Đā andswaredon hig and cwǣdon, Wē nyton. Þā cwæð hē, Nē ic ēow ne secge of hwylcum anwealde ic þās þing wyrce.
21.28: Hū þincð ēow? Ān mann hæfde twēgen suna; þā cwæð hē tō þām yldran suna, Gā and wyrce tō dæg on mīnum wīngearde .
21.29: Đā cwæð hē, Ic nelle; ēode þēh syðþan tō þām wingearde .
21.30: Þā cwæð hē eal swā tō þām ōðrum. Đā andswarode sē him and cwæð, Hlāford ic gā; and ne ēode swā þēah.
21.31: Hwæðer þāra twēgra dyde þæs fæder willan? Þā cwǣdon hig, Sē æftera. Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Sōð ic ēow secge þæt mānfulle and myltystran gāð beforan ēow on Godes rīce.
21.32: Iohannes cōm on rihtwīsnesse wege, and gē ne gelȳfdon him; witodlīce mānfulle and myltystran gelȳfdon; and gē gesāwon, and ne dydon syðþan nāne dǣdbōte þæt gē gelȳfdon on him. ​ Đys [godspel] sceal on þǣre ōðre wucan innan lenctene on frīgedæg.
21.33: Gehȳrað nū ōþer bigspel: Sum hīredes ealdor wæs sē plantode wingeard , and betȳnde hyne, and sette þǣr on wīnwringan, and getimbrode ānne stȳpel, and gesette þone mid eorþtylion; and fērde on elþēodignysse.
21.34: Þā ðāra wæstma tīd genēalǣhte, þā sende hē hys þēowas tō þām eorðtylion þæt hig onfēngon his wæstmas.
21.35: Đā nāmon hig hys þēowas, and swungon sumne, sumne hig ofslōgun, sumne hig oftorfodun.
21.36: Đā sende hē eft ōðre þēowas sēlran þonne þā ǣrran wǣron; ðā dydon hig þām gelīce.
21.37: Æt nēhstan hē sende hys sunu him tō, and cwæð, Hig forwandiað þæt hig ne dōn mīnum suna swā.
21.38: Witodlīce þā ðā tylian þone sunu gesāwun, þā cwǣdon hig betwyx him, Đēs ys yrfenuma; uton gān and ofslēan hyne, and habban ūs hys ǣhta.
21.39: Đā nāmon hig and ofslōgon hyne, and āwurpon wiðūtan þone wīngeard. ​
21.40: Hwæt dēþ ðēs wīngeardes hlāford þām eorþtylion, þonne hē cymð?
21.41: Đā cwǣdon hig, Hē fordēð þā yfelan mid yfele, and gesett hys wingeard myd ōþrum tilion þe him hys wæstm hyra tīdon āgyfon.
21.42: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlynd, Ne rǣdde gē nǣfre on gewritum, Sē stān þe ðā timbriendan āwurpon ys geworden tō þǣre hyrnan hēafde; ðys ys fram Drihtne gewordyn, and hyt ys wundorlīc on ūrum ēagum.
21.43: For þām ic secge ēow þæt ēow byð ætbrōden Godes rīce, and byð geseald þǣre þēode þe hys earnað.
21.44: And sē þe fylþ uppan þysne stān, hē byð tobrȳsed; and hē tōbrȳsð þone ðe hē onuppan fylð.
21.45: Þā þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā Pharisei hys bigspel gehȳrdon, þā ongēton hig þæt hē hit sǣde be him.
21.46: Hī sōhton hyne, and ondrēdon þæt folc, for þām þe hī hæfdon hyne for ǣnne wītegan.

22.1: Đā sǣde hē hym eft ōðer bigspel and þus cwæð,
22.2: Heofona rīce ys gelīc geworden þām cyninge þe macude hys suna gyfta ,
22.3: and sende his þēowas and clypode þā gelaðodan tō þām gyftum; þā noldon hī cuman.
22.4: Đā sende hē eft ōðere þēowas, and sǣde þām gelaþedon, Nū ic gegearwode mīne feorme; mīne fearras and mīne fugelas synt ofslegene, and ealle mīne þing synt gearwe; cumað tō þām gyftum.
22.5: Đā forgȳmdon hig þæt, and fērdun, sum tō his tūne, sum tō hys mangunge .
22.6: And þā ōþre nāmon hys þēowas, and mid tēonan geswencton, and ofslōgon.
22.7: Đā sē cyning þæt gehȳrde, þā wæs hē yrre; and sende hys here tō, and fordyde þā manslagan, and hyra burh forbærnde.
22.8: Þā cwæð hē tō hys þēowum, Witodlīce þās ​ gyfta synt gearwe , ac þā ðe gelaþode wǣron ne synt wyrþe.
22.9: Gāð nū witodlīce to wega gelǣtum, and clypiað to þisum gyftum swā hwylce swā gē gemēton.
22.10: Đā ēodon þā þēowas ūt on þā wegas, and gegaderedon ealle ðā þe hig gemētton, gōde and yfele; þā wǣrun þā gyfthūs mid sīttyndum mannum gefyllede.
22.11: Đā ēode sē cyning in þæt hē wolde gesēon þā ðe þǣr sǣton, þā geseah hē þǣr ǣnne mann þe næs mid gyftlīcum rēafe gescrȳd;
22.12: þā cwæð hē, Lā frēond, hūmeta ēodest þū in, and næfdest gyftlīc rēaf? Đā gesuwode hē.
22.13: And sē cyning cwæþ tō hys þēnon, Gebindað hys handa and hys fēt, and wurpaþ hyne on þā ūttran þȳstro; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.
22.14: Witodlīce manega synt gelaþode, and fēawa gecorene. Đys godspel sceal on xxiii. wucan ofer pentecosten.
22.15: Đā ongunnon þā Pharisei rǣdan þæt hig woldon þone Hǣlend on hys sprǣce befōn. ​
22.16: Þā sendon hī him hyra leorningcnihtas tō mid þām Herodianiscum, and þus cwǣdon, Lārēow, wē witon þæt þū eart sōðfæst, and þū lǣrst Godes weg mid sōðfæstnysse, and ðū ne wandest for nānon menn, nē þū ne bescēawast nānes mannes hād.
22.17: Sege ūs, Hwæt þincð þē? ys hyt ālȳfed þæt man Cāsere gaful sylle, þe na?
22.18: Þā sē Hǣlend hyra fācn gehȳrde, þā cwæð hē, Lā līcceteras, hwī fandige gē mīn?
22.19: Ætȳwað mē þæs gafoles mynyt. Đā brōhton hī him ānne pening .
22.20: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Hwæs anlīcnys ys þis and ðis ofergewrit?
22.21: Hig cwǣdon, Þæs Cāsyres. Đā cwæð hē, Āgyfað þām Cāsere þā þing þe ðæs Cāsyres synt, and Gode þā ðing þe Godes synt.
22.22: Þā hig þæt gehȳrdon, þā wundrodon hig, and forlēton hyne, and fērdon on weg.
22.23: On þām dæge cōmon tō him Saducei, þā secgeað þæt nān ǣryst ne sȳ, and hig āxodon hyne,
22.24: and cwǣdon, Lāreow, Moyses sǣde gif ​ hwā dēad syg, and bearn næbbe, þæt his brōðor nyme hys wīf, and strȳne him bearn.
22.25: Witodlīce mid ūs wǣrun seofun gebrōþru; and sē forma fette wīf, and forð fērde, and lǣfde hys brēþer his wīf būtan bearne;
22.26: and sē ōðer eal swā, and sē þrydda, oþ ðone seofoþan.
22.27: Þā æt sīþemestan forþ fērde þæt wīf.
22.28: Hwylces þǣra seofona byð þæt wīf on þām ǣriste? ealle hig hæfdon hig.
22.29: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend hym and cwæð, Gē dweliað, and ne cunnon hālige gewritu, nē Godes mægen.
22.30: Witodlīce ne wīfiað hig, nē hig ne ceorliað on þām ǣryste, ac hig synt swylce Godes englas on heofone.
22.31: Ne rǣdde gē be dēadra manna ǣryste þæt ēow fram Gode gesǣd wæs,
22.32: Ic eom Abrahames God, and Isaaces God, and Iacobes God? Nys God nā dēadra, ac lybbyndra.
22.33: Þā þæt folc þæt gehȳrde, þā wundrudon hig hys lāre. ​ Đys [godspel] sceal on þǣre wucan ofer pentecosten.
22.34: Þā þā Phariseiscean gehȳrdon þæt hē hēt þā Saduceiscan stylle bēon, þā ēodon hig tōgædere.
22.35: And ān þe wæs þǣre ǣ lārēow āxode hyne, and fandode hys, þus cweðende,
22.36: Lā Lārēow, hwæt ys þæt mǣste bebod on þǣre ǣ?
22.37: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lufa Drihten þīnne God on ealre þīnre heortan, and on ealre þīnre sāwle, and on eallum þīnum mōde.
22.38: Þis ys þæt mǣste and þæt fyrmyste bebod.
22.39: Ōþyr ys þysum gelīc, Lufa þīnne nēhstan swā swā þē sylfne.
22.40: On þysum twām bebodum byþ gefylled eall sēo ǣ.
22.41: Þā þā Phariseiscan gegaderude wǣrun, þā cwæð sē Hǣlynd,
22.42: Hwæt þincð ēow be Crīste? hwæs sunu ys hē? Hig cwǣdun, Dauides.
22.43: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Hwī clypað Dauid hyne on Gāste Drihtyn, and cwyð,
22.44: Drihten cwæð tō mīnum Drihtne, Site on ​ mīne swȳþran healfe, oð þæt ic gesette þīne fȳnd þē tō fōtscamole.
22.45: Gyf Dauid hyne on Gāste Dryhten clypað, hū ys hē hys sunu?
22.46: Đā ne mihton hig him nān word andswarian, nē nān ne dorste of ðām dæge hyne nān þing māre āxigean.

23.1: Þā spræc sē Hǣlynd to þām folce and tō hys leorningcnyhton,
23.2: and cwæð , Bōceras and Pharisei sǣtun ofer Moyses lārēowsetl:
23.3: healdaþ and wyrceað swā hwæt swā hig secgeaþ; and ne dō gē nā æfter heora worcum: hig secgeað, and ne dōð.
23.4: Hig bindað hefige byrþyna þe man āberan ne mæg, and lecgeað þā uppan manna exla; and nellað hig þā mid heora fingre æthrīnan.
23.5: Ealle heora worc hig dōð þæt menn hī ​ gesēon; hig tōbrǣdaþ hyra healsbēc , and mǣrsiað heora rēafa fnadu;
23.6: hig lufigeað þā fyrmystan setl on gebēorscypum, and þā fyrmystan lārēowsetl on gesomnungum,
23.7: and þæt hig man grēte on strǣtum, and þæt menn hig lārēowas nemnon.
23.8: Ne gyrne gē þæt ēow man lārēowas nemne; ān ys ēower lārēow; gē synt ealle gebrōþru.
23.9: And ne nemne gē ēow fædyr ofer eorþan; ān ys ēower Fædyr, sē þe on heofonum ys.
23.10: Nē ēow man ne nemne lārēowas; for þām ān, Crīst, is ēower Lārēow.
23.11: Sē þe ēower yltst sȳ, bēo sē ēower þēn.
23.12: Witodlīce sē þe hyne ūpp āhefð se byþ genyþerud; and sē þe hyne sylfne geēaðmēt sē byð ūpp āhafyn. Đys [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg on þǣre nygeðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
23.13: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras! for þām gē belūcað heofona rice beforan ​ mannum; nē gē in ne gāþ, nē gē ne geþafiað þæt ōðre in gān.
23.15: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras! for þām gē befarað sǣ and eorþan þæt gē dōn ānne elþēodigne ; and þonne hē gewordyn byð, gē gedōð hyne helle bearn twȳfealdlīcor þonne ēow.
23.16: Wā ēow blindan lāttēowas! gē secgeað swā hwylc swā swereþ on temple, þæt hē ys nāht; swā hwā swā swereð on þæs temples golde, sē ys scyldig.
23.17: Ēalā gē dysegan and blindan! hwæþer ys māre, ðe þæt gold, þe þæt templ ðe þæt gold gehālgað?
23.18: And swā hwā swā swereþ on þām wēofode, þæt ys nāht; swā hwylc swā swereþ on þǣre offrunge þe ofer þæt wēofud ys, sē ys gyltig.
23.19: Ēalā gē blindan! hwæþer ys māre, þe offrung, þe þæt wēofud þe gehālgað þā offrunge?
23.20: Witodlīce sē þe swereþ on wēofude, hē swereð on him and on eallum þām þe him ofer synt. {{nop} ​
23.21: And sē þe swereð on temple, hē swereð on him and on þām þe him on eardiað.
23.22: And sē ðe swerað on heofonan, hē sweryð on Godes þrymsetle and on þām þe ofer þæt sitt.
23.23: Wā ēow, bōceras and Pharisei, liccetteras! gē þe tēoðiað mintan, and dile, and cymen , and gē forlēton þā þing þe synt hefegran þǣre ǣ, dōm, and mildheortnysse, and gelēafan; þās þing hyt gebyrede þæt gē dydon, and þā ōðre ne forlētun.
23.24: Lā blindan lāttēowas, gē drehnigeað þone gnætt aweg, and drincað þone olfynd.
23.25: Wā ēow, bōceras and Pharisei, līccetteras! for þām gē clǣnsiað þæt wiðūtan ys caliceas and dixas, and gē synt innan fulle rēaflāces and unclǣnnysse.
23.26: Ēalā þū blinda Phariseus, clǣnsa ǣryst þæt wiðinnan ys calicys and discys, þæt hyt sī clǣne þæt wiðūtan ys.
23.27: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras! ​ for þām gē synt gelīce hwītum byrgenum, þā þinceað mannum ūtan wlitige, and hig synt innan fulle dēadra bāna and ealre fȳlþe.
23.28: And swā gē ætȳwað mannum ūtan rihtwīse, innan gē sunt fulle līccettunge and unrihtwīsnesse.
23.29: Wā ēow, bōcyras and Pharisei, līccetteras! gē þe timbriað wītegena byrgene, and glengað rihtwīsra gemyndstōwa,
23.30: and gē cweþað, Gyf wē wǣrun on ūre fædera dagum, nǣre wē heora gefēran on þǣra wītegena blōdes gyte.
23.31: Witodlīce gē synt ēow sylfum to gewittnysse þæt gē synt þǣra bearn ðe ofslōgon þā wītegan.
23.32: And gefylle gē þæt gemet ēowra fædera.
23.33: Ēalā gē nǣddran and nǣddrena cynn, hū flēo gē fram helle dōme? Đys godspel sceal on sancte Stefanes mæssedæg.
23.34: Ic sende tō ēow wītegan and wīse bōcyras; and gē hig ofslēað, and hōð, and swingað on ​ ēowrum gesomnungum, and gē hig ēhtað of byrig on byrig:
23.35: þæt ofer ēow cume ǣlc rihtwīs blōd þe wæs āgoten ofer eorþan, fram Abelys blōde þæs rihtwīsan oð Zacharias blōd, Barachias suna, þone gē ofslōgon betwyx þām temple and þām wēofode.
23.36: Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ealle þās þing cumaþ ofer þās cnēorisse.
23.37: Ēalā Ierusalem, ēalā Ierusalem , þū þe wītegan ofslihst, and mid stānum oftorfast þā ðe tō þē āsende synt! swīðe oft ic wolde þīne bearn gegaderigan, swā sēo henn hyre cīcenu under hyre fyþeru gegaderað, and þū noldest!
23.38: Witodlīce nū byþ ēower hūs ēow wēste forlǣten.
23.39: Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne gesēoþ gē mē heonon forð, ǣr þām þe gē secgeon, Sȳ geblētsod sē þe cōm on Drihtnes naman.

24.1: And þā sē Hǣlend ūt ēode of þām temple; him tō gēnēalǣhton hys leorningcnihtas þæt hī him ætȳwdon þæs temples getimbrunge.
24.2: Þā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Gesēoþ gē eall þis? Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne bið hēr lǣfed stān uppan stāne þe ne bēo tōworpen.
24.3: Đā hē sæt uppan Oliuetes dūne, þā comun hys leorningcnihtas dīhlīce, and cwǣdon, Sege ūs hwænne þās ðing gewurþun? and hwilc tācn sī þīnes tōcymys, and worulde geendunge?
24.4: Đā andswarode hē him and cwæð, Warniað þæt ēow nān man ne beswīce.
24.5: Manega cumaþ on mīnum naman, and cweðaþ, Ic eom Crīst; and beswīcaþ manega.
24.6: Witodlīce gē gehȳrað gefeoht and gefeohta hlīsan; warnigeað þæt gē ne bēon gedrēfede; ðās þing sceolun gewurþan, ac nys þonne gȳt sē ende.
24.7: Þēod winð ongēn þēode, and rīce ongēn rīce; and manncwealmas bēoð, and hungras wīde geond land, and eorþan styrunga. ​
24.8: Ealle þās þing synt þǣra sāra anginnu.
24.9: Ðonne syllað hī ēow on gedrēfednysse, and ofslēað ēow; and ealle menn ēow hatigeað for mīnum naman.
24.10: And þonne bēoð manega ungetrȳwsode, and belǣwað betwyx him, and hatigað him betwȳnan.
24.11: And manega lēase wītegan cumað, and beswīcað manega.
24.12: And for þām þe unryhtwīsnys rīxað, manegra lufu ācōlaþ.
24.13: Witodlīce sē þe þurhwunað oð ende sē byþ hāl.
24.14: And þis godspel byþ bodod ofer ealle eorþan on gewittnysse eallum þēodum; and þonne cymð sēo geendung.
24.15: Ðonne gē gesēoð þā onsceonunge þǣre tōworpennysse þe sē wītega gecwæð, Daniel, þā hē stōd on hāligre stōwe,—ongyte sē ðe hit rǣt,—
24.16: Flēon þonne tō muntum, þā þe on Iudea lande synt. ​
24.17: And sē þe ys uppan hys hūse, ne gā hē nyþyr þæt hē ǣnig þing on his hūse fecce.
24.18: And sē þe is on æcyre, ne cyrre hē þæt he hys tunecan nyme.
24.19: Wā ēacniendum and fēdendum on þām dagum!
24.20: Biddað þæt ēower flēam on wintra oððe on restedæge ne gewurþe.
24.21: Witodlīce þonne byð swā mycel gedeorf, swā næs of middangeardes fruman oþ þis, nē nū ne gewurð.
24.22: And būton þā dagas gescyrte wǣrun, nǣre nān mann hāl gewordyn; ac for þām gecorenum þe hē gecēas þā dagas bēoð gescyrte.
24.23: Đonne gyf ēow hwā segð, Nū Crīst ys hēr, oþþe ðǣr; ne gelȳfe gē him.
24.24: Þonne cumað lēase Crīstas and lēase wītegan, and dōð mycle tācn and forebēacn, þæt ðā bēoþ on gedwolan gelǣdde, gyf hyt bēon mæg, þe gecorene wǣrun.
24.26: Gyf hig ēow secgeað, Hēr hē ys on ​ wēstene; ne fare gē ūt: gyf hig secgeað, Hēr hē is on þurhfērun; ne gelȳfe gē.
24.27: Witodlīce swā swā līgyt færð fram ēastdǣle and ætȳwð oþ westdǣl, swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
24.28: Swā hwǣr swā hold byþ, þæder bēoð earnas gegaderude.
24.29: Sōna æfter þǣra daga gedrēfydnesse, sēo sunne byð forsworcen, and sē mōna hys lēoht ne sylð, and steorran feallaþ of þǣre heofenan, and þǣre heofenan mægenu bēoþ āstyrede:
24.30: and þonne ætȳwð mannes Suna tācn on heofonan; and þonne wēpað ealle eorþan mǣgþa, and gesēoð mannes Sunu cumende on heofonan, genipum mid myclum mægene and mægenþrymme.
24.31: And hē āsent hys englas mid bȳman and mycelre stefne, and hī gegaderigað hys gecorenan of fēower middaneardes endum, of heofona hēahnyssum oð hyra gemǣru. ​
24.32: Leornigeað bigspell be þām fīctrēowe: þonne hys twig byþ hnesce, and lēaf ācennede, gē witun þæt sumor ys gehende;
24.33: and wite gē swā, þonne gē þās þing gesēoð, þæt hē ys on durum gehende.
24.34: Sōð ic secge ēow þæt ðēos cnēorys ne gewīt, ǣr þām þe ealle þās þing gewurðon.
24.35: Heofone and eorþe gewītað; witodlīce mīne word ne gewītað.
24.36: Nāt nān mann be þām dæge nē be þǣre tīde, nē furðun englas, būton Fæder āna.
24.37: Witodlīce swā swā on Noes dagum wæs, swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
24.38: Swā hī wǣrun on þām dagum ǣr þām flōde, etende, and drincynde, and wīfigende, and gyfta syllende, oð þone dæg þe Noe on þā earce eode,
24.39: and hī nyston ǣr þæt flōd cōm, and nam hig ealle; swā byð mannes Suna tōcyme.
24.40: Ðonne bēoð twēgen on æcyre; ān byð genumen, and ōðer byþ lǣfyd.
24.41: Twā bēoð æt cwyrne grindende; ān byð ​ genumen, and ōðer byþ lǣfed. Twēgen bēoþ on bedde; ān byð genumen, and ōþer byð lǣfed. Đys godspel sceal to mænies confessores mæssedæge.
24.42: Wacigeað witodlīce, for þām þe gē nyton on hwylcyre tīde ēower Hlāford cuman wyle.
24.43: Witað þæt gyf sē hīredes ealdor wiste on hwylcere tīde sē þēof tōwerd wǣre, witodlīce hē wolde wacigean, and nolde geþafigan þæt man hys hūs underdulfe.
24.44: And for þām bēo gē gearwe; for þām ðe mannes Sunu wyle cuman on þǣre tīde þe gē nyton.
24.45: Wēnst þū hwā sȳ getrȳwe and glēaw þēow, þone geset hys hlāfurd ofer his hīred þæt hē him on tīde mete sylle?
24.46: Ēadig ys sē þēow þe hys hlāfurd hyne gemēt þus dōndne, þonne hē cymð.
24.47: Sōþ ic ēow secge þæt ofer eall þæt hē āh hē hyne gesett.
24.48: Gyf sē yfela þēowa ðencþ on hys heortan and cwyþ, Mīn hlāfurd uferað hys cyme; ​
24.49: and āgynð bēatan hys efenþēowas, and yt and drincþ mid druncenum;
24.50: þonne cymþ ðæs wēales hlāford on þām dæge ðe hē nā ne wēnþ, and on ðǣre tīde þe hē nāt,
24.51: and tōdǣlþ hyne, and āsett hys dǣl mid līccetterum; þǣr byþ wōp and tōþa grīstbitung.

25.1: Þonne byþ heofena rīce gelīc þām tȳn fǣmnum þe ðā lēohtfatu nāmon, and fērdon ongēn þone brȳdguman and þā brȳde.
25.2: Hyra fīf wǣron dysige, and fīf glēawe.
25.3: Ac þā fīf dysegan nāmon lēohtfatu, and ne nāmon nānne ele mid hym;
25.4: ðā glēawan nāmon ele on hyra fatum mid þām lēohtfatum.
25.5: Đā sē brȳdguma ylde, þā hnappudon hig ealle and slēpun. ​
25.6: Witodlīce tō middyre nihte man hrȳmde and cwæþ, Nū sē brȳdguma cymð; farað him tōgēnys.
25.7: Þā āryson ealle þā fǣmnan, and glengdon heora lēohtfatu.
25.8: Đā cwǣdon þā dysegan tō þām wīsum, Syllaþ ūs of ēowrum ele; for þām ūre lēohtfatu synt ācwencte.
25.9: Đā andswarudun þā glēawan and cwǣdun, Nese, þē lǣs þe wē and gē nabbon genōh; gāþ tō þām cȳpendum, and bycgað ēow ele.
25.10: Witodlīce þā hig fērdun and woldon bycgean, þā cōm sē brȳdguma; and þā ðe gearwe wǣrun ēodun in mid him tō þām gyftum; and sēo duru wæs belocyn.
25.11: Đā æt nēhstan cōmon þā ōðre fǣmnan, and cwǣdun, Dryhtyn, Dryhtyn, lǣt ūs in.
25.12: Đā andswarode hē heom and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, ne cann ic ēow.
25.13: Witodlīce waciað, for þam ðe gē nyton nē þone dæg nē þā tīde. ​ Đys godspel gebyrað on sancte Syluestres mæssedæge, and tō ōðra confessorum.
25.14: Sum mann fērde on elþēodignesse , and clypode hys þēowas, and betǣhte hym hys ǣhta.
25.15: And ānum hē sealde fīf pund, sumum twā, sumum ān; ǣghwylcum be hys āgenum mægene; and fērde sōna.
25.16: Đā fērde sē þe ðā fīf pund underfēng, and gestrȳnde ōþre fīfe.
25.17: And eal swā sē ðe þā twā underfēng gestrȳnde ōðre twā.
25.18: Witodlīce sē þe þæt ān underfēng fērde and bedēalf hyt on eorðan, and behȳdde hys hlāfurdes feoh.
25.19: Witodlīce æfter miclum fyrste cōm þǣra þēowa hlāfurd, and dyhte hym gerād.
25.20: Đā cōm sē þe ðā fīf pund underfēng, and brōhte ōþre fīfe, and cwæð, Hlāfurd, fīf pund þū sealdest mē; nū ic gestrȳnde ōðre fīfe.
25.21: Đā cwæþ hys hlāford tō hym, Bēo blīþe, þū gōda þēow and getrȳwa; for þām ðe þū wǣre getrȳwe ofer lȳtle þing, ic gesette þē ofer mycle; gā intō þīnes hlāfordes blisse. ​
25.22: Þā cōm sē þe þā twā pund underfēng, and cwæð, Hlāford, twā pund þū mē sealdest; nū ic hæbbe gestrȳnyd ōðre twā.
25.23: Đā cwæð hys hlāford tō hym, Geblissa, þū gōda þēowa and getrȳwa; for þām ðe þū wǣre getrȳwe ofer fēawa, ofer fela ic ðē gesette; gā on þīnes hlāfordes gefēan.
25.24: Đā cōm sē þe þæt ān pund underfēng, and cwæð, Hlāford, ic wāt þæt ðū eart heard mann; þū rīpst þǣr ðū ne sēowe, and gaderast þǣr ðū ne sprengdest:
25.25: and ic fērde ofdrǣd, and behȳdde þīn pund on eorþan; hēr þū hæfst þæt ðīn ys.
25.26: Đā andswarode hys hlāford him and cwæþ, Þū yfela ðēow and slāwa, ðū wistest þæt ic rȳpe þǣr ic ne sāwe, and ic gaderige þǣr ic ne strēdde;
25.27: hyt gebyrede þæt þū befæstest mīn feoh mynyterum; and ic nāme, þænne ic cōme, þæt mīn ys mid þām gafole.
25.28: Ānymaþ þæt pund æt hym, and syllað þām þe mē ðā tȳn pund brōhte.
25.29: Witodlīce ǣlcon þǣra þe hæfð man sylþ, ​ and hē hæfð genōh; ðām þe næfð, þæt hym þincð þæt hē hæbbe, þæt hym byð ætbrōdyn.
25.30: And wurpað þone unnyttan þēowan on þā ūttran þȳstru; þǣr byð wōp and tōþa grīstbitung. Đys [godspel] sceal on mōnandæg on forman fæstendæg.
25.31: Witudlīce þonne mannes Sunu cymð on hys mægenþrymme, and ealle englas mid him, þonne sitt hē ofer hys mægenþrymmes setl.
25.32: And ealle þēoda bēoþ tōforan hym gegaderude; and hē āsyndrað hī hym betwȳnan, swā swā sē hyrde āsyndraþ ðā scēp fram tyccenum;
25.33: and hē gesett þā scēp on hys swīðran healfe, and þā tyccenu on hys wynsteran healfe.
25.34: [ Đonne cwið sē Cyning tō ðām þe on his swīðran healfe bēoð ,] Cumað gē geblētsode mīnes Fæder, and onfōð þæt rīce þæt ēow gegearwod ys of middaneardes frymþe.
25.35: Mē hingrode, and gē mē sealdon etan; mē þyrste, and gē mē sealdun drincan; ic wæs cuma, and gē mē in laþodon; ​
25.36: ic wæs nacud, and gē mē scrȳddon; ic wæs untrum, and gē ēodun tō mē; ic wæs on cwearterne, and gē cōmon tō mē.
25.37: Þonne andswariað þā rihtwīsan and cweþað, Drihten, hwænne gesāwe wē ðē hingrigendne, and wē ðē fēddon? þyrstendne, and wē ðē drinc sealdon?
25.38: Hwænne gesāwe wē þæt ðū cuma wǣre, and þē in laþodon? oððe nacodne, and wē þē scrȳddon?
25.39: [ oððe hwænne gesāwon wē ðē untrumne ,] oððe on cwearterne, and cōmon tō þē?
25.40: Đonne andswarað sē Cyning hym and cwyþ tō heom, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Swā lange swā gē dydon ānum of ðysum mīnum lǣstum gebrōðrum , swā lange gē hyt dydon mē.
25.41: Þonne segþ hē þām þe bēoð on hys wynstran healfe, Gewītað, āwyrgyde, fram mē on þæt ēce fȳr þe ys dēofle and hys englum gegearwud. ​
25.42: Witodlīce mē hingryde, and gē ne sealdon mē etan; mē þyrste, and gē mē drincan ne sealdun;
25.43: ic wæs cuma, and gē mē †in ne gelaþodun; ic wæs nacod, and gē ne scrȳddon mē; ic wæs untrum and on cwearterne, and gē ne cōmon æt mē.
25.44: Đonne andswarigeaþ hym þā and cweðaþ, Dryhtyn, hwænne gesāwe wē þē hingrigendne, oððe þyrstendne , oðþe cuman, oððe untrumne, oþþe on cwearterne, and wē ne þēnedon þē?
25.45: Þonne andswarað sē Cyning heom and cwyð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Swā lange swā gē ne dydon ānum of þysum lǣstum, ne dyde gē hyt mē.
25.46: And þonne farað hig on ēce sūsle; and þā rihtwīsan on þæt ēce līf.

26.1: Witodlīce þā sē Hǣlend hæfde ealle þās sprǣca geendud, þā cwæð hē tō hys leorningcnihtum,
26.2: Wite gē þæt æfter twām dagum bēoð ēastro, ​ and mannes Bearn byþ geseald þæt hē sī on rōde āhangen.
26.3: Đā wǣron gesamnode þā ealdras þǣra sācerda, and hlāfordas þæs folces, to ðǣra sācerda ealdres botle þe wæs genemned Kaiphas;
26.4: and hig hæfdon mycel gemōt þæt hig woldon þone Hǣlend mid fācne besyrwan, and ofslēan.
26.5: Hig cwǣdon witodlīce sume þæt hyt ne mihte bēon on þām frēolsdæge, þē lǣs tō mycel styrung wurde on þām folce.
26.6: Đā sē Hǣlynd wæs on Bethania, on Symones hūse þæs hrēoflan,
26.7: ðā genēalǣhte him tō sum wīf, sēo hæfde box mid dēorwyrðre sealfe, and āgēat uppan hys hēafud þǣr hē sæt.
26.8: Þā gesāwun hys leorningcnihtas þæt, and wurdon gebolgene, and cwǣdon, Tō hwan ys þiss forspilled?
26.9: Þis mihte bēon geseald tō myclum wurþe, and þearfum gedǣled.
26.10: Þā sē Hǣlend hyt wiste, þā cwæð hē tō heom, Hwī synt gē grame þysum wīfe? witodlīce gōd weorc hēo worhte on me. ​
26.11: Symle gē habbað þearfan mid ēow; ac gē nabbað mē symle.
26.12: Hēo dyde þās sealfe on mīnne līchaman þæt ic wǣre gesmyryd tō bebyrgynne.
26.13: Sōð ic secge ēow, Swa hwǣr swā þys godspel byð gebodud on eallum middanearde, byð gesǣd on hyre gemynd þæt hēo ðiss dyde.
26.14: Đā fērde ān of þām twelfum, þe wæs genemned Iudas, sē wiþersaca, tō þǣra sācerda ealdrum,
26.15: and cwæð tō heom, Hwæt wylle gē mē syllan, and ic hyne belǣwe ēow? Đā behēton hig hym þrītig scyllinga.
26.16: And syþþan hē smēade geornlīce þæt hē hyne wolde belǣwan.
26.17: Þā on þām forman gearcungdæge genēalǣhton ðā leorningcnihtas tō þām Hǣlende, and þus cwǣdon, Hwǣr wylt ðū þæt wē gegearwion þē þīne ðēnunga tō ēastron?
26.18: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlynd, Farað on þās ceastre tō sumum menn, and secgeað him, Sē Lārēow segð, Mīn tīma ys gehende þæt ic mid þē wyrce mīne ēastro mid mīnum leorningcnihtum. ​
26.19: And þā leorningcnihtas dydon swā sē Hǣlynd heom bebēad; and hig gegearwodon him ēasterþēnunga.
26.20: On þām ǣfene sæt sē Hǣlynd mid hys twelf leorningcnihtum æt gereorde.
26.21: And þā hī ǣtun, hē cwæð tō him, Witodlīce ic secge ēow þæt ān ēower belǣwð mē.
26.22: Đā wurdon hig swīþe geunrōtsode, and ongann ānra gehwylc cweðan, Drihtyn, cwyst þū eom ic hyt?
26.23: And hē andswarode and þus cwæð, Sē þe bedȳpð on disce mid mē hys hand sē mē belǣwð.
26.24: Witodlīce mannes Sunu færþ, swā hit āwriten ys be him; wā þām menn þurh þone þe byþ mannes Sunu belǣwed! betere wǣre þām menn þæt hē nǣfre nǣre ācenned.
26.25: Þā cwæð Iudas þe hyne belǣwde, Cwyst þū, Lārēow, hwæðer ic hyt sī? Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Þū hyt sǣdest.
26.26: Witodlīce þā hig ǣtun, sē Hǣlend nam hlāf, and hyne geblētsode, and bræc, and sealde hys leorningcnihtum, and cwæð, Onfōþ, and etað; þis ys mīn līchama. ​
26.27: And hē genam þone calic, þanciende, and sealde hym, þus cweþende, Drincað ealle of þisum;
26.28: þis is witodlīce mīnes blōdes calic nīwre ǣ, þæt byð for manegum āgoten on synna forgyfenysse.
26.29: Witodlīce ic secge ēow þæt ic ne drince heonun forð of þysum eorðlīcan wīne, ǣr þām dǣge þe ic drince þæt nīwe mid ēow on mīnes Fæder rīce.
26.30: Đā hig hæfdon heora lofsang gesungene , þā fērdon hig uppan Oliuetes dūne.
26.31: Đā sǣde sē Hǣlend heom, Ealle gē wurþað ⟨ geuntrēow ⟩ sode on mē on þysse nihte: hyt ys āwriten, Þurh þæs hyrdes slege byð sēo heord tōdrǣfed.
26.32: Witodlīce æfter þām þe ic of dēaþe ārīse, ic cume tō ēow on Galilea.
26.33: Đā andwyrde Petrus him and þus cwæð, Đēah þe hig ealle geuntrēowsion on þē, ic nǣfre ne geuntrēowsige.
26.34: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Sōþ ic secge þē þæt on þissere nihte, ǣr þām þe cocc crāwe þrīwa, þū wiðsæcst mīn. ​
26.35: Đā sǣde Petrus him, Witudlīce þēah þe ic scyle sweltan mid þē, ne wiþsace ic þīn. Gelīce þām cwǣdon ealle ðā ōþre leorningcnihtas.
26.36: Đā cōm sē Hǣlynd mid him on þone tūn þe is genemned Gezemani, and sǣde hys leorningcnihtum, Sittað hēr, oð þæt ic gā hider geond and mē gebidde.
26.37: And hē genam Petrum and Zebedeus twēgen suna, and ongann unrōtsian and bēon unrōt.
26.38: Đā sǣde sē Hǣlynd heom, Unrōt ys mīn sāwl oþ dēað; gebīdað hēr, and waciað mid mē.
26.39: And þā hē wæs lȳthwōn þanon āgān, hē āfēoll on hys ansȳne, and hyne gebæd and þus cwæð, Fæder mīn, gyf hyt bēon mæge, gewīte þēs calic fram mē; þēah hwæþere nā swā swā ic wylle, ac swā swā þū wylt.
26.40: And hē cōm tō hys leorningcnihtum, and hē gemētte hig slǣpende; and hē sǣde Petre, Swā, ne mihton gē nū wacian āne tīd mid mē?
26.41: Waciaþ and gebiddað ēow þæt gē in ne gān on costunge; witudlīce sē gāst is hræd, and þæt flǣsc ys untrum.
26.42: Eft ōþre sīðe hē fērde, and hyne gebæd and ​ cwæþ, Mīn Fæder, gyf þēs calic ne mæge gewītan būton ic hyne drince, gewurþe þīn willa.
26.43: And hē cōm eft, and gemētte hig slǣpende; sōðlīce heora ēagan wǣron gehefegode.
26.44: And hē forlēt hig eft and fērde, and hyne gebæd þryddan sīðe, cweþende þæt ylce gebed.
26.45: Þā cōm hē tō hys leorningcnihtum, and sǣde heom, Slāpað eallunga, and restað ēow; nū genēalǣcþ sēo tīd, and mannes Sunu byð geseald on synfulra hand.
26.46: Ārīsað, uton faran; nū genēalǣcð sē þe mē belǣwð.
26.47: Đā hē þās þing spræc, þā cōm Iudas, ān of þām twelfum, and micel folc mid hym mid swurdum and sāhlum, āsende fram þǣra sācerda ealdrum and þæs folces ealdrum.
26.48: Sē þe hyne belǣwde sealde heom tācn and cwæð, Swā hwæne swā ic cysse, sē hyt is; nimaþ hyne.
26.49: And hē genēalǣhte hrædlīce tō þām Hǣlende, and cwæð, Hāl bēo þū, Lārēow; and he cyste hyne.
26.50: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ēalā frēond, tō hwan becōm þū? Đā genēalǣhton hig, and þone Hǣlend genāmon. ​
26.51: Witudlīce ān þǣra þe mid þām Hǣlende wæs ābrǣd hys swurd, and āslōh of ānys þǣra sācerda ealdres þēowan ēare.
26.52: Đā cwæð sē Hælend tō hym, Dō þīn swurd on hys scǣþe; witodlīce ealle þā ðe swurd nymað, mid swurde hig forwurþað.
26.53: Wēnst þū þæt ic ne myhte biddan mīnne Fæder þæt hē sende mē nū mā þonne twelf ēorydu engla?
26.54: Hū magon bēon gefyllede þā hālgan gewritu þe be mē āwritene synt, for þām þus hyt gebyrað tō bēonne?
26.55: On þǣre tīde cwæð sē Hǣlend tō þām folce, Eall swā tō þēofe gē synt cumene mid swurdum and mid sāhlum mē tō nymenne; dæghwāmlīce ic sæt mid ēow on þām temple and lǣrde ēow, and gē mē ne nāmon.
26.56: Đis eall ys geworden þæt ðǣra wītegena hālgan gewritu sȳn gefyllede. Þā flugon ealle þā leorningcnihtas, and forlēton hyne.
26.57: And hig genāmon þone Hǣlend, and ⟨ lǣd ⟩ don hyne tō Caiphan þǣra sācerda ealdre ⟨ þǣr ⟩ ðā bōceras and þā ealdras gesamnod wǣron. ​
26.58: Petrus hym fylide feorrane oð hē cōm tō þǣra sācerda ealdres botle; and hē in ēode, and sæt mid þām þēnum þæt hē gesāwe þone ende.
26.59: Witodlīce þǣra sācerda ealdras and eall þæt gemōt sōhton lēase saga ongēn þone Hǣlend ðæt hig hyne tō dēaþe sealdon;
26.60: and hig ne mihton nāne findan. Đā þā manega mid lēasum onsagum genēalǣhton, þā æt nēhstan cōmon twēgen þǣra lēogera, and cwǣdon,
26.61: Đēs sǣde, Ic mæg tōwurpan Godes templ, and æfter þrȳm dagum hyt eft getimbrigean.
26.62: Đā ārās ealdor þǣra sācerda, and cwæð, Ne andwyrtst þū năn þing ongēn þā ðe þiss ðē onsecgeað?
26.63: Sē Hǣlend suwode. Þā sē ealdor þǣra sācerda cwæð, Ic hālsige þē ðurh þone lyfiendan God þæt ðū secge ūs gyf þū sȳ Crīst, Godes Sunu.
26.64: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlynd him tō, Þæt ðū sǣdest. Sōð ic ēow secge, Æfter þyson gē gesēoð mannes Bearn sittende on þā swīðran healfe ​ Godes mægenþrymmes, and cumendne on heofones wolcnum.
26.65: Đā þǣra sācerda ealdor slāt hys āgyn rēaf, and cwæð, Þis ys bysmorsprǣc; tō hwī wilnige wē ǣnigre ōþre sage? nū gē gehȳrdon of hym gyltlīce sprǣce;
26.66: hwæt ys ēow nū geþūht? Hig andwyrdon ealle and cwǣdon, Hē is dēaþes scyldig.
26.67: Þā spǣtton hig on hys ansȳne, and bēoton hyne mid heora fȳstum; sume hyne slōgon on his ansȳne mid hyra brādum handum,
26.68: and cwǣdon, Sege ūs, Crīst, hwæt is sē þe ðē slōh
26.69: Petrus sōðlīce sǣt ūte on þām cafertūne; þā cōm tō hym ān þēowyn, and cwæð, And þū wǣre mid þām Galileiscean Hǣlynde.
26.70: And hē wiðsōc beforan eallum and cwæð, Nāt ic hwæt þū segst.
26.71: Đā hē ūt ēode of þǣre dura, ðā geseah hyne ōþer wȳln, and sǣde þām ðe þǣr wǣron, And þēs wæs mid þām Nazareniscean Hǣlende. ​
26.72: And hē wiðsōc eft mid āþe þæt hē hys nān þing ne cūðe.
26.73: Đā æfter lȳtlum fyrste genēalǣhton þā ðe þǣr stōdun, and cwǣdon to Petre, Sōþlīce þū eart of hym, and þīn sprǣc þē geswutelað.
26.74: Đā ætsōc hē and swerede þæt hē nǣfre þone man ne cūþe. And hrædlīce þā crēow sē cocc.
26.75: Þā gemunde Petrus þæs Hǣlendes word þe hē cwæð, Ǣr ðām þe sē cocc crāwe, þrīwa ðū mē widsæcst. And hē ēode ūt, and wēop bityrlīce.

27.1: Witodlīce þā hyt morgen wæs, ðā worhton ealle þǣra sācerda ealdras gemōt and þæs folces ealdras ongēn þone Hǣlend þæt hig hyne dēaþe belǣwdon;
27.2: and hig lǣddon hyne gebundenne, and sealdon hyne þām Pontiscean Pilate þām dēman.
27.3: Đā geseah Iudas þe hyne belǣwde þæt hē fordēmed wæs, þā ongann hē hrēowsian, and brōhte þā þrīttig scyllingas tō þǣra sācerda ealdrum, and cwæð, ​
27.4: Ic syngode, þā ic sealde þæt rihtwīse blōd. Đā cwǣdon hig, Hwæt spycst þū þæt tō ūs?
27.5: And hē āwearp þā scyllingas in on þæt templ, and fērde and mid grȳne hyne sylfne āhēng.
27.6: Đā sōðlīce þǣra sācerda ealdras onfēngon þæs seolfres, and cwǣdon, Nys hyt nā ālȳfed þæt wē āsendon hyt on ūre maðmcyste, for þām hyt is blōdes wurð.
27.7: Hig worhton þā gemōt, and smēadon hū hig sceoldon þæs Hǣlendes wurð ātēon; þā gebohton hig ǣnne æcyr mid þām fēo tigylwyrhtena on tō bebyrgenne elþēodisce menn.
27.8: For þām is sē æcer gehāten Acheldemagh, þæt is on ūre geþēode, blōdes æcyr; and swā hē is gehāten oð þisne dæg.
27.9: Đā wæs gefylled þæt gecweden is þurh Hieremiam þone wītegan, þus cweþende, And þā hig onfēngon þrīttig scyllinga, þæs gebohtan wurð þone ðe wæs ǣr gewurþod fram Israhela bearnum;
27.10: and hig sealdon þæt on tigelwyrhtena æcyr, swā swā Drihten mē gesette. ​
27.11: Þā stōd sē Hǣlend beforan þām dēman, and sē dēma hyne āxode þus cweðende, Eart þū Iudea Cyning? Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Þæt ðū segst.
27.12: And mid þȳ ðe hyne wrēgdon þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā hlāfordas, nān þing hē ne andswarode.
27.13: Đā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Ne gehȳrst þū hū fela sagena hig ongēn þē secgeað?
27.14: And hē nē andwyrde mid nānum worde; swā þæt sē dēma wundrode swīþlīce.
27.15: Hig hæfdon heom tō gewunan tō heora symbeldæge þæt sē dēma sceolde forgyfan þām folce ǣnne forwyrhtne mann, swylcne hig habban woldon.
27.16: Hē hæfde þā sōðlīce ǣnne strangne þēofmann gehæftne, sē wæs genemned Barrabbas.
27.17: Þā þæt folc gesamnod wæs, þā cwæð Pilatus, Hwæþer wylle gē þæt ic ēow āgyfe? þe Barrabban, ðe þone Hǣlynd ðe is Crīst gehāten?
27.18: Hē wiste sōðlīce þæt hig hyne for andan him sealdon.
27.19: Hē sæt þā Pilatus on his dōmsetle; þā sende his wīf tō hym, and cwæð, Ne bēo þē nān þing ​ gemǣne ongēn þisne rihtwīsan; sōðlīce fela ic hæbbe geþolod tō dæg þurh gesyhðe for hym.
27.20: Đā lǣrdon þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā hlāfordas þæt folc þæt hig bǣdon Barrabban, and þone Hǣlend fordydon.
27.21: Đā andwyrde sē dēma and sǣde heom, Hwæþerne wylle gē þæt ic forgyfe ēow of þisum twām? Đā cwǣdon hig, Barrabban.
27.22: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō heom, Witodlīce hwæt dō ic be þām Hǣlende þe is Crīst genemned? Đā cwǣdon hig ealle, Sȳ hē on rōde āhangen.
27.23: Đā cwæð sē dēma tō heom, Witodlīce hwæt yfeles dyde þēs? Hī ðā swīþor clypodon þus cweðende, Sȳ hē āhangen.
27.24: Đā geseah Pilatus þæt hyt nāht ne fremode, ac gewurde māre gehlȳd, þā genam hē wæter and þwōh hys handa beforan þām folce, and cwæð, Unscyldig ic eom fram þyses rihtwīsan blōde; gē gesēoð.
27.25: Đā andswarode eall þæt folc and cwæð, Sȳ hys blōd ofer ūs and ofer ūre bearn.
27.26: Đā forgeaf hē hym Barrabban; and þone Hǣlynd hē lēt swingan, and sealde heom tō āhōnne. ​
27.27: Þā underfēngon þæs dēman cempan þone Hǣlynd on ðām dōmerne, and gegaderodon ealne þone ðrēat tō heom;
27.28: and unscrȳddon hyne hys āgenum rēafe, and scrȳddon hyne mid weolcenrēadum scyccelse;
27.29: and wundon cynehelm of þornum, and āsetton ofer hys hēafod, and hrēod on hys swīðran; and bīgdon heora cnēow beforan him, and bysmorudun hyne þuss cweþende,
27.30: Hāl wes þū, Iudea Cyning! and spǣtton on hyne, and nāmon hrēod and bēotun hys hēafod.
27.31: And æfter þām þe hig hyne þus bysmerodon, hig unscrȳddon hyne þām scyccelse, and scrȳddon hyne mid hys āgenum rēafe, and lǣddon hyne tō āhōnne.
27.32: Sōþlīce ðā hig ūt fērdon, þā gemētton hig ǣnne Cyreniscne mann cumende heom tōgēnes, þæs nama wæs Symon; þone hig nȳddon þæt hē bǣre hys rōde.
27.33: Đā cōmon hig on þā stōwe þe ys genemned Golgotha, þæt is, hēafodpannan stōw.
27.34: And hig sealdon hym wīn drincan, wið geallan gemenged; and þā hē hys onbyrigde, þā nolde hē hyt drincan. ​
27.35: Sōþlīce ǣfter þām þe hig hyne on rōde āhēngon, hig tōdǣldon hys rēaf, and wurpon hlot þǣr ofer: þæt wǣre gefylled þæt ðe gecweden wæs þurh ðone wītegan, and þus cwæð, Hig tōdǣldon heom mīne rēaf, and ofer mīne rēaf hig wurpon hlot.
27.37: And hig āsetton ofer hys hēafod hys gylt þuss āwritenne, Đis ys sē Hǣlynd, Iudea Cyning
27.38: Đā wǣron āhangen mid hym twēgen sceaþan, ān on þā swīðran healfe, and ōðer on þā wynstran.
27.39: Witodlīce þā wegfērendan hyne bysmeredon, and cwehton heora hēafod,
27.40: And cwǣdon, Wā þæt ðēs tōwyrpð Godes templ, and on þrīm dagum hyt eft getimbrað; gehǣl nū þē sylfne; gyf þū sȳ Godes Sunu, gā nyþer of þǣre rōde.
27.41: Ēac þǣra sācerda ealdras hyne bysmeredon mid þām bōcerum and mid þam ealdrum, and cwǣdun,
27.42: Ōþere hē gehǣlde, and hyne sylfne gehǣlan ne mæg. Gyf hē Israhela Cyning sȳ, gā nū nyþer of þǣre rōde, and wē gelȳfað hym. ​
27.43: Hē gelȳfð on God; ālȳse hē hyne nū, gyf hē wylle: witodlice hē sǣde, Godes Sunu ic eom.
27.44: Gelīce þā sceaðan þe mid him āhangene wǣron hyne hyspdun.
27.45: Witodlīce fram þǣre sixtan tīde wǣron geworden þȳstru ofer ealle eorðan oþ þā nigoþan tīd.
27.46: And ymbe þā nygoðan tīd clypode sē Hǣlend mycelre stefne and þuss cwæð, Heli, Heli, lema zabdani? þæt ys on englisc, Mīn God, mīn God, tō hwī forlēte þū me?
27.47: Sōþlīce sume þā ðe þǣr stōdon and þis gehȳrdon cwǣdon, Nū hē clypað Heliam.
27.48: Đā hrædlīce arn ān heora and genam āne spongean, and fylde hig mid ecede, and āsette ān hrēod þǣr on, and sealde hym drincan.
27.49: Witodlīce þā ōðre cwǣdon, Lǣt; utun gesēon hwæþer Helias cume, and wylle hyne ālȳsan.
27.50: Þā clypode sē Hǣlynd eft mycelre stefne, and āsende hys gāst.
27.51: And þǣrrihte ðæs temples wāhryft wearð tōsliten on twēgen dǣlas fram ufeweardon oð nyþeweard; and sēo eorðe bifode; and stanas tōburston; ​
27.52: and byrgena wurdun geopenode; and manige hālige līchaman ðe ǣr slēpon āryson;
27.53: and þā hig ūt ēodon of þām byrgenum æfter hys ǣryste, hig cōmun on þā hāligan ceastre, and ætēowdon hig manegum.
27.54: Witodlīce þæs hundredes ealdor, and ðā þe mid him wǣron healdende þone Hǣlynd, þā hig gesāwon þā eorðbifunge and þā ðing ðe þǣr gewurdon, hig ondrēdon heom ðearle, and cwǣdon, Sōðlīce Godes Sunu wæs þēs.
27.55: Witodlīce þǣr wǣron manega wīf feorran, þā ðe fyligdon þām Hǣlende fram Galilea, him ðēnigende.
27.56: Betwuh þām wæs sēo Magdalenisce Maria, and Maria Iacobes mōder and Iosephes mōdur, and Zebedeis sunena mōdor.
27.57: Sōðlīce þā hyt ǣfen wæs, cōm sum welig mann of Arimathia, þæs nama wæs Iosep, sē sylfa wæs þæs Hǣlyndes leorningcniht.
27.58: Hē genēalǣhte tō Pilate, and bæd þæs Hǣlyndes līchaman. Đā hēt Pilatus āgyfan him þone līchaman. ​
27.59: And Iosep genam þone līchaman, and bewand hyne mid clǣnre scȳtan,
27.60: and lēde hyne on hys nīwan byrgene, ðā hē āhēow on stāne; and hē tō āwylte mycelne stān tō hlide þǣre byrgene, and fērde syþþan.
27.61: Đǣr wæs sōðlīce sēo Magdalenisce Maria and sēo ōðer Maria, sittende æt þǣre byrgene.
27.62: Witodlīce ōðrum dæge þe wæs gearcungdæg, cōmon tōgædere þǣra sācerda ealdras and þā sundorhālgan tō Pilate,
27.63: and cwǣdon, Hlāford, wē gemunon þæt sē swica sǣde, þā hē on līfe wæs, Æfter þrȳm dagon ic ārīse.
27.64: Hāt nū healdan þā byrgene oð þone þryddan dæg, þē lǣs hys leorningcnihtas cumon and forstelon hyne, and secgeon þām folce þæt hē āryse of dēaþe; þonne byð þæt æftre gedwyld wyrse þonne þæt ǣrre.
27.65: Đā cwæð Pilatus, Gē habbað heordrǣdenne; farað, and healdað swā swā gē witon.
27.66: Sōþlīce hig fērdon, and ymbetrymedon þā byrgene, and innseglodon þone stān, mid þām weardum.

28.1: Sōðlīce þām restedæges ǣfene, sē þe onlīhte on þām forman restedæge, cōm sēo Magdalenisce Maria and sēo ōðer Maria þæt hig woldon gesēon þā byrgene.
28.2: And þǣr wearð geworden micel eorþbifung; witodlīce Drihtenes engel āstāh of heofenan, and genēalǣhte and āwylte þone stān, and sæt þǣr onuppan.
28.3: Hys ansȳn wæs swylce līgyt, and hys rēaf swā hwīte swā snāw.
28.4: Witodlīce þā weardas wǣron āfyrhte, and wǣron gewordene swylce hig dēade wǣron.
28.5: Đā andswarode sē engel and sǣde þām wīfon, Ne ondrǣde gē ēow; ic wāt witodlīce þæt gē sēceað þone Hǣlynd þone þe on rōde āhangen wæs.
28.6: Nys hē hēr; hē ārās sōðlīce, swā swā hē sǣde. Cumað, and gesēoþ þā stōwe þe sē Hǣlynd wæs on ālēd.
28.7: And farað hrædlīce, and secgeað hys leorningcnihtum þæt hē ārās; and sōðlīce hē cymð ​ beforan ēow on Galileam; þǣr gē hyne gesēoþ: nū ic secge ēow. Đys [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg on ðǣre ōðre ēasterwucan.
28.8: Đā fērdon hig hrædlīce fram þǣre byrgene mid ege and mid myclum gefēan, and urnon and cȳðdon hyt hys leorningcnihton.
28.9: And efne þā cōm sē Hǣlynd ongēan hig, and cwæð, Hāle wese gē. Hig genēalǣhton, and genāmon hys fēt and tō him geēaðmēddon.
28.10: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlynd tō heom, Ne ondrǣde gē ēow; farað, and cȳþað mīnum gebrōþrum þæt hig faron on Galileam, þǣr hig gesēoþ mē.
28.11: Þā þā hig fērdon, þā cōmon sume þā weardas on þā ceastre, and cȳðdon þǣra sācerda ealdrum ealle þā ðing þe ðǣr gewordene wǣron .
28.12: Đā gesamnudon þā ealdras hig, and worhtun gemōt, and sealdon þām ðegenum micyl feoh, and cwǣdon,
28.13: Secgeað þæt hys leorningcnihtas cōmon nihtes, and forstǣlan hyne ðā wē slēpun. ​
28.14: And gyf sē dēma þiss geāxað, wē lǣrað hyne, and gedōð ēow sorhlēase.
28.15: Đā onfēngon hig þæs fēos, and dydon eall swā hig gelǣrede wǣron; and þis word wæs gewīdmǣrsod mid Iudeum oð þisne andweardan dæg. Đis [godspel] sceal on frīgedæg innan þǣre ēasterwucan.
28.16: Đā fērdon þā endlufun leorningcnihtas on þone munt þǣr sē Hǣlynd heom dihte,
28.17: and hyne þǣr gesāwun, and hig tō him geēaðmēddun; witodlīce sume hig twēonedon.
28.18: Đā genēalǣhte sē Hǣlynd, and spræc tō heom þās þing and þuss cwæð, Mē is geseald ǣlc anweald on heofonan and on eorðan.
28.19: Farað witodlīce and lǣrað ealle þēoda, and fulligeað hig on naman Fæder, and Suna, and þæs Hālgan Gāstes;
28.20: and lǣrað þæt hig healdon ealle þā ðing þe ic ēow bebēad. And ic bēo mid ēow ealle dagas oð worulde geendunge. †Amen.

1.1: Her ys godspelles angyn Hælendes Cristes, godes suna.
1.2: Swa awriten is on ðæs witegan bec Isaiam, “Nu! ic asende minne engel beforan ðinre ansyne, se gegearwaþ ðinne weg beforan ðe.
1.3: Clypigende stefen on ðam westene, ‘gegearwiaþ Drihtnes weg, doþ rihte his siðas.’”
1.4: Iohannes wæs on westene fulligende, and bodiende dædbote fulwiht, on synna forgyfenesse.
1.5: And to him ferde eall Iudeisc rice, and ealle Hierosolimaware; and wæron fram him gefullode on Iordanes flode, hyra synna anddetende.
1.6: And Iohannes wæs gescryd mid oluendes hærum, and fellen gyrdel wæs ymbe his lendenu; and gærstapan, and wudu hunig he æt,
1.7: And he bodode, and cwæþ, Strengra cymþ æfter me, ðæs ne eom ic wyrðe ðæt ic his sceona þwanga bugende uncytte.
1.8: Ic fullige eow on wætere; he eow fullaþ on Halgum gaste. Þæt fullwiht Iesus
1.9: And on ðam dagum, come se Hælend fram Nazareth galilee, and wæs gefullod on Iordane fram Iohanne.
1.10: And sona of ðam wætere, he geseah opene heofonas, and Haligne gast swa culfran astigende, and on him wunigende.
1.11: And ðam wæs stefn of heofenum geworden, Ðu eart min gelufoda suna, on ðe ic gelicode. Seo costnung Iesus
1.12: And sona gast hine on westen genydde.
1.13: And he on westene wæs feowertig daga and feowertig nihta, and he wæs fram Satane gecostnod, and he mid wilddeorum wæs, and him englas þenodon.
1.14: Syððan Iohannes geseald wæs, com se Hælend on galileam, godes rices godspell bodigende,
1.15: And ðus cweðende, witodlice tid is gefylled, and heofena rice genelæcþ; doþ dædbote, and gelyfaþ ðam godspelle. Iesus hateþ his forman larmenn
1.16: And ða he ferde wið ða galileiscan sæ, he geseah Simonem, and Andream, his broðor, hyra nett on ða sæ lætende; soþlice hi wæron fisceras.
1.17: And ða cwæþ se Hælend, Cumaþ æfter me; and ic do inc ðæt gyt beoþ sawla onfonde.
1.18: And hi ða hrædlice him fyligdon, and forleton heora nett.
1.19: And ðanon hwon agan, he geseah Iacobun Zebedei, and Iohannes his broðor, and hi on heora scype heora nett logodon.
1.20: And he hi sona clypode; and hi heora fæder, Zebedeo, on scipe forleton, mid hyrligum, [and hi folgodon hine.] Mann mid unclænum gaste
1.21: And ferdon to Cafarnaum, and sona restedagum he lærde hi, on gesamnunge ingangende.
1.22: And hi wundredon be his lare; soþlice he wæs hi lærende, swa swa se ðe anweald hæfþ, næs swa boceras.
1.23: And on heora gesamnunge wæs sum man on unclænum gaste, and he hrymde,
1.24: And cwæþ, Eala Nazarenisca Hælend, hwæt is us and ðe? com ðu us to forspillanne? ic wat ðu eart godes halga.
1.25: Ða cidde se Hælend him, and cwæþ, Adumba, and ga of ðisum men.
1.26: And se unclæna gast hine slitende, and mycelre sefne clypigende, him of eode.
1.27: Ða wundredon hi ealle, swa ðæt hi betwux him cwædon, Hwæt ys ðis? hwæt is ðeos niwe lar? ðæt he on anwealde unclænum gastum bebyt, and hi hyrsumiaþ him.
1.28: And sona ferde his hlisa to galilea rice. Iesus hæleþ manige
1.29: Hrædlice of hyra gesamnunge hi comon on Simonis and Andreas hus, mid Iacobe and Iohanne.
1.30: Soþlice ða sæt Simonis sweger hriþigende; and hi him be hyre sædon.
1.31: And genealæcende, he hi upahof, hyre handa gegripenre, and hrædlice se fefer hi forlet, and heo þenode him.
1.32: Soþlice ða hit wæs æfen geworden, ða sunne to setle eode, hi brohton to him ealle ða unhalan, and ða ðe wode wæron.
1.33: And eall seo burhwaru wæs gegaderod to ðære duran.
1.34: And he manega gehælde ðe missenlicum adlum gedrehte wæron, and manega deofolseocnyssa he utadraf, and hi sprecan ne let, forðam hi wiston ðæt he Crist wæs. Iesus bodaþ in galileam
1.35: And swiðe ær arisende, he ferde on weste stowe, and hine ðar gebæd.
1.36: And him fylidge Simon, and ða ðe mid him wæron.
1.37: And ða hi hine gemetton, hi sædon him, Eall ðis folc ðe secþ.
1.38: Ða cwæþ he, Fare we on gehende tunas and ceastra, ðæt ic ðar bodige, witodice to ðam ic com.
1.39: And he wæs bodigende on heora gesamnungum, and ealre galilea, and deofolseocnessa utadrifende. Iesus clænsaþ hreoflan Ðys godspel sceal on wodnesdæg on þære fifteoðan wucan ofer pentecosten.
1.40: And to him com sum hreofla, hine biddende, and gebigedum cneowum, him to cwæþ, Drihten, gif ðu wylt, ðu miht geclænsian me.
1.41: Soþlice se Hælend him miltsode, and his hand aþenode, and hine æhrinende, and ðus cwæþ, Ic wylle, beo ðu geclænsod.
1.42: And ða he ðus cwæþ, sona seo hreofnes him fram gewat, and he wæs geclænsod.
1.43: And sona he bead him, [and onsent hine].
1.44: And cwæþ, warna, ðæt ðu hit nanum men ne secge; ac ga, and ætyw ðe ðara sacerda ealdre, and bring for ðinre clænsunga ðæt Moyses bebead, him on gewitnesse.
1.45: And he, ða utgangende, ongan bodian, and widmærsian ða spræce, swi ðæt he ne mihte openlice on ða ceastre gan, ac beon ute on westum stowum; and hi æghwanon to him comon.

2.1: And eft æfter dagum, he eode into Cafarnaum. And hit wæs gehyred, ðæt he wæs on huse,
2.2: And manega togædere comon, … And he to heom spræc.
2.3: And hi comon anne laman to him berende, ðone feower men bæron.
2.4: And ða hi ne mihton hine inbringan for ðære mænigeo, hi openodon ðone hrof, ðar se Hælend wæs; and … hi ða inasendon ðæt bed, ðe se lama onlæg.
2.5: Soþlice ða se Hælend geseah heora geleafan, he cwæþ to ðam laman, Sunu, ðe synt ðine synna forgifene.
2.6: Ðar wæron sume of ðam bocerum sittende, and on heora heortan þencende,
2.7: Hwi spycþ ðes ðus? He dysegaþ; hwa mæg synna forgyfan, buton god ana?
2.8: Ða se Hælend ðæt on his gaste oncneow, ðað hi swa betwux him þohton, he cweaþ to him, Hwi þence ge ðas þing on eowrum heortum?
2.9: Hwæðer is eðre to secgenne to ðam laman, Ðe synd ðine synna forgifene, hwæðer ðe cweðan, Aris, nim ðin bed, and ga?
2.10: Ðæt ge soþlice witon ðæt mannes sunu hæfþ anweald on eorþan synna to forgyfanne, he cwæþ to ðam laman,
2.11: Ðe ic secge, aris, nim ðin bed, and ga to ðinum huse.
2.12: And he sona aras, and, [underleat bere,] beforan him eallum eode, swa ðæt ealle wundredon, .… and ðus cwædon, Næfre we ær ðyllic ne gesawon. Iesus hateþ Leui
2.13: Eft he uteode to ðære sæ, and eall seo mænigeo him to com; and he hi lærde.
2.14: And ða he forþeode, he geseah Leuin Alphei sittende æt hys cepsetle, and he cwæþ to him. Folga me. Ðaaras he and folgode him.
2.15: And hit gewearþ, ða he sæt on his huse, ðæt manega manfulle … sæton mid ðam Hælende and his leorningcnihtum; soþlice manega, ða ðe him fyligdon, wæron.
2.16: Boceras and Farisei, and cwædon, witodlice he ytt mid manfullum and synfullum, and hi cwædon to his leorningcnihtum, Hwi ytt eower lareow and drincþ mid manfullum and synfullum?
2.17: Ða se Hælend ðis gehyrde, he sæde him, Ne beþurfon na ða halan læces, ac ða ðe untrume synt; ne com ic na ðæt ic clypode rihtwise, ac synfulle. Frignung ymb fæstunge
2.18: And ða wæron Iohannes leorningcnihtas and Pharisei fæstende; and ða comon hi, and sædon him, Hwi fæstaþ Iohannes leorningcnihtas and Phariseorum, and ðine ne fæstaþ?
2.19: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Cweðe ge scolon, ðæs brydguman cnihtas fæstan, swa lange swa se brydguma mid him is? Ne magon hi fæstan, swalange tide, swahi ðone brydguman mid him habbaþ.
2.20: Soþlice ða dagas cumaþ, ðonne se brydguma him biþ fram acyrred, and ðonne hi fæstaþ on ðam dagum.
2.21: Nan man ne siwaþ niwne scyp to ealdum reafe, elles he afyrþ ðone niwan scyp of ðam ealdan reafe, and biþ mare slite.
2.22: And nan man ne deþ niwe win on ealde bytta, elles ðæt win tobrycþ ða bytta, and ðæt win biþ agoten, and ða bytta forwurðaþ. Ac niwe win sceal beon gedon on niwe bytta, ðonne beoþ butu gehealden. Iesus is Dryhten restedæges
2.23: Eft wæs geworden, ða he restedagum þurh æceras eode, his leorningcnihtas ongunnon ða ear pluccigean.
2.24: Ða cwædon Pharisei to him, Loca nu! hwæt ðine leorningcnihtas doþ, ðæt him alyfed næs on restedagum.
2.25: Ða sæde he hym, Ne rædde ge næfre hwæt dyde Dauid, … ða hine himgrode, and ða ðe mid him wæron?
2.26: Hu he in godes huse eode, under Abiathar, ðara sacerda ealdre, and he æt ða offrunghlafas. ðe him ne alyfede næron to etanne, buton sacerdum anum, and he sealde ðam ðe mid him wæron.
2.27: And he sæde him, Restedæg wæs geworht for ðam men, næs se man for ðam restedæge;
2.28: witodlice drihten is mannes sunu eac swylce restedæges.

3.1: And eft he eode on gesomnunge, and ðar wæs an man forscruncene hand hæbbende.
3.2: And hi gymdon, hwæðer he on reste dagum gehælde, ðæt hi hine gewregdon.
3.3: Ða cwæþ he to ðam men ðe forscruncene hand hæfde, Aris gemang him.
3.4: Ða cwæþ he, Alyfþ restedagum wel to donne, hwæðer ðe yfele? sawla gehælan, hwæðer ðe forspillan? And hi su wodon.
3.5: And hi besceawigende mid yrre, ofer hyra heortan blindnesse geunret, cwæþ to ðam men, Aþene ðine hand. And he aþenede he, ða wearþ his hand gehæled sona.
3.6: Ða Pharisei mid Herodianiscum utgangende, þeahtedon ongen hine, hu hi hine fordon mihton. Manigo folgaþ Iesus
3.7: And ða ferde se Hælend to ðære sæ mid his leorningcnihtum; and mycel menigeo him fyligde fram galilea and Iudea,
3.8: And Hierusalem, and fram Idumea and begeondan Iordane, and to him com mycel menegeo, ymbe Tirum and Sidone, gehyrende ða þing ðe he worhte.
3.9: And he cwæþ to his cnihtum, ðæt hi him on scipe þenodon, for ðære menigum, ðæt hi hine ne ofþrungon;
3.10: Soþlice manega he gehælde, …. swa ðæt hi æthrinon his. And swa fela swa untrumnessa,
3.11: And unclæne gastas hæfdon, ða hi hine gesawon, hi toforan him astrehton, and ðus cweðende, cypedon, Ðu eart godes sunu.
3.12: And he him swyðe forbead, ðæt hi hine ne geswutelodon. Þa Twelfe
3.13: And on anne munt he ferde, and to him geclypode ða ðe he wolde; and hi to him comon.
3.14: And he dyde, ðæt hi twelfe mid him wæron, and he hi asende godspell to bodigenne.
3.15: And he him anweald sealde untrumnessa to hælanne, and deofolseocnessa ut to adrifanne.
3.17: And Iacobum Zebedei and Iohannem, his broðor, and him naman onsette Boanerges, ðæt is, þunres bearn;
3.18: And Andream and Philippum, and Bartholomeum and Matheum, and Thomam and Iacobum Alphei, and Taddeum and Simonem Chananeum,
3.19: And Iudam Scarioth, se hine sealde.
3.20: And eft him to com swa micel menigu, ðæt hi næfdon hlaf to etanne.
3.21: And ða hi hine gehyrdon, hi ferdon ðæt hi hyne namon; and ðus cwædon, Soþliice he is on hatheortnesse gewend. Seo bysmerung þæs Halgan gastes
3.22: And ða boceras ðe wendon fram Hierusalem, cwædon, Soþlice he hæfþ Beelzebub, and on deofla ealdre he deofolseocnessa utadrifþ.
3.23: And he hi togædere geclypode, and on bigspellum him to cwæþ, Hu mæg Satanas Satanan ut adrifan?
3.24: And gif his rice on him sylfum byþ todæled, hu mæg hit standan?
3.25: And gif dæt hus ofer hit sylfe ys todæled, hu mæg hit standan?
3.26: And gif Satanas winþ ongen hine sylfne, he biþ todæled, and he standan ne mæg, ac hæfþ ende.
3.27: Ne mæg man ðone strangan his æhta and his fatu bereafian, and on his hus gan, buton man ðone strangan ærest gebinde, and ðonne hys hus reafige.
3.28: Soþlice ic eow secge, ðæt ealle sinna synd manna bearnum forgyfene, and bysmerunga, ðam ðe hi bysmeriaþ.
3.29: Soþlice ic eow secge, se ðone Halgan gast bysmeraþ, se næfþ on ecnysse forgyfenesse, ac biþ eces gyltes scyldig.
3.30: Forðam ðe hi cwædon, He hæfþ unclænne gast. Iesus modor and gebroðru
3.31: Ða com to him his modor and his gebrodðra, and ðar ute stodon, and to him sendon, and to him clypedon.
3.32: And mycel menigu ymb hine sæt; and to him cwædon, Her is ðin modor, and ðine gebroðra ute and secaþ ðe.
3.33: He ða him andswarode and cwæþ, Hwylc is min modor and mine gebroðru?
3.34: And he cwæþ, ða behealdende, ðe him abuton sæton, Her is min modor and mine gebroðru.
3.35: Soþlice, se ðe deþ godes willan, se is min modor, and min broðor, and swustor.

4.1: And eft he ongan hi æt ðære sæ læran; and him wæs mycel menegu to gegaderod, swa ðæt he on scip eode, and on ðære sæ wæs, and eall seo menegu ymbe ða sæ wæs, on lande.
4.2: And he hi fela on bigspellum lærde. And him to cwæþ on hys lare,
4.3: gehyraþ. (Ðys godspell sceal on þære wucan æfter þam þe man belycð alleluia.) Ut eode se sædere his sæd to sawenne.
4.4: And ða he sew, sum feoll wið ðone weg, and fugelas comon, and hit fræton.
4.5: Sum feoll ofer stanscyligean, ðar hit næfde mycele eorþan; and sona upeode, forðam ðe hit næfde eorþan þiccnesse.
4.6: Ða hit upeode, seo sunne hit forswælde, and hit forscranc, forðam hit wyrtruman næfde.
4.7: And sum feoll on þornas, ða stigon ða þornas, and forþrysmodon ðæt, and hit wæstm ne bær.
4.8: And sum feoll on god land, and hit sealde, uppstigende, and wexende, wæstm; and an brohte þritigfealdne, sum syxtigfealdne, sum hundfealdne.
4.9: And he cwæþ, gehyre, se ðe earan hæbbe to gehyranne. Se ende þara bispella
4.10: And ða he ana wæs, hine axodon ðæt bigspell ða twelfe ðe mid him wæron.
4.11: And he sæde him, Eow is geseald to witanne godes rices gerynu. Ðam ðe uite synd, ealle þing on bigspellum gewurðaþ.
4.12: Ðæt hi geseonde geseon, and na ne geseon, and gehyrende gehyron, and ne ongyton; ðelæs hi hwænne syn gecyrede, and him sin hyra synna forgyfene.
4.13: Ða sæde he him, ge nyton ðis bigspell and hu mage ge ealle bigspell witan?
4.14: Se ðe sæwþ, word he sæwþ.
4.15: Soþlice ða synd wið ðone weg, ðar ðæt word is gesawen; and ðonne hi hit gehyraþ, sona cymþ Satanas, and afyrþ ðæt word ðe on heora heortan asawen ys.
4.16: And ða synd gelice ðe synd ofer ða stanscylian gesawen, sona ðænue hi ðæt word gehyraþ, and ðæt mid blisse onfoþ;
4.17: And hi nabbaþ wyrtruman on him, ac beoþ unsaðolfæste; and syððan upcymþ deofles costnung, and his ehtnys for ðam worde, ….
4.18: Hi synd on þornum gesawen ðæt synd; ða ðe þæt word gehyraþ,
4.19: And of yrmþe, and swicdome woroldwelena, and oðra gewilnunga, ðæt word ofþrysmiaþ, and synd buton wæstme gewordene.
4.20: And ða ðe gesawene synd ofer ðæt gode land, ða synda ðe ðæt word gehyraþ, and onfoþ, and wæstm bringaþ, sum þritigfealdne, sum syxtigfealdne, and sum hundfealdne. Leohtfæt under bydene
4.21: He sæde him, Cwyst ðu cymþ ðæt leohtfæt, ðæt hit beo under bydene aset, oððe under bedde? wite geare, ðæt hit sy ofer candelstæf aset?
4.22: Soþlice nis nan þing behydd, ðe nesy geswutelod; ne nis digle geworden, ac ðæt hit openlice cume.
4.23: gehyre, gif hwa earan hæbbe to gehyranne.
4.24: And he cwæþ to him, warniaþ hwæt ge gehyron. And on ðam gemete ðe ge metaþ, eow biþ gemeten, and eow biþ geict.
4.25: Ðam biþ geseald ðe hæfþ, and ðam ðe næfþ, eac ðæt he hæfþ, him biþ ætbroden. Þæt bispell ymb þæt weaxende sæd and þæt senepsæd
4.26: And he cwæþ, godes rice ys, swylce man wurpe god sæd on his land, and sawe,
4.27: And arise dæges and nihtes, and ðæt sæd growe, and wexe, ðonne he nat.
4.28: Soþlice sylfwilles seo eorþe wæstm beraþ, ærest gærs, syððan ear, syððan fulne hwæte on ðam eare.
4.29: And ðonne se wæstm hine forþbringþ, sona he sent his sicol, forðam ðæt rip æt is.
4.30: And eft he cwæþ, For hwam geanlicie we heofena rice? oððe hwylcum bigspelle wiðmete we hit?
4.31: Swa swa senepes sæd, ðonne hit biþ on eorþan gesawen, hit is ealra sæda læst ðe on eorþan synd;
4.32: And ðonne hyt asawen biþ, hit astihþ, and biþ ealra wyrta mæst; and hæfþ swa mycele bogas, ðæt heofenes fugelas eardian magon under his sceade.
4.33: And manegum swylcum bigspellum he spræc to him, ðæt hi mihton gehyran;
4.34: Ne spæc he na butan bigspelle. Eall he his leorningcnihtum asundron rehte. Seo gestillung þæs stormes
4.35: And sæde him, ðonne æfen biþ, Uton faran agen.
4.36: And ða menigu forlætende, hi onfengon hine, swa he on scipe wæs; and oðre scipu wæron mid him.
4.37: And ða wæs mycel yst windes geworden, and yþa he awearp on ðæt scyp, ðæt hit gefylled wæs.
4.38: And he wæs on scipe, ofer bolster slapende. And hi awehton hine, and cwædon, Ne belimpþ to ðe, ðæt we forweorðaþ?
4.39: And he aras, and ðam winde bebead, and cwæþ to ðære sæ, Suwa, and gestil. And se wind geswac ða, and wearþ mycel smyltnes.
4.40: And he sæde him, Hwi synd ge forhte? gyt ge babbaþ geleafan?
4.41: And hi micclum ege him ondredon, and cwædon ælc to oðrum, Hwæt wenst ðu, hwæt is ðes? ðæt him windas and sæ hyrsumiaþ.

5.1: Ða comon hi ofer ðære sæs muþan on ðæt rice Hierasenorum.
5.2: And hym of scipe gangendum, him sona agen arn an aman of dam byrgenum on unclænum gaste.
5.3: Se hæfde on byrgenum scræf, and hine nan man mid racenteagum ne mihte gebindan.
5.4: Forðam he oft mid fotcopsum and racenteagum gebunden, toslat ða raceteaga, and ða fotcopsas tobræc, and hine nan man gewyldan ne mihte.
5.5: And symle, dæges and nihtes, he wæs on byrgenum and on muntum, hrymende, and hine sylfne mid stanum ceorfende.
5.6: Soþlice ða he ðone Hæland feorran geseah, he arn, and hine gebæd.
5.7: And mycelre stemne hrymende, and ðus cwæþ, Eala mæra Hælend, godes sunu, hwæt is me and ðe? Ic halsige ðe þurh god, ðæt ðu me ne þreage.
5.8: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Eala unclæna gast, ga of ðysum men.
5.9: Ða ahsode he hyne, Hwæt is ðin nama? Ða cwæþ he, Min nama is legio; forðam we manega synd.
5.10: And he hine swyðe bæd, ðæt he hine of ðam rice ne nydde.
5.11: Ðar wæs embe ðone munt mycel swyna heord læswigende.
5.12: And ða unclænan gastas hyne bædon, and cwædon, Send us on ðas swyn, ðæt we on hi gegan.
5.13: And ða lyfde se Hælend sona. And ða eodon ða unclænan gastas on ða swyn, and on myclum hryre seo heord wearþ on sæ bescofen, twa þusendo, and wurdon adruncene on ðære sæ.
5.14: Soþlice ða ðe hi heoldon, flugon, and cyðdon on ðære ceastre, and on lande; and hi uteodon, ðæt hi gesawon hwæt ðar gedon wære.
5.15: And hi comon to ðam Hælende, and hi gesawon ðone ðe mid deofle gedreht wæs, gescrydne sittan, and hales modes; and hi him ondredon.
5.16: And hi rehton him, ða ðe hit gesawon, hu hit gedon wæs be ðam ðe deofolseocnesse hæfde, and be ðam swynum.
5.17: And hi bædon, ðæt he of hyra gemærum fore.
5.18: Ða he on scip edoe, hine ongan biddan, se ðe ær mid deofle gedreht wæs, ðæt he mid him wære.
5.19: Him ða se Hælend ne getiðode, ac he sæde him, ga to ðinum huse to ðinum hiwum, and cyþ him, hu mycel Drihten gedyde, and he gemiltsode ðe.
5.20: And he ða ferde, and ongan bodigean on Decapolim, hu fela se Hælend him dyde; and hig ealle ðæs wundredon. Seo hælo wifes and Iairus seocre dohtor
5.21: And ða se Hælend eft on scype ferde ofer ðone muþan, him com to mycel menigu, and wæs ymbe ða sæ.
5.22: And ða com sum of heahgesamnungum, Iairus hatte, and ða he hyne geseah, he astrehte hine to his fotum,
5.23: And hine swyðe bæd, and he cwæþ, Min dohtor is on ytemestum sðe; cum, and sete ðine hand ofer hi, ðæt heo hal sy, and lybbe.
5.24: Ða ferde he mid him, and him fyligde mycel menigeo, and þrungon hine.
5.25: And ða ðæt wif ðe on blodes ryne twelf winter wæs,
5.26: And fram manegum læcum fela þinga þolode, and dælde eall ðæt heo ahte, and hit naht ne fremode, ac wæs ðe wyrse.
5.27: Ða heo be ðam Hælende gehyrde, eho com wiðæftan ða menigu, and his reaf æthran.
5.28: Soþlice heo cwæþ, gif ic furðon his reafes æthrin, ic beo hal.
5.29: And ða sona wearþ hyre blodes ryne adruwod, and heo on hire gefredde ðæt heo of ðam wite gehæled wæs.
5.30: And ða se Hælend oncneow on him silfum ðæt him mægen of eode, he cwæþ, bewend to ðære menigu, Hwa æthran mines reafes?
5.31: Ða cwædon his leorningcnihtas, Ðu gesyhst ðas menigu ðe þringende, and ðu cwyst, Hwa æthran me?
5.32: And ða beseah hine, ðæt he gesawe ðæne ðe ðæt dyde.
5.33: Ðat wif ða ondrædende and forhtigende, … com, and astrehte hi beforan him, and sæde him eall ðæt riht.
5.34: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Dohtor, ðin geleafa ðe hale gedyde; ga ðe on sibbe, and beo of ðisum hal.
5.35: Him ða gyt sprecendum, hi comon fram ðam heahgesamnungum, and cwædon, Ðin dohtor is dead; hwi drecst ðu leng ðone lareow?
5.36: Ða he gehyrde ðæt word, ða cwæþ se Hælend, Ne ondræd ðu ðe, gelyf for an.
5.37: And he ne let him ænig ne fyligean, buton Petrum, and Iacobum, and Iohannem, Iacobes broðor.
5.38: And hi comon on ðæs heahealdres hus. And he geseah mycel gehyd, wepende and geomriende.
5.39: And ða he ineode, he cwæþ, Hwi synd ge gedrefede, and wepaþ? Nis ðis mæden na dead, ac heo slæpþ.
5.40: Ða tældon hi hine. He ða, eallum utadrifenum, nam ðæs mædenes [fæder and] moder, and ða ðe mid him wæron, and inneodon suwiende, ðar ðæt mæden wæs.
5.41: And hire hand nam, and cwæþ, Thalimtha, cumi, ðæt is on ure geþeode gereht, Mæden, ðe ic secge, aris.
5.42: And heo sona aras, and eode; soþlice heo wæs twelf wintre. And ealle hi wundredon mycelre wundrunge.
5.43: And he him þearle behead, ðæt hi hyt nanum men ne sædon. And he het hire etan syllan.

6.1: And ða he ðanum eode, he ferde on his eðel; and him folgodon his leorningcnihtas.
6.2: And gewordenum restedæge, he ongan on gesamnunge læran. And manege gehyrdon and wundredon on his lare, and cwædon, Hwanon synd ðyssum ealle ðas þing? And hwæt is se wisdom ðe him geseald is, and swylce mihta ðe þurh his handa gewordene synd?
6.3: Hu nys [ðys] se smiþ, Marian sunu, Iacobes broðor and Isoepes and Iude and Simonis? hu ne synd his swustra her mid us? And ða wurdon hi gedrefede.
6.4: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Soþlice nis nan witega buton wurþscipe, buton on his eðele, and on his mægþe, and on his huse.
6.5: And he ne mihte ðar ænig mægen wyrcan, buton feawa untrunie, onasettum his handum, he gehælde.
6.6: And he wundrode for heora ungeleafan, He ða lærende ða castel beferde. Iesus utsent þa leorningcnihtas
6.7: And him twelfe to geclypode, and agan hi sendan twam and twam; and him anweald sealde unclænra gasta,
6.8: And him bebead, ðæt hi naht on wege ne namon, buton gyrde ane, ne codd, ne hlaf, ne feoh on heora gyrdlum,
6.9: Ac gesceode mid calcum, and ðæt hi mid twam tunecum gescrydde næron.
6.10: And he cwæþ to him, Swa hwyle hus swa ge ingaþ, wunigaþ ðar, oððæt ge utgan.
6.11: And swa hwylce swa eow ne gehyraþ, ðonne ge ðanon utgaþ asceacaþ ðæt dust of eowrum fortum, him on gewitnesse.
6.12: And utgangende, hi bodedon, ðæt hi dædbote dydon.
6.13: And hi manega deofolseocnessa utadrifon, and manega untrume mid ele smyredon, and gehældon. Se deaþ Iohannes þæs Fullwihteres
6.14: And ða gehyrde Herodes se cyng, ðæt soþlice his nama wæs swutol geworden, and he[d] cwæþ, witodlice Iohannes se Fulluhtere of deaþe aras, and on him synd forðam mægenu geworht.
6.15: Sume cwædon, He is Elias; sume cwædon, He is witega, swylce an of ðam witegum.
6.16: Ða Herodes ðæt gehyrde, he cwæþ, Se Iohannes, ðe ic beheafdode, se aras of deaþe.
6.17: Soþlice Herodes sende, and het Iohannem, gebindan on cwerterne, for ðære Herodiadiscan, his broðor lafe, Philippus; forðam ðe he nam hi.
6.18: Ða sæde Iohannes Herode, Nys ðe alyfed, to hæbbenne ðines broðer wif.
6.19: Ða syrwde Herodias ymbe hine, and wolde hyne ofslean, and heo ne mihte.
6.20: Soðlice Herodes ondred Iohannem, and wiste ðæt he wæs rihtwis and halig, and he heold hine on cwerterne. And he gehyrde ðæt he fela wundra worhte, and he lufelice him hyrde.
6.21: Ða se dæg com Herodes gebyrdtide, he gegearwode mycele feorme his ealdormannum, and ðam fyrmestum on galilea.
6.22: And ða ða ðæra Herodiadiscan dohtor inneode, and trumbode, hit licode Herode, and eallum ðam ðe him mid sæton, se cing cwæþ ða to ðam mædene, Bide me swa hwæt swa ðu wylle, and ic ðe sylle.
6.23: And he swor hire, Soþes ic ðe sylle, swa hwæt swa ðu me bitst, ðeah ðu wylle healf min rice.
6.24: Ða heo uteode, heo cwæþ to hyre meder, Hwæs bidde ic? Ða cwæþ heo, Iohannes heafod ðæs Fulluhteres.
6.25: Sona ða heo mid ofeste in to ðam cyninge eode, heo bæd, and ðus cwæþ, Ic wylle ðæt ðu me hrædlice on anum disce sylle Iohannes heafod.
6.26: Ða wearþ se cyning geunret forðam aþe, and forðam ðe him mid sæton nolde ðeah hi geunretan;
6.27: Ac sende ænne cwellere, and bebead ðæt man his heafod on anum disce brohte. And he hine ða on cwerterne beheafdode,
6.28: And his heafod on disce brohte, and hit sealde ðam mædene, and ðæt mæden hit sealde hire meder.
6.29: Ða his cnihtas ðæt gehyrdon, hi comon, and his lic namon, and hine on byrgene ledon. Fife þusendu wordon gefed
6.30: Soþlice ða ða apostolas togædere comon, hi cyddon ðam Hælende eall, ðæt hi dydon, and hi lærdon.
6.31: And he sæde him, Cumaþ and uton gan onsundron on weste stowe; and us hwon restan. Soþlice manega wæron ðe comon, and agenhwyrfdon, and fyrst næfdon ðæt hi æton.
6.32: And on scryp stigende, hi foron onsundron on weste stowe.
6.33: And gesawon hi farende, and hi gecneowon manega, and gangende of ðam burgum, ðyder urnon, and him beforan comon.
6.34: And ða se Hælend ðanon eode he geseah mycele menegu, and he gemiltsode him, forðam ðe hi wæron swa swa scep ðe nanne hyrde nabbaþ. And he ongan hi fela læran.
6.35: And ða hit mycel ylding wæs, his leorningcnihtas him to comon, and cwædon, Deos stow is weste, and tima is forþagan;
6.36: Forlæt ðas manegu, ðæt hi faron on gehende tunas, and him mete bicgan ðæt hi eton.
6.37: Ða cwæþ he, Sylle ge him etan. Ða cwædon hi, Uton gan and mid twam hundred penegum hlafas biegan, and we him etan syllaþ.
6.38: Ða cwæþ he, Hu fela hlafa hæbba ge? gaþ and lociaþ. And ða hi wiston, hi cwædon, Fif hlafas, and twegen fixas.
6.39: And ða bebead se Hælend, ðæt ðæt fole sæte ofer ðæt grene hig.
6.40: And hi ða sæton, hundredum, and fiftigum.
6.41: And fif hlafum, and twam fixum onfangenum, he on heofon locode, and hi bletsode, and ða hlafas bræc, and sealde his leorningcnihtum, ðæt hi toforan him asetton. And twegen fixas him eallon dælde;
6.42: And hi æton ða ealle, and gefyllede wurdon.
6.43: And hi namon ðara hlafa, and fixa lafa, twelf wilian fulle.
6.44: Soþlice fif þusend manna, ðara etendra wæron. Iesus gangeþ ofer wætere
6.45: Ða sona he nydde his leorningcnihtas on scyp stigan, ðæt hig him beforan foron ofer ðæne muþan to Bethsaida, oð he ðæt folc forlete.
6.46: And ða he hi forlet, he ferde on ðone munt, and hine ana ðar gehæd.
6.47: And ða æfen wæs, ðæt scyp wæs on middre sæ, and he ana wæs on lande;
6.48: And he geseah hi on rewette swincende; him wæs wiðerweard wind. And on niht embe ða feorþan wæccan, he com to him ofer ða sæ gangende, and wolde hi forbugan.
6.49: Ða hi hine gesawon ofer ða sæ gangende, hi wendon ðæt hit unfæle gast wære, and hi clypedon;
6.50: Hi ealle hine gesawon, and wurdon gedrefede. And sona he spræc to him, and cwæþ, gelyfaþ, ic hit eom; ne þurfon ge eow ondrædan.
6.51: And he on scryp to him eode, and se wind geswac. And hi ðæs ðe ma betwux him wundredon;
6.52: Ne ongeton hi be ðam hlafum; soþlice heora heorte wæs ablend. Seo hælo seocra on genesaret
6.53: And ða hi ofersegledon, hi comon to genesaret, and ðar wicedon.
6.54: And ða hi of scipe eodon, sona hi hine gecneowon.
6.55: And eall ðæt rice befarende, hi on sæccingum bæron ða untruman, ðar hi hine gehyrdon.
6.56: And swa hwar swa he on wic oððe on tunas eode, on stræton hi ða untruman ledon, and hine bædon, ðæt hi huru his refes fnæd æthrinon; and swa fela swa hine æthrinon, hi wurdon hale.

7.1: Ða comon to him Pharisei and sume boceras cumende fram Hierusalem.
7.2: And ða hi gesawon sume of his leorningcnihtum besmitenum handum, ðæt is, unþwogenum handum, etan, hi tældon hi and cwædon,
7.3: Pharisei and ealle Iudeas ne etaþ, buton hi hyra handa gelomlice þwean, healdende hira yldrena gesetnessa.
7.4: And on stræte, hi ne etaþ, buton hi geþwegene beon; and manega oðre synd, ðe him gesette synd, ðæt is calicea fyrmþa, and ceaca, arfata, and mæstlinga.
7.5: And ða acsodon hine Pharisei and ða boceras, Hwi ne gaþ ðine leorningcnihtas æfter ure yldrena gesetnysse, ac besmitenum handum hyra hlaf þicgaþ?
7.6: Ða andswarode he him, wel witegode Isaias be eow, licceterum, swa hit awriten is, Ðis folc me mid welerum weorþaþ, soþlice hyra heorte is feor fram me;
7.7: On idel hi me weorþiaþ, and manna lara and behodu læraþ.[e]
7.8: Soþlice ge forlætaþ godes bebod, and healdaþ manna laga, þweala ceaca, and calica; and manega oðre ðyllice þing ge doþ.
7.9: Ða sæde he him, wel ge on idel dydon godes bebod, ðæt ge eower laga healdon.
7.10: Moyses cwæþ, wurþa ðinne fæder and ðine modor; and se ðe wyrigþ his fæder and his modor, swelte se deaþe.
7.11: Soþlice ge cweðaþ, gif hwa segþ his fæder and meder, Corban, ðæt is on ure geþeode, gyfu gif hwylc is of me, ðe fremaþ;
7.12: And ofer ðæt ge ne lætaþ hine ænig þing don his fæder oððe meder,
7.13: Toslitende godes bebod for eower stuntan lage, ðe ge gesetton; and manega oðre þing ðyssum gelice ge doþ. Þæt fulaþ mann
7.14: And eft ða manegu he him to clypode, and cwæþ, gehyraþ me ealle, and ongytaþ.
7.15: Nys nan þing of ðam men on hine gangende, ðæt hine besmitan mæge; ac ða þing ðe of ðam men forþgaþ, ða hine besmitaþ.
7.16: gif hwa earan hæbbe, gehlyste me.
7.17: And ða se Hælend fram ðære menegu eode, his leorningcnihtas hine an bigspel acsodon.
7.18: Ða cwæþ he, And synd ge ðus ungleawe? Ne ongyte ge, ðæt eall ðæt utan cymþ on ðone man gangende, ne mæg hine besmitan?
7.19: Forðam hit ne gæþ on his heortan, ac on his innoþ, and on forþgang gewiteþ, ealle mettas clænsigende.
7.20: Ða sæde he him, Ðæt ða þing ðe of ðam men gaþ, ða hine besmitaþ.
7.21: Innan, of manna heortan yfele geþancas cumaþ, unrihthæmedu, and forligeru, manslihtas,
7.22: [Stala,] gitsung, man, facnu, sceamleast, yfel gesihþ, dysinessa, ofermodignessa, stuntscipe.
7.23: and ealle ðas yfelu of ðam innoðe cumaþ, and ðone man besmitaþ. Se geleafa þæs Sirofeniscan wifes
7.24: Ða ferde he ðanon on ða endas Tyri and Sidonis. And he inagan on ðæt hus, he nolde ðæt hit ænig wiste; and he ne mihte hit bemiþan.
7.25: Sona ða an wif, be him gehyrde, ðære dohtor hæfde unclænne gast, heo ineode, and to his fotum hi astrehte.
7.26: Soþlice ðæt wif wæs hæðen, Sirofenisces cynnes. And bæd hine, ðæt he ðone deofol of hyre dehter adrife.
7.27: Ða sæde he hire, Læt ærest ða bearn beon gefylled; nis na god ðæt man nime ðara bearna hlaf, and hundum werpe.
7.28: Ða andswarode heo, and cwæþ, Drihten, ðæt is soþ; witodlice ða hwelpas etaþ under ðære mysan, of ðara cilda cruman.
7.29: Ða sæde he hyre, For ðære spræce ga, nu se deofol of ðinre dehter gewit.
7.30: And ða heo on hyre hus eode, heo gemette ðæt mæden on hire bedde licgende, and ðone deofol utgan. Seo hælo deafes
7.31: And eft he eode of Tyra gemærum, and com þurh Sidonem to ðære galileiscan sæ, betwux middle endas Decapoleos.
7.32: And hi læddon him ænne deafne and dumbne, and hine bædon, dæt he his hand him on asette.
7.33: Ða nam he hine onsundran of ðære menigu, and his fingras on his earan dyde; and spætende his tungan onhran.
7.34: And on ðone heofon behealdende, geomrode, and cwæþ, Effeta, ðæt is on ure gþeode, Sy ðu ontyned,
7.35: And sona wurdon his earan geopenode, and his tungan bend wearþ unslyped, and he rihte spræc.
7.36: And he bead him, ðæt hi hit nanum men ne sædon; soþlice swa he him swiðor bebead, swa hi swiðor bodedon,
7.37: And ðæs ðe ma wundredon, and cwædon, Ealle þing he wel dyde, and he dyde ðæt deafe gehyrdon, and dumbe spræcon.

8.1: Eft on ðam dagum, him wæs mid micel menigu, and næfdon hwæt hi æton, ða cwæþ he, to somne geclypedum his leorningcnihtum,
8.2: Ie gemiltsige ðysse menegu, forðam hi þry dagas me geanbidiaþ, and nabbaþ hwæt hi eton;
8.3: gif ic hi fæstende to hyra husum læte, be wege hi geteorigeaþ; sume hi comon feorran.
8.4: And ða andswarodon him his leorningcnihtas, Hwanon mæg ænig man ðas mid hlafum on ðisum westene gefyllan?
8.5: Ða axode he hi, Hu fela hlafa hæbbe ge? He cwædon, Seofon.
8.6: Ða het he sittan ða menegu ofer ða eorþan. And nam ða seofon hlafas, and gode þancode, and hi bræc, and sealde his leorningcnihtum, ðæt hi toforan him asetton. And he swa dydon.
8.7: And hi næfdon buton feawa fixa; and he ða bletsode, and het beforan him settan.
8.8: And hi æton, and wurdon gefyllede; and hi namon ðæt of ðam brytsenum belaf, seofon wilian fulle.
8.9: Soþlice ða ðe ðar æton, wæron fif[f] þusend; and he hi ða forlet.
8.10: And sona he on scyp, mid his leorningcnihtum, astah, and com on ða dælas Dalmanuþa. Þa Sundorhalgan
8.11: And ða ferdon ða Pharisei, and ongunnon mid him smeagean, and tacen of heofone sohton, and his fandedon.
8.12: Ða cwæþ he, geomriende on his gaste, Hwi secþ ðeos cneoris tacen? Soþlice ic eow secge, ne biþ ðisse cneorisse tacen geseald.
8.13: And hi ða forlætende, eft on scyp astah, and ferde ofer ðone muþan.
8.14: And hi ofergeton ðæt hi hlafas ne namon, and hi næfdon on scype mid him buton ænne hlaf.
8.15: And he him bead, and cwæþ, Lociaþ, and warniaþ fram Pharisea, and Herodes hæfe.
8.16: Ða þohton, hi betwux him, and cwædon, Næbbe we nane hlafas.
8.17: Ða se Hælend ðæt wiste, he cwæþ, Hwæt þence ge, forðam ge hlafas nabbaþ? gyt ge ne oncnawaþ, ne ne ongytaþ; gyt ge habbaþ eowre heortan geblende.
8.18: Eagan ge habbaþ, and ne geseoþ, and earan, and ne gehyraþ; ne ge ne þencaþ,
8.19: Hwænne ic bræc fif hlafas and twegen fixas, and hu fela wyligena ge namon fulle? Hi cwædon ða, Twelfe.
8.20: And hwænne seofon hlafas feower þusendum, and hu fela wyligena brytsena ge namon fulle? Hi sædon, Seofon.
8.21: Ða sæde he him, Hwi ne ongyte ge gyt? Seo hælo blindes
8.22: And hi comon ða to Bethzaida, and hi brohton him ða ænne blindne, and hine bædon, ðæt he hine æthrine.
8.23: And ða æthran he ðæs blindan hand, and lædde hine butan ða wic, and spætte on his eagan, and his hand onasette, and hine axode, hwæðer he aht gesawe.
8.24: Ða cwaað he ða, ða he hyne beseah, Ic geseo men swylce treow gangende.
8.25: Eft he asette his handa ofer his eagan, and he geseah ða, and wearþ geedniwod, swa ðæt he beorhtlice eall geseah.
8.26: Ða sende he hyne to his huse, and cwæþ, ga to ðinum huse; and ðeah ðu on tun ga, nænegum ðu hit ne sege. Petrus hateþ Crist
8.27: Ða eode he and his leorningcnihtas on ðæt castel Cesareæ Philippi. And he on wege his leorningcnihtas ahsode, Hwæt secgaþ men ðæt ic sy?
8.28: Ða andswarodon hi, Sume, Iohannem ðone Fulluhtere; sume, Heliam; sume, sumne of ðam witegum.
8.29: Ða cwæþ he, Hwæt secge ge ðæt ic sy? Ða andswarode Petrus him, and cwæþ, Ðu eart Crist.
8.30: And ða bead he him, ðæt hi nænegum be him ne sædon. Iesus forecweðeþ his deaþ
8.31: Ða ongan he hi læran, ðat mannes sunu gebyreþ fela þinga þolian, and beon aworpen fram ealdormannum, and heahsacerdum, and bocerum, and beon ofslegen, and æfter þrim dagum arisan.
8.32: And spræc ða openlice. And ða nam Petrus hine, and ongan hine þreagean.
8.33: Ða bewende he hine, and cidde Petre, and cwæþ, ga onbæc, Satanas; forðam ðu nast ða þing ðe synd godes, ac ða þing ðe synd manna.
8.34: Ða cwæþ he, togædere geclypedre menegu, mid his leorningcnihtum, gif hwa wyle me fyligean, wiðsace hine sylfne, and nime his cwylminge, and folgige me.
8.35: Se ðe wyle his sawle hale gedon, se hi forspilþ; se ðe forspilþ his sawle for me and for ðam godspelle se hig gehælþ.
8.36: Hwæt fremaþ men, ðeah he eallne middaneard gestryne, and do his sawle forwyrd?
8.37: Oððe hwylc gewryxl sylþ se man for his sawle?
8.38: Soþlice se ðe me forsyhþ, and mine word on ðisre unrihthæmedan and synfulran cneorisse, ðone mannes sunu forsyhþ, ðonne he cymþ on his fæder wuldre, mid halgum englum.

9.1: Ða sæde he him, Soþlice ic secge eow, ðæt sume synd her wuniende, ðe deaþ ne onbyrigeaþ, ær hi geseon godes rice on mægne cuman. Seo oferhiwung
9.2: Ða æfter syx dagum nam se Hælend Petrum, and Iacobum, and Iohannem, and lædde hi sylfe on sundron on sumne heahne munt; and wearþ beforan him oferhiwod.
9.3: And his reaf wurdon glitiniende swa hwite swa snaw, swa nan fullere ofer eorþan ne mæg swa hwite gedon.
9.4: Ða ætywde him Helias mid Moyse, and to him spræcon.
