9.5: Ða andswarode Petrus him and cwæþ. Lareow, god is ðæt we her beon; and uton wyrcan her þreo eardungstowa, ðe ane, and Moyse ane, and Helie ane.
9.6: Soþlice he nyste hweat he cwæþ; he wæs afæred mid ege.
9.7: And seo lyft hi ofersceadewode; and stefn com of ðære lyfte, and cwæþ, Ðes is min leofesta sunu, gehyraþ hine.
9.8: And sona ða hi besawon, hi nanne hi mid him ne gesawon, buton ðone Hælend sylfne mid him.
9.9: And ða hi of ðam munte astigon, he bead him, ðæt hi nanum ne sædon ða þing ðe hi gesawon, buton ðonne mannes sunu of deaþe arise.
9.10: Hi ða ðæt word geheoldon betwux him, and smeadon hwæt ðæt wære, ðonne he of deaþe arise.
9.11: And hi hine ahsodon ða, Hwæt secgaþ Pharisei and ða boceras, ðæt gebyraþ ærest Helias cume?
9.12: Ða sæde he him andswariende, Helias ealle þing geedniwaþ, ðonne he cymþ; swa be mannes suna awriten is, ðæt he fela þolige, and si oferhogod.
9.13: Ac ic secge eow, ðæt Helias com, and hi dydon him swa hwæt swa hi woldon, swa be him awriten is. Cniht unclænne gast hæbbende
9.14: And ða he com to his leorningcnihtum, he geseah mycele menegu abuton hi, and boceras mid him sprecende.
9.15: And sona eall foc ðæne Hælend geseonde, wearþ afæred, and forht; and hine gretende, him to urnon.
9.16: Ða ahsode he hi, Hwæt smeage ge betweox eow?
9.17: Him andswarode an of ðære menigu, Lareow, ic brohte minne sunu dumbne gast hæbbende;
9.18: Se swa hwær swa he hine gelæcþ, forgnit hine, and toþum gristbitaþ, and forscrincþ. And ic sæde ðinum leorningcnihtum, ðæt hi hine utadrifon, and hi ne mihton.
9.19: Ða andswarode he him Eala! ungeleaffulle cneorys, swa lange swa ic mid eow beo swa lange ic eow þolige? Bringaþ hine to me.
9.20: Ða brohton hi hine. And ða he hine geseah, sona se gast hine gedrefde; and on eorþan forgnyden, fæmende he tearflode.
9.21: And ða ahsode he hys fæder, Hu lang tid is, syððan him ðis gebyrede? Ða cwæþ he, Of cildhade;
9.22: He hine gelomlice on fyr and on wæter sende, ðæt he hine forspilde; ac gif ðu hwæt miht, gefylst us, ure gemiltsod.
9.23: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, gyf ðu gelyfan miht, ealle þing synd gelyfedum mihtlice.
9.24: Ða sona hyrmde ðæs cildes fæder and wepende cwæþ, Drihten, ic gelyfe; gefylst minre ungeleaffulnysse.
9.25: And ða se Hælend geseah ða toyrnendan menegu, he bebead ðam unclænan gaste, ðus cweðende, Eala deafa and dumba gast, ic beode ðe, ga of him, and ne ga ðu leng on hine.
9.26: He ða hrymende, and hine swyðe slitende, eode of him; and he wæs swylce he dead wære, swa ðæt manega cwædon, soþlice he is dead.
9.27: Ða nam se Hælend his hand, and hine upahof; and he aras ða.
9.28: And ða he into ðam huse code, his leorningcnihtas hine digollice ahsodon, Hwi ne mihton we hine utadrifan?
9.29: Ða sæde he, Ðis cyn ne mæg of nanum men utgan, buton þurh gebedu and on fæstene. Oðer forecwide Iesus deaðes and uppastigunge
9.30: Ða hi ðanon ferdon, hig forbugon galileam; he nolde ðæt hit ænig man wiste.
9.31: Soplice he lærde his leorningcnihtas, and sæde, Soþlice mannes sunu biþ geseald on synfulra handa, ðæt hi hine ofslean, and ofslagen, ðam þriddan dæge he arist.
9.32: Ða nyston hi ðæt word, and hi adredon hine ahsiende. gewinn ongemang þara folgera
9.33: Ða comon hi to Capharnaum. And ða hi æt ham wæron, he ahsode hi Hwæt smeade ge be wege?
9.34: And hi suwodon; witodlice hi on wege smeadon, hwylc hyra yldost wære.
9.35: Ða he sæt he clypode hi twelfe, and sæde him, gif eower hwylc wyle beon fyrmest, beo se eaðmodost, and eower ealra þen.
9.36: Ða nam he anne cnapan, and gesette on hyra middele; ða he hine beclypte, he sæde him,
9.37: Swa hwylc swa anne of dus geradum cnapum on minum naman onfehþ, se onfehþ me; and se ðe me onfehþ, he ne onfehþ me, ac ðone ðe me sende.
9.38: Ða andswarode Iohannes, and cwæþ, Lareow, sumne we gesawon on ðinum naman deofolseocnessa utadrifende, se ne fyligþ us, and we him forbudon.
9.39: Ða cwæþ he, Ne forbeode ge him; nis nan ðe on minum naman mægen wyrce, and mæge raðe be me yfele sprecan.
9.40: Se ðe nis agen eow, se is for eow.
9.41: Soþlice se ðe sylþ drinc eow calic fulne wæteres on minum naman, forðam ge Cristes synd, ic eow soþ secge, ne forlyst he his mede.
9.42: And swa hwa swa gedrefþ ænne of ðyssum lytlingum on me gelyfendum, betere him wære ðæt an cweornstan wære to his sweoran gecnyt, and wære on sæ beworpen.
9.43: And gif ðin hand ðe swicaþ, ceorf hi of; betere ðe is ðæt ðu wanhal to life ga, ðonne ðu twa handa hæbbe and fare on helle, and on unacwencedlic fyr,
9.44: Ðar hyra wyrm ne swylt, and fyr ne biþ acwenced.
9.45: And gif ðin fot swicaþ ðe, ceorf hine of; betere ðe is ðæt ðu healt ga on ece lif, ðonne ðu hæbbe twegen fet and si aworpen on helle, unacwencedlices fyres,
9.46: Ðar hyra wyrm ne swylt, ne fyr ne biþ adwæsced.
9.47: gif ðin eage ðe swicaþ, weorp hit ut; betere ðe is mid anum eagan gan on godes rice, ðonne twa eagan hæbbende sy aworpen on helle fyr,
9.48: Ðar hyra wyrm ne swylt, ne fyr ne biþ acwenced.
9.49: Soþlice æle man biþ mid fyre gesylt, and ælc offrung biþ mid sealte gesylt.
9.50: god is sealt; gif ðæt sealt unsealt biþ, on ðam ðe ge hit syltaþ? Habbaþ sealt on eow, and habbaþ sibbe betwux eow.

10.1: And ðanon, he com on Iudeisce endas of Iordane; ða comon eft menigu to him, and swa swa he gewunode, he hi lærde eftsona.
10.2: Ða genealæhton him Pharisei, and hine axodon, Hwæðer alyfþ ænegum men his wif forlætan? his ðus fandigende.
10.3: Ða andswarode he him, Hwæt bead Moyses eow?
10.4: Hi sædon, Moyses lyfde ðæt man write hiwgedales boc, and hi forlete.
10.5: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, For eowre heortan heardnesse he eow wrat ðis bebod.
10.6: Fram fruman gesceasfte god hi geworhte wæpnedman and wimman;
10.7: And cwæþ, Forðam se man forlæt his fæder and moder, and hine his wife gðeot,
10.8: And beoþ twegen on anum flæsce. witodlice ne synd na twegen, ac an flæsc.
10.9: Ðæt god gesamnode, ne syndrige ðæt nan man.
10.10: And eft innan huse his leorningcnihtas hine be ðam ylcan ahsodon.
10.11: Ða cwæþ he, Swa hwylc man swa his wif forlæt, and oðer nimþ, unrihthæmed he wyrcþ þurh hi.
10.12: And gif ðæt wif hire were forlæt, and oðerne nimþ, heo unrihthæmþ. Lætaþ þa cildru cuman to me
10.13: And hi brohton him hyra lytlingas, ðæt he hi æthrine; ða ciddon his leorningcnihtas ðam ðe hi brohton.
10.14: Ða se Hælend hi geseah, unwurðlice he hit forbead, and sæde him, Lætaþ ða lytlingas to me cuman, and ne forbeode ge him, soþlice swylcera is heofona rice.
10.15: Soþlice ic secge eow, swa hwylc swa godes rice ne onfehþ swa lytling, ne gaæþ he on ðæt.
10.16: Ða beclypte he hi, and his handa ofer hi settende, bletsode hi. Se welga geonga mann
10.17: And ða he on wege eode, sum him to arn, and gebigedum cneowe toforan him, cwæþ, and bæd hine, La goda lareow, hwæt do ic, ðæt ic ece lif age?
10.18: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Hwi segst ðu me godne? Nis nan man god, buton god ana.
10.19: Canst ðu ða bebodu, ne unrihthæm ðu, ne slyh ðu, ne stel ðu, ne sege ðu lease gewitnesse, facen ne do ðu, weorþa ðinne fæder and ðine moder.
10.20: Ða andswarode he, goda lareow, eall ðis ic geheold of minre geoguðe.
10.21: Se Hælend hine ða behealdende, lufode; and sæde him, An þing ðe is wana; gesyle eall ðæt ðu age, and syle hit þearfum, ðonne hæfst ðu goldhord on heofonum; and cum, and folga me.
10.22: And for ðam worde he wæs geunret, and ferde gnornigende, forðam he hæfde mycele æhta.
10.23: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to his leorningcnihtum, hine beseonde, Swyðe earfoþlice on godes rice gaþ ða ðe feoh habbaþ.
10.24: Ða forhtodon his leorningcnihtas be his wordum, Eft se Hælend him andswariende cwæþ, Eala cild, swyðe earfoþlice ða ðe on heora feo getruwigeaþ gaþ on godes rice.
10.25: Eaðere ys olfende to farenne þurh nædle þyrel, ðonne se rice and se welega on godes rica ga.
10.26: Hi ðæs ðe ma betwux him wundredon, and cwædon, And hwa mæg beon hal?
10.27: Ða beheold se Hælend hi, and cwæþ, Mid mannum hit is uneaðelic, ac na mid gode; ealle þing mid gode synd eaðelice.
10.28: Ða ongan Petrus cweðan, witodlice! we ealle þing forleton, and folgodon ðe.
10.29: Ða andswarode him se Hælend, Nis nan ðe his hus forlæt, oððe gebroðru, oððe geswustra, oððe fæder, oððe moder, ððe bearn, oððe æceras for me and for ðam godspelle,
10.30: Ðe hundfeald ne onfo nu on ðisse tide, hus, and broðru, and swustra, and fæder and moder, and bearn, and æceras, mid ehtnessum, and on toweardre worulde ece lif.
10.31: Manega fyrmesta beoþ ytemeste, and ytemeste fyrmeste. Se þridda forecwide Iesus deaðes
10.32: Soþlice hi ferdon on wege to Hierusalem; and se Hælend him beforan eode, and hi adredon him hine, and him fyligdon. And eft he nam hi twelfe, and ongan him secgan, ða þing ðe him towearde wæron.
10.33: Ðæt we nu astigaþ to Hierusalem, and mannes sunu biþ geseald sacerda ealdrum, and bocerum, and ealdrum; and hi hine deaþe genyðeriaþ, and hi hine þeodum syllaþ.
10.34: And hi hine bysmriaþ, and hi him on spætaþ, and hine swingaþ; and ofsleaþ hine, and he arist on ðam briddan dæge. Seo ascung fram Iacobus and Iohannes
10.35: Him ða genealæhton to Iacobus and Iohannes, Zebedeis suna, and cwædon, Lareow, we wyllaþ, ðæt ðu us do, swa hwæt swa we biddaþ.
10.36: Ða cwæþ he, Hwæt wylle gyt ðæt in inc do?
10.37: Ða cwædon hi, Syle unc, ðæt wyt sitton, on ðinum wuldre, an on ðine swyðran healfe, and oðer on ðine wynstran.
10.38: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, gyt nyton hwæt gyt biddaþ; mage gyt drincan ðone calic, ðe ic drince, and beon gefullod on ðam fulluhte, ðe ic beo gefullod?
10.39: Ða cwædon hi, wyt magon. Ða cwæþ se Hælend, gyt drincaþ ðone calic ðe ic drince, gyt beoþ gefullode ðam fulluhte, ðe ic beo gefullod;
10.40: Soþlice nis hit na min inc to syllenne ðæt gyt sitton on mine swyðram healfe oððe on ða wynstran, ac ðam ðe hit gegearwod ys.
10.41: Ða gebulgon ða tyne hi be Iacobe and Iohanne.
10.42: Ða clypode se Hælend hi, and cwæþ, wite ge, ðæt ða ðe on þeodum ealdorscype habbaþ, ðæt hyra ealdras anweald ofer hi habbaþ.
10.43: Soþlice on eow hit nis swa, ac swa hwylc swa wyle mid eow yldest beon, se byþ eower þen,
10.44: And se ðe wyle on eow fyrmest beon, se byþ ealra þeow.
10.45: Soþlice ne come mannes sunu, ðæt him man þenode, ac ðæt he þenode, and his sawle sealde for manegra alysednysse. Seo hælo blindes Bartimeus
10.46: Ða comon hi to gericho; and he ferde fram gericho, and his leorningcnihtas, and mycel menegu, Timeus sunu, Bartimeus, sæt blind, wið ðone weg wædla.
10.47: Ða he gehyrde, ðæt hit wæs se Nazarenisca Hælend, he ongan ða clypian, and cweðan, Hælend, Dauides sunu, gemiltsa me.
10.48: Ða budon him manega, ðæt he suwode; he clypode ða ðæs ðe ma, Miltsa me, Dauides sunu.
10.49: Ða ætstod se Hælend and het hine clypian; ða sædon hi ðam blindan, Beo geheortra, and aris, se Hælend ðe clypaþ.
10.50: He ða, awearp his reaf, and forþræsde, and to him com.
10.51: Ða cwæþ se Hæland, Hwæt wylt ðu ðæt ic ðe do? Ða cwæþ he, Lareow, ðæt ic geseo.
10.52: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to him, ga, ðin geleafa ðe halne gedyde. And he sona geseah, and him fyligde on wege.

11.1: Ða he genealæhte Hierusalem and Bethania, to Oliuetes dune, he sende his twegen leorningcnihtas,
11.2: And cwæþ to him, Faraþ to ðam castele ðe [ongen] inc ys; and gyt ðar sona gemetaþ assan folan getigedne, ofer ðæne nan man gyt ne sæt; untigeaþ hine, and to me gelædaþ.
11.3: And gyf hwa to inc hwæt cwyþ, secgaþ, ðæt Drihten hæfþ his neode, and he hine sona hider læt.
11.4: And ða hi utferdon, hi gemetton ðone folan ute, on twycenan, beforan dura getigedne; ða untigdon hi hine.
11.5: And sume ðe ðar stodon ðus sædon him, Hwæt do gyt, ðone folan untigende?
11.6: Ða cwædon hi, swa se Hælend unc bead; and hi leton hi ða.
11.7: Ða læddon hi ðone folan to ðam Hælende, and hi hyra reaf onaledon, and he onsæt.
11.8: Manega hyra reaf on ðone weg strehton, sume ða [bogas] of ðam treowum heowon, and streowodon on ðone weg.
11.9: And ða ðe beforan eodon, and ða ðe æfterfolgodon, cwædon ðus, Osanna, sy gebletsod se ðe com on Drihtnes naman;
11.10: Si gebletsod ðæt rice ðe com ures fæder Dauides; Osanna on heahnessum.
11.11: And he eode ða on Hierosolima templ; and ealle þing he besceawode, ða æfen tima wæs, he ferde to Bethaniam, mid his twelf leorningcnihtum. Iesus awirgeþ þæt æppeltreow
11.12: And oðrum dæge, ða hi ferdon fram Bethania, hine hingrode.
11.13: Ða he feorran geseah an fictreow ðe leaf hæfde, he com, and sohte hwæðer he ðar on aht funde; ða he him to com, ne funde he ðar, buton leaf ane; soþlice hit wæs ðæs fictreowes tima.
11.14: Ða cwæþ he, Heononforþ on ecnesse ne ete ænig man wæstm of ðe. And his leorningcnihtas ðæt gehyrdon; Seo clænsung þæs temples
11.15: Ða comon hi eft to Hierusalem. And ða he on ðæt templ eode, he ongan drifan of ðam temple syllende and bicgende; and mynetera þrocu, and heahsetlu ðe ða culfran cypton he tobræc;
11.16: And he ne geþafode, ðæt ænig man ænig fæt þurh ðæt temple bære.
11.17: And he ða lærende, ðus cwæþ to him, Nis hit awriten, Ðæt min hus fram eallum þeodum biþ genemned gebedhus? soþlice ge dydon ðæt to sceaþena scræfe.
11.18: Ða ðæra sacerda ealdras and ða boceras ðis gehyrdon, hi þohton hu hi hine forspildon; ðeh hi him adredon hine, forðam eall seo menigu wundrode be his lare.
11.19: And ða hit æfen wæs, he eode of ðære ceastre. Þæt forscruncene ficctreow
11.20: On merigen ða hi ferdon, hi gesawon ðæt fictreow forscruncen of ðam wyrtruman.
11.21: Ða cwæþ Petrus, Lareow, loca! hu forscranc ðæt fictreow, ðe ðu wyrigdest.
11.22: Ða cwæþ se Hælend him andswarigende, Habbaþ godes truwan;
11.23: Ic secge eow to soþe, swa hwylc swa cwyþ to ðisum munte, Si ðu afyrred, and on sæ aworpen; and on his heortan ne twynaþ, ac gelyfþ, swa hwæt swa he cwyþ, gewurðe ðis, ðæt gewyrþ.
11.24: Forðam ic eow secge, swa hwæt swa ge gyrnende biddaþ, gelyfaþ ðæt ge hit onfoþ, and hit eow becymþ.
11.25: And ðonne ge standaþ eow to gebiddenne, forgifaþ, gif ge hwæt agen ænigne habbaþ, ðæt eow eower synna forgyfe, eower heofonlica fæder se ðe on heofonum ys.
11.26: gyf ge ne forgyfaþ, ne eow eower synna ne forgyfþ, eower fæder [se þe on heofonum ys ne sceall forgyfan eower synna.][g] Iesus anweald getweogeþ mannum
11.27: Ða com he eft to Hierusalem. And ða he on ðam temple eode, him to genealæhton ða heahsacerdas, and boceras, and ealdras,
11.28: And ðus cwædon, On hwylcum anwealde dest ðu ðas þing? And hwa sealde ðe ðisne anweald, ðæt ðu ðis do?
11.29: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, And ic ahsige eow anre spræce, andswariaþ me, and ic secge eow ðonne, hwylcum anwealde ic ðis do.
11.30: Hweðer wæs Iohannes fulluht ðe of heofone, ðe of mannum? andswariaþ me.
11.31: Ða þohton hi, and cwædon betweox him, gif we secgaþ of heofone, he segþ us, Hwi ne gelyde ge him;
11.32: gif we secgaþ of mannum, we ondrædaþ ðis folc; ealle hi hæfdon Iohannem, ðæt he wære soþlice witega.
11.33: Ða andswaredon hi ðam Hælende and cwædon, we nyton. Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Ne ic eow ne secge, on hwylcum anwealde ic ðas þing do.

12.1: Ða ongan he him bigspel reccan. Sum man him plantode wingeard, and betynde hine, and dealf anne seaþ, and getimbrode ænne stypel, and gesette hine mid eorþtilium, and ferde on elþeodignysse;
12.2: Ða sende he to ðam tilium his þeow on tide, ðæt he ðæs wingeardes wæstm onfenge.
12.3: Ða swungon hi ðæne, and forleton hine idelhende.
12.4: And eft he him sende oðerne þeow, and hi ðone on heafde gewundodon, and mid teonum geswencton.
12.5: And eft he him sume sende, and hi ðæne ofslogon, and manega oðre, sume hi beoton, sume hi ofslogon.
12.6: ?a hæfde he ða gyt ænne leofostne sunu, ða sende he æt nehstan him ðæne, and cwæþ, witodlice minne sunu hig forwandiaþ.
12.7: Ða cwædon ða tilian him betweonan, Her is se yrfenuma; uton ofslean hine, ðonne biþ ure seo yrfweardnes.
12.8: Hi ði ofslogon hine, and wurpon wiðutan ðone wingeard.
12.9: Hwæt deþ ðæs wingeardes hladord? He cymþ, and fordeþ ða tiligean, and sylþ oðron ðone wingeard.
12.10: Ne rædde he ðis gewrit, Se stan ðe ða wyrhtan awurpon, ðes ys geworden on ðære hyrnan heafod?
12.11: Ðis ys fram Drihtne geworden, and hit is wundorlic on uron eagum.[h]
12.12: Ða smeadon hi ðæt hi gefengon hine, and hi ondredon ða menigu; hi oncneowon ða ðæt he ðis bigspel to him sæde; hi ferdon ða, and hine forleton. Seo agiefung geafola to Casere
12.13: Ða sendon hi to him sume of Phariseum and Herodianum, ðæt hi befengon hine on his worde.
12.14: Ða comon hi and ðus mid facne cwædon, Lareow, we witon ðæt ðu eart soþfæst, and ðu ne recst be ænegum men; ne besceawast ðu manna ansyne, ac ðu godes weg lærst on soþfæstnysse. Alyfþ gaful to syllanne ðam Casere? ….
12.15: Hwæðer ðe we ne syllaþ? Ða cwæþ he, and heora lotwrenceas wiste, Hwi fandige ge min? bringaþ me ðone pening, ðæt ic hine geseo.
12.16: Ða brohton hi him. Ða sæde he him, Hwæs is ðeos anlicnys, and ðis gewrit? Hi cwædon, Ðæs Caseres.
12.17: Ða cwæþ se Hælend to him, Agyfaþ ðam Casere ða þing ðe ðæs Caseres synd, and gode ða ðe godes synd. Ða wundrodon hi be ðam. Þa rihwisendas and seo ærist
12.18: Ða comon him to Saducei, ða secgaþ ðæt ærist ne sy, and hine ahsodon, and ðus cwædon,
12.19: Lareow, Moyses us wrat, gif hwæs broðor dead biþ, and læfþ his wif, and næfþ nan bearn, ðæt his broðor nime his wif, and his broðor sæd wecce.
12.20: Eornostlice seofon gebroðru wæron; and se æresta nam wif, and wearþ dead, na læfedum sæde.
12.21: And ða nam se oðer hi, and wearþ dead, ne se sæd ne læfde. gelice se þridda.
12.22: And ealle seofon hi hæfdon, and sæd ne læfdon. Ealra æftemest ða forþferde ðæt wif.
12.23: On ðam æriste, …. hwylces ðara seofona biþ ðæt wif? hi ealle hi hæfdon.
12.24: Ða andswarode him se Hælend, Hu ne dweligaþ ge, forðam ðe ge nyton ða halgan gewritu, ne godes mægen?
12.25: Soþlice ðonne hi of deaþe arisaþ, ne wifiaþ hi, ne ne giftiaþ, ac hi synd swylce godes englas on heofonum.
12.26: Be ðam deadum, ðæt hi arison, ne rædde ge on Moyses bec, hu god to him cwæþ, ofer ðone gorstbeam, Ic eom Abrahames god, and Isaaces god, and Iacobes god?
12.27: Nys god deadra, ac he ys lybbendra; soþlice swyðe ge dweligeaþ. Þæt greate bod
12.28: Ða genealæhte him an of ðam bocerum, ðe gehyrde hi smeagende, and geseah ðæt he him wel andswarode, and ahsode hine, hwæt wære ealra beboda mæst.
12.29: Ða andswarode he him, Ðæt is ðæt mæste behod ealra, Israhel, gehyr, urne Drihten god he is an god;
12.30: And lufa ðinne Drihten god of ealre ðinre heortan, and of ealre ðinre sawle, eallum ðinum mode, and of eallum ðinum mægene. Ðæt is ðæt fyrmeste bebod.
12.31: Soþlice is oðer ðissum gelic, Lufa ðinne nehstan swa ðe sylfne. Nys oðer mare bebod.
12.32: Ða cwæþ se bocere, Lareow, well ðu on soþe cwæde; ðæt an god is, and nys oðer, butan him;
12.33: And ðæt he si gelufod of ealre heortan, and of eallum andgyte, and of ealre sawle, and of ealre strengþe, and lufigean his nehstan swa hine sylfne, ðæt is mare eallum onsægdnyssum and offrungum.
12.34: Ða se Hælend geseah ðæt he him wislice andwyrde, he sæde him, Ne eart ðu feor fram godes rice. And hine ne dorste nan man acsian.
12.35: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, on ðam temple lærende, Hu secgaþ ða boceras, ðæt Crist sy Dauides sunu?
12.36: Dauid sylf cwæþ to ðam Halgan gaste, Drihten cwæþ to minum drihtne, “Site on mine swyðran healfe, oð ic ðine fynd asette to fotsceamole ðinra fota.”
12.37: Dauid sylf nemde hine drihten, and hwanon is he his sunu? And mycel menegu hine luflice gehyrde.
12.38: Ða sæde he him on his lare, warniaþ fram bocerum, ða wyllaþ on gegyrlum gan, and beon on strætum grete,
12.39: And on fyrmestum lareowsetlum sittan on gesamnungum, and ða fyrmestan setl on gebeorscipum;
12.40: Ða ðe wudewena hus forswelgaþ, mid heora langsuman gebede; ða onfoþ lengestne dom. Þære widuwan offrung
12.41: Ða sæt se Hælend ongen ðone tollsceamol, and geseah hu ðæt folc hyra feoh torfode on ðone tollsceamul; and manega welige torfodon fela.
12.42: Ða com an earm wuduwe, and wearp twegen feorðlingas.
12.43: Ða clypode he his leorningcnihtas, and sæde him, Soþlice ic eow secge, ðæt ðeos earme wuduwe eallinga mæst sealde, ðara ðe on tollsceamul sealdon.
12.44: Ealle sendon of ðam ðe hi genoh hæfdon; soþlice ðeos of hyre yrmþe eall ðæt heo hæfde sealde, ealle hyre andlyfene.

13.1: Ða he of ðam temple eode, ða cweaþ an of his leorningcnihtum to him, Lareow, loca, hwylce stanas her synd, and hwylce getimbrunga ðisses temples.
13.2: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Ne geseo ge ealle ðas mycelan getimbrunga? ne biþ her læfed stan ofer stan, ðe ne beo toworpen. Tacn þæs endes þære ielde
13.3: Ða hi sæton on Oliuetes dune ongen ðæt tempel, synderlice hine Petrus, and Iacobus, and Iohannes, and Andreas acsodon,
13.4: Sege us, hwænne ðas þing gewurdon, and hwyle tacen biþ, ðænne ealle dis þing onginnaþ beon geendod.
13.5: Ða ongan se Hælend him andswarigende to ccweðan, warniaþ, ðæt eow nan man ne beswice;
13.6: Soþlice manega cumaþ on minum naman, and cweðaþ, Ic eom Crist; and beswicaþ manega.
13.7: And ðonne ge gehyraþ gefeohtu and gefeohta hlisan, ne ondræde ge eow; hit gebyraþ ðæt hit gebelimpe, ac ðonne gyt nis ende.
13.8: Soþlice þeod arist agen þeode, and rice ongen rice, and beoþ eorþan styrunga geond stowa and hungor; ðis synd sara angin.
13.9: warniaþ eow sylfe, hi syllaþ eow on geþeahte, and swingaþ on gesamnungum; and ge standaþ beforan demum and cyningum for minum naman, him on gewitnesse.
13.10: And on ealle þeoda ærest gebyraþ beon ðæt godspel gebodod.
13.11: And ðonne hi syllende eow lædaþ, ne foresmeage ge hwæt ge specon, ac specaþ ðæt eow on ðære tide geseald biþ; ne synd ge na specende, ac se Halga gast.
13.12: Soþlice se broðor ðone broðor to deaþe sylþ, and se fæder his sunu, and ða bearn arisaþ agen hyra magas, and mid deaþe hi gewæceaþ.
13.13: And ge beoþ eallum on hatunge for minum naman; soþlice se biþ hal, se ðe oð ende þurhwunaþ. Seo toworpenness asceonung
13.14: Ðonne ge geseoþ ðære toworpennysse asceonunge, [s]tandan ðar heo ne sceal; ðonne ongyte se ðe ræt; fieon ðonne on muntas, ða ðe synd on Iudea.
13.15: And se ðe is ofer þecene, ne stige he on his hus, ne he in ne ga, ðæt he aht on his huse nime;
13.16: And se ðe biþ on æcere, ne cyrre he ongean ðæt he his reaf nime.
13.18: Biddaþ, ðæt ðis on wintra ne geweorðe.
13.19: Soþlice on ðam dagum beoþ swylce gedrefednessa, swylce ne gewurdon of frymþe ðære gesceafte, ðe god gesceop, oð nu, ne na ne geweorðeþ.
13.20: And gif Drihten ðas dagas ne gescyrte, nan flæse ne wurde hal; ac for ðam gecorenum ðe he geceas, he gescyrte ða dagas.
13.21: And gif eow hwyle segþ, witodlice! her is Crist, witodlice! ðær he is, ne gelyfe ge.
13.22: Soþlice lease Cristas and lease witegan arisaþ, and wyrcaþ forebeacnu, to beswicanne, eac, gif hit beon mæg, ða gecorenan.
13.23: warniaþ eow; nu! ealle þing ðe ic eow foresæde. Se tocyme þæs Suna menn
13.24: Ac on ðam dagum, æfter ðære geswencednysse, byþ sunne aþeostrod, and se mona his beorhtnesse ne sylþ,
13.25: And heofones steorran beoþ feallende, and beoþ astyrode, ða megenu ðe on heofonum synd.
13.26: Ðonne geseoþ hi mannes sunu cumendne on genipum, mid mycelum mægene and wuldre.
13.27: Ðonne set he his englas, and hi gaderiaþ his gecorenan of feower windum, of eorþam heahnesse oð heofones heahnesse.
13.28: Leorniaþ an bigspel be ðam fictreowe. Ðonne his twi biþ mearu, and leaf beoþ acennede, ge witon ðæt sumor is gehende.
13.29: And wite ge, ðonne ge ðas þing geseoþ, ðæt he is dura gehende.
13.30: Soþlice ic eow secge, ðæt ðeos cneores ne gewit, ærðam ealle ðas þing geweorðon.
13.31: Heofon and eorþe gewitaþ, witodlice mine word ne gewitaþ.
13.32: Be ðam dæge and ðære tide nan man nat, ne englas on heofone, ne mannes sunu, buton fæder ana.
13.33: warniaþ, and waciaþ, and gebiddaþ eow; ge nyton, hwænne seo tid ys.
13.34: Swa se man ðe ælþeodilice ferde, forlet his hus, and sealde his þeowum ðæne anwald gehwylces weorces, and beode ðam durewearde, ðæt he wacige.
13.35: Eornostlice wacigeaþ, ge nyton, hwænne ðæs huses hlaford cymþ, ðe on æfen, ðe on midre nihte, ðe on hancrede, ðe on mergen;
13.36: Ðelæs he eow slapende gemete, ðonne he færinga cymþ.
13.37: Soþlice ðæt ic dow secge, eallum ic hit secge, waciaþ.

14.1: Soþlice ða æfter twam dagum wæron eastron [….] And ða solhton ða heahsacerdas and ða boceras, hu hi hine mid facne namon, and ofslogon.
14.2: Ða cwædon hi, Næs na on freolsdæge, ðelæs ðæs folces gehlyd weorðe. Iesus wierþ smirwod
14.3: And ða se Hælend wæs on Bethania, on Simones huse anes hreoflan, and ðar sæt, ða com an wif, and hæfde hyre sealfbox deorwyrþes nardes; and tobrocenum sealfboxe, ofer his heafod aget.
14.4: Sume hit unweorðlice forbæron, and betwux him sylfum cwæðon, Forhwi wæs ðisse sealfe forspillednes geworden?
14.5: Ðeos sealf mihte beon geseald to þrim hund penegum, and beon þearfum geseald. And yrsodon agen hi.
14.6: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Lætaþ hi; hwi synd ge hyre grame? god weore heo on me worhte.
14.7: Soþlice symble ge habbaþ þearfan mid eow, and ðonne ge wyllaþ, ge magon him teala don; me ge symble nabbaþ.
14.8: Ðeos sealde ðæt heo hæfde; heo com to smyrianne minne lichaman on byrgene.
14.9: Soþlice ic eow secge, swa hwar swa ðis godspell gebodod biþ on eallum middanearde, biþ gebodod, ðæt heo ðis on his gemynde dyde. Iudas geþafaþ to sellenne Iesus
14.10: Ða Iudas Scarioth, ðæt is wiðersaca, an of ðam twelfum, ferde to ðam heahsacerdum, ðæt he hine belæwde.
14.11: Ða hi ðis gehyrdon hi fahnodon, and beheton him feoh to syllanne. And he smeade hu he hine digellice sealde. Þæt æftermeste eostor
14.12: And ðam forman dæge azimorum, ða hi eastron offrodon, his leorningcnihtas him sædon, Hwyder wylt ðu ðæt we faron, and gegearwian ðe; ðæt ðu eastron ete?
14.13: Ða sende he twegen of his leorningcnihtum, and sæde him, gaþ on ða ceastre, and inc agenyrnþ sum man berende sume wæterflaxan; folgiaþ him.
14.14: And swa hwyder swa he ingæþ, secgaþ ðæs huses hlaforde, U’re lareow segþ, Hwar is min gysthus and min gereord, hwar ete ic eastron mid minum leorningcnihtum?
14.15: And he inc geswutelaþ mycele healle gedæfte, and gegearwiaþ us ðara.
14.16: Ða ferdon his leorningcnihtas, and comon on ða ceastre, and fundon hit eall swa he sædle; and gegearwodon ða eastron,
14.17: Soþlice ða æfen com, him twelfum mid him.
14.18: Sittendum, and etendum, sæde se Hælend, Soþlice ic eow secge; ðæt eower an ðe mid me yt, gesylþ me.
14.19: Ða ongunnon hi beon dreorige, and betwux him cweðan, Cwyst ðu eom ic hit? ….
14.20: Ða sæde he him, An of eow twelfum me sylþ, se ðe his hand on disce mid me dypþ.
14.21: And witodlice mannes sunu gæþ, swa be him awriten is; wa ðam men, þurh ðone ðe mannes sunu geseald biþ. Betere him wære, ðæt se man acenned nære. Seo setness þæs Hælendes Husles
14.22: Him ða etendum, afeng se Hælend hlaf, and hine bletsiende bræc, and sealde him, and ðus cwæþ. Nimaþ; ðis ys min lichama.
14.23: And onfeng calice, and gode þancas dyde and sealde him, and ealle him of druncon.
14.24: Ða sæde he him, Ðis ys min blod ðære niwan cyðnesse, ðæt biþ for manegum egoten.
14.25: Soþlice ic eow secge, ðæt ic heononforþ ne drince of ðyses wingeardes cynne, oð ðone dæg ðonne ic hine niwne drince on godes rice. Petrus wiðersæc wierþ forewitgod
14.26: And gecwedenum lofe, hi ferdon on Elebergena munt.
14.27: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Ealle ge beoþ geuntreowsode on ðisse nihte; forðam ðe hit awriten is, Ic slea ðæne hyrde, and beoþ ða scep todræfede.
14.28: Ac æfter ðam ðe ic arise, ic cume beforan eow on galileam.
14.29: Ða sæde Petrus him, Ðæh ðe ealle swicion, ne swicige ic ðe na.
14.30: Ða cwæþ se Hælend, Soþlice ic ðe secge, ðæt ðu on ðisse nihte ær hana tuwa crawe, þriwa wiðsæcst min.
14.31: And he ðæs ðe mare spræc, And ðeah me gebyrige mid ðe to sweltanne, ne ætsace ic ðin. And swa hi cwædon ealle. Iesus bideþ in gezemanie
14.32: Ða comon hi to anum tune, ðæs nam wæs gezemani. And he cwæþ to his leorningcnihtum, Sittaþ her, oð ðæt ic me gebidde.
14.33: And he nam ða mid him Petrum and Iacobum and Iohannem, ða ongan he forhtian, and sargian.
14.34: And sæde him, Unrot is min sawl oð deaþ; gebidaþ her, and waciaþ.
14.35: Ða he lythwon forþstop, he astrebte hine ofer ða eorþan, and he bæd, gif hit beon mihte, ðæt he on ðære tide fram him gewite.
14.36: And ða cwæþ he, Abba, ðæt is, Fæder, on ure geþeode, ealle þing ðe synd mihtiglice, afyr ðysne calic fram me; ac na ðæt ic wylle, ac ðæt ðu.
14.37: Ða com he, and funde hi slæpende. And cwæþ to Petre, Simon, slæpst ðu? ne mihtest ðu ane tide wacian?
14.38: waciaþ, and gebiddaþ, ðæt ge on costnunge ne gan; witodlice se gast is gearu, ac ðæt flæsc is untrum.
14.39: And eft he gebæd ða ylcan spræce.
14.40: And ða he hine eft agenbewende, he funde hi slæpende; hyra eagan wæron gehefegode. And hi nyston, hwæt hi him andswaredon.
14.41: Ða com he þriddan siðe, and sæde him, Slapaþ nu, and restaþ; genoh nit ys. Tima ys cumen; nu! is mannes sunu geseald on synfulra handa.
14.42: Arisaþ, uton gan; nu! is gehende se ðe me sylþ. Iesus wierþ geseald and gehæft
14.43: Him ða ða gyt sprecendum, com Iudas Scarioth, ðæt ys wiðersaca, an of ðam twelfum, and mid him mycel menegeo mid swurdum and mid sahlum, fram heahsacerdum, bocerum, and ealdrum.
14.44: Soþlice his læwa him tacen sealde, and ðus cwæþ, Swa hwylcne swa ic cysse, he hit ys; nimaþ, and lædaþ hine wærlice.
14.45: And sona swa he com, he genealæhte him to, an cwæþ, Lareow; and cyste hine.
14.46: And hi hyra handa on hine wurpon, and namon hine.
14.47: Soþlice an of ðam ðe ðar embe uton stodon, his swurde abræd, and sloh ðæs sacerdes þeow, and his eare ofacearf.
14.48: Ða cwæþ se Hælend him andswariende, Swa swa to anum sceaþan ge ferdon mid swurdum and treowum, me gefon?
14.49: Ðonne ic dæghwamlice mid eow wæs, on temple lærende, and ge me ne namon; ac ðæt ða gewritu syn gefyllede.
14.50: Ða forleton his leorningcnihtas ealle hyne, and flugon.
14.51: Sum iungling him fyligde, mid anre scytan bewæfed nacod; and hi namon hine.
14.52: Ða aworpenre ðære scytan, nacod he him fram fleah. Iesus stent ætforan þæm witenagemote
14.53: And hi læddon ðæn Hælend to ðam heahsacerde. And comon ealle sacerdas and boceras and ealdras togædere.
14.54: Petrus him fyligde feorran oð ðæs heahsacerdes cafertun. And he sæt mid ðam þenum, and wyrmde hine æt ðam fyre.
14.55: Ða heahsacerdas sohton, and eall geþeaht, tale agen ðone Hælend, ðæt hi hine to deaþe sealdon; and hi ne fundon.
14.56: Manega sædon lease gecyðnysse agen hine, and ða cyðnessa næron ðæslice.
14.57: Ða arison sume and sædon lease cyðnesse agen hine, and ðus cwædon,
14.58: Soþes we gehyrdon hine secgan, Ic towurpe ðis handworhte tempel, and æfter þrim dagum ic oðer unhandworht getimbrie.
14.60: Ða aras sum heahsacerd on hyra midlene, and ahsode ðæne Hælend, Ne andswarast ðu nan þing agen ðæt ðas ðe onwurpaþ?
14.61: He suwode, and naht ne andswarode. Eft hine acsode se heahsacerd, Eart ðu Crist, ðæs gebletsodan godes sunu?
14.62: Ða sæde se Hælend, Ic eom; and ge geseoþ mannes sunu on swyðran healfe sittan his mægenes, and cumende mid heofones genipum.
14.63: Ða cwæþ se heahsacerd, his reaf slitende, Hwi gewilnige we gyt cyðera?
14.64: ge gehyrdon his bysmer. Hwæt þincþ eow? Ða hyrwdon hi ealle hine and cwædon ðæt he wære deaþes scyldig.
14.65: And sume agunnon him on spætan, and oferwreon his ansyne, and mid fystum hine beoton, and him to cwædon, Aræd. And ða þenas hine mid handum beoton. Petrus ætsacþ Crist
14.66: And ða Petrus wæs on cafertune, ða com to him an þinen ðæs heahsacerdes.
14.67: And Ða heo geseah Petrum wyrmende, ða cwæþ heo, Ðu wære mid ðam Nazareniscan Hælende.
14.68: Ða ætsoc he, and cwæþ, Ic nat, ne ne can, hwæt ðu segst. And he eode ða of ðam cafertune; and se hana creow.
14.69: Eft ða hine gecneow oðer þinen, heo ongan cweðan to ðam ðe ðar abutan stodon, Soþlice ðes ys of ðam.
14.70: And he eft ætsoc. And eft ða ymbe lytel, ða ðe ætstodon cwædon to Petre, Soþlice ðu eart of ðam, galileise ðu eart. ….
14.71: Ða ongan he ætsacan and swerian, Soþes ne can ic ðæne man, ðe ge secgaþ.
14.72: And ða eftsona creow se hana. Ða gemunde Petrus ðæs Hælendes worde ðe he him sæde, Ær se hana crawe tuwa, þriwa ðu me ætsæcst. Ða ongan he wepan.

15.1: Ða sona on mergen, worhton ða heahsacerdas hyra gemot mid ealdrum, and bocerum, and eallum werodum, and læddon ðæne Hælend, gebundenne, and sealdon hine Pilato.
15.2: Ða acsode Pilatus hine, Eart ðu Iudea cyning? Ða andswarode he him, Ðu hit segst.
15.3: Ða wregdon hine ða heahsacerdas on manegum þingum.
15.4: Eft Pilatus hine acsode, Ne andswarast ðu nan þing? Loca, hu micelum hi ðe wregeaþ?
15.5: Ða ne andswarode se Hælend him na mare, swa ðæt Pilatus wundrode. geseald to rodfæstnunge
15.6: On symbeldæge wæs his gewuna ðæt he him forgeafe ænne gebundenne, swa hwylcne swa hi bædon.
15.7: Ða bædon hi Barraban, se wæs gebunden mid ðam ræplingum, se þurh swiccræft manslyht geworhte.
15.8: And ða he ferde, ða ongan seo menegeu hine biddan, swa heo symle dyde.
15.9: Ða cwæþ Pilatus, wylle ge ðæt ic eow forgyfe Iudea cyning?
15.10: He wiste, ðæt þurh andan hine sealdon ða heahsacerdas.
15.11: Ða astyredon ða bisceopas ða menegu, ðæt he him Barraban forgefe.
15.12: Eft Pilatus him andswarode, Hwæt do ic be Iudea cyninge?
15.13: Hi eft hrymdon and cwædon, Hoh hine.
15.14: Ða sæde Pilatus, Hwæt yfeles dyde he? Hi ðæs ðe ma clypedon, Ahoh hine.
15.15: Pilatus wolde ða ðam folce gecweman, and forgef him Barraban, and sealde him ðone Hælend, beswungenne, ðæt he ahangen wære.
15.16: Ða læddon ða cempan hine on ðæs domernes cafertun, and hi tosomne eall werod clypedon,
15.17: And scryddon hine mid purpuran. And him onsetton þyrnenne helm, awundenne;
15.18: And ongunnon hine ðus gretan, Hal wes, ðu Iudea cyning.
15.19: And beoton hine on ðæt heafod mid hreode, and spætton him on; and heora cneow bigdon and hine geeaðmeddon.
15.20: And syððan hi hine bysmrydon, unscryddon hine ðam purpuran, and scryddon hine mid his reafum, and læddon hine, ðæt hi hine ahengon. Seo rodfæstnung
15.21: And genyddon sumne wegferendne, Simonem Cyreneum, cumende of ðam tune, Alexandres fæder and Rufi, ðæt he his rode bære.
15.22: And hi læddon hine on ða stowe golgotha, ðæt is on ure geþeode gereht, Heafodpannena stow.
15.23: And sealdon him gebiterod win, and he hit ne onfeng.
15.24: And ða hi hine ahengon hi dældon his reaf, and hlotu warpon, hwæt gehwa name.
15.25: Ða wæs underntid, hi ahengon hine.
15.26: And ofergewrit his gyltes wes awriten, JUDEA CYNINg.
15.27: And hi ahengon mid him twegen sceaþan, anne on his swyðran healfe, and oðerne on his wynstran.
15.28: Ða wæs ðæt gewrit gefylled ðæt cwyþ, And he wæs mid unrihtwisum geteald.
15.29: And ða ðe forþstopon hine gremedon, and hyra heafod cwehton, and ðus cwædon, wala! se towyrpþ ðæt tempel and on þrim dagum eft getimbraþ;
15.30: gehæl ðe sylfne, of ðære rode stigende.
15.31: Eallswa ða heahsacerdas bysmriende, betwux ðam bocerum, cwædon, Oðre he hale gedyde, hine sylfne he ne mæg halne gedon.
15.32: Crist, Israhela cyning, astige nu of rode, ðæt, we gescon, and gelyfon. And ða ðe him mid hangodon, wæron him mid gebundene. Iesus deaþ
15.33: And ðære syxtan tide, wurdon þystru gewordene geond ealle eorþan oð nontide.
15.34: And to nontide se Hælend clypode mycelre stemne, Heloi, Heloi, lema sabattani, ðæt is on ure geþeode, Min god, min god, hwi forlete ðu me?
15.35: And sume ðe ðar abuton stodon and ðis gehyrdon, hi cwædon, Nu! ðes clypaþ Heliam.
15.36: Ða arn hyra an, and fylde ane spingan mid ecede, and on hreod sette, and him drincan sealde, and cwæþ, Læetaþ, ðæt we geseon, hwæðer Helias cune hine nyðer to settanne.
15.37: Se Hælend, ða asende his stefne, and forþferde.
15.38: And ðæs temples wahrift wæs tosliten on twa of ufeweardum oð neoðeweard.
15.39: Ða se hundredman, ðe ðar stod agen, geseah ðæt se Hælend swa clypiende forþferde, he cwæþ, Soþlice, ðes man wæs godes sunu.
15.40: And ða wif wæron feorran behealdende, and betwux ðam wæs seo Magdalenisce Maria, and Maria Iacobes moðor [ðæs gingran, and Iosepes moder,] and Salomeæ.
15.41: And ða he wæs on galilea, hi fyligdon him, and him þenedon, and manega oðre, ðe him mid ferdon on Ierusalem. Iesus byrigness
15.42: And ða æfen wæs geworden, ðæt wæs parasceue ðæt is ær sæterdæge,
15.43: Ða com Iosep, se æðela gerefa, of Arimathia, se sylfa godes rices geanbidode; and he dyrstiglice in to Pilate eode, and bæd ðæs Hælendes lichaman.
15.44: Ða wundrode Pilatus, gif he ða gyt forþferde. Ða clypode he ðæne hundredman, and hine ahsode, hwæðer he dead wære;
15.45: Ða he wiste ðæt, ða agef he ðone lichaman Iosepe.
15.46: Ða bohte Isoep ane scytan, ... and hine ðaron befeold, and on byrgene lede seo wæs of stane aheawen, and wylte anne stan to ðære byrgene dura.
15.47: Ða com Maria Magdalene, and Iosepes Maria and beheodlon, hwar he geled wære.

16.1: And ða sæternes dæg wæs agan, seo Magdalenisce Maria, and Iacobes Maria, and Salomeæ bohton wyrt gemang, ðæt hi comon and hine smyredon.
16.2: And swyðe ær anum restedæge, comon to ðære byrgene, upasprungenre sunnan.
16.3: And cwædon him betwynan, Hwa awylt us ðysne stan of ðære byrgene dura?
16.4: Ða hi hi besawon hi gesawon ðæne stan aweg awyltne, soþlice he wæs swyðe mycel.
16.5: And ða hi eodon on ða byrgene hi gesawon anne geongne, on ða swyðran healfe sittende, hwitum gegyrlan oferwrogenne; and hi ða forhtodon.
16.6: Ða cwæþ he to him, Ne forhtige ge na; ge secaþ ðæne Nazareniscan Hælend ahangenne; he aras, nis he her; her is seo stow ðær hi hine ledon.
16.7: Ac faraþ, and secgaþ his leorningcnihtum, and Petre, ðæt he gæþ toforan eow on galileam; ðar ge hine geseoþ, swa he eow sæde.
16.8: And hi uteodon and flugon fram ðære byrgene; and wæron afærede for ðære gesyhþe ðe hi gesawon, and hig nanum men naht ne sædon, soþlice hi him adredon. Iesus cymþ to Marie Magdalene
16.9: Ða he aras on ærne morgen on restedæge, æryst he ætywde ðære Magdaleniscan Marian, of ðære he utadraf seofon deofolseocnyssa.
16.10: And heo ða uteode and hit ðam cydde ðe mid him wæron, heofendum and wependum.
16.11: Ða hi gehyrdon ðæt he leofode, and hi hine gesawon, ða ne gelyfdon hi him. Iesus cymþ to twæm leornungcnihtum
16.12: Æfter ðam him twam he wæs ætywed on oðrum hiwe, him on ðone tun farendum.
16.13: And hi ða foron and ðæt oðrum cyddon, and hi him ne gelyfdon. Þæt greate ærend
16.14: Ða æt nehstan, he ætywde him ændlefene, ðar hi ætgædere sæton, and tælde hyra ungeleaffulnesse, and hyra heortan heardnesse, forðam ðe hi ne gelyfdon ðam, ðe hine gesawon of deaþe arisan.
16.15: And he sæde him, Faraþ into ealne middaneard, and bodiaþ godspell ealre gesceafte.
16.16: Se ðe gelyfþ, and gefullod biþ, se biþ hal; soþlice se ðe ne gelyfþ, se biþ genyðerod.
16.17: Ðas tacnu fyliaþ ðam, ðe gelyfaþ. On minum naman hi deofolseocnessa utdrifaþ; hi sprecaþ niwum tungum;
16.18: Næddran hi afyrraþ; and him ne deraþ, ðeah hi hwæt deadbærlices drincon. Ofer seoce hi hyra handa settaþ, and hi beoþ hale.
16.19: And witodlice Drihten Hælend, syððan he to him spræc, he wæs on heofonum afangen, and he sit on godes swiðran healfe.
16.20: Soþlice hi ða farende æghwar bodedon, Drihtne midwyrcendum, and trymmendre spræce æfterfyligendum tacnum.

1.1: Forþam ðe ƿitodlice maneȝa þohton þara þinȝa race ȝeendebyrdan þe on us ȝefyllede synt.
1.2: sƿa us betæhtun ða þe hyt of frymðe ȝesaƿon. And þære spræce þenas ƿæron;
1.3: Me ȝeþuhte ȝeornlice eallum oð endebyrdnesse ƿritan þe: þu se selusta þeophilus
1.4: þæt ðu oncnaƿe þara ƿorda soþfæstnesse of ðam ðe þu ȝelæred eart;
1.5: On herodes daȝum iudea cynincȝes. Ƿæs sum sacerd on naman zacharias of abian tune. and his ƿif ƿæs of aarones dohtrum. and hyre nama ƿæs elizabeþ;
1.6: Soðlice hiȝ ƿæron butu rihtƿise beforan ȝode. Ȝanȝende on eallum his bebodum and rihtƿisnessum butan ƿrohte.
1.7: and hiȝ næfdon nan bearn. forðam þe: elizabeþ ƿæs unberende. and hy on heora daȝum butu forðeodon;
1.8: Soðlice ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa zacharias his sacerdhades breac on hys ȝeƿrixles endebyrdnesse beforan ȝode:
1.9: æfter ȝeƿunan ðæs sacerdhades hlotes. he eode þæt he hys offrunȝa sette; þa he on ȝodes tempel eode
1.10: eall ƿerod þæs folces ƿæs ute ȝebiddende on þære offrunȝa timan.
1.11: þa ætyƿde him drihtnes enȝel standende on þæs ƿeofodes sƿyðran healfe;
1.12: þa ƿearð zacharias ȝedrefed þæt ȝeseonde and him eȝe onhreas;
1.13: þa cƿæð se enȝel him to. ne ondræd þu þe zacharias. Forþam þin ben ys ȝehyred and þin ƿif elizabeþ þe sunu cenð. and þu nemst hys naman Iohannes:
1.14: and he byð þe to ȝefean and to blisse, and maneȝa on his acennednysse ȝefaȝniað
1.15: Soðlice he byð mære beforan drihtne and he ne drincð ƿin ne beor: and he byð ȝefylled on haliȝum ȝaste. þonne ȝyt of hys modor innoðe:
1.16: and maneȝa israhela bearna he ȝecyrð to drihtne hyra ȝode.
1.17: and he ȝæð toforan him on ȝaste. and elias mihte. þæt he fædera heortan to heora bearnum ȝecyrre. and unȝeleaffulle to rihtƿisra ȝleaƿscype. drihtne fullfremed folc ȝeȝearƿian;
1.18: þa cƿæð zacharias to þam enȝele. hƿanun ƿat ic þis; Ic eom nu eald and min ƿif on hyre daȝum forðeode;
1.19: þa andsƿarode him se enȝel; Ic eom ȝabriel ic þe stande beforan ȝode: and ic eom asend ƿið þe sprecan. and þe ðis bodian;
1.20: And nu þu byst suƿiende. and þu sprecan ne miht. oð þone dæȝ þe ðas ðinȝ ȝeƿurðaþ: forþam þu minum ƿordum ne ȝelyfdest. þa beoð on hyra timan ȝefyllede;
1.21: And þæt folc ƿæs zachariam ȝeanbidiende and ƿundrodon þæt he on þam temple læt ƿæs;
1.22: þa he uteode ne mihte he him to sprecan. and hiȝ oncneoƿon þæt he on þam temple sume ȝesihtðe ȝeseah. and he ƿæs bicniende him and dum þurhƿunede;
1.23: þa ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa his þenunȝa daȝas. ȝefyllede ƿæron. he ferde to his huse;
1.24: Soðlice æfter daȝum elizabeþ his ƿif ȝeeacnode and heo bediȝlude hiȝ fif monþas and cƿæð;
1.25: Soðlice me drihten ȝedyde þus. On þam daȝum þe he ȝeseah minne hosp betux mannum afyrran.
1.26: Soþlice on þam syxtan monðe ƿæs asend ȝabriel se enȝel fram drihtne on ȝalilea ceastre. þære nama ƿæs nazareþ.
1.27: to beƿeddudre fæmnan anum ƿere. þæs nama ƿæs iosep. of dauides huse. and þære fæmnan nama ƿæs maria.
1.28: þa cƿæþ se enȝel inȝanȝende. hal ƿes ðu mid ȝyfe ȝefylled. drihten mid þe; þu eart ȝebletsud on ƿifum.
1.29: þa ƿearð heo on his spræce ȝedrefed. and þohte hƿæt seo ȝretinȝ ƿære;
1.30: þa cƿæð se enȝel. ne ondræd þu ðe maria; Soðlice þu ȝyfe mid ȝode ȝemettest:
1.31: Soðlice nu þu on innoðe ȝeeacnast. and sunu censt and his naman hælend ȝenemnest;
1.32: Se byð mære and þæs hehstan sunu ȝenemned. and him sylþ drihten ȝod his fæder. dauides setl.
1.33: and he ricsað on ecnesse on Iacobes huse: and hys rices ende ne byþ;
1.34: þa cƿæð maria to þam enȝle. hu ȝeƿyrð þis forðam ic ƿere ne oncnaƿe;
1.35: þa andsƿarode hyre se enȝel; Se halȝa ȝast on þe becymþ and þæs heahstan miht þe ofersceadað: and forðam þæt haliȝe ðe of þe acenned byð byþ ȝodes sunu ȝenemned
1.36: and nu elizabeþ þin mæȝe sunu on hyre ylde ȝeeacnode. And þe monað ys hyre sixta. seo is unberende ȝenemned:
1.37: forþam nis ælc ƿord mid ȝode unmihtelic;
1.38: þa cƿæþ maria her is drihtnes þinen. ȝeƿurþe me æfter þinum ƿorde. and se enȝel hyre fram ȝeƿat.
1.39: Soþlice on þam daȝum aras maria and ferde on muntland mid ofste. on iudeisce ceastre
1.40: and eode into zacharias huse and ȝrete elizabeþ;
1.41: þa ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa elizabeþ ȝehyrde marian ȝretinȝe: þa ȝefaȝnude þæt cild on hyre innoðe; And þa ƿearð elizabeþ haleȝum ȝaste ȝefylled.
1.42: and heo clypode micelre stefne. and cƿæþ. ou eart betƿux ƿifum ȝebletsod. and ȝebletsud ys þines innoðes ƿæstm.
1.43: and hƿanun is me ðis þæt mines drihtnes modor to me cume:
1.44: Sona sƿa þinre ȝretinȝe stefn on minum earum ȝeƿorden ƿæs. þa fahnude min cild. on minum innoþe;
1.45: And eadiȝ þu eart ðu þe ȝelyfdest þæt fulfremede synd. þa ðinȝ þe ðe fram drihtne ȝesæde synd;
1.46: þa cƿæð maria min saƿl mærsaþ drihten;
1.47: And min ȝast ȝeblissude on ȝode minum hælende;
1.48: Forðam þe he ȝeseah hys þinene eadmodnesse; Soþlice heonun forð me eadiȝe secȝað ealle cneoressa.
1.49: forðam þe me micele þinȝ dyde se ðe mihtiȝ is. and hys nama ys haliȝ
1.50: and hys mildheortnes of cneoresse on cneoresse hyne ondrædendum;
1.51: He ƿorhte on hys earme: he todælde þa ofermodan. On mode hyra heortan;
1.52: He aƿearp þa rican of setle. and ða eaðmodan up ahof;
1.53: Hinȝriende he mid ȝodum ȝefylde. and ofermode idele forlet;
1.54: He afenȝ israhel hys cniht. and ȝemunde hys mildheortnesse;
1.55: Sƿa he spræc to urum fæderum abrahame and hys sæde on aƿoruld;
1.56: Soþlice maria ƿunude mid hyre sƿylce þry monþas. and ȝeƿende þa to hyre huse;
1.57: þa ƿæs ȝefylled elizabeþe cenninȝtid. and heo sunu cende.
1.58: and hyre nehcheburas and hyre cuðan þæt ȝehyrdon þæt drihten hys mildheortnesse mid hyre mærsude. and hiȝ mid hyre blissodon;
1.59: þa on þam ehteoþan dæȝe hiȝ comon þæt cild ymsniþan. and nemdon hyne hys fæder naman zachariam.
1.60: þa andsƿarode his modor nese soþes. ac he byð iohannes ȝenemned;
1.61: þa cƿædon hiȝ to hyre. nis nan on þinre mæȝðe þyson naman ȝenemned;
1.62: þa bicnodon hi to hys fæder hƿæt he ƿolde hine ȝenemnedne beon:
1.63: þa ƿrat he ȝebedenum ƿexbrede; Iohannes is hys nama; þa ƿundrodon hiȝ ealle;
1.64: þa ƿearð sona hys muð and hys tunȝe ȝeopenod and he spræc drihten bletsiende;
1.65: þa ƿearð eȝe ȝeƿorden ofer ealle hyra nehcheburas: and ofer ealle iudea muntland. ƿæron þas ƿord ȝeƿidmærsode
1.66: and ealle þa ðe hit ȝehyrdon on heora heortan settun and cƿædon; Ƿenstu hƿæt byð þes cnapa: ƿitodlice drihtenes hand ƿæs mid him;
1.67: And zacharias his fæder ƿæs mid haleȝum ȝaste ȝe fylled. and he ƿiteȝode and cƿæþ;
1.68: Ȝebletsud si drihten israhela ȝod: forþam þe he ȝeneosode. and his folces alysednesse dyde;
1.69: and he us hæle horn arærde. on dauides huse hys cnihtes;
1.70: Sƿa he spræc þurh hys haleȝra ƿiteȝena muð. þa ðe of ƿorldes frymðe spræcon.
1.71: and he alysde us of urum feondum. and of ealra þara handa þe us hatedon;
1.72: Mildheortnesse to ƿyrcænne mid urum fæderum. and ȝemunan his haleȝan cyþnesse;
1.73: Hyne us to syllenne þone að. þe he urum fæder abrahame sƿor.
1.74: þæt ƿe butan eȝe of ure feonda handa alysede him þeoƿian.
1.75: On haliȝnesse beforan him. eallum urum daȝum;
1.76: And þu cnapa byst þæs hehstan ƿiteȝa ȝenemned. þu ȝæst beforan drihtnes ansyne. his ƿeȝas ȝearƿian;
1.77: To syllenne his folce hys hæle ȝeƿit on hyra synna. forȝyfnesse;
1.78: þurh innoþas ures ȝodes mildheortnesse. on þam he us ȝeneosode of eastdæle up sprinȝende;
1.79: Onlihtan þam þe on ðystrum and on deaþes sceade sittað. ure fet to ȝereccenne on sybbe ƿeȝ;
1.80: Soþlice se cnapa ƿeox. and ƿæs on ȝaste ȝestranȝod. and ƿæs on ƿestenum oþ þone dæȝ hys ætiƿednessum on israhel;

2.1: Soþlice on þam daȝum ƿæs ȝeƿorden ȝebod fram þam casere auȝusto. þæt eall ymbehƿyrft ƿære tomearcod;
2.2: (þeos tomearcodnes ƿæs æryst ȝeƿorden fram þam deman syriȝe cirino. )
2.3: and ealle hiȝ eodon. and syndrie ferdon on hyra ceastre;
2.4: þa ferde iosep fram ȝalilea of þære ceastre nazareþ: on iudeisce ceastre dauides. seo is ȝenemned beþleem
2.5: (forþam þe he ƿæs of dauides huse. and hirede) þæt he ferde mid marian þe him beƿeddod ƿæs. and ƿæs ȝeeacnod;
2.6: Soðlice ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa hi þar ƿæron. hire daȝas ƿæron ȝefyllede þæt heo cende.
2.7: and heo cende hyre frumcennedan sunu. and hine mid cildclaþum beƿand. and hine on binne alede. forþam þe hiȝ næfdon rum on cumena huse;
2.8: and hyrdas ƿæron on þam ylcan rice ƿaciende: and nihtƿæccan healdende ofer heora heorda
2.9: þa stod drihtnes enȝel ƿiþ hiȝ and ȝodes beorhtnes him ymbelscean: and hi him mycelum eȝe adredon.
2.10: and se enȝel him to cƿæð; Nelle ȝe eoƿ adrædan. soþlice nu ic eoƿ bodie mycelne ȝefean. se bið eallum folce.
2.11: forþam todæȝ eoƿ ys hælend acenned. se is drihten crist on dauides ceastre;
2.12: And þis tacen eoƿ byð; Ȝe ȝemetað an cild hreȝlum beƿunden. and on binne aled;
2.13: And þa ƿæs færinȝa ȝeƿorden mid þam enȝle mycelnes heofonlices ƿerydes ȝod heriendra. and þus cƿeþendra;
2.14: Ȝode sy ƿuldor on heahnesse and on eorðan sybb mannum ȝodes ƿillan;
2.15: and hit ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa ða enȝlas to heofene ferdon. þa hyrdas him betƿynan spræcon and cƿædon; Utun faran to beþleem. and ȝeseon þæt ƿord þe ȝeƿorden is. þæt drihten us ætyƿde;
2.16: and hiȝ efstende comon: and ȝemetton marian and iosep and þæt cild on binne aled;
2.17: þa hi þæt ȝesaƿon þa oncneoƿon hiȝ be þam ƿorde þe him ȝesæd ƿæs be þam cilde;
2.18: And ealle þa ðe ȝehyrdon ƿundredon be þam þe him þa hyrdas sædon;
2.19: Maria ȝeheold ealle þas ƿord on hyre heortan smeaȝende;
2.20: þa ȝeƿendon ham þa hyrdas ȝod ƿuldriende and heriende on eallum þam ðe hi ȝehyrdon. and ȝesaƿon; Sƿa to him ȝecƿeden ƿæs:
2.21: Efter þam þe ehta daȝas ȝefyllede ƿæron þæt ðæt cild emsnyden ƿære. his nama ƿæs hælend; Se ƿæs fram enȝle ȝenemned: ær he on innoðe ȝeeacnod ƿære;
2.22: and æfter þam þe hyre clænsunȝe daȝas ȝefyllede ƿæron. æfter moyses æ. hi læddon hyne on hierusalem þæt hi hine ȝode ȝesettun
2.23: (sƿa sƿa on drihtnes æ. aƿriten is; þæt ælc ƿæpned ȝecyndlim: ontynende. byð drihtne haliȝ ȝenemned; )
2.24: And þæt hiȝ offrunȝe sealdon æfter þam þe drihtnes æ. ȝecƿeden is. tƿa turtlan. oððe tƿeȝen culfran briddas.
2.25: and þa ƿæs an man on hierusalam þæs nama ƿæs simeon and þes man ƿæs rihtƿis and oþ israhela frofor ȝeanbidiende. and hali ȝast him on ƿæs.
2.26: and he andsƿare fram þam haleȝan ȝaste onfenȝ. þæt he deað ne ȝesaƿe. buton he ær drihten crist ȝesaƿe;
2.27: And on ȝaste he on þæt tempel com. and þa his maȝas læddon þone hælend. þæt hiȝ for him æfter þære æ ȝeƿunan dydon.
2.28: he onfenȝ hine mid his handum: and ȝod bletsode and cƿæð;
2.29: Drihten. nu þu lætst þinne þeoƿ æfter þinum ƿorde on sibbe;
2.30: Forðam mine eaȝan ȝesaƿon þine hæle.
2.31: ða þu ȝeearƿodest beforan ansyne eallra folca;
2.32: Leoht to þeoda aƿriȝenesse and to þines folces ƿuldre israhel:
2.33: þa ƿæs his fæder and his modor ƿundriende be þam þe be him ȝesæde ƿæron;
2.34: And þa bletsude hiȝ simeon and cƿæþ to marian his meder; Loca nu þes is on hryre. and on æryst asett maneȝra on israhel. and on tacen þam ðe ƿiðcƿeden byð;
2.35: (And his sƿurd þine saƿle þurhfærð.) þæt ȝeþohtas syn aƿriȝene of maneȝum heortum;
2.36: And anna ƿæs ƿiteȝystre fanueles dohtor of asseres mæȝðe þeos ƿunude maniȝne dæȝ. and heo leofode mid hyre ƿere seofan ȝer of hyre fæmnhade.
2.37: and heo ƿæs ƿudeƿe oð feoƿer and hundeahtatiȝ ȝeara; Seo of þam temple ne ȝeƿat. dæȝes and nihtes þeoƿiȝende on fæstenum and on halsunȝum;
2.38: And þeos ðære tide becumende drihtne andette and be him spræc eallum þam þe ȝeanbidedon hieru salem alysednesse;
2.39: And þa hi ealle þinȝ ȝefyldon: æfter drihtnes æ hi ȝehƿurfon on ȝalileam on heora ceastre nazareþ;
2.40: Soðlice þæt cild ƿeox and ƿæs ȝestranȝod ƿisdomes full. and ȝodes ȝyfu ƿæs on him.
2.41: and his maȝas ferdon ælce ȝere to hierusalem on easterdæȝes freolstide.
2.42: and þa he ƿæs tƿelf ƿintre hy foron to hierusalem to þan easterlican freolse æfter hyra ȝeƿunan.
2.43: And ȝefylledum daȝum þa hiȝ aȝen ȝehƿurfon. belaf se hælend on hierusalem. and his maȝas þæt nyston.
2.44: ƿendon þæt he on heora ȝefere ƿære. þa comon hiȝ anes dæȝes fær: and hine sohton betux his maȝas and his cuðan.
2.45: ða hiȝ hyne ne fundon hiȝ ȝeƿendun to hierusalem hyne secende;
2.46: þa æfter þrim daȝum hiȝ fundon hine on þam temple sittende onmiddan þam lareoƿum. hlystende and hi ahsiende;
2.47: þa ƿundrodon hiȝ ealle þe ȝehyrdon be his ȝleaƿscipe: and hys andsƿarum;
2.48: þa cƿæð his modor to him; Sunu hƿi dydest þu unc ðus. þin fæder and ic sariȝende þe sohton;
2.49: þa cƿæð he to him. hƿæt is þæt ȝyt me sohton: nyste ȝyt þæt me ȝebyrað to beonne on þam ðinȝum ðe mines fæder synt;
2.50: þa ne onȝeton hiȝ þæt ƿord þe he to him spræc;
2.51: þa ferde he mid him and com to nazareþ. and ƿæs him underþeod; And his modor ȝeheold ealle þas ƿord on hyre heortan smeaȝende;
2.52: And se hælend þeah on ƿisdome and on ylde. and mid ȝyfe. mid ȝode and mid mannum

3.1: Soðlice þam fifteoðan ȝeare þæs caseres anƿealdes tiberii. Beȝymendum þam pontiscan pilate iudea þeode. Feorðan dæles rica ȝalilee herode: filippo his breþer feorðan dæles rica. Iturie. And þæs rica traconitidis and lisania abiline feorþan dæles rica.
3.2: under ðara sacerda ealdrum anna and caifa: ȝodes ƿord ƿæs ȝeƿorden ofer zacharias sunu on ƿestene
3.3: and he com into eall iordanes ricæ bodiende dædbote fulluht. and synna forȝyfenesse:
3.4: sƿa hit aƿriten ys on isaias bec þæs ƿiteȝan; Clypiendes stefen on ƿestene. ȝeȝearƿiað drihtnes ƿeȝ: doð his siðas rihte;
3.5: Ælc denu bið ȝefylled. and ælc munt and beorh byð ȝenyðerud: and þƿuru beoð on ȝerihte: and unȝerydu on smeðe ƿeȝas.
3.6: and ælc flæsc ȝesihð ȝodes hæle; and ælc flæsc ȝesihð ȝodes hæle;
3.7: Soþlice he cƿæð to þam meneȝum þe ferdon þæt hi ƿæron ȝefullode fram him: eala næddrena cynn hƿa ætyƿde eoƿ þæt ȝe fleon fram þam toƿerdan yrre;
3.8: Doð ȝeornlice dædbote ƿæstmas: and ne onȝynne ȝe cƿeðan. ƿe habbað us to fæder abraham; Ic secȝe eoƿ. þæt ȝod is sƿa mihtiȝ þæt he mæȝ of þysum stanum abrahames bearn aƿeccan;
3.9: Nu is seo æx asett. to ðæs treoƿes ƿyrtruman: ƿitodlice ælc treoƿ þe ne bryncð ȝodne ƿæsm. bið forcorfen and on fyr aƿorpen;
3.10: þa ahsodon hyne þa meneȝu and cƿædon: hƿæt do ƿe;
3.11: þa cƿæð he to him. se þe hæfð tƿa tunecan sylle þam þe næfð. and þam ȝelice do se þe mettas hæfþ;
3.12: þa comon þa manfullan þæt hiȝ aþƿeȝene ƿæron. and cƿædon to him. lareoƿ hƿæt do ƿe;
3.13: þa cƿæð he ne do ȝe naht mare þonne þæt eoƿ ȝeset is;
3.14: þa ahsodon hine þa cempan and cƿædon: and hƿæt do ƿe; þa sæde he him. ne slea ȝe nanne; Ne tale ne doð. and beoð eðhylde on eoƿrum andlyfenum;
3.15: Soðlice þam folce ƿenendum and eallum on hyra heortan þencendum be iohanne hƿæþer he crist ƿære;
3.16: þa andsƿarude iohannes him: eallum secȝende; Ƿitodlice ic eoƿ on ƿætere fulliȝe; Soþlice cymð strenȝra þonne ic: þæs ic ne eom ƿyrðe þæt ic hys sceoþƿancȝ uncnytte; He eoƿ fullað on halȝum ȝaste and on fyre;
3.17: and his fann ys on his handa. and he feormað his bernes flore: and ȝaderað hys hƿæte into his berne. þæt ceaf he forbærnð. on unacƿencedlicum fyre;
3.18: Maneȝa oðre þinȝ bodi'ȝ'ende he þæt folc lærde;
3.19: Herodes se feorðan dæles rica: þa he ƿæs fram him ȝeðread. be ðære herodiadiscan hys broðor ƿife: and be eallum yfelum þe herodes dyde;
3.20: and ofer eall þæt ȝeicte þæt he beclysde iohannem on cƿearterne;
3.21: Soðlice ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa eall þæt folc ƿæs ȝefullod: and þam hælende ȝefulledum and ȝebiddendum. heofon ƿæs ȝeopenud
3.22: and se haleȝa ȝast astah lichamlicre ansyne on hyne sƿa an culfre: and stefen ƿæs of heofone ȝeƿorden and þus cƿæð; þu eart min ȝecorena sunu: on þe me ȝelicode.
3.23: and se hælend ƿæs on ylde sƿylce þritiȝ ƿintre: þæt menn ƿendon þæt he ƿære iosepes sunu; Se ƿæs heliȝes sunu:
3.24: se ƿæs Nazareth: swa of cneorysse on cneorysse 38 oð Adam, se wæs Godes sunu, oð fif and hundseofantig cneoryssa;

4.1: Soðlice se hælend ƿæs full halȝum ȝaste and ferde fram iordane. and he ƿæs fram haliȝum ȝaste ȝelæd. on sumum ƿestene
4.2: feoƿertiȝ daȝa. and ƿæs fram deofle costod. and he on þam daȝum nan þinȝ ne æt; And þam daȝum ȝefylledum hine hinȝrede;
4.3: þa cƿæð se deofol him to: ȝif þu sy ȝodes sunu seȝe þisum stane þæt he to hlafe ȝeƿurðe;
4.4: þa andsƿarude him se hælend; Hit is aƿriten þæt se man ne leofað be hlafe anum. ac of ælcum ȝodes ƿorde;
4.5: And þa lædde se deofol hyne. and ætyƿde him ealle ricu eorðan ymbehƿyrftes. on anre byrhmhƿile
4.6: and to him cƿæð; Ealne þisne anƿeald ic ðe sylle: and hyra ƿuldor. forþam þe hi me synt ȝesealde. and ic hi sylle þam ðe ic ƿylle;
4.7: Ƿitodlice ealle hiȝ beoð þine ȝif þu ȝeeaðmetst beforan me;
4.8: þa andsƿarode him se hælend; Hit is aƿriten. drihten þinne ȝod ðu ȝeeadmetst. and him anum þeoƿast;
4.9: þa lædde he hyne on hierusalem and ȝesette hine ofer þæs temples hricȝ. and him to cƿæð; Ȝyf þu sy ȝodes sunu asend þe heonun nyþer;
4.10: Soðlice hyt is aƿriten: þæt he hys enȝlum be þe bebyt þæt hiȝ þe ȝehealdon.
4.11: and þæt hiȝ þe mid handum nimon. þe læs þu ðinne fot æt stane ætspeorne;
4.12: þa cƿæð se hælend him andsƿariende; Hyt is ȝecƿeden: ne costa þu drihten þinne ȝod;
4.13: and ealre þære costunȝe ȝefylledre. se deofol him sume hƿile fram ȝeƿat;
4.14: þa ferde se hælend on ȝastes mæȝene on ȝalileam: and his hlisa be him ferde on eall þæt rice
4.15: and he lærde be hyra ȝesamnunȝum. and ƿæs fram eallum ȝemærsod;
4.16: þa com he to nazareþ. þar he afed ƿæs. and he eode on restedæȝe on þa ȝesamnunȝe æfter his ȝeƿunan and he aras þæt he rædde.
4.17: and him ƿæs ȝeseald isaias boc þæs ƿiteȝan and sona sƿa he þa boc unfeold þa funde he þar aƿriten:
4.18: drihtnes ȝast is ofer me: forþam þe he smyrede me. he sende me þearfum bodian: and ȝehæftum alysednesse. and blindum ȝesihþe: forbrocene ȝehælan
4.19: and bodian drihtnes andfenȝe ȝer. and edleanes dæȝ;
4.20: And þa he þa boc befeold he hiȝ þam ðene aȝef and sæt: and ealra heora eaȝan on þære ȝesamnunȝe ƿæron on hyne behealdende;
4.21: þa onȝan he him to cƿeðan; Soþlice todæȝ þis ȝeƿrit is on eoƿrum earum ȝefylled;
4.22: And hiȝ ealle ƿæron þæs ȝecnæƿe: and ƿundredon be þam ƿordum þe of his muðe eode and þus cƿædun; Nys þes iosepes sunu.
4.23: ða cƿæþ he. Ƿitodlice ȝe secȝað me þas ȝelicnesse. Eala læce. Ȝehæl ðe sylfne; Do her on þinum earde: sƿa fela ƿundra sƿa ƿe ȝehyrdon ȝedone on cafarnaum;
4.24: þa cƿæð he soðlice ic eoƿ secȝe þæt nan ƿiteȝa nis andfenȝe on his eþele;
4.25: Soþlice ic eoƿ secȝe maneȝa ƿudeƿan ƿæron on helias daȝum on hisrahel. ða þa seo heofon ƿæs belocen þreo ȝer and syx monþas; þa ƿæs ȝeƿorden mycel hunȝer on ealre eorðan
4.26: and to þara nanum næs helias asend. Buton to anre ƿudeƿan on sarepta sidonie;
4.27: And maneȝa licþroƿeras ƿæron on israhel: under heliseo þam ƿiteȝan: and hyra nan næs aclænsud buton naaman se sirisca;
4.28: ƿurdon hiȝ ealle on þære ȝesamnunȝe mid yrre ȝefylled. þas þinȝ ȝehyrende;
4.29: and hiȝ arison and scufon hine of ðære ceastre. and læddon hine ofer ðæs muntes cnæpp: ofer þone hyra buruh ȝetimbrud ƿæs: þæt hi hyne nyðer bescufon.
4.30: þa ferde he þurh hyra midlen;
4.31: And he ferde to cafarnaum on ȝalileisce ceastre: and hi þar on restedaȝum lærde
4.32: and hiȝ ƿundredon be his lare: forþam his spæc on anƿealde ƿæs;
4.33: And on hyra ȝesamnunȝe ƿæs sum man unclæne deofol hæbbende: and he hrymde micelre stefne
4.34: and cƿæþ; Læt la nadzarenisca hælend. hƿæt is us and þe: com þu us to forspillanne. ic ƿat þæt ðu eart ȝodes haleȝa;
4.35: And þa cidde him se hælend and cƿæþ. adumba and ȝa him of; and þa he ut adraf hine on heora midlene: he him fram ȝeƿat: and him naht ne derude;
4.36: þa ƿurdon hiȝ ealle forhte and spræcon him betƿynan. and cƿædon. hƿæt ys þæt ƿord þæt he on mihte and on mæȝene unclsenum ȝastum bebyt and hiȝ utȝað;
4.37: þa ƿæs his hlisa ȝeƿidmærsod on ælcere stoƿe þæs rices;
4.38: Soþlice he aras of heora ȝesamnunȝe and ferde on simones hus; þa ƿæs simones sƿeȝer ȝesƿenced on mycelum feferum. and hiȝ hyne for hyre bædon.
4.39: and he standende ofer hiȝ þam fefore bebead and he hiȝ forlet and heo sona aras and him þenode;
4.40: Soðlice þa sunne asah ealle þe untrume ƿæron on mislicum adlum hiȝ læddon him to and he syndryȝum hys hand on settende hiȝ ȝehælde;
4.41: þa ferdon þa deoflu of maneȝum hrymende and cƿeðende; Soðes þu eart ȝodes sunu. and he ne ȝeþafude þæt hiȝ æni þinȝ spræcon forþam þe ƿiston þæt he crist ƿæs;
4.42: þa ȝeƿordenum dæȝe se hælend utȝanȝende ferde on ƿeste stoƿe: and þa meniu hine sohtun. and hi comon to him: and behæfdon hine: þæt he him fram ne ȝeƿite;
4.43: þa sæde he him. soðlice me ȝedafænað oðrum ceastrum ȝodes rice bodian. forþam. to þam ic eom asend
4.44: and he ƿæs bodiȝende on ȝalilea ȝesamnunȝum;

5.1: Soþlice ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa ða meneȝu him to comon þæt hiȝ ȝodes ƿord ȝehyrdon. he stod ƿið þone mere ȝenesareþ.
5.2: and he ȝeseah tƿa scipu standende ƿið þæne mere; þa fisceras eodun and ƿohson heora nett;
5.3: He þa astiȝende on an scyp: þæt ƿæs simones. bæd hyne þæt he hit lyþƿon fram lande tuȝe: and on þam scipe sittende he lærde þa meneȝu;
5.4: þa he sprecan ȝesƿac he cƿæþ to simone; Teoh hit on dypan and lætað eoƿre nett on þone fiscƿer;
5.5: þa cƿæþ simon him andsƿariende; Eala bebeodend ealle niht sƿincende ƿe naht ne ȝefenȝon; Soðlice on þinum ƿorde ic min nett ut læte;
5.6: and þa hi þæt dydon hiȝ betuȝon mycele meniȝeo fixa: and hyra net ƿæs tobrocen.
5.7: and hiȝ bicnodon hyra ȝeferan. þe on oðrum scipe ƿæron. þæt hi comun and him fylston; þa comon hiȝ and ȝefyldon butu þa scypu: sƿa þæt hi neh ƿæron besencte;
5.8: þa petrus þæt ȝeseah he feoll to þæs hælendes cneoƿum and cƿæð; Drihten. ȝeƿit fram me forþam ic eom synfull mann.
5.9: and he ƿundrude and ealle þa ðe mid him ƿæron on þam ƿere þara fixa þe hi ȝefenȝon;
5.10: Ȝelice iacobum and iohannem zebedeis suna: þa ƿæron simones ȝeferan; þa cƿæþ se hælend to simone: ne ondræd þu þe; Heonon forð þu byst men ȝefonde;
5.11: and hiȝ tuȝon hyra scypo to lande. and forleton hiȝ and folȝodon | þam hælende;
5.12: þa he ƿæs on anre ceastre þa ƿæs þær an hreofla and þa he ȝeseah þæne hælend þa astrehte he hine and bæd and þus cƿæð; Drihten. ȝyfþu ƿylt þu miht me ȝeclænsian;
5.13: And he æþran hine his handa aþenede and cƿæð; Ic ƿylle. si ðu ȝeclænsud; And sona se hreofla him fram ferde
5.14: and he bebead him þæt he hit nanum men ne sæde. ac ȝa and ætyƿ þe þam sacerde. and brinȝ for þinre clænsunȝa sƿa moyses bebead him on ȝeƿitnesse;
5.15: Ƿitodlice þæs þe ma seo spræc be him ferde and mycele meneȝeo comun þæt hi ȝehyrdon and ƿurdon ȝehælede fram hyra untrumnessum;
5.16: He þa ferde on ƿesten and hyne ȝebæd;
5.17: þa ƿæs anum dæȝe ȝeƿorden þæt he sæt and hiȝ lærde and þa ƿæron þa farisei sittende and þære. æ. lareoƿ ƿæs: þa comon of ælcon castele ȝalile,e and iudele. and hierusalem and drihtnes mæȝen ƿæs hiȝ to ȝehælenne;
5.18: And þa bæron men on anum bedde anne man. se ƿæs lama.
5.19: and hiȝ ne mihton hine in brinȝan and alecȝan beforan him: for ðære meniȝo þe mid þam hælende ƿæs; þa astiȝon hiȝ uppan þæne hrof and þurh þa ƿatelas hine mid þam bedde asende beforan þæne hælend;
5.20: þa he ȝeseah hyra ȝeleafan he cƿæð; La mann þe synd þine synna forȝyfene;
5.21: þa aȝunnon þencan þa boceras and farisei and cƿædon. hƿæt is þes þe her sprycþ ƿoffunȝa; Hƿa mæȝ synna forȝyfan buton ȝod ana;
5.22: þa se hælend ȝecneoƿ hyra ȝeþancas. he andsƿariende cƿæþ to him. hƿæt þence ȝe on eoƿrum heortum.
5.23: hƿæðer is eðre to cƿeþenne þe synd þine synna forȝyfene: hƿæþer þe cƿeþan aris and ȝa.
5.24: þæt ȝe ƿiton þæt mannes sunu on eoroan anƿeald hæfð synna to forȝyfanne; (And he sæde þam laman.) þe ic secȝe aris. nim þin bed: and ȝa on þin hus;
5.25: and he sona beforan him aras. and nam þæt he on læȝ and to his huse ferde and ȝod ƿuldrode.
5.26: and hiȝ ealle ƿundredon and ȝod mærsodon and ƿæron mid eȝe ȝefyllede: and cƿædon. soðes ƿe todæȝ ƿundru ȝesaƿon;
5.27: þa æfter þam he uteode and ȝeseah publicanum he ƿæs oþrum naman leui ȝehaten æt ceapsceamule sittende: and he cƿæþ to him filiȝ me;
5.28: And he him þa filiȝde and ealle hys þinȝ forlet;
5.29: And leui dyde him mycelne ȝebeorscype on his huse: and þar ƿæs mycel meneȝeo manfulra and oðerra þe mid him sæton;
5.30: þa murcnodon þa farisei and þa boceras and cƿædon to hys leorninȝcnihtum. hƿi ete ȝe and drincað mid manfullum and synfullum;
5.31: þa andsƿarude se hælend and cƿæþ to him; Ne beþurfon læces þa ðe hale synd: ac þa ðe unhælþe habbaþ;
5.32: Ne com ic rihtƿise clypian: ac synfulle on dædbote;
5.33: þa cƿædon hiȝ to him. hƿi fæstað iohannes leorninȝcnihtas ȝelomlice and halsunȝa doð: and eallsƿa farisea. and þine etað and drincað;
5.34: þa cƿæð he cƿyst þu maȝon þæs brydȝuman bearn fæstan sƿa lanȝe sƿa se brydȝuma myd him ys;
5.35: Soþlice þa daȝas cumaþ þonne se brydȝuma him byð afyrred. þonne fæstað hiȝ on þam daȝum;
5.36: þa sæde he him an biȝspell. ne asend nan man scyp of niƿum reafe on eald reaf. elles þæt niƿe slit. and se niƿa scyp ne hylpð þam ealdan;
5.37: Ne nan man ne sent niƿe ƿin on ealde bytta: elles þæt niƿe ƿin brycð þa bytta and þæt ƿin byð aȝoten. and þa bytta forƿurðað;
5.38: Ac niƿe ƿin is to sendenne on niƿe bytta: þonne beoð þa bytta ȝehealdene;
5.39: And ne drincð nan man eald ƿin and ƿylle sona þæt niƿe: he cƿyþ. þæt ealde is betere;

6.1: Soþlice ƿæs ȝeƿorden on þam æfteran restedæȝe: æryst þa he ferde þurh þa æceras hys leorninȝcnihtas þa ear pluccedon and mid hyra handum ȝnidon and æton;
6.2: þa cƿædon sume ofþan sundorhalȝan. hƿi do ȝe þæt eoƿ alyfed nis on restedaȝon;
6.3: þa andsƿarode him se hælend ne rædde ȝe þæt. hƿæt dauid dyde þa hine hinȝrede. and þa ðe mid him ƿæron.
6.4: hu he eode into ȝodes huse: and nam þa offrunȝhlafas and hiȝ æt. and þam sealde þe mid him ƿærun. þa nærun alyfede to etanne buton sacerdon anum;
6.5: And he sæde him þæt drihten is mannes sunu. eac sƿylce restedæȝes;
6.6: Soðlice on oðrum restedæȝe ƿæs ȝeƿorden þæt he on ȝesamnunȝe eode and lærde. and þar ƿæs sum man and his sƿyðre hand ƿæs forscruncen;
6.7: þa ȝymdon þa boceras and farisei hƿæþer he on restedæȝe hælde. þæt hi hyne ȝeƿreȝdon. Soþlice he ƿiste hyra ȝeþancas:
6.8: and he sæde þam men þe ða forscruncenan hand hæfde. aris and stand her amiddan; þa aras he and stod;
6.9: þa cƿæþ se hælend | to him; Ic ahsiȝe eoƿ alyfð on restedaȝum ƿel don. oððe yfele. saƿle hale ȝedon. hƿæþer þe forspillan;
6.10: And him eallum ȝesceaƿodum myd yrre he sæde þam men; Aþene þine hand: and he aþenode and his hand ƿæs ȝeedniƿod;
6.11: þa ƿurdon hiȝ mid unƿisdome ȝefyllede and spæcon betux him hƿæt hiȝ þam hælende dydon;
6.12: Soþlice on þam daȝum he ferde on anne munt hine ȝebiddan. and ƿæs þar ƿaciende on ȝodes ȝebede;
6.13: And þa ða dæȝ ƿæs he clypode hys leorninȝcnihtas and ȝeceas tƿelf of him. and þa he nemde apostolas;
6.14: Simonem (þæne he nemde petrus) and his broðor andreas. Iacobum and Iohannem. filippum. and barþolomeum.
6.15: and þomam. and Maþeum. and Iacobum. Alfei. and simonem. se is ȝenemned zelotes.
6.16: Iudam. Iacobi. and iudam scarioð se ƿæs læƿa;
6.17: And mid him farendum he stod on feldlicre stoƿe: and mycel ƿered his leorninȝcnihta: and mycel meneȝeo fram ealra iudea and fram ierusalem: and ofer muþan and sæ ȝemæro tiri and sidonis.
6.18: ða coman þæt hi hyne ȝehyrdon. and ƿæron of hyra adlum ȝehælede. and þa ðe ƿæron of unclænum ȝastum ȝedrehte ƿærun ȝehælede;
6.19: And eal seo meniȝeo sohte hine to æþrinenne. forþam þe mæȝen of him eode and he ealle ȝehælde;
6.20: þa cƿæþ se hælend beseonde to his leorninȝcnihtum; Eadiȝe synd ȝe þearfan on ȝaste forþam þe ȝodes rice is eoƿer;
6.21: Eadiȝe synd ȝe ðe hinȝriað nu. forþam ȝe beoð ȝefyllede; Eadiȝe synt ȝe ðe nu ƿepað. forþam ȝe hlihaþ;
6.22: Eadiȝe beo ȝe. þone eoƿ men hatiað and ehtað. and onhiscað: and aƿurpað eoƿerne naman sƿa sƿa yfel for mannes suna;
6.23: Ȝeblissiað and ȝefaȝniað on þam daȝum. nu eoƿer med is mycel on heofenum; Soðlice æfter þissum þinȝum hyra fæderas dydon þam ƿiteȝum;
6.24: þeah hƿæðere ƿa eoƿ ƿiteȝum. forþam þe ȝe eoƿerne frofor habbað;
6.25: Ƿa eoƿ þe ȝefyllede synt: forþam þe ȝe hinȝriað; Ƿa eoƿ þe nu hlihað. forþam þe ȝe heofað and ƿepað;
6.26: Ƿa eoƿ þonne eoƿ ealle men bletsiað. æfter þissum þinȝum hyra fæderas dydon þam ƿiteȝum;
6.27: Ac ic eoƿ seȝe forþam þe ȝe ȝehyraþ: lufiað eoƿre fynd doþ þam tala þe eoƿ hatedon;
6.28: Bletsiað þa oe eoƿ ƿiriao: ȝebiddaþ for þa þe eoƿ onhisceað;
6.29: And þam þe slihþ on þin ȝeƿenȝe ƿend oðer aȝen. and þam þe ðin reaf nymþ: ne forbeod him no þine tunecan;
6.30: Syle ælcum þe ðe bidde. and se ðe nimð þa ðinȝ þe ðine synt ne myneȝa þu hyra;
6.31: And sƿa ȝe ƿyllað þæt eoƿ men don doþ him ȝelice;
6.32: and hƿylc þanc is eoƿ ȝif ȝe lufiað þa þe eoƿ lufiað; Soðlice synfulle lufiað þa þe hi lufiað;
6.33: And ȝyf ȝe ƿel doð. þam ðe eoƿ ƿel doð: hƿylc þanc is eoƿ. ƿitodlice þæt doo synfulle
6.34: and ȝyf ȝe lænaþ þam þe ȝe eft æt onfoð. hƿylc þanc is eoƿ: Soþlice synfulle synfullum lænað. þæt hi ȝelice onfon.
6.35: þeah hƿæðere lufiað eoƿre fynd and him ƿel doð. and læne syllað nan þinȝ þanun eft ȝehihtende. and eoƿer med byþ mycel on heofone; and ȝe beoþ þæs hehstan bearn. forþam þe he is ȝod ofer unþancfulle and ofer yfele;
6.36: Heornostlice beoþ mildheorte sƿa eoƿer fæder is mildheort;
6.37: Nelle ȝe deman. and ȝe ne beoð demede; Nelle ȝe ȝenyðerian. and ȝe ne beoð ȝenyþerude; Forȝyfaþ. and eoƿ byð forȝyfen;
6.38: Syllað and eoƿ byþ ȝeseald ȝod ȝemet and full: and ȝeheapod and oferfloƿende hiȝ syllaþ on eoƿerne bearm; þam sylfan ȝemete þe ȝe metað. eoƿ byð ȝemeten;
6.39: þa sæde he him sum biȝspell; Seȝst þu. mæȝ se blinda þæne blindan lædan. hu ne feallaþ hiȝ beȝen on þæne pytt;
6.40: Nis se leorninȝcniht ofer þone lareoƿ; Ælc byð fulfremed. ȝif he is sƿylce hys lareoƿ;
6.41: Hƿi ȝesihst þu þa eȝle on þines broþor eaȝan: and ne ȝesihst þæne beam on þinum eaȝan;
6.42: And hu miht þu seȝan þinum breþer broþor læt þæt ic ateo þa eȝle of þinum eaȝe: and þu sylf ne ȝesyhst þæne beam on þinum aȝenum eaȝan; Eala licetere. teoh æryst þone beam of þinum eaȝe: and þonne þu ȝesihst þæt ðu ateo þa eȝle of þines broðor eaȝe;
6.43: Nys ȝod treoƿ þe yfelne ƿæsm deð: ne nis yfel treoƿ. ȝodne ƿæstm donde;
6.44: Ælc treoƿ is be his ƿæstme oncnaƿen; Ne hiȝ of þornum ficæppla ne ȝaderiað: ne ƿinberian on ȝorste ne nimað;
6.45: Ȝod man of ȝodum ȝoldhorde: hys heortan. ȝod forð brinȝð: and yfel man of yfelum ȝoldhorde yfel forð brinȝþ; Soðlice se muð spycð sƿa seo heorte þencð.
6.46: hƿi clypie ȝe me drihten drihten. and ne doð þæt ic eoƿ secȝe;
6.47: Ælc þara þe to me cymþ and mine spræca ȝehyrð and þa deþ: ic him ætyƿe hƿam he ȝelic is;
6.48: He ys ȝelic timbriendum men his hus: se dealf deopne and hys ȝrundƿeall ofer þæne stan asette; Soðlice ȝeƿordenum flode hit fleoƿ into þam huse. and hyt ne mihte þæt hus astirian. hit ƿæs of er þæne stan ȝetrymed
6.49: Se ðe ȝehyrð and ne deþ: he is ȝelic þam timbriendan men his hus of er þa eorþan butan ȝrundƿealle. and þæt flod in fleoƿ. and hrædlice hyt afeoll and ƿearð mycel hryre þæs huses;

7.1: Soþlice ða he ealle his ƿord ȝyfylde on þæs folces hlyste. he eode into cafarnaum;
7.2: þa ƿæs sumes hundredmannes þeoƿa untrum. se ƿæs sƿeltendlic: se ƿæs him dyre;
7.3: And þa he ȝehyrde be þam hælende he sende to him iudea ealdras and bæd þæt he come. and hys þeoƿ ȝehælde;
7.4: þa hi to þam hælende comun. hi bædon hyne ȝeornlice and þus cƿædon; He is ƿyrðe þæt ðu him tiliȝe:
7.5: ƿitodlice he lufað ure þeode: and he us ure samnunȝe ȝetimbrode;
7.6: þa ferde se hælend mid him: and þa he ƿæs unfeor þam huse se hundredmann sende hys frynd to him and cƿæþ; Drihten nelle þu beon ȝedreht: ne eom ic ƿyrðe þæt ðu ȝa under mine þecene.
7.7: forþam ic ne tealde me sylfne þæt ic to ðe come; Ac cƿeð þin ƿord and min cniht byð ȝehæled;
7.8: Ic eom an man under anƿealde ȝesett; Cempan under me hæbbende. and ic secȝe þissum ȝa and he ȝæð: and ic secȝe þissum cum þonne cymð he. and ic secȝe minum þeoƿe: do þis and he deð;
7.9: þa ƿundrude se hælend þam ȝehyredum: and cƿæþ to þære meniȝeo beƿend; Soþlice ic secȝe eoƿ ne funde ic on israhel sƿa mycelne ȝeleafan.
7.10: and þa ða ham comon ðe asende ƿæron hiȝ ȝemetton halne þone þe ær untrum ƿæs;
7.11: þa ƿæs syððan ȝeƿorden he ferde on þa ceastre þe is ȝenemned naim: and mid him ferdun hys leorninȝcnihtas. and mycel meneȝo;
7.12: þa he ȝenealæhte þære ceastre ȝate þa ƿæs þar an dead man ȝeboren anre ƿudeƿan sunu þe nanne oðerne næfde; and seo ƿudeƿe ƿæs þar: and mycel meneȝu þære burhƿare mid hyre;
7.13: þa se hælend hiȝ ȝeseah þa ƿæs he mid mildheortnesse of er hiȝ ȝefylled. and cƿæþ to hyre. ne ƿep þu na.
7.14: þa ȝenealæhte he and þa cyste æþran. þa ætstodon þa þe hyne bæron; þa cƿæþ se hælend. eala ȝeonȝa þe ic secȝe aris;
7.15: þa aras se þe dead ƿæs. and onȝan sprecan: þa aȝef he hine hys meder;
7.16: þa ofereode eȝe hiȝ ealle. and hiȝ ȝod mærsodon and cƿædon. þæt mære ƿiteȝa on us aras; and þæt ȝod hys folc ȝeneosude;
7.17: þa ferde þeos spæc be him on ealle iudea: and embe eall þæt rice;
7.18: þa cyddun iohannes leorninȝcnihtas him be eallum þysum þinȝum;
7.19: þa clypode iohannes tƿeȝen of his leorninȝcnihtum. and sende to þam hælende. and þus cƿæþ; Eart þu þe cumene eart. hƿæðer þe ƿe oþres scylon onbydan;
7.20: þa hiȝ to him comun þus hiȝ cƿædon. Iohannes se fulluhtere us sende to þe and þus cƿæð; Eart þu ðe to cumenne eart þe ƿe sculon oðres onbidan;
7.21: Soðlice on þære tide he ȝehælde maneȝa of adlum: ȝe of ƿitum and of yfelum ȝastum. and maneȝum blindum he ȝesihþe forȝeaf;
7.22: þa cƿæþ se hælend; Faraþ and cyþað iohanne þa ðinȝ þe ȝe ȝesaƿon and ȝehyrdon; þæt blinde ȝeseoð and healte ȝaþ. hreoflan synt ȝehælede: deafe ȝehyrað. deade arisaþ. þearfan bodiað:
7.23: and eadiȝ ys sƿa hƿylc sƿa ne byð on me ȝeuntryƿsud;
7.24: And þa þa iohannes ærynddracan ferdon: þa cƿæð se hælend to þam folce be Iohanne; Hƿi ferde ȝe on ƿestene ȝeseon þæt hreod þe byð mid ƿinde astyred;
7.25: Ac hƿi ferde ȝe to seonne þone man mid hnescum reafum ȝescryddne; þa ðe synt on deorƿurðum reafe and on estum;
7.26: Ac hƿi ferde ȝe þæne ƿiteȝan ȝeseon: ƿitodlice ic eoƿ secȝe he is mara þonne ƿiteȝa;
7.27: þes is be þam þe aƿriten is: nu ic asende minne enȝel beforan þine ansyne: se ȝeȝearƿað þinne ƿeȝ beforan
7.28: Soþlice ic eoƿ secȝe. nis betƿux ƿifa bearnum nan mærra ƿiteȝa þonne iohannes se fulluhtere; Se þe is læssa on ȝodes rice. se is his mara:
7.29: and eall folc þis ȝehyrende sundorhalȝan ȝod heredon and ȝefullede on iohannes fulluhte;
7.30: Soðlice þa sundorhalȝan and þa æȝleaƿan forhoȝodon þæs hælendes ȝeþeaht on him sylfon. na fram þam hælende ȝefullode;
7.31: Hƿam telle ic ȝelice þisse cneorisse men: and ham synt hi ȝelice;
7.32: Hi synt ȝelice cildum on stræte sittendum and specendum betƿux him and cƿeðendum; Ƿe sunȝon eoƿ be hearpan. and ȝe ne saltudun. ƿe heofdun and ȝe ne ƿeopun;
7.33: Soþlice iohannes com se fulluhtere hlaf ne etende ne ƿin drincende: and ȝe cƿeðað: deofollseocnysse he hæfð;
7.34: Mannes sunu com. etende and drincende. and ȝe cƿeþað þes man is sƿelȝend and ƿin drinȝcende: manfullra and synfulra freond;
7.35: And ƿisdom is ȝerihtƿisud on eallum his bearnum;
7.36: þa bæd hine sum of þam sundorhalȝum þæt he mid him æte; ða eode he into þæs fariseiscan huse and ȝesæt;
7.37: And þa þæt ƿifþe ƿæs on þære ceastre synfull. þa heo oncneoƿ þæt he sæt on þæs fariseus huse: heo brohte hyre sealfbox.
7.38: and stod ƿiðæftan his fet. and onȝan mid hyre tearum hys fet þƿean. and driȝde mid hyre heafdes fexe. and cyste hys fet and mid sealfe smyrede;
7.39: þa se sundorhalȝa þe hyne in ȝelaðode þæt ȝeseah; he cƿæþ on hys ȝeþance; Ȝyf þe man ƿiteȝa ƿære. ƿitodlice he ƿiste hƿæt. and hƿylc þis ƿif ƿære þe his æþrinþ þæt heo synful is;
7.40: þa cƿæð se hælend him andsƿariende; Symon ic hæbbe þe to secȝenne sum ðinȝ; þa cƿæð he. lareoƿ seȝe þænne;
7.41: Tƿeȝen ȝafolȝyldon ƿæron sumum lænende: an sceolde fif hund peneȝa: and oðer fiftiȝ;
7.42: þa hiȝ næfdon hƿanon hi hyt aȝuldon: he hit him bam forȝef; Hƿæþer lufode hyne sƿyðor;
7.43: þa andsƿarode simon. ic ƿene. se ðe he mare torȝef; þa cƿæð he rihte. þu demdest;
7.44: þa beƿende he hyne to þam ƿife. and sæde simone; Ȝesyhst þu þis ƿif ic eode into þinum huse ne sealdest þu me ƿætan to minum fotum; þeos mid hyre tearum mine fet þƿoh. and mid hyre loccum driȝde;
7.45: Coss þu me ne sealdest: þeos syððan ic ineode. ne ȝesƿac þæt heo mine fet ne cyste;
7.46: Min heafod þu mid ele ne smyredest. þeos smyrede mid sealfe mine fet;
7.47: Forþam ic secȝe þe: hyre synt maneȝa sinna forȝyfene. forþam heo me sƿyðe lufode; Læsse lufað þam ðe læsse forȝyfen ys;
7.48: þa cƿæþ he to hyre. þe synt þine synna forȝyfenne;
7.49: þa beȝunnon þa ðe þar sæton betƿux him cƿeðan; Hƿæt is þes þe manna synna forȝyfð;
7.50: þa cƿæþ he to þam ƿife: þin ȝeleafa þe dyde hale ȝa nu on sybbe;

8.1: Syððan ƿæs ȝeƿorden þæt he ferde þurh þa ceastre and þæt castel: ȝodes rice prediciende and bodiende. and hi tƿelfe mid
8.2: And sume ƿif þe ƿæron ȝehælede of aƿyrȝdum ȝastum: and untrumnessum: seo maȝdalenisce maria ofþære seofan deoflu uteodon:
8.3: and iohanna chuzan ƿif herodes ȝerefan: and susanna and maneȝa oðre þe him of hyra spedum þenedon;
8.4: Soþlice þa mycel meneȝeo com and of þam ceastrum to him efstun. he sæde him an biȝspel;
8.5: Sum man his sæd seoƿ. þa he þæt seoƿ sum feoll ƿið þæne ƿeȝ and ƿearð fortreden: and heofones fuȝulas hyt fræton;
8.6: And sum feoll of er þæne stan and hit forscranc forþam þe hit ƿætan næfde;
8.7: and sum feoll on þa þornas. and þa þornas hyt forþrysmodon;
8.8: And sum feoll on ȝode eorðan: and ƿorhte hundfealde ƿæsm; þa clypode he. and cƿæð; Ȝehyre se ðe earan hæbbe;
8.9: þa ahsodon hine hys leorninȝcnihtas hƿæt þæt biȝspel ƿære;
8.10: þa cƿæð he eoƿ is ȝeseald þæt ȝe ƿitun ȝodes rices ȝeryne: and oðrum on biȝspellum; þæt hi ȝeseonde ne ȝeseon. and ȝehyrende ne onȝyton;
8.11: Soðlice þis is þæt biȝspell. þæt sæd ys ȝodes ƿord;
8.12: þa ðe synt ƿið þæne ƿeȝ. þæt synt þa þe ȝehyrað: syððan se deofol cymþ. and ætbryt þæt ƿord of hyra heortan þæt hiȝ þurh þone ȝeleafan hale ne ȝeƿurðað;
8.13: þa ðe synt of er þæne stan þa þæt ƿord mid ȝefean onfoð. and þa nabbað ƿyrtruman forþam þe hi hƿilum ȝelyfað: and aƿaciað on þære costnunȝe timan;
8.14: þæt sæd þe feoll on þa ðornas þæt synt þa ðe ȝehyrað: and of carum and of ƿelum and of lustum þiss lifes synt forþrysmede. and nanne ƿæstm ne brinȝað;
8.15: þæt feoll on ða ȝodan eorðan: þæt synt þa ðe on ȝodre and on selestre heortan ȝehyrende þæt ƿord healdað and ƿæstm on ȝeþylde brinȝað;
8.16: Ne of erƿrihð nan man mid fæte his onælede leohtfæt. oððe under bedd asett: ac of er candelstæf asett. þæt ða inȝanȝendan leoht ȝeseon;
8.17: Soðlice nis nan ðinȝ diȝle þæt ne sy ȝesƿutelod: ne behydd. þæt ne sy cuþ. and open;
8.18: Ƿarniað hu ȝe ȝehyran: þam byð ȝeseald ðe hæfð: and sƿa hƿylc sƿa næfð þæt he ƿene þæt he hæbbe. him byð afyrred;
8.19: His modor and his ȝebroðru: him to comun and hi ne mihton hine for þære meneȝu ȝeneosian;
8.20: þa ƿæs him ȝecyðed. þin modor and þine ȝebroðru standað her ute. ƿyllað þe ȝeseon;
8.21: þa cƿæð he to him: min modor and mine ȝebroðru synt þa ðe ȝehyrað and doð ȝodes ƿord;
8.22: Soðlice anum dæȝe ƿæs ȝeƿorden þa he on scyp eode and his leorninȝcnihtas: þa cƿæþ he to him; Utun seȝlian of er þisne mere. and hiȝ seȝlydan þa;
8.23: þa hiȝ reoƿun. þa slep he; þa com ƿindi yst and hiȝ forhtodon;
8.24: þa ȝenealæhton hiȝ him to and cƿædon. hlaford. ƿe forƿurðað; þa aras he and ðreade þæne ƿind and þæs ƿæteres hreohnesse; þa ȝesƿac se ƿind and ƿearð mycel smyltnes;
8.25: þa cƿæþ se hælend hƿar is eoƿer ȝeleafa. þa adredon hiȝ and ƿundredon and betƿux him cƿædon; Ƿenst þu hƿæt is þes. þæt he bebyt ȝe ƿindum ȝe sa . and hiȝ him hyrsumiað;
8.26: þa reoƿon hiȝ to ȝerasenorum rice. þæt is foran onȝen ȝalileam;
8.27: þa he to lande com. him aȝen arn sum man. se hæfde deofolseocnesse lanȝe tide. and næs mid nanon reafe ȝescrydd: and ne mihte on huse ȝeƿunian ac on byrȝenum;
8.28: þa he ȝeseah þæne hælend he astrehte hyne toforan him: and cƿæþ mycelre stefne hrymende; Hƿæt is me and þe: la hælend þæs hehstan ȝodes sunu; Ic halsiȝe þe þæt ðu ne ðreaȝe me;
8.29: (þa bead he þam unclænan ȝaste þæt he of ðam men ferde; Soþlice lanȝe tide he hyne ȝeȝrap: and he ƿæs mid racenteaȝum ȝebunden and mid fotcopsum ȝehealden: and toborstenum bendum he ƿæs fram deofle on ƿesten ȝelædd; )
8.30: þa ahsode se hælend hine: hƿæt is þin nama; þa cƿæð he leȝio: þæt is on ure ȝeþeode eored: forþam þe maneȝa deoflu on hine eodun;
8.31: þa bædon hiȝ hine þæt he him ne bude þæt hi on ȝrund ne bescuton;
8.32: And þar ƿæs mycel heord sƿyna on þam munte læsiendra: þa bædon hy þæt he lyfde him on þa ȝan: þa lyfde he him:
8.33: þa eodon hiȝ of þam men on þa sƿyn. þa ferde seo heord myculum ræse on ðæne mere and ƿearð þar adruncen;
8.34: þa ða hyrdas þæt ȝesaƿon þa fluȝon hiȝ and cyddon on þa ceastre and on tunum;
8.35: þa eodon hiȝ ut þæt hiȝ ȝesaƿon þæt ðar ȝeƿorden ƿæs: þa comon hiȝ to þam hælende. þa fundon hiȝ ðæne man þe deofol of eode ȝescryddne and halum mode æt his fotum. and hiȝ adredon him;
8.36: þa cyddon him þa ðe ȝesaƿon hu he ƿæs hal ȝeƿorden of ðam eorede;
8.37: þa bæd hine eall meneȝo þæs rices ȝerasenorum þæt he fram him ȝeƿite: forþam hiȝ mycelum eȝe ȝehæfte ƿærun; þa ƿende he on scype aȝen
8.38: þa bæd hyne se man ðe se deofol of eode þæt he mid him ƿunede; þa forlet se hælend hyne and cƿæð to him:
