1.12: Sōðlice swā hwylce swā hyne underfēngon, hē sealde him anweald þæt hi wæron Godes bearn, þām ðe gelyfað on his naman:
1.13: ðā ne synt ācennede of blōdum, nē of flǣsces willan, nē of weres willan, ac hig synt of Gode ācennede.
1.14: And þæt Word wæs flǣsc geworden, and eardode on ūs, and we gesāwon hys wuldor, swylce āncennedes wuldor of Fæder, þæt wæs ful mid gyfe and sōðfæstnysse.
1.15: Iohannes cȳþ gewitnesse be him, and clypaþ þus cweðende, Þēs wæs þe ic sǣde, Sē ðe tō cumenne is æfter mē wæs geworden beforan mē, for ðām hē wæs ǣr þonne ic.
1.16: And of his gefyllednesse wē ealle onfēngon gyfe for gyfe.
1.17: For þām þe ǣ wæs geseald þurh Moysen; and gyfu and sōþfæstnes is geworden þurh Hǣlend Crīst.
1.18: Ne geseah nǣfre nān mann God, būtan sē āncenneda Sunu hit cȳðde, sē is on his Fæder bearme.
1.19: And þæt is Iohannes gewitnes: Đā þā Iudeas sendon hyra sācerdas and hyra dīaconas fram Ierusalem tō him þæt hī āxsodon hine and þus cwǣdon, Hwæt eart þū?
1.20: And hē cȳðde and ne wiðsōc, and þus cwæð, Ne eom ic nā Crīst.
1.21: And hig āxsodon hine and þus cwǣdon, Eart ðū Elias? And he cwæð, Ne eom ic hit. Đā cwǣdon hī, Eart ðū wītega? And hē andwyrde and cwæð, Nic.
1.22: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Hwæt eart þū? þæt wē andwyrde bringon þām ðe ūs tō þē sendon. Hwæt segst þū be þē sylfum?
1.23: Hē cwæð, Ic eom clypiendes stefn on wēstene, Gerihtað Drihtnes weg, swā sē witega Isaias cwæð.
1.24: And þā þe þær āsende wǣron, þā wǣron of sundorhālgon.
1.25: And hig āxsodon hine and cwǣdon tō him, Hwī fullast þū, gif þū ne eart Crīst, nē Elias, nē wītega?
1.26: Iohannes him andswarode, Ic fullige on wætere; tōmiddes ēow stōd þe gē ne cunnon.
1.27: Hē is þe æfter mē tōweard is, sē wæs geworden beforan mē; ne eom ic wyrðe þæt ic unbinde his scēoþwang.
1.28: Đās ðing wǣron gewordene on Bethania begeondan Iordanen þǣr Iohannes fullode.
1.29: Ōþre dæg Iohannes geseah þone Hǣlend tō him cumende, and cwæð, Hēr is Godes lamb; hēr is sē þe dēð aweg middaneardes synne.
1.30: Þēs is be þām ic sēde, Æfter mē cymð wer þe mē beforan geworden wæs, for ðām þe hē wæs ǣr ðonne ic.
1.31: And ic hyne nyste; ac ic cōm and fullode on wætere tō ðǣm þæt hē wǣre geswutelud on Israhela folce.
1.32: And Iohannes cȳþde gewitnesse cweðende, Þæt ic geseah nyðer cumendne Gāst of heofenum swā swā culfran, and wunode ofer hine.
1.33: And ic hine ne cūðe; ac sē þe mē sende tō fullianne on wætere, hē cwæð tō mē, Ofer þone þe ðū gesyhst nyðer stigendne Gāst and ofer hine wuniendne, þæt is sē ðe fullað on Hālgum Gāste.
1.34: And ic geseah, and gewitnesse cȳðde þæt þēs is Godes Sunu.
1.35: Eft ōðre dæg stōd Iohannes, and twēgen of his leorningcnihtum;
1.36: and hē cwæð, þā he geseaḥ þone Hǣlend gangende, Hēr is Godes lamb.
1.37: Ðā gehȳrdon hyne twēgen leorningcnihtas sprecende, and fylidon þām Hǣlende.
1.38: Þā beseah sē Hǣlend, and geseah hig him fyliende, and cwæð tō him, Hwæt sēce gyt? Hi cwǣdon to him, Rabbi, þæt is gecweden and gereht, Lārēow, hwār eardast ðū?
1.39: Hē cwǣþ tō him, Cumaþ and gesēoþ. Hig cōmon and gesāwon hwār hē wunode, and mid him wunodon on ðām dæge; hit was þā sēo tēoðe tīd.
1.40: Andreas, Simones brōþur Petres, was ōþer of þām twām, þā gehȳrdon æt Iohanne, and him fyligdon.
1.41: Ðēs gemētte ǣrost Simonem his brōðor, and cwæð tō him, Wē gemētton Messīam, þæt is gereht Crīst.
1.42: And hig lǣddon hine tō þām Hǣlende. Đā behēold sē Hǣlend hyne, and cwæþ, Þū eart Simon Ionan sunu; þu bist genemned Cephas, þæt is gereht, Petrus.
1.43: On mergen hē wolde faran on Galilea, and hē gemētte Philippus; and sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Fylig mē.
1.44: Sōþlīce Philippus was fram Bethzaida, Andreas ceastre and Petres.
1.45: Philippus gemētte Nathanael, and cwæþ tō him, Wē gemētton ðone Hǣlend, Iosepes sunu of Nazareth, þone wrāt Moyses and þā witegan on ðǣre ǣ.
1.46: And Nathanahel cwæð tō him, Mæg ǣnig þing gōdes bēon of Nazareth? Philippus cwæð to him, Cum and geseoh.
1.47: Đā geseah sē Hǣlend Nathanahel tō him cumendne, and cwæð be him, Hēr is Israhelisc wer, on ðām nis nān fācn.
1.48: Đā cwæð Nathanahel tō him, Hwanon cūðest ðū mē? Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Ic geseah þē þā þū wāre under þām fīctreowe, ǣr ðām þe Philippus þē clypode. 50. Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Þū gesyhst māre þonne þis sȳ, for ðām þe þū gelȳfdest ðā ic cwæð þæt ic gesāwe þē under þām fīctrēowe. 51. And hē sǣde him, Sōð ic secge ēow, Gē gesēoð opene heofonas, and Godes englas ūp stīgende and nyðer stīgende ofer mannes Sunu.

2.1: On þām þriddan dæge wǣron gyfta gewordene on Chanaa Galilee; and þæs Hǣlendes mōdor wæs þǣr.
2.2: Sōþlīce sē Hǣlend and his leorningcnihtas wǣron gelaðode tō þām gyfton.
2.3: And þā þæt wīn getēorude, þā cwæð þæs Hǣlendes mōdor tō him, Hī nabbað wīn.
2.4: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Lā wif, hwæt is mē and þē? gȳt mīn tīma ne cōm.
2.5: Đā cwæð þæs Hǣlendes mōdor tō þām þēnum, Dōð swā hwæt swā hē ēow secge.
2.6: Þǣr wǣron sōðlīce āset six stǣnene wæterfatu, æfter Iudea geclǣnsunge, ǣlc wæs on twēgra sestra gemete oððe on þrēora.
2.7: Đā bēad sē Hǣlend þæt hig þā fatu mid wætere gefyldon. And hig gefyldon þā oþ þone brerd.
2.8: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend, Hladaþ nū, and berað þǣre drihte ealdre. And hī nāmon.
2.9: Đā sē drihte-ealdor þæs wīnes onbyrigde þe of þām wætere geworden was, hē nyste hwanon hyt cōm, - þā þēnas sōðlice wiston þe þæt water hlōdon; sē drihte-ealdor clypode þone brȳdguman,
2.10: and cwæð tō him, Ǣlc man sylþ ǣrest gōd wīn, and þonne hig druncene bēoð, þæt þe wyrse byð; ðū gehēolde þæt gōde wīn oð þis.
2.11: Đis wæs þæt forme tācn þe sē Hǣlend worhte on Chanaa Galilee, and geswutelode his wuldor; and his leorningcnihtas gelȳfdon on hine.
2.12: Æfter þyson he and hys mōdor and his gebrōðru and his leorningcnihtas fōron tō Capharnaum, and wunedon þār fēawa daga.
2.13: And hit was nēah Iudea ēastron, and sē Hǣlend fōr tō Ierusalem,
2.14: and gemētte on þām temple þā ðe sealdon oxan and scēap and culfran, and sittende myneteras.
2.15: And hē worhte swipan of strengon, and hig ealle of ðām temple ādrāf, ge scēap ge oxan; and hē āgēat þāra mynetera feoh, and tōwearp hyra mȳsan;
2.16: and sǣde þām þe ðā culfran cȳpton, Dōð þās þing heonon; ne wyrce gē mīnes Fæder hūs tō mangunghūse.
2.17: Þā gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt ðe āwriten is, Þīnes hūses anda mē et.
2.18: Đā andswaredon him þā Iudeas and cwǣdon, Hwylc tācn ætȳwst þū ūs, for ðām þe þū ðās ðing dēst?
2.19: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Tōwurpað þis tempel, and ic hit ārǣre binnan þrīm dagon.
2.20: Đā Iudeas cwǣdon tō him, Þis tempel wæs getimbrod on six and fēowertigon wintron, and ārǣrst þū hit on þrȳm dagon?
2.21: Sōðlīce hē hyt cwæð be hys līchaman temple.
2.22: Đā hē of dēaðe ārās, þā gemundon his leorningcnihtas þæt hē hit be him sylfum cwæð; and hī gelȳfdon hālegum gewrite and þǣre sprǣce þe sē Hǣlend spræc.
2.23: Đā hē wæs on Ierusalem on ēastron ōn frēolsdæge, manega gelȳfdon on his naman, þā hī gesāwon ðā tācna þe hē worhte.
2.24: Sē Hǣlend ne geswutelode hine sylfne him, for ðām hē cūðe hī ealle,
2.25: and for þām him næs nān þearf þæt ǣnig man sǣde gewitnesse be men; hē wiste witodlīce hwat wæs on men.

3.1: Sōðlīce sum Phariseisc man wæs genemned Nichodemus, sē wæs Iudea ealdor.
3.2: Đēs cōm tō him on niht, and cwæð tō him, Rabbī, þæt is, Lārēow, wē witon þæt þū cōme fram Gode; ne mæg nān man þās tācn wyrcan þe ðū wyrcst, būton God bēo mid him.
3.3: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōð ic þē secge, Būton hwā bēo ednīwan gecenned, ne mæg hē gesēon Godes rīce.
3.4: Đā cwæð Nichodemus tō him, Hū mæg man bēon eft ācenned þonne hē bið eald? Cwyst ðū mæg hē eft cuman on his mōdor innoð and bēon eft ācenned?
3.5: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic þē secge, Būton hwā bēo geedcenned of wætere and of Hāligum Gāste, ne mæg hē in faran on Godes rīce.
3.6: Ðæt þe ācenned is of flǣsce þæt is flǣsc; and þæt þe of Gāste is ācenned þæt is gāst.
3.7: Ne wundra þū for ðām þe ic sǣde þē, Ēow gebyrað þæt gē bēon ācennede ednīwan.
3.8: Gāst oreðað þār hē wile, and þū gehȳrst his stefne, and þū nāst hwanon hē cymþ, nē hwyder hē gǣþ; swā is ǣlc þe ācenned is of Gāste.
3.9: Đā andswarode Nichodemus and cwæð, Hu magon þās þing þus geweorðan?
3.10: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him, Ðu eart lārēow Israhela folce, and þū nāst þās ðing?
3.11: Sōþ ic þē secge, þæt wē sprecað þæt wē witon, and we cȳðað þæt wē gesāwon; and gē ne underfōð ūre cȳðnesse.
3.12: Gif ic ēow eorþlīce þing sǣde, and gē ne gelȳfað, hūmeta gelȳfe gē gif ic ēow heofonlīce þing secge?
3.13: And nān man ne āstīhð tō heofenum, būton sē ðe nyðer cōm of heofonum, mannes Sunu sē ðe cōm of heofonum.
3.14: And swā swā Moyses þā nǣddran ūp āhōf on þām wēstene, swā gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu bēo ūp āhafen:
3.15: Þæt nān þāra ne forwurðe þe on hyne gelyfð, ac hæbbe þæt ēce līf.
3.16: God lufode middaneard swā þæt hē sealde his āncennedan Sunu, þæt nān ne forwurðe þe on hine gelȳfð, ac hæbbe þæt ēce līf.
3.17: Ne sende God his Sunu on middanearde þæt hē dēmde middanearde, ac þæt middaneard sȳ gehǣled þurh hine.
3.18: Ne biþ þām gedēmed ðe on hine gelȳfð; sē ðe ne gelȳfð, him biþ gedēmed, for þām þe hē ne gelȳfde on ðone naman þæs āncennedan Godes Suna.
3.19: Þæt is sē dōm, þæt lēoht cōm on middaneard, and menn lufedon þȳstro swȳþor ðonne þæt lēoht: hyra weorc wǣron yfele.
3.20: Ælc ðāra þe yfele dēð hatað þæt lēoht, and hē ne cymþ to lēohte, þæt his weorc ne sȳn gerihtlǣhte.
3.21: Witodlīce sē ðe wyrcð sōðfæstnesse cymp tō ðām lēohte, þæt his weorc sȳn geswutelude, for ðām þe hig synt on Gode gedōne.
3.22: Æfter þyson cōm sē Hǣlend and his leorningcnihtas tō Iudea lande, and wunode ðǣr mid him, and fullode.
3.23: And Iohannes fullode on Enon wið Salim, for ðām þe þǣr wǣron manega wætro; and hī tōgædere cōmun, and wǣron gefullode.
3.24: Ðā gȳt næs Iohannes gedōn on cweartern.
3.25: Þā smēadon Iohannes leorningcnihtas and þā Iudeas be þǣre clǣnsunge,
3.26: and cōmon tō Iohanne, and cwǣdon tō him, Rabbī, sē ðe mid þē was begeondan Iordane, be ðām þū cȳðdest gewitnesse, nū hē fullaþ, and ealle hig cumaþ tō him.
3.27: Iohannes andwurde and cwæð, Ne mæg mann nān þing underfōn, būton hit bēo him of heofonum geseald.
3.28: Gē sylfe mē synd tō gewitnesse þæt ic sǣde, Ne eom ic Crīst, ac ic eom āsend beforan hine.
3.29: Sē ðe brȳde hæfð sē is brȳdguma; sē þe is þæs brȳdguman frēond and stent and gehȳrþ hyne, mid gefēan he geblissað for þæs brȳdguman stefne: þēs mīn gefēa is gefylled.
3.30: Hit gebyrað þæt hē weaxe, and þæt ic wanige.
3.31: Sē ðe ufenan cōm sē is ofer ealle; sē þe of eorðan is sē sprycþ be eorðan; sē þe of heofone cōm sē is ofer ealle.
3.32: And hē cȳð þæt hē geseah and gehȳrde, and nān man ne underfēhð his cȳðnesse.
3.33: Sōðlīce sē þe his cȳðnesse underfēhþ, hē getācnað þæt God is sōðfæstnys.
3.34: Sē ðe God sende sprycð Godes word; ne sylþ God þone Gāst be gemete.
3.35: Fæder lufað þone Sunu, and sealde ealle þing on his hand.
3.36: Sē þe gelȳfð on Sunu sē hæfð ēce līf; sē þe þām Suna is ungelēafsum ne gesyhþ hē līf, ac Godes yrre wunað ofer hine.

4.1: Đā sē Hǣlend wyste þæt þā Pharisei gehȳrdon þæt hē hæfde mā leorningcnihta þonne Iohannes, -
4.2: þēah sē Hǣlend ne fullode, ac his leorningcnihtas, -
4.3: ðā forlēt hē Iudea land, and fōr eft on Galilea.
4.4: Him gebyrode þæt hē sceolde faran þurh Samaria land.
4.5: Witodlīce hē cōm on Samarian ceastre, þe is genemned Sichar, nēah þām tūne þe Iacob sealde Iosepe his suna;
4.6: þǣr wæs Iacobes wyl. Sē Hǣlend sæt æt ðām wylle, þā hē wæs wērig gegān; and hit wæs middæg.
4.7: Þā cōm þǣr ān wif of Samaria, wolde wæter feccan; ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Syle mē drincan.
4.8: His leorningcnihtas fērdon þā tō þǣre ceastre, woldon him mete bicgan.
4.9: Þā cwæð þæt Samaritanisce wīf tō him, Hūmeta bitst þū æt mē drincan, þonne ðū eart Iudeisc, and ic eom Samaritanisc wīf? ne brūcað Iudeas and Samaritanisce metes ætgædere.
4.10: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō hyre, Gif þū wistest Godes gyfe, and hwæt sē is þe cwið tō þē, Syle me drincan, witodlīce þū bǣde hine þæt hē sealde þē līfes wæter.
4.11: Đā cwæð þæt wīf tō him, Lēof, ne ðū næfst nān þing mid tō hladanne, and þēs pyt is dēop; hwanon hæfst þū līfes wæter?
4.12: Cwyst ðū þæt þū sī mǣrra þonne ūre fæder Iacob, sē ðe ūs þisne þytt sealde, and hē and his bearn and his nȳtenu of ðām druncon?
4.13: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæþ tō hyre, Ǣlcne ðāra þyrst eft þe of ðyson wætere drincð;
4.14: witodlīce ǣlc þāra þe drincð of þām wætere þe ic him sylle... bið on him will forð rǣsendes wætres on ēce līf.
4.15: Đā cwæþ þæt wīf tō him, Hlāford, syle mē þæt water þæt mē ne þyrste, nē ic ne ðurfe hēr feccan.
4.16: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Ga, clypa þīnne ceorl, and cum hider.
4.17: Đā andwurde þæt wīf and cwæð, Næbbe ic nānne ceorl. Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend to hyre, Wel þū cwǣde þæt þū næfst ceorl;
4.18: witodlīce þū hæfdest fīf ceorlas, and sē ðe ðū nū hæfst nis ðīn ceorl; æt þām þū sǣdest sōð.
4.19: Đā cwæð þæt wīf tō him, Lēof, þæs mē ðyncð þū eart wītega.<Ref>A, þæs þe me; Corp., ðingþ, B, þingð, C, ðingþu, (for ðingþ þu), A, þyncð.</ref>
4.20: Ūre fæderas hig gebǣdon on þissere dūne, and gē secgað þæt on Ierusalem sȳ sēo stōw þæt man on gebidde.
4.21: Đā cwad sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Lā wif, gelȳf mē, þæt sēo tīd cymð þonne gē ne gebiddaþ Fæder nē on þisse dūne nē on Ierusalem.
4.22: Gē gebiddað þæt gē nyton; we gebiddaþ þæt wē witon; for þām þe hǣl is of Iudeum.
4.23: Ac seo tid cymð, and nū is, þonne sōþe gebedmen gebiddaþ Fæder on gāste and on sōðfæstnesse; witodlīce Fæder sēcþ swylce þe hyne gebiddon.
4.24: Gāst is God; and þām þe hyne gebiddað gebyrað þæt hig gebiddon on gāste and on sōðfæstnesse.
4.25: Ðæt wīf cwæþ tō him, Ic wāt þæt Messīas cymð þe is genemned Crīst; þonne hē cymð, hē cȳð ūs ealle ðing.
4.26: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Ic hit eom þe wið þē sprece.
4.27: And þǣrrihte cōmon his leorningcnihtas, and hig wundredon þæt hē wiþ þæt wīf spræc; þēah hyra nān ne cwæð, Hwæt sēcst þū? oððe, Hwæt sprycst þū wið hig?
4.28: Witodlice þæt wīf forlēt hyre wæterfæt, and ēode tō þǣre byrig, and cwæð tō þām mannum,
4.29: Cumað and gesēoð þone man þe mē sǣde ealle þā þing þe ic dyde; cweðe gē is hē Crīst?
4.30: Đā ēodon hī ūt of ðǣre byrig, and cōmon tō him.
4.31: Ongemang þām his leorningcnihtas hine bǣdon, and þus cwǣdon, Lārēow, et.
4.32: Đā cwæð hē tō him, Ic hæbbe þone mete tō etanne þe gē nyton.
4.33: Đā cwædon his leorningcnihtas him betwȳnan, Hwæðer ǣnig man him mete brōhte?
4.34: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Mīn mete is þæt ic wyrce þæs willan ðe me sende, þæt ic fullfremme his weorc.
4.35: Hū ne secge gē þæt nū gȳt synt fēowur mōnðas ǣr man rīpan mæge? nū ic ēow secge, Hebbað ūpp ēowre ēagan, and gesēoð þās eardas þæt hig synt scīre tō rīpanne.
4.36: And sē ðe rīpð nimð mēde, and gaderaþ wæstm on ēcum līfe, þæt ætgædere geblission sē þe sǣwþ and sē ðe rīpþ.
4.37: On þyson is witodlīce sōð word, for ðām ōþer is sē ðe sǣwþ, ōþer is sē ðe rīpþ.
4.38: Ic sende ēow tō rīpanne þæt þæt gē ne beswuncon; ōðre swuncon, and gē ēodun on hyra geswinc.
4.39: Witodlīce manige Samaritanisce of ðǣre ceastre gelȳfdon on hyne for þæs wīfes wordon þe be him cȳþde, Þæt hē sǣde mē ealle þā þing þe ic dyde.
4.40: Đā þā Samaritaniscean cōmon tō him, hig gebǣdon hine þæt hē wunode ðǣr; and hē wunode þǣr twēgen dagas.
4.41: And mycle mā gelȳfdon for his spǣce;
4.42: and cwǣdon tō þām wīfe, Ne gelȳfe wē nā for ðīnre sprǣce; wē sylfe gehȳrdon, and wē witon þæt hē is sōþ middaneardes Hǣlend.
4.43: Sōðlīce after twām dagon hē fērde þanone, and fōr tō Galilea.
4.44: Sē Hǣlend sylf cȳþde gewitnesse þæt nān wītega næfð nānne wurðscype on hys āgenum earde.
4.45: Þā hē cōm tō Galileam, þā underfēngon hī hine, þā hi gesāwon ealle þā þing þe hē worhte on Ierusalem on frēolsdæge; and hī cōmun tō þām frēolsdage.
4.46: And hē cōm eft tō Chanaa Galileę, þǣr hē worhte þæt wīn of watere. Sum undercyning wæs, þæs sunu was gesȳclod on Capharnaum.
4.47: Þā þā sē gehȳrde þæt sē Hælend fōr fram Iudea tō Galilea, hē com tō him and bæd hine þæt hē fōre and gehǣlde his sunu; sōðlīce hē læg æt forðfōre.
4.48: Đā cwǣþ sē Hǣlend tō him, Buton gē tācna and forebēacna gesēon, ne gelȳfe gē.
4.49: Đā cwæð sē undercing tō him, Đrihten, far ǣr mīn sunu swelte.
4.50: And sē Hælend cwæð, Gā, þīn sunu leofað. Đā ēode hē, and gelȳfde þǣre sprǣce þe sē Hǣlend him sǣde.
4.51: Đā hē fōr, þā urnon his þēowas ongēan hyne, and sǣdon þæt his sunu leofode.
4.52: Đā āxode hē tō hwylcon tīman him bet wǣre. And hī sǣdon him, Gyrstandæg tō þǣre seofoþan tīde sē fēfor hine forlēt.
4.53: Đā ongeat sē fæder þæt hit was on þǣre tīde ðe sē Hǣlend cwæð, Þīn sunu leofað. And hē gelȳfde and eall his hīwrǣden.
4.54: Sē Hǣlend worhte þis tācen eft ōþre sīþe, þā hē cōm fram Iudea lande tō Galilea.

5.1: Æfter þyson wæs Iudea frēolsdæg, and sē Hǣlend fōr tō Ierusalem.
5.2: On Ierusalem ys ān mere, sē is genemned on Ebrēisc Bethsaida; sē mere hæfð fīf porticas.
5.3: On þām porticon læg mycel menigeo geādludra, blindra, and healtra, and forscruncenra, and geanbīdedon þæs wæteres styrunge.
5.4: Drihtenes engel cōm tō his tīman on þone mere, and þæt water was āstyred; and sē þe raþust cōm on þone mere after þæs wateres styrunge wearþ gehǣled fram swā hwylcere untrumnysse swā hē on wæs.
5.5: Đær was sum man eahta and þrīttig wintra on his untrumnysse.
5.6: Þā sē Hǣlend geseah þysne licgean, and wiste þæt hē þǣr lange tīde wæs, ðā cwæþ hē tō him, Wylt þū hāl bēon?
5.7: Đā andswarode sē sēoca him and cwæþ, Drihten, ic næbbe nānne man þæt mē dō on þone mere, þonne þæt wæter āstyred bið; þonne ic cume, þonne biþ ōþer beforan mē.
5.8: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Arīs, nim þīn bed, and gā.
5.9: And sē man wæs sōna hāl, and hē nam his bed, and ēode. Hit was restedæg on ðām dæge.
5.10: Đā cwǣdon þā Iudeas tō þām þe þǣr gehǣled wæs, Hit is restedæg; nis ðē ālȳfed þæt þū þīn bedd bere.
5.11: Hē andswarude him and cwæð, Sē ðe mē gehǣlde sē cwæð tō mē, Nim þīn bedd, and gā.
5.12: Đā āxsodon hī hine, Hwæt sē man wǣre þe þē sǣde, Nīm þīn bedd, and gā?
5.13: Sē þe þǣr gehǣled wæs nyste hwā hit wæs; sē Hǣlend sōþlīce bēah fram þǣre gegaderunge.
5.14: Æfter þām sē Hǣlend hine gemētte on þām temple, and cwæþ tō him, Nū þū eart hāl geworden; ne synga þū, þē læs þe þē on sumon þingon wyrs getīde.
5.15: Đā fōr sē man, and cȳðde hit þām Iudean þæt hit wǣre sē Hǣlend þe hyne hǣlde.
5.16: For þām þā Iudeas ēhton þone Hǣlend, for ðām þe hē dyde þās þing on restedæge.
5.17: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, Mīn Fæder wyrcð oþ þis nū gȳt, and ic wyrce.
5.18: Þæs þē mā þā Iudeas sōhton hine tō ofslēanne, næs nā for þām ānum þe he þone restedæg bræc, ac for þām þe hē cwæð þæt God wǣre his Fæder, and hine sylfne dyde Gode gelīcne.
5.19: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæþ tō him, Sōð ic ēow secge, Ne mæg sē Sunu nān þing dōn, būton þæt he gesyhþ his Fæder dōn; ðā þing þe he wyrcþ, sē Sunu wyrcð gelīce.
5.20: Sē lufað þone Sunu, and geswutelað him ealle þā ping þe hē wyrcþ; and māran weorc þonne þās sȳn hē geswutelað him, þæt gē wundrigeon.
5.21: Swā sē Fǣder āwecð þā dēadan and gelīffæst, swā ēac sē Sunu gelīffæst þā ðe hē wyle.
5.22: Nē sē Fæder ne dēmo nānum menn, ac hē sealde ǣlcne dōm þām Suna;
5.23: þæt ealle ārwurþigeon þone Sunu, swā swa hig ārwurþigeaþ þone Fæder. Sē ðe ne ārwurðaþ þone Sunu, ne arwurþaþ hē þone Fæder þe hine sende.
5.24: Sōð ic secge ēow, þæt sē þe mīn word gehyrð, and þām gelȳfð þe mē sende, sē hæfð ēce līf, and ne cymþ æt þām dōme, ac færð fram dēaðe tō līfe.
5.25: Sōð ic secge ēow, Þæt sēo tīd cymð, and nū is, þonne þā dēadan gehȳrað Godes Suna stefne; and þā lybbað þe hig gehȳrað.
5.26: Swā sē Fæder hæfþ līf on him sylfon, swā he sealde þām Suna þæt hē hæfde līf on him syluon;
5.27: and sealde him anweald þæt hē mōste dēman, for ðām þe hē is mannes Sunu.
5.28: Ne wundrigeon gē ðæs þæt sēo tid cymð þæt ealle gehȳrað his stefne þe on byrgenum synt;
5.29: and þā þe gōd worhton farað on līfes ǣreste; and þā þe yfel dydon, on dōmes ǣreste.
5.30: Ne mæg ic nān þing dōn fram mē sylfum; ic dēme swā swā ic gehȳre, and mīn dōm is ryht, for ðām ic ne sēce mīnne willan ac þæs þe mē sende.
5.31: Gif ic gewitnesse be mē cȳþe, mīn gewitnes nis sōð.
5.32: Ōþer is sē ðe cȳþ gewitnesse be mē; and ic wāt þæt sēo cȳðnes is sōð þe hē cȳþ be mē.
5.33: Gē sendon tō Iohanne, and hē cȳðde sōþfæstnesse gewitnesse.
5.34: Ic ne onfō gewitnesse fram menn; ac þās þing ic secge þæt gē sȳn hāle.
5.35: Hē wæs byrnende lēohtfæt and lȳhtende; gē woldon sume hwīle geblissian on his lēohte.
5.36: Ic hæbbe māran gewitnesse þonne Iohannes; witodlīce þā weorc þe Fæder mē sealde þæt ic hig fullfremme, ðā weorc þe ic wyrce cȳþað gewitnesse be mē þæt Fæder mē āsende.
5.37: And sē Fæder þe mē sende cȳþ gewitnesse be mē. Nē gē nǣfre his stefne ne gehȳrdon, nē gē his hīw ne gesāwon.
5.38: And gē nabbað his word on ēow wunigende; for þām þe gē ne gelȳfað þām ðe hē sende.
5.39: Smēageað hālige gewritu, for ðām þe gē awēnað þæt gē habbon ēce līf on þām; and hig synt þe gewitnesse cȳþaþ be mē;
5.40: and gē nellað cuman tō mē þæt gē habbon līf.
5.41: Ne underfō ic nāne beorhtnesse æt mannum.
5.42: Ac ic gecnēow ēow, þæt gē nabbaþ Godes lufe on ēow.
5.43: Ic cōm on mīnes Fæder naman, and gē mē ne underfēngon; gyf ōþer cymþ on his āgenum naman, hyne gē underfōð.
5.44: Hū mage gē gelȳfan þe ēow betwēonan wuldor underfōð, and ne sēceaþ þæt wuldor þe is fram Gode syluum?
5.45: Ne wēne gē þæt ic ēow wrēge tō Fæder; sē is þe ēow wrēgð, Moyses on þone gē gehyhtað.
5.46: Witodlīce gif gē gelȳfdon on Moyse, gē gelȳfdon ēac mē; sōðlīce hē wrāt be mē.
5.47: Gif gē his stafum ne gelȳfað, hū gelȳfe gē mīnum wordum?

6.1: Æfter þyson fōr sē Hǣlend ofer þā Galileiscan sǣ, sēo is Tiberiadis.
6.2: And him fylide mycel folc, for þām þe hig gesāwon þā tācna þe hē worhte on þām þe wǣron geuntrumode.
6.3: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend āstāh on ānne munt, and sæt þār mid his leorningcnihton.
6.4: Hit was gehende ēastron, Iudea frēolsdæge.
6.5: Đā sē Hǣlend his ēagan ūp āhōf and geseah þæt micel folc cōm tō him, hē cwæð tō Philippe, Hwǣr bicge wē hlāfas þæt þās eton?
6.6: Þæt hē cwæþ his fandigende; hē wiste hwæt hē dōn wolde.
6.7: Đā andwurde him Philippus and cwæð, Nabbað hī genōh on twēgera hundred penega wurþe hlāfes, þæt ǣlc sumne dǣl nyme.
6.8: Đā andwyrde him ān his leorningcnihta, Andreas, Simones brōþur Petres,
6.9: Hēr is ān cnapa þe hæfp fīf berene hlāfas and twēgen fixas; ac hwæt synt þā þing betwux swā manegum mannum?
6.10: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Dōð þæt þās men sitton. On þǣre stōwe wæs mycel gærs; ðǣr sǣton þā swylce fīf þūsendo manna.
6.11: Sē Hǣlend nam þā hlāfas, and þanc wurðlīce dyde, and hig tōdǣlde þām sittendum, and eall swā of þām fixum swā mycel swā hig woldon.
6.12: Đā hig fulle wǣron, þā cwæð hē tō his leorningcnihton, Gaderiaþ þā brytsena þe þār tō lāfe wǣron, þæt hig ne losigeon.
6.13: Hig gegaderedon, and fyldon twelf wyligeon fulle þǣra brytsena of þām þe þā lǣfdon þþe of þām fīf berenan hlāfon ǣton.
6.14: Đā men cwǣdon, þā hig gesāwon þæt hē þæt tācen worhte, Þæt þēs is sōðlīce wītega þe on middangeard cymþ.
6.15: Đā sē Hǣlend wiste þæt hig woldon cuman and hine gelæccean and tō cynge dōn, þā flēah hē āna uppon þone munt.
6.17: And þā hig ēodon on scyp, hi cōmon ofer þā sǣ tō Capharnaum; hit wearð þā þȳstre, and sē Hǣlend ne cōm tō him.
6.18: Mycel wind blēow, and hit was hrēoh sǣ.
6.19: Witodlīce þā hig hæfdon gerōwen swylce twēntig furlanga oððe þrīttig, þā gesāwon hig þone Hǣlend uppan þǣre sǣ gān, and þæt hē wæs gehende þām scype; and hig him ondrēdon.
6.20: Hē cwæð þā tō him, Ic hit eom; ne ondrǣdað ēow.
6.21: Hig woldon hyne niman on þæt scyp; and sōna þæt scyp wæs æt þām lande þe hig woldon tō faran.
6.22: Sōþlīce ōþre dæg sēo menigeo þe stōd begeondan þām mere geseah þæt þǣr næs būtan ān scyp, and þæt sē Hǣlend ne ēode on scyp mid his leorningcnihtan, ac his leorningcnihtas sylfe āna fōron;-
6.23: ōðre scypu cōmon fram Tiberiade wið þā stōwe þār hig þone hlāf ǣton, Drihtne þanciende;-
6.24: ðā sēo menigeo geseah þæt sē Hǣlend þār næs nē his leorningcnihtas, þā ēodon hig on scipu, and cōman tō Capharnaum, sōhton ðone Hǣlend.
6.25: And þā hig gemētton hyne begeondan þām mere, hig cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, hwænne cōme þū hider?
6.26: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ne sēce gē mē for ðām þe gē tācnu gesāwon, ac for þām þe gē ǣton of ðām hlāfon, and synt fulle.
6.27: Ne wyrceaþ æfter þām mete þe forwyrð, ac æfter þām þe þurhwunað on ēce līf, ðone mannes Sunu ēow sylþ; þone God Fæder getācnode.
6.28: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Hwæt dō wē þæt wē wyrceon Godes weorc?
6.29: Þā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, þæt is Godes weorc, þæt gē gelȳfan on ðone þe hē sende.
6.30: Đā cwǣdon hig, Hwat dēst þū tō tācne þæt wē gesēon and gelȳfon þæt þū hit wyrce?
6.31: Ūre fæderas ton heofonlīcne mete on wēstene; swā hit āwriten is, Hē sealde him etan hlāf of heofone.
6.32: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Sōð ic secge ēow, Ne sealde Moyses ēow hlāf of heofonum; ac mīn Fæder ēow sylþ soðne hlāf of heofonum.
6.33: Hit is Godes hlāf þe of heofone cōm, and sylþ middanearde līf.
6.34: Hig cwǣdon tō him, Drihten, syle ūs þysne hlāf.
6.35: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom līfes hlāf; ne hingrað þone þe tō mē cymð, and ne þyrst þone nǣfre ðe on mē gelyfð.
6.36: Ac ic ēow sǣde þæt gē gesāwon mē, and ne gelȳfdon.
6.37: Eall þæt Fæder mē sylþ cymð tō mē; and ic ne wyrpe ūt ðone þe to mē cymð.
6.38: For þām þe ic ne cōm of heofonum þæt ic mīnne willan dō, ac þæs willan þe mē sende.
6.39: Ðæt is þæs Fæder willa ðe mē sende, þæt ic nān þing ne forlēose of ðām þe hē mē sealde, ac āwecce þæt on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
6.40: Ðis is mīnes Fæder willa þe mē sende, þæt ǣlc þe ðone Sunu gesyhþ and on hine gelȳfð hæbbe ēce līf; and ic hine awecce on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
6.41: Đā murcnodon þā Iudeas be him for þām þe hē cwæð, Ic eom hlāf þe of heofonum cōm.
6.42: And hig cwǣdon, Hū nis þis sē Hǣlend, Iosepes sunu? wē cunnon his fæder and his mōdor; hūmeta segð þēs, Ic cōm of heofonum?
6.43: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð tō him, Ne murcniaþ ēow betwȳnan.
6.44: Ne mæg nān man cuman tō mē, būton sē Fæder þe mē sende hyne tēo; and ic hine ārǣre on ðām ȳtemestan dæge.
6.45: On ðǣra wītegena bōcum is āwriten, Ealle ēaðlǣre beoð Godes. Ǣlc þe gehȳrde æt Fæder, and leornode, cymð tō mē.
6.46: Ne geseah nān man Fæder, būton sē ðe is of Gode, sē gesyhþ Fæder.
6.47: Sōð ic secge ēow, Sē hæfð ēce līf þe on mē gelȳfð.
6.49: Ūre fæderas ǣton heofunlīcne mete on wēstene, and hig synd dēade.
6.50: Đis is sē hlāf þe of heofonum cōm, þæt ne swelte sē ðe of him ytt.
6.51: Ic eom lybbende hlāf þe of heofonum cōm; swā hwā swā ytt of ðyson hlāfe, hē leofað on ēcnysse; and sē hlāf þe ic sylle is mīn flǣsc, for middaneardes līfe.
6.52: Þā Iudeas fliton him betwȳnan and cwǣdon, Hū mæg þēs his flǣsc us syllan tō etanne?
6.53: Þā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō him, Sōþ ic secge ēow, Næbbe gē līf on ēow, būton gē eton mannes Suna flǣsc and his blōd drincon.
6.54: Sē hæfð ēce līf þe ytt mīn flǣsc and drincð mīn blōd; and ic hine ārǣre on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
6.55: Sōþlīce mīn flæsc is mete, and mīn blōd is drinc.
6.56: Sē ðe ytt mīn flǣsc and drincð mīn blōd, hē wunað on mē, and ic on him.
6.57: Swā swā lybbende Fæder mē sende, and ic lybbe þurh Fæder; and sē ðe mē ytt, hē leofað þurh mē.
6.58: Þis is sē hlāf þe of heofonum cōm; nā swā swā ūre fæderas ǣton heofonlīcne mete, and dēade wǣron; sē þe ytt þysne hlāf, he leofað on ēcnysse.
6.59: Đās þing hē sǣde on gesamnunge, þā hē lǣrde on Capharnaum.
6.60: Manega his leorningcnihta cwǣdon, þā hig ðis gehȳrdon, Heard is þēos sprǣc; hwā mæg hig gehȳran?
6.61: Ðā wiste sē Hǣlend þæt his leorningcnihtas murcnedon betweox him sylfon be þison, and hē cwæð tō him, þæt ēow beswīcð?
6.62: Gyf gē gesēoþ mannes Sunu āstīgendne þǣr hē ǣr wæs?
6.63: Gāst is sē ðe gelīffæst; flǣsc ne fremað nān þing; þā word þe ic ēow sǣde synt gāst and līf.
6.64: Ac sume gē ne gelȳfað. Witodlīce sē Hǣlend wiste æt fruman hwæt þā gelȳfedan wǣron, and hwā hine belǣwon wolde.
6.65: And hē cwæð, For þig ic ēow sǣde þæt nān man ne mæg cuman to mē, būton mīn Fæder hit him sylle.
6.66: Syððan manega his leorningcnihta cyrdon on bæc, and ne ēodun mid him.
6.67: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō þām twelfum, Cweðe gē wylle gē fram mē?
6.68: Þā andwyrde him Simon Petrus and cwæð, Drihten, tō hwām gā wē? þū hæfst ēces līfes word.
6.69: And wē gelȳfað and witon þæt þū eart Crīst, Godes Sunu.
6.70: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Hū ne gecēas ic ēow twelfe, and ēower ān is dēofol?
6.71: Hē hyt cwæþ be Iuda Scarioþe; þēs hine belǣwde, þā hē wæs ān þāra twelfa.

7.1: Syþþan fōr sē Hǣlend tō Galilea; hē nolde faran tō Iudea, for þām þe þā Iudeas hine sōhton and woldon hyne ofslēan.
7.3: His brōðra cwǣdon to him, Far heonon and gā on Iudea land, þæt þīne leorningcnihtas gesēon þā weorc þe þū wyrcst.
7.4: Ne dēð nan man nān þing on dīglum, ac sēcþ þæt hit open sȳ. Gif ðū þās þing dēst, geswutela þē sylfne middanearde.
7.5: Witodlīce nē his māgas ne gelȳfdon on hyne.
7.6: Đā cwæþ sē Hǣlend tō him, Gȳt ne cōm min tīd; ēower tīd is symble gearu.
7.7: Ne mæg middaneard ēow hatigean; ac hē hatað mē, for þām ic cȳþe gewitnesse be him þæt his weorc synt yfele.
7.8: Fare gē to þison frēolsdæge; ic ne fare tō þison frēolsdæge, for þām mīn tīd nis gȳt gefylled.
7.9: Hē wunede on Galilea, þā hē þās þing sǣde.
7.10: Eft þā his gebrōðru fōron, þā fōr hē ēac tō ðām freolsdæge, næs nā openlīce ac dīgollīce.
7.11: Đā Iudeas hyne sōhton on þām frēolsdæge, and cwǣdon, Hwār is hē?
7.12: And mycel gehlȳd wæs on þǣre menigeo be him. Sume cwǣdon, He is gōd; ōðre cwǣdon, Nese, ac he beswīcð þis folc.
7.13: Þeah hwæþere ne spæc nān man openlīce be him for þǣra Iudea ege.
7.14: Þā hit wæs mid dæg þæs frēolsdæges, þā ēode sē Hǣlend intō þām temple, and lǣrde.
7.15: And þā Iudeas wundredon and cwǣdon, Hūmeta cann þēs stafas, þonne hē ne leornode?
7.16: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Mīn lār nis nā mīn, ac þæs þe mē sende.
7.17: Gyf hwā wyle his willan dōn, hē gecnǣwð be þǣre lāre, hwæþer hēo sī of Gode, hwæþer þe ic be mē sylfum spece.
7.18: Sē þe be him sylfum sprycð sēcþ his āgen wuldor; sē þe sēcþ þæs wuldor þe hyne sende, sē is sōþfæst, and nis nān unrihtwisnys on him.
7.19: Hū ne sealde Moyses ēow ǣ, and ēower nān ne healt þā ǣ? Hwi sece gē mē tō ofslēanne?
7.20: Þā andswarode sēo menigeo and cwæð, Dēofol þe sticað on; hwā sēcð þē tō ofslēanne?
7.21: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Ān weorc ic worhte, and ealle gē wundrigeaþ.
7.22: For ðȳ Moyses ēow sealde ymbsnidenesse; næs nā for þī þe hēo of Moyse sȳ, ac of fæderon; and on restedæge gē ymbsnīðaþ mann,
7.23: þæt Moyses ǣ ne sȳ tōworpen; and gē belgaþ wið mē for ðām þe ic gehǣlde ānne man on restedæge?
7.24: Ne dēme gē be ansȳne, ac dēmað rihtne dōm.
7.25: Sume cwǣdon þā ðe wǣron of Ierusalem, Hū nis ðis sē ðe hī sēceaþ tō ofslēanne?
7.26: And nu hē spycþ openlīce, and hig ne cweðaþ nān ðing tō him. Cweðe wē hwæþer þā ealdras ongyton þæt þis is Crīst?
7.27: Ac wē witon hwanon þēs is; ðonne Crīst cymþ, þonne nāt nān mann hwanon hē biþ.
7.28: Sē Hǣlend clypode and lærde on þām temple and cwæð, Mē gē cunnon, and gē witon hwanon ic eom; and ic ne cōm fram mē sylfum, ac sē is sōð þe mē sende, þone gē ne cunnon.
7.29: Ic hyne can; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic bēo lēas, and ēow gelīc. Ic hyne can, and ic eom of him, and hē mē sende.
7.30: Hig hine sōhton tō nimanne; and hyra nān hys ne æthrān, for ðām þe his tīd ne cōm þā gyt.
7.31: Manega of ðǣre menigeo gelȳfdon on hine, and cwǣdon, Cweþe gē wyrcð Crīst mā tācna þonne he cymð þonne þēs dēð?
7.32: Þā Pharisei gehȳrdon þā menigeo þus murcnigende be him. Đā ealdras and ðā Pharisei sendon hyra þēnas þæt hig woldon hine gefōn.
7.33: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Gȳt ic bēo sume hwīle mid ēow, and ic gā tō ðām þe mē sende.
7.34: Gē sēcað mē, and ne findaþ; and gē ne magon cuman þār ic eom.
7.35: Þā Iudeas cwǣdon betwēonan him sylfum, Hwyder wyle þēs faran þæt wē hine ne findon? cwyst ðū wyle hē faran on ðēoda tōdrǣfednysse, and hig lǣran?
7.36: Hwæt is ðēos spræc þe hē sprycð, Gē sēceaþ mē, and ne findaþ; and gē ne magon cuman þār ic eom?
7.37: On þām æftemestan mǣran frēolsdæge stōd sē Hǣlend and clypode, Cume tō mē sē ðe hine þyrste, and drince.
7.38: Se þe gelyfþ on mē, swā þæt gewrit cwyð, lybbendes wætres flōd flowað of his innoðe.
7.39: Þæt he cwæð be þām Gāste þe þā sceoldon underfōn þe on hyne gelyfdon; þā gyt næs sē Gāst geseald, for þām pe sē Hǣlend næs ðā gȳt gewuldrud.
7.40: Of ðǣre tide sēo menigeo cwæð, þā hēo gehȳrde ðās his sprǣce, Đēs is sōð wītega.
7.41: Sume cwǣdon, Hē is Crīst. Sume cwǣdon, Cweðe gē cymþ Crīst fram Galilea?
7.42: Hū ne cwyð þæt gewrit þæt Crīst cymð of Dauides cynne, and of Bethleem ceastre, þār þār Dauid wæs?
7.43: Witodlīce ungeþwǣrnes wæs geworden on þǣre menigeo for him.
7.44: Sume hig woldon hine niman; ac hyra nān his ne æthrān.
7.45: Þā þēnas comon tō þām bisceopum and tō þām Phariseon; and hig cwǣdon to him, For hwī ne brōhton gē hine hider?
7.46: Þā andwyrdon þā þēnas and cwǣdon, Ne spræc nǣfre nān man swā þēs man sprycþ.
7.47: Þā cwǣdon þā Pharisei tō him, Synt gē beswicene?
7.48: Cweðe gē gelȳfde ǣnig þǣra ealdra oððe þǣra Pharisea on hyne?
7.49: Ac þēos menigeo þe ne cūðe þā ǣ, hig synt āwyrgede.
7.50: Ða cwæð Nichodemus tō him, - sē þe cōm tō him on nyht sē wæs hyra ān, -
7.51: Cwyst þū dēmð ūre ǣ ǣnigne man, būton hyne man ǣr gehȳre, and wite hwæt hē dō?
7.52: Hig andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Cwyst þū þæt þū sī Galileisc? Smēa, and geseoh þæt nān wītega ne cymð fram Galilea.

8.1: Sē Hǣlend fōr on Oliuetes dūne.
8.2: And cōm eft on dægrēd tō þām temple, and eall þæt folc cōm tō him; and hē sæt, and lǣrde hig.
8.3: Ða lǣddon þā Pharisei and ðā bōceras tō him ān wīf, sēo wǣs āparod on unrihthǣmede, and setton hig tōmiddes hyra,
8.4: and cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, þis wīf wæs āfunden on unrihtum hǣmede.
8.5: Moyes ūs bebead on þǣre ǣ þæt wē sceoldon þus gerāde mid stānum oftorfian; hwæt cwyst þū?
8.6: Ðis hig cwǣdon his fandiende, þæt hig hine wrēhton. Sē Hǣlend ābēah nyþer, and wrāt mid his fingre on þǣre eorþan.
8.7: Þā hig þurhwunedon hine āxsiende, þā ārās hē ūpp, and cwæð tō him, Lōca, hwylc ēower sī synlēas, wurpe ǣrest stān on hī.
8.8: And hē ābēah eft, and wrāt on þǣre eorþan.
8.9: Ðā hig þis gehȳrdon, þā ēodon hig ūt, ān æfter ānum; and hē gebād þār sylf, and þæt wīf stōd þǣr on middan.
8.10: Sē Hǣlend ārās upp, and cwæð tō hyre, Wīf, hwǣr synd þā ðe þē wrēgdon? ne fordēmde þē nān man?
8.11: And hēo cwæð, Nā, Drihten. And sē Hǣlend cwæð, Nē ic þē ne fordēme; dō gā, and ne synga þū nǣfre mā.
8.12: Eft sē Hǣlend spræc þās þing tō him and cwæð, Ic eom middaneardes lēoht; sē þe mē fyliþ ne gǣð hē ōn þȳstro, ac hē hæfð līfes lēoht.
8.13: Ða Pharisei cwǣdon tō him, Þū cȳþst gewitnesse be ðē sylfon; nis ðīn gewitnes sōð.
8.14: Sē Hǣlend andswarede and cwæð tō him, Gif ic cȳþe gewitnesse be mē sylfum, mīn gewitnes is sōþ; for þām þe ic wāt hwanon ic cōm, and hwyder ic gā; gē nyton hwanon ic cōm, nē hwyder ic gā.
8.15: Gē dēmað æfter flǣsce; ic ne dēme nānum men.
8.16: And gif ic dēme, mīn dōm is sōð; for ðām þe ic ne eom āna, ac ic and sē Fæder þe mē sende.
8.17: And on ēowre ǣ is āwriten þæt twēgra manna gewitnes is sōð.
8.18: Ic eom þe cȳpe gewitnesse be mē sylfum, and sē Fæder þe mē sende cȳþ gewitnesse be mē.
8.19: Witodlīce hig cwǣdon to him, Hwār is þin Fæder? Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Nē cunne gē mē, nē mīnne Fæder; gyf gē mē cūþon, wēn is þæt gē cūþon minne Fæder.
8.20: Ðās word hē spæc æt cēapsceamule; and nān man hyne ne nam, for þām þe hys tīd ne cōm þā gȳt.
8.21: Witodlīce eft sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him, Ic fare, and gē mē sēceað, and gē sweltaþ; on ēowre synne; ne mage gē cuman þyder ic fare.
8.22: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas, Cweðe gē ofslyhþ hē hine sylfne, for þām hē segð, Gē ne magon cuman þyder ic fare?
8.23: Ðā cwæþ hē tō him, Gē synt nyþane; and ic eom ufane: ge synt of þison middanearde; ic ne eom of þissan middanearde.
8.24: Ic ēow sǣde þæt gē sweltað on ēowrum synnum; gif gē ne gelȳfað þæt ic hit sȳ, gē sweltað on ēowre synne.
8.25: Ðā cwǣdon hī tō him, Hwæt eart þū? Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom fruma þe tō ēow sprece.
8.26: Ic haebbe fela be ēow tō sprecenne and tō dēmenne; ac sē þe mē sende is soðfæst; and ic sprece on middanearde þā þing þe ic æt him gehȳrde.
8.27: And hig ne undergēaton þæt hē tealde him God tō Fæder.
8.28: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Þonne gē mannes Sunu ūpp āhebbaþ, þonne gecnāwe gē þæt ic hit eom, and ic ne dō nān þing of mē sylfum, ac ic sprece þās þing swā Fæder mē lǣrde.
8.29: And sē ðe mē sende is mid mē; and hē ne forlǣt mē ānne; for þām þe ic wyrce symble þā þing þe him synt gecwēme.
8.30: Ðā he ðās ðing spræc, manega gelȳfdon on hine,
8.31: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæð tō þām Iudeon þe him gelȳfdon, Gif gē wunegeað on mīnre spǣce, sōðlīce gē bēoð mīne leorningcnihtas;
8.32: and gē oncnāwað sōðfæstnysse, and sōþfæstnes ēow ālȳst.
8.33: Ðā andswarodon hī him and cwǣdon, Wē synt Abrahames cynnes, and ne þēowedon wē nanum men nǣfre; hūmeta cwyst þū, Gē bēoð frīge?
8.34: Sē Hǣlend him andswarude and cwæð, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Þæt þe synne wyrcð is þǣre synne þēow.
8.35: Witodlīce sē þēow ne wunaþ on hūse on ēcnesse; sē sunu wunaþ on ēcnesse.
8.36: Gif sē Sunu ēow alyst, gē bēoð soðlīce frīge.
8.37: Ic wāt þæt gē synt Abrahames bearn; ac gē sēceað mē tō ofslēanne, for þām mīn spǣc ne wunaþ on ēow.
8.38: Ic sprece þæt þe ic mid Fæder geseah; and gē dōð þā þing þē gē mid ēowrum fæder gesāwon.
8.39: Ðā andswarodon hig and cwǣdon tō him, Abraham is ūre fæder. Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gif gē Abrahames bearn synt, wyrceað Abrahames weorc.
8.40: Nū gē seceað mē tō ofslēanne, þone man þe ēow sǣde sōðfæstnesse, þā þe ic gehȳrde of Gode; ne dyde Abraham swā.
8.41: Gē wyrceað ēowres fæder weorc. Hig cwǣdon witodlīce tō him, Ne synt wē of forligere acennede; we habbað ānne God tō Fæder.
8.42: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him, Gif God wǣre ēowre Faeder, witodlīce gē lufedon mē. Ic cōm of Gode; nē cōm ic nā fram mē sylfon, ac hē mē sende.
8.43: Hwī ne gecnāwe gē mīne sprǣce? for þām þe gē ne magon gehȳran mīne spǣce.
8.44: Gē synt dēofles bearn, and gē wyllaþ wyrcean ēowres fæder willan. Hē wæs fram frymþe manslaga, and hē ne wunode on sōðfæstnesse, for ðām þe sōðfæstnes nis on him. Ðonne he sprycð lēasunga, hē sprycþ of him sylfum, for þām þe hē is lēas and his fæder ēac.
8.45: Witodlīce gē ne gelȳfað mē, for þām þe ic secge ēow sōdfæstnysse.
8.46: Hwylc ēower āscunað mē for synne? Gif ic sōð secge, hwī ne gelȳfe gē mē?
8.47: Sē þe is of Gode gehȳrð Godes word; for þig gē ne gehȳrað, for þām þe gē ne synt of Gode.
8.48: Witodlīce þā Iudeas andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Hwi ne cweþe wē wel þæt ðū eart Samaritanisc, and eart wōd?
8.49: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð, Ne eom ic wōd; ac ic ārwurþige mīnne Fæder, and gē unārwurðedon mē.
8.50: Witodlīce ne sēce ic mīn wuldor; sē is þe sēcð and dēmð.
8.51: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Gif hwā mīne sprǣce gehealt, ne gesyhþ hē dēað nǣfre.
8.52: Ðā cwǣdon þā Iudeas, Nū wē witon þæt þū eart wōd. Abraham wæs dēad, and þā witegan; and þū cwyst, Gif hwā mīne sprǣce gehealt, ne bið hē nǣfre dēad.
8.53: Cwyst þū þæt þū sȳ mǣrra þonne ūre fæder Abraham, sē wæs dēad? and þā wītegan wǣron dēade; hwæt þincð þē þæt þū sȳ?
8.54: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Gif ic wuldrige mē sylfne, nis mīn wuldor nāht; mīn Fæder is þe mē wuldrað, be þæm gē cweðaþ; þæt hē sȳ ūre God.
8.55: And gē ne cūðon hine. Ic hyne cann; and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, ic bēo lēasē and ēow gelīc; ac ic hyne cann, and ic healde his sprǣce.
8.56: Abraham ēower fæder geblissode þæt hē gesāwe mīnne dæg; and hē geseah, and geblissode.
8.57: Ðā Iudeas cwǣdon tō him, Gȳt þū ne eart fīftigwintre, and gesāwe þū Abraham?
8.58: Sē Hǣlend cwæþ tō him, Ic wæs ǣr þām þe Abraham wæs.
8.59: Hig nāmon stanas tō þām þæt hig woldon hyne torfian; sē Hǣlend hine bedīglode, and ēode of ðām temple.

9.1: Ðā sē Hǣlend fōr, þā gesēah hē ānne man þe wæs blind geboren.
9.2: And his leorningcnihtas hine āxodon and cwǣdon, Lārēow, hwæt syngode, þēs oððe his māgas, þæt hē wǣre blind geboren?
9.3: Sē Hǣlend andswarude and cwæð, ne syngode hē nē his māgas; ac þæt Godes weorc wǣre geswutelod on him.
9.4: Mē gebyrað tō wyrceanne þæs weorc þe mē sende, þā hwīle þe hit dæg is; niht cymþ, þonne nān man wyrcan ne mæg.
9.5: Ic eom middaneardes lēoht, þā hwīle þe ic on middanearde eom.
9.6: Ðā hē þās þing sǣde, þā spǣtte hē on þā eorþan, and worhte fenn of his spātle, and smyrede mid þām fenne ofer his ēagan,
9.7: and cwæð tō him, Gā and þweah þē on Syloes mere. Hē fōr and þwōh hine, and cōm gesēonde.
9.8: Witodlīce his nēahgebūras and þā þe hine gesāwon þā hē wǣdla was cwǣdon, Hū nis þis se ðe sæt and wǣdlode?
9.9: Sume cwǣdon, Hē hyt is; sume cwǣdon, Nese, ac is him gelīc. Hē cwæþ sōðlīce, Ic hit eom.
9.10: Đā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hū wǣron þīne ēagan geopenede?
9.11: Hē andswarode and cwæð, Sē man þe is genemned Hǣlend worhte fenn, and smyrede mīne ēagan, and cwæð tō mē, Gā tō Syloes mere, and þweah þē; and ic ēode and þwōh mē, and geseah.
9.12: Đā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hwār is hē? Þā cwæð hē, Ic nāt.
9.13: Hig lǣddon tō þām Phariseon þone þe þār blind wæs.
9.14: Hit was restedæg þā sē Hǣlend worhte þæt fenn, and his ēagan untȳnde.
9.15: Eft þā Pharisei hyne āxsedon hū hē gesāwe. He cwæð tō him, Hē dyde fenn ofer mīne ēagan, and ic þwōh, and ic gesēo.
9.16: Sume þā Pharisei cwadon, Nis ðēs man of Gode þe restedæg ne healt. Sume cwǣdon, Hū mæg synful mann þās tācn wyrcean? And hig fliton him betwēonan.
9.17: Hig cwǣdon eft tō þām blindan, Hwæt segst þū be þām þe þīne ēagan untȳnde? Hē cwæð, Hē is wītega.
9.18: Ne gelyfdon þā Iudeas be him, þæt hē blind wǣre and gesāwe, ǣr þam þe hig clypodon his māgas þe gesāwon,
9.19: and āxodon hig and cwǣdon, Is ðis ēower sunu þe gē secgað þæt blind wǣre ācenned? hūmeta gesyhþ hē nū?
9.20: Hys māgas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, We witon þæt þēs is ūre sunu, and þæt hē wæs blind ācenned;
9.21: wē nyton hūmete hē nū gesyhþ, nē hwā his ēagan untȳnde; axiað hine sylfne; ylde hē hæfð; sprece for hine sylfne.
9.22: His māgas spǣcon þās þing, for þām þe hig ondrēdon þā Iudeas; ðā gedihton þā Iudeas, gif hwā Crīst andette, þæt hē wǣre būtan hyra gefērrǣdene.
9.23: For þām cwǣdon his māgas, Hē hæfþ ylde; āxiað hine sylfne.
9.24: Đā clypodon hig eft þone mann þe ǣr blind wæs, and cwǣdon tō him, Sege Gode wuldor; wē witon þæt hē is synful.
9.25: And hē cwæð, Gif hē synful is, þæt ic nāt; ān þing ic wāt, þæt ic wæs blind, and þæt ic nū gesēo.
9.26: Đā cwǣdon hig tō him, Hwæt dyde hē þē? hū ontȳnde hē þīne ēagan?
9.27: Hē andswarode him and cwæð, Ic ēow sǣde ǣr, and gē gehȳrdon; hwī wylle gē hyt eft gehȳran? cweðe gē wylle gē bēon his leorningcnihtas?
9.28: Þā wyrigdon hig hine, and cwǣdon, Sī þū his leorningcniht; wē synt Moyses leorningcnihtas.
9.29: Wē witon þæt God spæc wiþ Moyses; nyte wē hwanon þēs is.
9.30: Sē man andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þæt is wundorlīc þæt gē nyton hwanon hē is, and hē untȳnde mīne ēagan.
9.31: Wē witon sōþlīce þæt God ne gehȳrþ synfulle; ac gif hwā is Gode gecoren, and his willan wyrcð, þone hē gehȳrð.
9.32: Ne gehȳrde wē nǣfre on worulde þæt ǣnig ontȳnde þæs ēagan þe wǣre blind geboren.
9.33: Ne mihte þēs nān þing dōn, gif hē nǣre of Gode.
9.34: Hig andswaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Eall þū eart on synnum geboren, and þū lǣrst ūs? And hig drifon hine ūt.
9.35: Đā sē Hǣlend gehȳrde þæt hig hyne drifon ūt, þā cwæð hē tō him, þā hē hine gemitte, Gelȳfst þū on Godes Sunu?
9.36: Hē andswarude and cwæð, Hwylc is, Drihten, þæt ic on hine gelȳfe?
9.37: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, þū hine gesāwe, and sē ðe wið þē sprycð, sē hit is.
9.38: Đā cwæþ hē, Drihten, ic gelȳfe. And hē fēoll nyþer, and geēaðmēdde hyne.
9.39: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic cōm on þysne middaneard tō dēmenne, þæt þā sceolon gesēon þe ne gesēoð; and bēon blinde þā þe gesēoð.
9.40: Đā þæt gehyrdon þā Pharisei þe mid him wǣron, ðā cwǣdon hig tō hym, Cwyst þū synt wē blinde?
9.41: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Gif gē blinde wǣron, næfde gē nāne synne. Nu gē secgað þæt gē gesēon; þæt is ēowre synn.

10.1: Sōþ ic secge ēow, Sē þe ne gǣð æt þām gete intō scēapa falde, ac stȳhþ elles ofer, hē is þēof and sceaða.
10.2: Sē þe in gǣþ æt þām geate, hē is scēapa hyrde.
10.3: Þone sē geatweard lǣt in; and þā scēap gehȳrað his stefne; and hē nemð his āgene scēap be naman, and lǣt hig ūt.
10.4: And þonne hē his āgene scēap lǣt ūt, hē gǣð beforan him, and þā scēap him fyligeað, for þām þe hig gecnāwað his stefne.
10.5: Ne fyligeaþ hig uncūþum, ac flēoð fram him, for ðām þe hig ne gecnēowun uncūðra stefne.
10.6: Ðis bigspell sē Hǣlend him sǣde; hig nyston hwæt hē spræc tō him.
10.7: Eft sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Sōþ ic ēow secge, Ic eom scēapa geat.
10.8: Ealle þā þe cōmun wǣron þēofas and sceaþan; ac þā scēap hig ne gehȳrdon.
10.9: Ic eom geat; swā hwylc swā þurh mē gǣð byð hāl, and gǣð in and ūt, and fint lǣse.
10.10: Þēof ne cymð būton þæt hē stele, and slēa, and fordō; ic com tō þām þæt hig habbon līf, and habbon genōh.
10.11: Ic eom gōd hyrde; gōd hyrde sylþ his līf for his scēapon.
10.12: Sē hȳra, sē þe nis hyrde, and sē þe nāh þā scēap, þonne hē þone wulf gesyhþ, þonne flȳhþ hē and forlǣt þā scēap, and sē wulf nimð and tōdrīfð ðā scēap.
10.13: Sē hȳra flȳhþ for þām þe hē bið āhȳrod, and him ne gebyrað tō þām scēapum.
10.14: Ic eom gōd hyrde; and ic gecnāwe mīne scēap, and hig gecnāwað mē,
10.15: swā mīn Fæder can mē, and ic can mīnne Fæder; and ic sylle mīn āgen līf for mīnum scēapum.
10.16: And ic hæbbe ōðre scēap, þā ne synt of ðisse heorde; and hit gebyrað þæt ic lǣde þā, and hig gehȳrað mīne stefne; and hyt byþ ān heord, and ān hyrde.
10.17: For þām Fæder mē lufað, for þām pe ic sylle mīne sāwle, and hig eft nime.
10.18: Ne nimð hig nān man æt mē, ac lǣte hig fram mē sylfum. Ic hæbbe anweald mīne sāwle tō ālǣtanne, and ic hæbbe anweald hig eft tō nimanne. Þis bebod ic nam æt mīnum Fæder.
10.19: Eft wæs ungeðwǣrnes geworden betwyx þām Iudeum for þysum sprǣcum.
10.20: Manega hyra cwǣdon, Dēofol is on him, and hē wēt; hwī hlyste gē him?
10.21: Sume cwǣdon, Ne synt nā þās wōdes mannes word. Cwyst þū mæg wōd man blindra manna ēagan ontȳnan?
10.22: Þā wāron templhālgunga on Ierusalem, and hit wæs winter.
10.23: And sē Hǣlend ēode on þām temple on Salomones portice.
10.24: Đā bestōdon þā Iudeas hyne ūtan, and cwǣdon tō him, Hū lange gǣlst þū ūre līf? Sege ūs openlīce hwæþer þū Crīst sȳ.
10.25: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Ic spece tō ēow, and gē ne gelȳfað; þå weorc þe ic wyrce on mīnes Fæder naman, þā cȳþaþ gewitnesse be mē.
10.26: Ac gē ne gelȳfað, for þām þe gē ne synt of mīnum scēapum.
10.27: Mīne scēap gehȳraþ mīne stefne, and ic gecnāwe hig, and hig folgiað mē;
10.28: and ic him sylle ēce līf, and hig ne forwurðaþ nǣfre, and ne nimð hig nān man of mīnre handa.
10.29: Þæt þe mīn Fæder mē sealde is mǣrre þonne ǣnig ōðer ðing; and ne mæg hit nān man niman of mīnes Fæder handa.
10.31: Đā Iudeas nāmon stānas þæt hig woldon hyne torfian.
10.32: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Manega gōde weorc ic ēow ætēowde be mīnum Fæder; for hwylcum þǣra weorca wylle gē mē hǣnan?
10.33: Þā Iudeas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, Ne hǣne we ðē for gōdum weorce; ac for þīnre bysmorspǣce; and for þām þe þū eart man, and wyrcst þē tō Gode.
10.34: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hū nys hit āwriten on ēowre ǣ, Þæt ic sǣde, Gē synt godas?
10.35: Gif hē þā tealde godas þe Godes spǣc tō wæs geworden, - and þæt hālige gewrit ne mæg bēon āwend,-
10.36: þe Fæder gehālgode and sende on middaneard, gē secgað, þæt þū bysmor spycst; for þām ic sǣde, Ic eom Godes Sunu?
10.37: Gif ic ne wyrce mīnes Fæder weorc, ne gelȳfað mē.
10.38: Gif ic wyrce mīnes Fæder weorc, and gif gē mē nellað gelȳfan, gelȳfað þām weorcum; þæt gē oncnāwun and gelȳfon þæt Fæder ys on mē, and ic on Fæder.
10.39: Hig smēadon witodlīce embe þæt hig woldon hine gefōn; and hē ēode ūt fram him.
10.40: And hē fōr eft ofer Iordanen tō þǣre stowe þe Iohannes wæs, and ǣrest on fullode; and hē wunode þār.
10.41: And manega cōmon tō him, and cwǣdon, Witodlīce ne worhte Iohannes nān tācn; ealle þā þing þe Iohannes sǣde be þyson wǣron sōðe.

11.1: Witodlīce sum sēoc man wæs genemned Lazarus, of Bethania, of Marian ceastre and of Martham his swustra.
11.2: Hit was sēo Maria þe smyrede Drihten mid þǣre sealfe, and drīgde his fēt mid hyre loccon; Lazarus hyre brōðor wæs geyfled.
11.3: His swustra sendon tō him and cwǣdon, Drihten, nū is sēoc sē ðe þū lufast.
11.4: Đā sē Hǣlend þæt gehȳrde, þā cwæð hē tō him, Nys þēos untrumnys nā for dēaðe, ac for Godes wuldre, þæt Godes Sunu sī gewuldrod þurh hyne.
11.5: Sōðlīce sē Hælend lufode Martham, and hyre swustor Mariam, and Lazarum hyra brōðor.
11.6: Witodlīce hē was twēgen dagas on ðǣre sylfan stōwe, þā hē gehȳrde þǣt hē sēoc wæs.
11.7: Æfter þisson hē cwæð tō his leorningcnihton, Uton faran eft tō Iudea lande.
11.8: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon tō him, Lārēow, nū þā Iudeas sōhton ðē þæt hig woldon þē hǣnan; and wylt þū eft faran ðyder?
11.9: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hū ne synt twelf tīda þæs dæges? Gif hwā gǣð on dæg, ne ætspyrnð hē, for þām hē gesyhþ þyses middaneardes lēoht.
11.10: Gif hē gǣð on niht, hē ætspyrnð, for þām þe lēoht nis on hyre.
11.11: Đās ðing hē cwæð; and syððan hē cwæð tō him, Lazarus ūre frēond slǣpð; ac ic wylle gān and āwreccan hyne of slǣpe.
11.12: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon, Drihten, gif hē slǣpð, hē byþ hāl.
11.13: Sē Hǣlend hit cwæð be his dēaþe; hi wēndon sōðlice þæt hē hyt sǣde be swefnes slǣpe.
11.14: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend openlice tō him, Ladzarus ys dēad.
11.15: And ic ēom blīþe for ēowrum þingon, þæt gē gelȳfon, for þām ic næs þār; ac uton gān tō him.
11.16: Đā cwææð Thomas tō hys gefēran, Uton gān and sweltan mid him.
11.17: Đā for sē Hǣlend, and gemette þæt hē wæs forðfaren, and for fēower dagon bebyrged.
11.18: Bethania ys gehende Ierusalem ofer fȳftȳne furlang.
11.19: Manega þāra Iudea cōmon tō Martham and tō Marian þæt hig woldon hī frēfrian for hyra brōðor þingon.
11.20: Đā Martha gehȳrde þæt sē Hǣlend cōm, þā arn hēo ongēan hyne; and Maria sæt æt hām.
11.21: Đā cwæð Martha to þām Hǣlende, Drihten, gif þū wǣre hēr, nǣre mīn brōðor dēad.
11.22: And ēac ic wāt nū þā þæt God þē sylð swā hwæt swā ðū hyne bitst.
11.23: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Þīn brōðor ārīst.
11.24: And Martha cwæþ tō him, Ic wāt þæt hē ārīst on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
11.25: And sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Ic eom ǣryst, and līf; sē ðe gelȳfð on mē, þēah hē dead sȳ, hē leofað;
11.26: and ne swylt nān þāra þe leofað and gelȳfð on mē. Gelȳfst þū þyses?
11.27: Hēo cwæð tō him, Witodlīce Drihten, ic gelȳfe þæt þū eart Crīst, Godes Sunu, þe on middaneard cōme.
11.28: And þā hēo ðās þing sǣde, hēo ēode and clypode diglīce Marian hyre swustor, þus cweþende, Hēr is ūre Lārēow, and clypað þē.
11.29: Đā hēo þæt gehȳrde, hēo ārās raðe and cōm tō him.
11.30: Þā gȳt ne cōm sē Hǣlend binnan þā ceastre, ac wæs ðā gȳt on ðǣre stōwe þār Martha him ongēan cōm.
11.31: Þā Iudeas þe wǣron mid hyre on hūse and hī frēfrodon, þā hig gesāwon þæt Maria ārās and mid ofste ūt ēode, hig fyligdon hyre, ðus cweþende, Hēo gǣð tō his byrgenne þæt hēo wēpe þār.
11.32: Đā Maria cōm þār sē Hǣlend wæs, and hēo hine geseah, hēo fēoll tō his fōtum, and cwæð tō him, Drihten, gif ðū wǣre hēr, nǣre mīn brōðor dēad.
11.33: Đā sē Hǣlend geseah þæt hēo wēop, and þæt þā Iudeas wēopon þe mid hyre cōmon, hē gēomrode on hys gāste and gedrēfde hyne sylfne,
11.34: and cwæð, Hwār lēde gē hine? Hig cwǣdon tō him, Drihten, gā and geseoh.
11.36: And þā Iudeas cwǣdon, Lōca nū hū hē hyne lufode.
11.37: Sume hī cwǣdon, Ne mihte ðēs, þe ontȳnde blindes ēagan, dōn ēac þæt þēs nǣre dēad?
11.38: Eft sē Hǣlend gēomrode on him sylfum, and cōm tō þǣre byrgenne. Hit was ān scræf, and þār wæs ān stān onuppan gelēd.
11.39: And sē Hǣlend cwæð, Dōð aweg þone stān. Ðā cwæð Martha tō him, þæs swustor þe þār dēadē wæs, Drihten, nū hē stincð; hē wæs for fēowur dagon dēad.
11.40: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō hyre, Hū ne sǣde ic ðe þæt þū gesyhst Godes wuldor, gif ðū gelȳfst?
11.41: Þā dydon hig aweg þone stān. Sē Hǣlend āhōf ūpp his ēagan, and cwæð, Fæder ic dō þē þancas for þām þū gehyrdest mē.
11.42: Ic wāt þæt þū mē symle gehȳrst; ac ic cwæð for þām folce þe hēr ymbūtan stent, þæt hig gelȳfon þæt þū mē āsendest.
11.43: Ðā hē ðās þing sǣde, hē clypode mycelre stefne, Lazarus, gā ūt.
11.44: And sōna stōp forð sē ðe dēad wæs, gebunden handan and fōtan; and hys nebb wæs mid swātlīne gebunden. Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Unbindað hine, and lǣtað gān.
11.45: Manega þāra Iudea þe cōmon tō Marian and gesāwon ðā þing þe hē dyde gelȳfdon on hine.
11.46: Hī sume fōron tō þām Phariseon, and sǣdon him þā ðing þe sē Hǣlend dyde.
11.47: Witodlīce þā bisceopas and þā Pharisei gaderydon gemōt, and cwǣdun, Hwæt dō wē? for þām þēs man wyrcð mycel tācn.
11.48: Gif wē hine forlǣtaþ, ealle gelȳfað on hine; and Romane cumað and nimað ūre land and ūrne þēodscipe.
11.49: Hyra ān wæs genemned Caiphas, sē wæs ðā on gēre bisceop, and cwæð tō him, Gē nyton nān þing,
11.50: nē ne geþenceað þæt ūs ys betere þæt ān man swelte for folce, and eall þēod ne forwurde.
11.51: Ne cwæð hē þæt of him sylfum; ac þā hē wæs þæt gēr bisceop, hē wītgode þæt sē Hǣlend sceolde sweltan for ðǣre þēode;
11.52: and nā synderlīce for þǣre dēode, ac þæt hē wolde gesomnian tōgædere Godes bearn þe tōdrifene wǣron.
11.53: Of þām dæge hig þōhton þæt hī woldon hyne ofslēan.
11.54: Þā ne fōr sē Hǣlend nā openlīce gemang ððām Iudeon, ac fōr on þæt land wið þæt wēsten, on þā burh þe ys genemned Effrem, and wunode þǣr myd his leorningcnihton.
11.55: Iudea ēastron wǣron gehende; and manega fōron of ðām lande tō Ierusalem ǣr þām ēastron, þæt hig woldon hig sylfe gehālgian.
11.56: Hig sōhton þone Hǣlend, and sprǣcon him betwȳnan ðǣr hig stōdon on ðām temple, and þus cwǣdon, Hwat wēne gē? Þæt hē ne cume tō frēolsdæge?
11.57: Þā bisceopas and þā Pharisei hæfdon beboden, gif hwā wiste hwār hē wǣre, þæt hē hyt cȳdde, þæt hig mihton hine niman.

12.1: Sē Hǣlend cōm syx dagon ǣr þām ēastron tō Bethania, þār Lazarus wæs dēad þe sē Hǣǣlend āwrehte.
12.2: Hig wrohton him þǣr bēorscipe; and Marða þēnode. Ladzarus wæs ān þǣra þe mid him sæt.
12.3: Maria nam ān pund dēorwyrðre sealfe mid þām wyrtgemange þe hig nardus hātað, and smyrede ðæs Hǣlendes fēt and drīgde mid hyre loccon; and þæt hūs was gefylled of ðǣre sealfe swæcce.
12.4: Þā cwæð ān his leorningcnihta, Iudas Scarioð þe hine belǣwde,
12.5: Hwī ne sealde hēo þās sealfe wiþ þrīm hundred penegon, þæt man mihte syllan þearfon?
12.6: Ne cwæð hē nā þæt for þig þe him gebyrode tō þām þearfon, ac for þām þe hē wæs þēof, and hæfde scrīn, and bær þā ðing þe man sende.
12.7: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Lǣt hig þæt hēo healde þā oð þone dæg þe man mē bebyrge.
12.8: Gē habbað symle þearfan mid ēow; ac gē nabbað mē symle.
12.9: Micel menio þāra Iudea gecnēow þæt hē wæs ðǣr; and hig cōmon, næs nā for þæs Hǣlendes þingon syndorlīce, ac þæt hig woldon gesēon Ladzarum þe hē āwehte of dēaðe.
12.10: Đāra sācerda ealdras þōhton þæt hig woldon Lazarum ofslēan;
12.11: for þām þe manega fōron fram þām Iudeon for his þingon, and gelȳfdon on þone Hǣlend.
12.12: On mergen mycel menio þe cōm tō þām freolsdage, þā hig gehȳrdon þæt sē Hǣlend cōm tō Ierusalem,
12.13: hī nāmon palmtrȳwa twigu, and ēodon ūt ongean hine, and clypedon, Sī Israhela Cing hāl and geblētsod þe cōm on Drihtnes naman.
12.14: And sē Hǣlend gemētte ānne assan and rād onuppan þām; swā hit āwriten ys,
12.15: Ne ondrǣd þū, Siones dohtor; nū þīn cing cymp uppan assan folan sittende.
12.16: Ne undergēton hys leorningcnihtas þās þing ǣrest; ac þā sē ǣlend wæs gewuldrod, þā gemundon hig þæt þās þing wāron āwritene be him, and þās þing hig dydon him.
12.17: Sēo menio þe wæs mid him, þā hē Ladzarum clypode of ðǣre byrgene and hine āwehte of dēaðe, cȳðde gewitnesse.
12.18: And for ðī him cōm sēo menio ongēan, for ðām þe hī gehȳrdon þæt hē worhte þæt tācn.
12.19: Đā Pharisei cwǣdon betwux him sylfon, Wē gesēoð þæt wē nān þing ne fremiað; nū wyle eall middaneard æfter him.
12.20: Sume ðā wǣron hǣðene þe fōron þæt hig woldon hī gebiddan on ðām frēolsdæge;
12.21: ðā genēalǣhton tō Philippe, sē wæs of þǣre Galileiscean Bethsaida, and hī bǣdon hine, and cwǣdon, Lēof, wē wyllað gesēon þone Hǣlend.
12.22: Đā ēode Philippus and sǣde hit Andree; and eft Andreas and Philippus hit sǣdon þām Hǣlende.
12.23: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Sēo tīd cymð þæt mannes Sunu by geswutelod. Ðys godspel sceal on tȳwesdæg on þǣre palmwucan.
12.24: Sōðlīce ic secge ēow, Þæt hwǣtene corn wunað āna, būton hyt fealle on eorpan and sȳ dēad; gif hit bið dēad, hit bringð mycelne wæstm.
12.25: Sē þe lufað his sāwle forspilþ hig; and sē þe hataþ his sāwle on þison middanearde gehylt hī on ēceon līfe.
12.26: Gif hwā þēnige mē, fylige mē; and mīn þēn bið þǣr þǣr ic eom. Gif me hwa þēnað, mīn Fæder hine wurðað.
12.27: Nū mīn sawl ys gedrēfed; and hwæt secge ic, Fæder, gehǣl mē of ðisse tīde. Ac for ðām ic cōm on þās tīd.
12.28: Fæder, gewuldra þīnne naman. Đā cōm stefn of heofone þus cweðende, And ic gewuldrode, and eft ic gewuldrige.
12.29: Sēo menio þe þǣr stōd and þæt gehȳrde sǣdon þæt hyt þunrode; sume sǣdon þæt engel spǣce wið hyne.
12.30: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne cōm þēos stefn for mīnon þingon, ac for ēowrum þingon.
12.31: Nū ys middaneardes dōm; nū byð ðysses middaneardes ealdor ūt āworpen.
12.32: And gif ic bēo ūpp āhafen fram eorðan, ic tēo ealle þing tō me sylfon.
12.33: Ðæt hē sǣde and tācnode hwylcum dēaðe hē wolde sweltan.
12.34: Sēo menio him andswarode and cwæð, Wē gehȳrdon on þǣre ǣ þæt Crīst bið on ēcnysse, and hūmeta segest þū, Hit gebyrað þæt mannes Sunu bēo ūpp āhafen? hwæt ys þēs mannes Sunu?
12.35: Þā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Nū gȳt ys lȳtel lēoht on ēow. Gāþ þā hwile þe gē lēoht habbað, þæt þȳstro ēow ne befōn; sē þe gǣð on þȳstro, hē nāt hwyder hē gǣð.
12.36: Þā hwīle þe gē lēoht habbon, gelȳfað on lēoht, þæt gē sȳn lēohtes bearn. Ðās þing sē Hǣlend him sǣde, and ēode and bedīglode hine fram him.
12.37: Đā hē swā mycele tācn dyde beforan him, hī ne gelȳfdon on hyne:
12.38: þæt ðæs wītegan word Isaias wǣre gefylled þā hē cwæð, Drihten, hwā gelȳfde þæs þe wē gehȳrdon? and hwām wæs Drihtnes strencð geswutelod?
12.39: For þī hī ne mihton gelȳfan, for þām Isaias cwæþ eft,
12.40: Hē āblende hyra ēagan, and āhyrde hyra heortan; þæt hī ne gesēon mid hyra ēagon, and mid hyra heortan ne ongyton, and sȳn gecyrrede, and ic hig gehǣle.
12.41: Isaias sǣde ðās þing þā hē geseah hys wuldor, and spræc be him.
12.42: And þēah manega of ðām ealdron gelȳfdon on hyne; ac hī hit ne cȳddon, for þǣra Pharisea þingon, þē lǣs hig man ūt ādrife of hyra gesomnunge.
12.43: Hī lufodon manna wuldor swīðor þonne Godes wuldor.
12.44: Sē Hǣlend clypode and cwæð tō him, Sē þe gelȳfað on mē, ne gelȳfþ hē nā on mē, ac on þone þe mē sende.
12.45: And sē ðe mē gesyhþ gesyhð þone þe mē sende.
12.46: Ic cōm tō lēohte on middaneard, and nān ðāra þe gelȳfð on mē ne wunað on þȳstron.
12.47: And gif hwā gehȳrð mīne word, and ne gehylt, ne dēme ic hine; ne cōm ic middaneard tō dēmanne, ac þæt ic gehǣle middaneard.
12.48: Se þe mē forhigð, and mīne word ne underfēhð, hē hæfþ hwā him dēme; sēo spǣc þe ic spæc, sēo him dēmð on þām ȳtemestan dæge.
12.49: For þām þe ic ne spece of mē sylfon; ac sē Fæder þe mē sende, hē mē bebēad hwæt ic cweþe, and hwæt ic spece.
12.50: And ic wāt þæt his bebod ys ēce līf; þā þing þe ic sprece ic sprece swā Fæder mē sǣde.

13.1: Ǣr þām ēsterfrēolsdæge, sē Hǣlend wiste þæt his tīd cōm þæt hē wolde gewītan of þyson middanearde tō his Fæder, þā hē lufode his leorningcnihtas þe wǣron on middanearde, on ende hē hig lufode.
13.2: And þā Drihtnes þēnung wæs gemacud, þā fōr sē dēofol on Iudas heortan Scariothes þæt hē hine belǣwde.
13.3: Hē wiste þæt Fæder sealde ealle þing on his handa, and þæt hē cōm of Gode, and cymð tō Gode;
13.4: hē ārās fram his þēnunge, and lēde his rēaf, and nam līnen hrægel and begyrde hyne.
13.5: Æfter þām hē dyde water on fæt, and þwōh his leorningcnihta fēt, and drīgde hig mid þǣre linwāde þe hē wæs mid begyrd.
13.6: Đā cōm hē tō Simone Petre. And Petrus cwæð tō him, Drihten, scealt þū ðwēan mīne fēt?
13.7: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þū nāst nū þæt ic dō, ac þū wāst syððan.
13.8: Petrus cwæð tō him, Ne þwyhst þū næfre mine fēt. Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæþ, Gif ic þē ne þwēa, næfst þū nānne dǣl myd mē.
13.9: Đā cwæð Simon Petrus tō him, Drihten, ne þweh þū nā mīne fēt āne, ac ēac mīn hēafod and mīne handa.
13.10: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Sē þe clǣne byþ ne beðearf būton þæt man his fēt þwēa, ac ys eall clǣne; and gē synt sume clǣne, næs nā ealle.
13.11: Hē wiste witodlīce hwā hyne sceolde belǣwan; for þām hē cwæð, Ne synt gē ealle clǣne.
13.12: Syððan hē hæfde hyra fēt āþwogene, hē nam his rēaf, and þā hē sæt, hē cwæð eft tō him, Wite gē hwæt ic ēow dyde?
13.13: Gē clypiað mē Lārēow and Drihten; and wel gē cweðaþ; swā ic eom sōþlice.
13.14: Gif ic þwōh ēowre fet ic þe eom ēower Lārēow and ēower Hlāford, gē sceolon þwēan ēower ǣlc ōðres fēt.
13.15: Ic ēow sealde bȳsene þæt gē dōn swā ic ēow dyde.
13.16: Sōþlice ic ēow secge, Nys sē ðēowa furðra þonne his hlāford; nē ǣrenddraca nys mǣrra þonne sē þe hyne sende.
13.17: Gif gē þās þing witon, gē bēoð ēadige gif gē hig dōð.
13.18: Ne secge ic be ēow eallon; ic wāt hwylce ic gecēas; ac þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled þe cwyþ, Sē þe ytt hlāf myd mē āhefþ hys hō ongēan mē.
13.19: Nū ic ēow secge ǣr þām þe hyt gewurþe, þæt gē gelȳfon, þonne hyt geworden bið, þæt ic hit eom.
13.20: Sōð ic ēow secge, Sē ðe underfehð þone þe ic sende underfēhð mē; sē þe underfehp mē underfehþ ðone ðe mē sende.
13.21: Ðā sē Hǣlend þās þing sǣde, hē wæs gedrēfed on gāste, and cȳðde and cwæð, Sōð ic ēow secge þæt ēower ān mē belǣwð.
13.22: Đā leorningcnihtas behēold hyra ǣlc ōðerne, and him twȳnode be hwām hē hit sǣde.
13.23: Ān þǣra leorningcnihta hlinode on þæs Hǣlendes bearme þone sē Hǣlend lufode.
13.24: Symon Petrus bīcnode tō þyson, and cwæð tō him, Hwæt is sē ðe hē hyt big segð?
13.25: Witodlīce þā hē hlinode ofer ðæs Hǣlendes brēostum, hē cwæð tō him, Drihten, hwæt ys hē?
13.26: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Hē ys sē ðe ic rǣce bedyppedne hlāf. And þā þā hē bedypte þone hlāf, hē sealde hyne Iudas Scariothe.
13.27: And þā æfter þām bitan, Satanas ēode on hyne. Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Dō rāðe þæt þū dōn wylt.
13.28: Nyste nān þāra sittendra tō hwām hē þæt sǣde.
13.29: Sume wēndon, for þām Iudas hæfde scrīn, þæt sē Hǣlend hit cwǣde be him, Bige þā þing be ūs þarf sȳ tō þām frēolsdæge; oððe þæt hē sealde sum þing þearfendum mannum.
13.30: Đā hē nam þone bitan, hē ēode ūt; þārrihte hit was niht.
13.31: Þā hē ūt ēode, and sē Hǣlend cwæð, Nū ys mannes Sunu geswutelod, and God ys geswutelod on him.
13.32: Gif God ys geswutelod on him, and God geswutelað hine on hym sylfum.
13.33: Lā bearn, nū gȳt ic eom gehwǣde tīd mid ēow. Gē mē sēceað; and swā ic þām Iudeon sǣde, Gē ne magon faran þyder þe ic fare; and nū ic ēow secge.
13.34: Ic ēow sylle nīwe bebod, þæt gē lufion ēow betwȳnan, swā ic ēow lufode.
13.35: Be þām oncnāwað ealle menn þæt gē synt mīne leorningcnihtas, gif gē habbað lufe ēow betwȳnan.
13.36: Simon Petrus cwæð tō him, Drihten, hwyder gǣst þū? Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ne miht þū mē fylian þyder ic nū fare; þū færst eft æfter mē.
13.37: Petrus cwæð tō him, Hwī ne mæg ic þē nū fylian? Ic sylle mīn līf for ðē.
13.38: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Đīn līf þū sylst for mē? Sōð ic þē secge, Ne crǣwð sē cocc ǣr ðū wiðsæcst mē þrīwa.

14.1: And hē cwæð tō his leomingcnihton, Ne sȳ ēower heorte gedrēfed; gē gelȳfað on God, and gelȳfað on mē.
14.2: On mīnes Fæder hūse synt manega eardungstōwa; ne sǣde ic ēow. Hit ys lȳtles wana þæt ic fare and wylle ēow eardungstōwe gearwian?
14.3: And gif ic fare and ēow eardungstōwe gegearwige, eft ic cume and nime ēow tō mē sylfon; þæt gē sȳn þǣr ic eom.
14.4: And gē witon hwyder ic fare, and gē cunnon þone weg.
14.5: Thomas cwæð tō him, Drihten, wē nyton hwyder þū færst; and hū mage wē þone weg cunnan?
14.6: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom weg, and sōðfæstnys, and līf; ne cymð nān tō Fæder butan þurh mē.
14.7: Gif gē cūðon mē, witodlīce gē cūðon mīnne Fæder; and heonon forð gē hyne gecnāwað, and gē hine gesāwon.
14.8: Philippus cwæð tō him, Drihten, ætȳw ūs þone Fæder, and we habbað genōh.
14.9: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Philippus, swā lange tīd ic wæs mid ēow, and gē ne gecnēowun mē? Sē þe mē gesyhð gesyhð mīnne Fæder; hūmeta cwyst þū, Ætȳw ūs þīnne Fæder?
14.10: Ne gelȳfst þū þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on mē? Đā word þe ic tō ēow sprece, ne sprece ic hī of mē sylfon; sē Fæder þe wunað on mē, hē wyrcð þā weorc.
14.11: Ne gelȳfe gē þæt ic eom on Fæder, and Fæder ys on mē? gelyfað for þām weorcon.
14.12: Sōð ic ēow secge, Sē ðe gelȳfð on mē, hē wyrcð þā weorc þe ic wyrce; and hē wyrcð māran þonne þā synt, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder.
14.13: And ic dō swā hwæt swā gē biddað on mīnon naman, þæt Fæder sī gewuldrod on Suna.
14.14: Gif gē hwæt mē biddaþ on mīnum naman, þæt ic dō.
14.15: Gif gē mē lufiað, healdað mīne beboda.
14.16: And ic bidde Fæder, and hē sylþ ēow ōðerne Frēfriend, þæt bēo ǣfre mid ēow,
14.17: sōðfæstnysse gāst þe ðēs middaneard ne mæg underfōn; hē ne cann hyne, for ðām þe hē ne gesyhþ hyne; gē hyne cunnon, for þām hē wunað mid ēow, and bið on ēow.
14.18: Ne lǣte ic ēow stēopcild; ic cume tō ēow.
14.19: Nū gȳt ys ān lȳtel fyrst, and middaneard mē ne gesyhþ; gē mē gesēoð; for þām ic lybbe, and gē lybbað.
14.20: On þām dæge gē gecnāwaþ þæt ic eom on mīnum Fæder, and gē synt on mē, and ic eom on ēow.
14.21: Sē þe hæfð mīne bebodu, and gehylt þā, hē ys þe mē lufað. Mīn Fæder lufað þone þe mē lufað, and ic lufige hyne, and geswutelige him mē sylfne.
14.22: Iudas cwæð tō him, - næs nā sē Scarioth, - Drihten, hwæt ys geworden þæt þū wylt þē sylfne geswuteligan ūs, næs middanearde?
14.23: Sē Hǣlend andswarode and cwæð tō him, Gif hwā mē lufað, hē hylt mīne sprǣce; and mīn Fæder lufað hine, and wē cumað tō him, and wē wyrceað eardungstōwa mid him.
14.24: Sē ðe mē ne lufað ne hylt hē mīne sprǣce; and nis hyt mīn sprǣc þe gē gehȳrdon, ac ðæs Fæder þe mē sende.
14.25: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde, þā ic mid ēow wunode.
14.26: Sē Hāliga Frōfre Gāst, þe Fæder sent on mīnum naman, ēow lǣrð ealle þing, and hē lǣrð ēow ealle þā þing þe ic ēow secge.
14.27: Ic lǣfe ēow sibbe; ic sylle ēow mīne sibbe; ne sylle ic ēow sibbe swā middaneard sylþ. Ne sȳ ēower heorte gedrēfed, nē ne forhtige gē.
14.28: Gē gehȳrdon þæt ic ēow sǣde, Ic gā, and ic cume tō ēow. Witodlīce gif gē mē lufedon, ge geblissodon, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder; for þām Fæder ys māra þonne ic.
14.29: And nū ic ēow sǣde ǣr ðām þe hit gewurðe, þæt gē gelȳfon þonne hit geworden bið.
14.30: Ne sprece ic nū nā fela wið ēow; ðyses middaneardes ealdor cymð, and hē næfð nān ðing on mē;
14.31: ac þæt middaneard oncnāwe þæt ic lufige Fæder, and ic dō swā Fæder mē bebēad. Arīsað, uton gān heonon.

15.1: Ic eom sōð wīneard, and mīn Fæder ys eorðtilia.
15.2: Hē dēð ǣlc twig aweg on mē þe blǣda ne byrð; and hē feormað ǣlc þāra þe blǣda byrþ, þæt hyt bere blǣda ðē swīðor.
15.3: Nū gē synt clǣne for þǣre sprǣce þe ic tō ēow spræc.
15.4: Wuniað on mē, and ic on ēow. Swā twig ne mæg blǣda beran him sylf, būton hit wunige on wīnearde; swā gē ne magon ēac, būton gē wunion on mē.
15.5: Ic eom wīneard, and gē synt twigu. Sē ðe wunað on mē, and ic on him, sē byrð mycle blǣda; for ðām gē ne magon nān ðing dōn būtan mē.
15.6: Gif hwā ne wunað on mē, hē byð āworpen ūt, swā twig, and fordrūwað; and hig gaderiað þā, and dōð on fȳr, and hig forbyrnað.
15.7: Gyf gē wuniað on mē, and mīne word wuniað on ēow, biddað swā hwæt swā gē wyllon, and hyt byð ēower.
15.8: On ðām ys mīn Fæder geswutelod, þæt gē beron mycle blǣda, and bēon mīne leorningcnihtas.
15.9: And ic lufode ēow, swā Fæder lufode me: wuniað on mīnre lufe.
15.10: Gif gē mīne bebodu gehealdað, gē wuniað on mīnre lufe; swā ic gehēold mīnes Fæder bebodu, and ic wunige on hys lufe.
15.11: Đās þing ic ēow sǣde þæt mīn gefēa sȳ on ēow, and ēower gefēa sȳ gefulled.
15.12: Ðis ys mīn bebod, þæt gē lufion ēow gemǣnelīce, swā ic ēow lufode.
15.13: Næfð nān man māran lufe þonne ðēos ys, þæt hwā sylle his līf for his frēondum.
15.14: Gē synt mīne frȳnd, gif gē dōð þā þing þe ic ēow bebēode.
15.15: Ne telle ic ēow tō ðēowan; for þām sē ðēowa nāt hwæt sē hlāford dēð. Ic tealde ēow tō frēondum; for þām ic cȳðde ēow ealle þā þing þe ic gehȳrde æt mīnum Fæder.
15.16: Ne gecure gē mē, ac ic gecēas ēow, and ic sette ēow þæt gē gān and blǣda beron, and ēowre blǣda gelǣston; þæt Fæder sylle ēow swā hwæt swā gē biddað on mīnum naman.
15.17: Đās þing ic ēow bēode, þæt gē lufion ēow gemǣnelīce.
15.18: Gif middaneard ēow hatað, witað þæt hē hatede mē ǣr ēow.
15.19: Gif ge of middanearde wǣron, middaneard lufode þæt his wæs; for þam þe gē ne synt of middanearde, ac ic ēow gecēas of middanearde, for ðī middaneard ēow hatað.
15.20: Gemunað mīnre sprǣce þe ic ēow sǣde, Nis se ðēowa mǣrra þonne his hlāford. Gif hī mē ēhton, hī wyllað ehtan ēower; gif hī mīne sprǣce hēoldon, hī healdað ēac ēowre.
15.21: Ac ealle þās þing hi doð ēow for mīnum naman, for þām hi ne cunnon þone þe mē sende.
15.22: Gif ic ne cōme and tō him ne sprǣce, næfdon hig nāne synne; nū hī nabbað nāne lāde be hyra synne.
15.23: Sē þe mē hatað hatað mīnne Fæder.
15.24: Gif ic nāne weorc ne worhte on him þe nān ōðer ne worhte, næfdon hī nāne synne; nu hī gesāwon, and hī hatedon ǣgðer ge mē ge mīnne Fæder.
15.25: Ac þæt sēo sprǣc sȳ gefylled þe on hyra ǣ āwriten ys, Þæt hī hatedon mē būton gewyrhton.
15.26: Đonne sē Frēfriend cymð þe ic ēow sende fram Fæder, sōðfæstnysse Gāst þe cymð fram Fæder, hē cȳð gewitnesse be mē;
15.27: and gē cȳðað gewitnesse, for ðām gē waron fram fruman mid mē.

16.1: Đās ðing ic ēow sǣde þæt gē ne swicion.
16.2: Hī dōð ēow of gesomnungum; ac sēo tīd cymð þæt ǣlc þe ēow ofslyhð wēnþ þæt hē þēnige Gode.
16.3: And þās ðing hig dōð, for þām þe hī ne cūþon mīnne Fæder, nē mē.
16.4: Ac þās þing ic ēow sǣde, þæt gē gemunon þonne hyra tīd cymð, þæt ic hit ēow sǣde. Ne sǣde ic ēow þās ðing æt fruman, for þām þe ic wæs mid ēow.
16.5: Nū ic fare tō ðām þe mē sende; and ēower nān ne āhsað mē hwyder ic fare.
16.6: Ac for þām þe ic spræc ðās þing tō ēow, unrōtnyss gefylde ēowre heortan.
16.7: Ac ic ēow secge sōðfæstnysse; Ēow fremað þæt ic fare. Gif ic ne fare, ne cymð sē Frēfriend tō ēow; witodlīce gif ic fare, ic hyne sende tō ēow.
16.8: And þonne hē cymð, hē þȳwþ þysne middaneard be synne, and be rihtwīsnysse, and be dōme:
16.9: be synne, for þām hi ne gelyfdon on mē;
16.10: be rihtwīsnysse, for þām ic fare tō Fæder, and gē mē ne gesēoð;
16.11: be dōme, for þām þyses middaneardes ealdur ys gedēmed.
16.12: Gyt ic hæbbe ēow fela tō secgenne, ac gē hyt ne magun nū ācuman.
16.13: Donne þǣre sōþfæstnysse Gāst cymð, hē lǣrð ēow ealle sōþfæstnysse; ne sprycð hē of him sylfon, ac hē sprycð þā þing þe hē gehȳrð, and cȳð ēow ðā þing þe tōwearde synt.
16.14: Hē mē geswutelað; for þām hē nimð of mīnum, and cȳð ēow.
16.15: Ealle þā þing þe mīn Fæder hæfð synt mīne; for þig ic cwað þæt hē nimð of mīnum, and cȳþ ēow.
16.16: Nū ymbe ān lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð; and eft embe lȳtel gē mē gesēoþ, for þām þe ic fare tō Fæder.
16.17: Đā cwǣdon his leorningcnihtas him betwynan, Hwæt ys þæt hē ūs segð, Ymbe lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð, and eft embe lȳtel and gē mē gesēoð; and, Þæt ic fare tō Fæder?
16.18: Hig cwǣdon witodlīce, Hwæt ys þæt hē cwyþ, Embe lȳtel? Wē nytan hwæt hē sprycð.
16.19: Sē Hǣlend wiste þæt hī woldon hyne āhsian, and hē cwæð tō him, Bē þām gē smēageað betwȳnan ēow, for þām ic sǣde, Embe lȳtel gē mē ne gesēoð, and eft embe lȳtel gē mē gesēoð?
16.20: Sōð ic ēow secge, þæt gē hēofiað and wēpað; middaneard geblissað; and gē bēoð unrōte, ac ēower unrōtnys byð gewend tō gefēan.
16.21: Ðænne wīf cenð, hēo hæfð unrōtnysse, for þām þe hyre tīd cōm; þonne hēo cenð cnapan, ne geman hēo þǣre hefignysse, for gefēan for þām mann byð ācenned on middaneard.
16.22: And witodlīce gē habbað nū unrōtnysse; eft ic ēow gesēo, and ēower heorte geblissað, and nān man ne nimþ ēowerne gefēan fram ēow.
16.23: And on þām dæge gē ne biddað mē nānes þinges. Sōð ic ēow secge, Gif gē hwæt biddað mīnne Fæder on mīnum naman, hē hyt sylþ ēow.
16.24: Oþ þis ne bǣde gē nān þing on mīnum naman: biddaþ, and gē underfōð, þæt ēower gefēa sȳ full.
16.25: Đās þing ic ēow sǣde on bigspellum. Sēo tīd cymð þænne ic ēow ne sprece on bigspellum, ac ic cȳðe ēow openlīce be mīnum Fæder.
16.26: On ðām dæge gē biddað on mīnum naman; and ic ēow ne secge, for þām ic bidde mīnne Fæder be ēow.
16.27: Witodlīce sē Fæder ēow lufað, for þām þe gē lufedon mē, and gelȳfdon þæt ic cōm of Gode.
16.28: Ic fōr fram Fæder, and cōm on middaneard; eft, ic forlǣte middaneard, and fare tō Fæder.
16.29: His leorningcnihtas cwǣdon tō him, Nū ðū sprycst openlīce, and ne segst nān bigspell.
16.30: Nū wē witon þæt þū wāst ealle ðing, and þē nis nan þearf þæt ǣnig þē āxie; on ðyson wē gelȳfað þæt þū cōme of Gode.
16.31: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Nū gē gelȳfað?
16.32: Nū cōm tīd and cymð þæt gē tōfaron ǣghwylc tō his āgenon, and forlǣton mē ānne; and ic ne eom āna, for þām mīn Fæder is mid mē.
16.33: Ðās þing ic ēow sǣde, þæt gē habbon sibbe on mē. Gē habbað hefige byrðene on middanearde; ac getrūwiað; ic forswīðde middaneard.

17.1: Ðās þing sē Hǣlend spræc, and āhōf upp his ēagan tō heofenum, and cwæð, Fæder, tīd ys cumen; geswutela þīnne Sunu, þæt þīn Sunu geswutelige þē:
17.2: and swā þū him sealdest anweald ǣlces mannes, þæt hē sylle ēce līf eallum þām þe þū him sealdest.
17.3: Ðis ys sōðlīce ēce līf, þæt hī oncnāwon þæt þū eart ān sōþ God, and sē ðe þū sendest, Hǣlende Crīst.
17.4: Ic þē geswutelode ofer eorþan; ic geendode þæt weorc þæt þū mē sealdest tō dōnne.
17.5: And nū, ðū Fæder, gebeorhta mē mid þē sylfon, mid ðǣre beorhtnysse þe ic hæfde myd þē ǣr ðām þe middaneard wǣre.
17.6: Ic geswutolode þīnne naman þām mannon þe ðū mē sealdest of middanearde; hig wǣron þīne, and þū hȳ sealdest mē; and hī gehēoldon þīne sprǣce.
17.7: Nū hī gecnēowon þæt ealle þā þing þe þū mē sealdest synd of ðē;
17.8: for þām ic sealde him þā word ðe ðū sealdest mē; and hig underfengon, and oncnēowon sōðlīce þæt ic cōm of þē, and hig gelȳfdon þæt þū mē sendest.
17.9: Ic bidde for hig; ne bidde ic for middanearde, ac for þā þe ðū mē sealdest, for þām hī synt þīne;
17.10: and ealle mīne synt þīne, and þīne synt mīne; and ic eom geswutelod on him.
17.11: And nū ic ne eom on middanearde, and hī synt on middanearde, and ic cume tō ðē. On ðǣre tīde sē Hǣlend behēold his leorningcnihtas, and cwæð, Hāliga Fæder, heald on ðīnum naman þæt þū mē sealdest, þæt hi sȳn ān, swā wyt synt.
17.12: Þā ic wæs mid him, ic hēold hī on þīnum naman; ic hēold þā þe þū mē sealdest, and ne forwearð hyra nān, būton forspillydnysse bearn; þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled.
17.13: Nu ic cume tō þē; and ðās þing ic sprece on middanearde, þæt hī habbon mīnne gefēan gefyllydne on him sylfon.
17.14: Ic sealde him þīne sprǣce; and middaneard hī hæfde on hatunge, for þām hī ne synt of middanearde, swā ic ēac ne eom of middanearde.
17.15: Ne bidde ic þæt þū hī nyme of middanearde, ac þæt þū hī gehealde of yfele.
17.16: Ne synt hī of middanearde, swā ic ne eom of middanearde.
17.17: Gehālga hī on sōðfæstnysse; þīn sprǣc ys sōðfæstnyss.
17.18: Swā þū mē sendest on middaneard, ic sende hī on middaneard.
17.19: And for hig ic hālgige mē sylfne, þæt hig sȳn ēac gehālgode on sōðfæstnysse.
17.20: Witodlīce ne gebidde ic for hī āne, ac ēac for ðā þe gȳt sceolon gelȳfan þurh hyra word on mē;
17.21: þæt ealle sȳn ān; swā þū Fæder eart on mē, and ic com on ðē, þæt hig sȳn ēac ān on unc; þæt middaneard gelȳfe þæt þū mē sendest.
17.22: And ic sealde him þā beorhtnysse þe ðū mē sealdest; þæt hī sȳn ān, swā wyt sȳn ān.
17.23: Ic eom on him, and þū eart on mē, þæt hī sȳn geendode on ān; þæt middaneard oncnāwe þæt þū mē sendest, and lufodest hig, swā þū mē lufodest.
17.24: Fæder, ic wylle þæt þā þe þū mē sealdest sȳn mid mē þār ic eom; þæt hig gesēon mīne beorhtnysse þe þū mē sealdest; for þām þū lufodest mē ǣr middaneard gesett wæs.
17.25: Lā, rihtwīīsa Fæder, middaneard þē ne gecnēow; witodlīce ic ðē gecnēow; and hī oncnēowon þæt þū mē sendyst;
17.26: and ic him cȳðde ðīnne naman, and gȳt wylle cȳþan; þæt sēo lufu ðe þū mē lufodest sȳ on him, and ic on him.

18.1: Þā sē Hǣlend þās þing cwæð, þā ēode hē ofer ðā burnan Cedron, ðǣr wæs ān wyrtūn, intō þām hē ēode and his leorningcnihtas.
18.2: Witodlīce Iudas, þe hyne belǣwde, wiste þā stōwe; for þām þe sē Hǣlend oftrǣdlīce cōm ðyder mid his leorningcnihton.
18.3: Þā underfēng Iudas þæt folc and þā þegnas æt þām bisceopum and æt ðām Phariseon, and cōm þyder mid lēohtfatum and mid blasum and mid wǣpnum.
18.4: Witodlīce sē Hǣlend wiste ealle þā þing þe him tōwearde wǣron; hē ēode ðā forð, and cwæð tō him, Hwæne sēce gē?
18.5: Hig andswaredon him and cwǣdon, Ðone Nazareniscean Hǣlend. Sē Hǣlend cwæð, Ic hit eom. Sōðlīce Iudas þe hine belǣwde stōd mid him.
18.6: Ðā hē openlīce sǣde, Ic hit eom, ðā ēodon hig under bæc and fēollon on ðā eorþan.
18.7: Eft hē hī āxode, Hwæne sēce gē? Hī cwǣdon, Þone Nazareniscean Hǣlend.
18.8: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Ic sǣde ēow þæt ic hit eom. Gif gē witodlīce me seceað, lǣtað þās faran:
18.9: þæt sēo sprǣc wǣre gefylled þe hē cwæð, Þæt ic nānne þǣra ne forspille þe ðū mē sealdest.
18.10: Witodlīce Simon Petrus ātēah his swurd, and slōh ðæs bisceopes þēowan, and ācerf him of swȳðre ēare. Þæs þēowan nama wæs Malchus.
18.11: Ðā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō Petre, Dō þīn swurd on scēaðe; þone calic þe mīn Fæder mē sealde, ne drince ic hine?
18.12: Ðæt folc and sē ealdor and þǣra Iudea ðegnas nāmon þone Hǣlend and bundon hine,
18.13: and lǣddon hine ǣrest tō Annan, sē wæs Caiphas swēor, and sē Caiphas wæs ðæs gēares bisceop.
18.14: Witodlīce Kaiphas dihte ðām Iudeon and cwæð þæt hyt wǣre betere þæt ān man swulte for folc.
18.15: Simon Petrus fylide þām Hǣlende, and ōðer leorningcniht. Sē ōðer leorningcniht wæs ðām bisceope cūð, and hē ēode inn mid þām Hǣlende on ðæs bisceopes cafertūn.
18.16: Petrus stōd at ðǣre dura þǣr ūte. Þā ēode sē leorningcniht ūt þe wæs ðæs bisceopes cūða, and cwæð tō ðǣre dureþīnene, and lǣdde Petrum inn.
18.17: Đā cwæð sēo duruðīnen tō Petre, Cwyst ðū eart ðū of ðyses leorningcnihtum? Đā cwæð hē, Nicc, ne eom ic.
18.18: Đā þēowas and ðā þegnas stōdon at ðām glēdon and wyrmdon hig, for þām hit was ceald; witodlīce Petrus stōd mid him and wyrmde hyne.
18.19: Sē bisceop āxode þone Hǣlend embe his leorningcnihtas, and embe his lāre.
18.20: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend and cwæð, Ic spræc openlīce tō middanearde, and ic lǣrde symble on gesomnunge, and on temple, þār ealle Iudeas tōgædere cōmon; and ic ne spæc nān þing dīgelīce.
18.21: Hwī āxast ðū mē? āxa þā þe gehȳrdon hwæt ic tō him spræc; hī witon þā ðing þe ic him sǣde.
18.22: Ðā hē þis cwæð, þā slōh ān ðǣra þēna þe ðār stōdon ðone Hǣlend mid his handa, and cwæð, Andswarast ðū swā þām bisceope?
18.23: Sē Hǣlend andswarode him and cwæð, Gif ic yfele spræc, cȳð gewittnysse be yfele; gif ic wel spræc, hwī bēatst þū mē?
18.24: Ðā sende Annas hine tō þām bisceope gebundene.
18.25: And Symon Petrus stōd and wyrmde hync. Ðā cwǣdon hī tō him, Cwyst þū eart þū of his leorningcnihton? Hē wiðsōc, and cwæð, Ic ne eom.
18.26: Ðā cwæð ān ðæs bisceopas þēowena, hys cūða þæs ēare slōh Petrus of, Hū ne geseah ic ðē on ðām wyrtūne mid hym?
18.27: Petrus þā eft wiðsōc; and sōna se cocc crēow.
18.28: Đā gelǣddon hī þone Hǣlend tō Caiphan on þæt dōmern; hit wæs þā morgen; and hig sylue ne ēodon intō ðām dōmerne, þæt hyg nǣron besmitene, ac þæt hi ǣton hyra ēastron.
18.29: Þā ēode Pilatus ūt tō him, and cwæð, Hwylce wrōhte bringe gē ongēan þysne man?
18.30: Hig answaredon and cwǣdon tō him, Gif hē nǣre yfeldǣde, ne sealde wē hine ðē.
18.31: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Nimað hine, and demað him be ēowre ǣ. Đā cwǣdon þā Iudeas tō him, Ūs nis nā ālȳfed þæt wē ǣnigne mann ofslēan;
18.32: þæt þæs Hǣlendes sprǣc wǣre gefylled þe hēe cwæð þā hē geswutelode hwylcon dēaðe hē swulte.
18.33: Đā ēode Pilatus eft intō þām dōmerne, and clypode ðone Hǣlend and cwæð tō him, Eart ðū Iudea Cining?
18.34: Đā andswarode sē Hǣlend him and cwæð, Cwyst þū þis of ðē sylfum, hwæðer ðe hyt þē ōðre sǣdon?
