18.35: Pilatus him andswarode and cwæð, Cwyst þū eom ic Iudeisc? Þīn þēod and þīne bisceopas ðē sealdon mē; hwæt dydest ðū?
18.36: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend, Mīn rīce nys of ðyson middanearde; gif mīn rīce wǣre of ðyson middanearde, witodlīce mīne þegnas fuhton þæt ic nǣre geseald Iudeon; nis mīn rīce of ðyson middanearde.
18.37: Đā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Eart ðū witodlīce cyning? Sē Hǣlend him andswarode and cwæð, Ðū hit segst þæt ic eom cyng. On ðām ic eom geboren, and tō þām ic cōm on middaneard, þæt ic cȳðe sōþfæstnysse. Ǣlc þǣra þe ys on sōðfæstnysse gehȳrð mīne stefne.
18.38: Đā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Hwæt ys sōðfæstnyss? And þā hē ðis cwæð, þā ēode hē eft ūt tō þām Iudeon, and cwæð tō him, Ne funde ic nānne gylt on ðyson menn.
18.39: Hit ys ēowor gewuna þæt ic forgyfe ēow ānne mann on ēastron; wylle gē þæt ic forgyfe ēow Iudea Cyning?
18.40: Hig clypodon ealle and cwǣdon, Nā ðysne, ac Barrabban. Witodlīce Barrabbas was þēof.

19.1: Đā nam Pilatus þone Hǣlend, and swang hyne.
19.2: And þā þēnas wundon þyrnenne cynehelm, and āsetton hyne on his hēafod, and scrȳddon hyne mid purpuran rēafe;
19.3: and hī cōmon tō hym, and cwǣdon, Hāl bēo ðū, Iudea Cyning! and hī plætton hyne mid hyra handum.
19.4: Đā ēode Pilatus eft ūt, and cwæð, Nū ic hyne lǣde hider ūt tō ēow, þæt gē ongyton þæt ic ne funde nānne gylt on him.
19.5: Þā ēode sē Hælend ūt, and bær þyrnenne cynehelm and purpuran reaf. And Pilatus sǣde him, Hēr is mann!
19.6: Witodlīce þā þā bisceopas and ðā þegnas hine gesāwon, ðā clypodon hig and cwǣdon, Hōh hyne, hōh hyne. Đā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Nime gē hine and hōð; ic ne funde nānne gylt on him.
19.7: Þā Iudeas him andswaredon and cwǣdon, Wē habbað ǣ, and be ūre ǣ hē sceal sweltan, for þām þe hē cwæð þæt hē wǣre Godes Sunu.
19.8: Þā Pilatus gehȳrde þās sprǣce, þā ondrēd hē him þæs þē swīðor;
19.9: and ēode eft intō þām dōmerne, and cwæð tō ðām Hǣlende, Hwanon eart ðū? Witodlīce sē Hǣlend him ne sealde nāne andsware.
19.10: Þā cwæð Pilatus tō him, Hwī ne sprycst ðū wiþ mē? Nāst þū þæt ic hæbbe mihte þē tō hōnne, and ic hæbbe mihte þē tō forlǣtenne?
19.11: Sē Hǣlend him andswarode, Næfdest þū nāne mihte ongēan mē, būton hyt wǣre þē ufan geseald; for þām sē hæfð māran synne sē ðe mē þē sealde.
19.12: And syðan sōhte Pilatus hū hē hyne forlēte. Đā Iudeas clypodon and cwǣdon, Gif þū hine forlǣtst, ne eart ðū þæs Cāseres frēond; ǣlc þǣra þe hyne tō cynge dēð ys þæs Cāseres wiðersaca.
19.13: Đā Pilatus þās sprǣce gehȳrde, þā lǣdde hē ūt þone Hǣlend, and sæt ætforan þām dōmsetle on ðǣre stōwe þe is genemned Lithostrōtus, and on Ebrēisc, Gabbatha.
19.14: Hit wæs þā ēastra gegearcungdæg; and hyt wæs sēo syxte tīd. Đā cwæð hē tō ðām Iudeon, Hēr ys ēower Cyning!
19.15: Hī clypodon ealle and cwǣdon, Nim hyne, nim hyne, and hōh. Đā cwæð Pilatus, Sceal ic hōn ēowerne Cyning? Him andswaredon þā bisceopas and cwǣdon, Næbbe wē nānne cyning būton Kāsere.
19.16: Đā sealde hē hyne hym tō āhōnne. Đā nāmon hȳ þone Hǣlend, and tugon hine ūt;
19.17: and hē bær his rōde mid him on þā stōwe þe ys genemned hēafodpannan stōw, and on Ebrēisc Golgotha;
19.18: þǣr hī hyne ahēngon, and twēgen ōðre mid him on twā healfa, and þone Hǣlend on middan.
19.19: Witodlīce Pilatus wrāt ofergewrit, and sette ofer his rōde; þǣr wæs on gewriten, Þis ys sē Nazareniscea Hǣlend, Iudea Cyning.
19.20: Manega ðǣra Iudea rǣddon þis gewrit; for þām þe sēo stōw was gehende þǣre ceastre þǣr sē Hǣlend wæs āhangen. Hit was āwriten Ebrēisceon stafon, and Grēcisceon, and Lēdenstafon.
19.21: Đā cwǣdon þā bisceopas tō Pilate, Ne wrīt ðū Iudea Cyng, ac þæt hē cwǣde, Ic eom Iudea Cyning.
19.22: Đā cwæð Pilatus, Ic wrāt þæt ic wrāt.
19.23: Đā þā cempan hine āhēngon, hī nāmon his rēaf, and worhton fēower dǣlas, ǣlcon cempan ānne dǣl; and tunecan: sāo tunece was unāsīwod, and was eall āwefen.
19.24: Đā cwǣdon hī him betwēonan, Ne slīte wē hȳ, ac uton hlēotan hwylces ūre hēo sȳ; þæt þæt hālige gewrit sȳ gefylled þe þus cwyþ, Hī tōdǣldon him mīne rēaf, and ofer mine rēaf hī wurpon hlott. Witodlīce þus dydon þā cempan.
19.25: Đā stōdon wið þā rōde þæs Hǣlendes mōdor, and his mōdor swustor, Maria Cleophe, and Maria Magdalenisce.
19.26: Đā sē Hǣlend gesēah his mōdor, and þone leorningcniht standende þe hē lufode, þā cwæð hē tō his mēder, Wīf, hēr ys þīn sunu!
19.27: Eft hē cwæð tō þām leorningcnihte, Hēr ys þīn mōdor! And of þǣre tīde sē leorningcniht hī nam tō him.
19.28: Æfter ðyson, þā sē Hǣlend wiste þæt ealle ðing wǣron geendode, þæt þæt hālige gewrit wǣre gefylled, þā cwæð hē, Mē þyrst.
19.29: Đā stōd ān fæt full ecedes; hī bewundon āne spyngan mid ysopo, sēo wæs full ecedes, and setton tō his mūðe.
19.30: Þā sē Hǣlend onfeng þæs ecedes, ðā cwæð hē, Hyt ys geendod: and hē āhylde his hēafod, and āgef his gāst.
19.31: Đā Iudeas bǣdon Pilatum þæt man forbrǣce hyra sceancan, and lēte hī nyðer, for þām þe hit was gegearcungdæg, þæt þā līchaman ne wunodon on rōde on restedæge; - sē dæg was mǣre restedæg.
19.32: Đā cōmon þā cempan, and brǣcon ðæs forman sceancan, and ðæs ōðres, þe mid him āhangen wæs.
19.33: Þā hī tō þām Hǣlende cōmon, and gesāwon þæt hē dēad wæs, ne brǣcon hī nā his sceancan;
19.34: ac ān þǣra cempena geopenode his sīdan mid spere, and hrædlīce þār flēow blōd ūt and wæter.
19.35: And sē ðe hit geseah cȳðde gewitnesse, and his gewitnes is sōð; and hē wāt þæt hē sōð sǣde, þæt gē gelȳfon.
19.36: Ðās þing wǣron gewordene þæt þæt gewrit wǣre gefylled, Ne forbræce gē nān bān on him.
19.37: And eft ōðer gewrit segð, Hī gesēoð on hwæne hig onfæstnodon.
19.38: Witodlīce Iosep fram Arimathea bæd Pilatum þæt hē mōste niman þæs Hǣlendes līchaman, for þām þe hē wæs þæs Hǣlendes leorningcniht; þis hē dyde dearnunga for ðǣra Iudea ege; and Pilatus him lȳfde. Đā cōm hē, and nām þæs Hǣlendes līchaman.
19.39: And Nichodemus cōm ðyder, sē þe ǣrest cōm tō þām Hǣlende on niht, and brōhte wyrtgemang and alewan, swylce hundtēontig boxa.
19.40: Hig nāmon þæs Hǣlendes līchaman, and bewundon hine mid līnenum clāðe mid wyrtgemangum, swā Iudea þēaw ys tō bebyrgenne.
19.41: Witodlīce þār wæs wyrtūn on ðǣre stōwe þār sē Hǣlend āhangen wæs; and on þām wyrtūne wæs nīwe byrgen, on þǣre þā gȳt nān mann næs ālēd.
19.42: Sōðlīce pār hig lēdon þone Hǣlend, for þām þǣra Iudea gearcung wæs wið þā byrgene.

20.1: Witodlīce on ānon restedæge sēo Magdalenisce Maria cōm on mergen, ǣr hit lēoht wǣre, tō þǣre byrgenne, and hēo geseah þæt sē stān aweg ānumen wæs fram þǣre byrgynne.
20.2: Đā arn hēo and cōm tō Simone Petre and tō þām oðron leorningcnihte þe sē Hǣlend lufode, and hēo cwæð tō him, Hī nāmon Drihten of byrgene, and wē nyton hwār hī hyne lēdon.
20.3: Petrus ēode ūt and sē ōðer leorningcniht, and cōmun tō þǣre byrgene.
20.4: Witodlīce hig twēgen urnon ætgædere; and sē ōðer leorningcniht forarn Petre forne, and cōm raðor tō ðǣre byrgenne;
20.5: and þā hē nyder ābēah, hē geseah þā līnwǣda licgan; and ne ēode þēah in.
20.6: Witodlīce Simon Petrus cōm æfter him, and ēode intō ðǣre byrgene, and hē geseah līnwāda licgean,
20.7: and þæt swātlīn þe wæs uppan his hēafde; ne læg hyt nā mid þām līnwādon, ac onsundron gefealden on ānre stōwe.
20.8: Đā ēode ēac in sē leorningcniht þe ǣrest cōm tō ðǣre byrgene, and geseah, and gelȳfde.
20.9: Witodlīce þā gȳt hī ne cūðon hālig gewrit, þæt hit gebyrede þæt hē sceolde fram dēaðe ārīsan.
20.10: Đā fōron eft þā leorningcnihtas to þām ōðron.
20.11: Witodlīce Maria stōd þār ūte æt ðǣre byrgyne, and wēop; and þā hēo wēop, hēo ābeah nyðer and beseah innan þā byrgene,
20.12: and geseah twēgen englas sittan mid hwīton rēafe, ānne æt þām hēafdon and ōðerne æt þām fōtum, þǣr ðæs Hǣlendes līc ālēd wæs.
20.13: Hī cwǣdon tō hyre, Wīf hwī wēpst þū? Þā cwæð hēo tō hym, For þām hī nāmon mīnne Drihten, and ic nāt hwār hī hine lēdon.
20.14: Đā hēo þās þing sǣde, þā bewende hēo hī on bæc, and geseah hwār se Hǣlend stōd, and hēo nyste þæt hyt sē Hǣlend wæs.
20.15: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Wīf, hwī wēpst ðū? hwæne sēcst þū? Hēo wēnde þæt hit sē wyrtweard wǣre, and cwæð tō him, Lēof, gif þū hine nāme, sege mē hwār þū hine lēdest, and ic hine nime.
20.16: Dā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Maria. Hēo bewende hī, and cwæð tō him, Rabbōni; þæt ys gecweden Lārēow.
20.17: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō hyre, Ne æthrīn þū mīn; nū gȳt ic ne āstāh tō mīnon Fæder. Gang tō mīnon brōþron, and sege him, Ic āstīge tō mīnon Fæder and tō ēowron Fæder, and tō mīnon Gode and tō ēowron Gode.
20.18: Đā cōm sēo Magdalenisce Maria, and cȳðde þām leorningcnihton and cwæð, Ic geseah Drihten; and þās þing hē mē sǣde.
20.19: Đā hit wæs ǣfen, on ānon þǣra restedaga, and ðā dura wǣron belocene ðǣr þā leorningcnihtas wǣron gegaderode for ðǣra Iudea ege, sē Hǣlend cōm and stōd tōmiddes hyra, and cwæð tō him, Sī sibb mid ēow.
20.20: And þā hē þæt cwæð, hē ætȳwde him his handa and his sīdan. Đā leorningcnihtas wǣron blīþe, þā hī hæfdon Drihten gesewen.
20.21: Hē cwæð eft tō him, Sī sib mid ēow; swā swā Fæder mē sende, ic sende ēow.
20.22: Đā hē þæt cwæð, þā blēow hē on hī, and cwæð tō him, Underfōð Hāligne Gāst:
20.23: þǣra synna þe gē forgyfað, hig bēoð him forgifene; and þāra þe gē healdað, hig bēoþ gehealdene.
20.24: Witodlīce Thomas, ān of þām twelfon, þe ys gecweden Didimus, þæt ys gelīcust, on ūre geþēode, hē næs mid him þā sē Hǣlend cōm.
20.25: Đā cwǣdon ða ōðre leorningcnihtas tō him, Wē gesāwon Drihten. Đā cwæð hē tō him, Ne gelȳfe ic, buton ic gesēo þǣra nægela fæstnunge on his handa, and ic dō mīnne finger on ðǣra nægela stede, and dō mīne hand tō his sīdan.
20.26: And eft æfter eahta dagun his leorningcnihtas wǣron inne, and Thomas mid him. Sē Hǣlend cōm, belocenum duron, and stōd tōmiddes him, and cwæð, Sȳ ēow sib.
20.27: Syððan hē sǣde Thome, Dō ðīnne finger hider, and geseoh mīne handa; and nim þīne hand and dō on mīne sīdan; and ne bēo þū ungelēaffull, ac gelēaffull.
20.28: Thomas andswarode and cwæð tō him, Þū eart mīn God and mīn Drihten.
20.29: Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, þū gelyfdest for þām þū mē gesāwe; þā synt ēadige þe ne gesāwon, and gelȳfdon.
20.30: Witodlīce manega ōðre tācen sē Hǣlend worhte on his leorningcnihta gesyhþe, þe ne synt on þysse bēc āwritene.
20.31: Witodlīce þās þing synt āwritene þæt ge gelȳfon þæt sē Hǣlend ys Crīst, Godes Sunu; and þæt gē habbon ēce līf þonne gē gelȳfað on his naman.

21.1: Eft æfter þan sē Hǣlend hine geswutelode þus æt ðǣre Tiberiadiscan sǣ.
21.2: Simon Petrus and Thomas, ðe ys gecweden gelīcost, wǣron ætgædere, and Nathanael sē wæs of Chana Galilęę, and Zebedeus suna, and ōðre twēgen þǣra leorningcnihta.
21.3: Đā cwæð Simon Petrus tō him, Ic wylle gān on fixað. Þā cwǣdon hī tō him, And wē wyllað gān mid þē. And hī ēodon ūt, and ēodon on scip, and ne fēngon nān þing on þǣre nihte.
21.4: Witodlīce on ǣrne mergen sē Hǣlend stōd on þām strande; ne gecnēowon þēah ðā leorningcnihtas þæt hit sē Hǣlend wæs.
21.5: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Cnapan, cweðe gē hæbbe gē sufol? Hig andswarodon him and cwǣdon, Nese.
21.6: Hē cwæð tō him, Lǣtað þæt nett on þā swīðran healfe þæs rēwettes, and gē gemētað. Hig lēton witodlīce, and ne mihton hit ātēon for ðǣra fixa menigu.
21.7: Witodlīce sē leorningcniht þe sē Hǣlend lufode cwæð tō Petre, Hit ys Drihten. Đā Petrus gehȳrde þæt hit Drihten wæs, þā dyde hē on his tunecan, and begyrde hine, - witodlīce hē wæsæ ǣr nacod, - and scēt innan sǣ.
21.8: Đā ōðre leorningcnihtas rēowon þār tō, - hī wǣron unfeor fram lande, swylce hit wǣre twā hund elna, - and tugon hyra fiscnett.
21.9: Đā hig on land ēodun, hī gesāwon licgan glēda, and fisc þǣr ofer, and hlāf.
21.10: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Bringað þā fixas þe gē nū gefēngon.
21.11: Simon Petrus ēode ūpp, and tēh his nett on land, micelra fixa full; þǣra wæs hundtēontig and ðrēo and fīftig; and ðā hyra swā fela wæs, næs þæt net tōbrocen.
21.12: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gāð hider and etað. And nān þǣra þe þar sæt ne dorste hine āxian hwæt hē wǣre; hī wiston þæt hit wæs Drihten.
21.13: And sē Hǣlend cōm and nām hlāf, and eac fisc, and sealde him.
21.14: On ðyson wæs sē Hǣlend þrīwa geswutelud his leorningcnihton, þā hē ārās of dēaðe.
21.15: Đā hī ǣton, þā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō Simone Petre, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē swīðor þænne ðās? Hē cwæð tō him, Gēa, Drihten; þū wāst þæt ic þē lufige. He cwæð tō him, Heald mīne lamb.
21.16: Hē cwæð eft tō him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē? Hē cwæð tō him, Gēa, Drihten; þū wast þæt ic ðē lufige. Đā cwæð hē tō him, Heald mīne lamb.
21.17: Hē cwæð þriddan sīðe tō him, Simon Iohannis, lufast ðū mē? Đā wæs Petrus sārig for þām þe hē cwæð þriddan sīðe tō him, Lufast þū mē? And hē cwæð tō him, Drihten, þū wāst ealle þing; þū wast þæt ic þē lufige. Đā cwæð hē tō him, Heald mīne scēap.
21.18: Sōð ic secge þē, þā þū gingra wǣre, þū gyrdest þē, and ēodest þǣr þū woldyst; witodlīce þonne þū ealdast, þū strecst þīne handa, and ōðer þē gyrt, and lǣt þyder þe þū nelt.
21.19: Ðæt hē sǣde witodlīce and tācnude hwylcon dēaðe hē wolde God geswuteligan. And þā hē þæt sǣde, þā cwæð hē tō him, Fylig mē.
21.20: Đā Petrus hine bewende, þā gesēah hē þæt sē leorningcniht him fylide þe sē Hǣlend lufode; sē þe hlinode on gebēorscipe ofer his brēost, and cwæð, Drihten, hwæt ys sē ðē belǣwð?
21.21: Witodlīce þā Petrus þysne gesēah, þā cwæð hē tō þām Hǣlende, Drihten, hwæt sceal þēs?
21.22: Đā cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Gif ic wylle þæt hē wunige ðus oð ic cume, hwæt tō þē? fylig ðū mē.
21.23: Witodlīce ðēos sprǣc cōm ūt gemang brōþrum, þæt sē leorningcniht ne swylt; and ne cwæð sē Hǣlend tō him, Ne swylt hē; ac gif ic wylle þæt hē wunige oð ic cume, hwæt tō þē?
21.24: Þis ys sē leorningcniht þe cȳð gewitnysse be þyson, and wrāt ðās þing; and wē witon þæt hys gewitnys ys sōð.
21.25: Witodlīce ōðre manega þing synt þe sē Hǣlend worhte; gif ðā ealle āwritene wǣron, ic wēne ne mihte þēs middaneard ealle þā bēc befōn.
